title: ‘False cases can’t keep him imprisoned forever’: Akhilesh backs Azam Khan after meeting in Rampur jail | Hindustan Times
description: The SP chief said the two discussed Khan’s health, party strategy across all 403 assembly constituencies and the future of Mohammad Ali Jauhar University.
content: With the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections just months away, Samajwadi Party national president Akhilesh Yadav on Thursday visited founding member and senior party leader Mohammad Azam Khan at Rampur district jail, delivering a strong public endorsement of the veteran leader’s continued importance in state politics.The visit came amid speculation in recent months that Khan was unhappy with Yadav and the SP leadership, lending significance to the meeting ahead of the assembly polls.Akhilesh reaffirms Azam Khan’s place in Samajwadi PartyAfter an approximately hour-long closed-door meeting, Akhilesh told reporters: “I have just met Azam Khan. Azam was, Azam is, and Azam will remain.” He added that no family, particularly no political family, had faced as much injustice as Azam Khan’s.Accusing the BJP-led state government of framing fabricated cases against Khan, Yadav said false cases could not keep the veteran leader incarcerated forever.“These false cases do not have the power to keep him imprisoned forever. It may take time and there may be some delay. But false cases do not have the power to keep the truth imprisoned,” he said.Also read: 2027 poll preparation: Akhilesh Yadav to meet Azam Khan in Rampur jail todayYadav alleges conspiracy to damage Mohammad Ali Jauhar UniversityHe also alleged that the Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur had been deliberately ruined as part of a conspiracy. “Even a dictatorial government would not have caused such devastation to an educational institution,” Yadav said, adding that the SP would fulfil Khan’s dream for the university.Describing the visit as both political and personal, Yadav said his bond with Rampur was emotional as well as political. He said the two leaders discussed Khan’s health, the party’s strategy for the 2027 elections and the political situation across all 403 assembly constituencies in the state.Yadav said Khan’s health had improved, although the hardships of jail continued to affect him. He added that Khan had not sought any specific seats for the upcoming elections but had offered suggestions on the party’s strategy, which had been taken on board.Also read: ED complaint leads to fresh FIR against SP leader Azam KhanYadav later visited Khan’s residence and met his family, including his wife, Tazeen Fatma.Azam Khan remains an influential figure in the SP’s support base among Muslims, particularly in western Uttar Pradesh. He has been lodged in Rampur district jail following convictions in multiple cases, including the dual PAN card case.Reacting to the visit, BJP chief spokesperson Dinesh Pratap Singh accused Akhilesh of approaching Khan for political reasons.“Akhilesh Yadav Ji, the Muslim community of Uttar Pradesh is no longer going to be misled by you. Today, the affection you suddenly show towards Azam Khan is not out of genuine love or affection; it is merely to use him as a stepping stone for your politics of appeasement,” Singh said.Also read: ED questions Azam Khan in Rampur jail over Jauhar Trust fund trailPrevious meetings between Akhilesh and Azam KhanAkhilesh Yadav last met Azam Khan at his official Lucknow residence on November 7, 2025. Before that, he visited Khan at his Rampur residence on October 8, 2025, following the veteran leader’s release from Sitapur jail. On March 23, 2024, Yadav visited Khan at Sitapur jail ahead of the Lok Sabha elections to discuss party strategy and candidate selection for Rampur and Moradabad. On September 30 last, Tazeen Fatma met Yadav in Lucknow.

title: CISF to recruit 450 sportspersons, amend rules for sports recruitment at three levels | Education
description: The CISF is developing sports infrastructure across its training establishments to provide better facilities for athletes and encourage participation.   | Education News
content: The Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) is set to recruit around 450 sportspersons against vacant posts, while amending its recruitment rules to facilitate sports recruitment at the Constable, Head Constable and Assistant Sub-Inspector levels, as part of efforts to strengthen its sports teams and improve performance at national and international competitions.The Central Armed Police Force (CAPF) under the Ministry of Home Affairs is also expanding sports infrastructure, providing financial incentives to athletes and coaches, and strengthening training facilities to encourage wider participation and improve medal prospects at major sporting events, including the Olympics, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games and World Police and Fire Games.AP Inter Exam 2027 Datesheet: BIEAP 1st, 2nd year timetable released, check exam dates here"Recruitment rules are being amended to allow sports recruitment at Constable, Head Constable and Assistant Sub-Inspector levels. Recruitment of about 450 sportspersons against vacant posts will begin soon," the CISF told ANI.The CISF is developing sports infrastructure across its training establishments to provide better facilities for athletes and encourage participation in a wider range of disciplines.Jamia students hold general body meeting, demand restoration of students' unionThe force said that sports facilities, including an athletics track, have been developed at the National Industrial Security Academy (NISA) in Hyderabad and the Subsidiary Training Centre (SSG) in Greater Noida."Sports infrastructure is also being developed at the CISF Women Battalion in Nuh in Haryana," said the CISF.In another major initiative, the force said, "the Sports Authority of India (SAI) is preparing a Detailed Project Report (DPR) for establishing a Regional Sports Centre at the CISF's Rajaditya Cholan Regional Training Centre (RCRTC) in Thakkolam."Amit Shah to attend DU's 103rd convocation on November 20Officials said the proposed centre is intended to support training in badminton, tennis, fencing and cycling, among other disciplines, and strengthen the force's sports ecosystem."The initiatives are aimed at improving training standards, providing athletes with better equipment and nutritional support, and creating more opportunities for personnel to excel in competitive sports," said the official.CISF Director General Praveer Ranjan announced this while meeting with the force's sportspersons who took part in various national and international games this year.Five CISF sportspersons represented India at the 20th Asian Games held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, in 2026. Head Constable Ritu won a gold medal as a member of the Indian women's kabaddi team.The force has also recorded a significant improvement in its performance at the All India Police Sports Clusters. The number of medals won across the five clusters increased from 120 in 2025–26 to 169 in 2026–27.In 2025–26, CISF sportspersons won 47 gold, 30 silver and 43 bronze medals. In 2026–27, the tally rose to 64 gold, 46 silver and 59 bronze medals.The number of trophies won by CISF teams also doubled from 10 in 2025–26 to 20 in 2026–27. The trophies in 2025–26 comprised six in men's and four in women's categories, while the 2026–27 tally included 10 trophies each in men's and women's categories.As part of its efforts to recognise sporting achievements, the CISF distributed cash awards worth approximately ₹97 lakh to medal-winning sportspersons and coaches for 2025–26.A total of 180 sportspersons and coaches will be awarded the Director General's Disc, while 161 personnel will receive the Director General's Commendation Certificates. Nine unit commanders will also be honoured with DG's Commendation Certificates for their contribution to promoting sports within the force.The CISF has introduced additional financial incentives to support athletes. A total of 18 sportspersons were granted special increments in 2026 for their achievements, including five for international-level performances and 13 for national-level achievements.To support athletes' nutritional requirements, approximately ₹2 crore has been paid towards off-season special diet allowances for 2026–27, while payments amounting to around ₹4 crore for in-season diets are in process.The force has also provided common sports kits worth approximately ₹76 lakh to all Central Sports Teams. In addition, ₹71 lakh has been transferred directly to athletes' bank accounts to meet their requirements for personal sports kits.Through recruitment, infrastructure development, financial incentives and recognition of achievements, the officials said, the CISF is seeking to strengthen its sporting capabilities and improve its representation and results at major national and international events.

title: San Francisco startup Marathon Fusion claims it has turned mercury into gold | Trending
description: San Francisco startup Marathon Fusion claims it has turned mercury into real, stable gold.  | Trending
content: San Francisco startup Marathon Fusion claims it has turned mercury into real, stable gold. “Last month, we demonstrated high-rate alchemy: turning mercury into real, stable gold, beating CERN’s record by a factor of 10,” the startup said in a social media post on October 21.CERN is another name for the European Organization for Nuclear Research. The acronym comes from its original French name, Conseil Européen pour la Recherche Nucléaire. The intergovernmental organisation operates the largest particle physics laboratory in the world.What Marathon Fusion saidMarathon Fusion said its production rate was 10 times the benchmark set by CERN in 2025, although it did not disclose how much gold it made. Last year, scientists at CERN turned lead into gold using the Large Hadron Collider (LHC). “In 2025, we published a bold proposal to use fusion reactors for gold production. And now we’ve done it: Mercury transmuted into stable gold, using fusion neutrons, at 10x the record set by CERN in 2025,” Marathon Fusion said.(Also read: India’s journey at CERN has been remarkable)In the post on X on October 21, Marathon Fusion wrote, "We've reduced alchemy to a series of difficult but tractable engineering problems." The company shared gamma-ray measurements that it said showed the presence of mercury-197 and gold-197 after irradiation.The startup said it had also used fusion-generated neutrons to irradiate zinc and produce copper-64 and copper-67, radioactive isotopes that can be used in cancer diagnosis and targeted treatment. How does the process work?Marathon Fusion's method relies on nuclear transmutation, a process that changes an atom's nucleus to create a different isotope or element. Unlike ordinary chemical reactions, which do not change an atom's nucleus, this method alters the nucleus itself.The company's proposed process uses high-energy neutrons produced by deuterium-tritium fusion. These neutrons interact with mercury-198, a naturally occurring stable isotope, to produce radioactive mercury-197. The mercury-197 then decays into gold-197, the stable isotope of gold.(Also read: Norwegians fall for wild investment scam: Buying gold and leaving it in the forest)In a 2025 paper, Marathon Fusion proposed placing mercury in a blanket surrounding a fusion reactor's core. The company estimated that a plant producing one gigawatt of thermal power could generate around two tonnes of gold annually. It argued that selling the gold could significantly increase the plant's revenue without reducing electricity production or the reactor's ability to produce tritium, a fuel used in fusion reactions.However, these figures are projections rather than results demonstrated at commercial scale. No commercial fusion power plant is currently operating.How does it compare with CERN's results?In 2025, researchers working on CERN's ALICE experiment at the Large Hadron Collider reported producing gold nuclei through collisions involving lead nuclei. Across the collider's four main experiments, about 86 billion gold nuclei were produced between 2015 and 2018, amounting to approximately 29 picograms of gold.

title: Nepali man held in Lucknow for bringing  ₹26 lakh in fake currency, jailed | Hindustan Times
description: Uttar Pradesh ATS arrested him near the Indo-Nepal border in 2015 with  ₹26.03 lakh in fake notes.
content: A special court in Lucknow on Thursday sentenced a Nepalese national, who was arrested with counterfeit Indian currency worth over ₹26 lakh near the Indo-Nepal border in Maharajganj in 2015, to nine years and seven months of rigorous imprisonment.Sheikh Javed Iqbal, also known as Ashfaq Ansari and Javed Ansari, was arrested by the Uttar Pradesh Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) on February 23, 2015, near Sonauli border with counterfeit Indian currency worth ₹26,03,500, according to a statement issued by the ATS on Thursday.The ATS had registered a case under sections 489B and 489C of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) at its Lucknow police station. Subsequent examination established that the seized notes were of high quality, while evidence gathered during the investigation indicated that the counterfeit currency had been imported from abroad. Section 16 of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967, was subsequently added to the case.Also Read | ₹17.29-cr fake currency case">Saharanpur PNB: NIA arrests two ‘main conspirators’ in ₹17.29-cr fake currency caseAfter completing the investigation, the ATS filed a charge sheet against Iqbal before the court. The special judge, ATS, and additional district and sessions judge (III), convicted him of circulating counterfeit Indian currency and sentenced him to rigorous imprisonment for nine years and seven months, besides imposing a fine of ₹30,000.The ATS attributed the conviction to the evidence presented in court and effective prosecution.Iqbal, a resident of Belwa in Nepal’s Parsa district, was also residing in the Mehtab Bagh locality of Lucknow, the statement said.

title: Pat Cummins admits Australia are struggling with the bat after crushing loss to South Africa | Cricket
description: Australia lost the Gqeberha Test by an innings and 31 runs after their batting came a cropper.  | Cricket
content: Australia captain Pat Cummins has admitted that the team has plenty of rethinking to do in the wake of a crushing loss in the second Test against South Africa at Gqeberha on Thursday.After being made to follow on, Australia were bowled out for 295 in the second innings, with Marnus Labuschagne, Nic Maddinson and Beau Webster continuing their poor run in the series. Labuschagne particularly came under fire after playing an uncharacteristic aerial shot, allowing the Proteas to get back into the game as he fell for 39.Also Read: Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma show why Vaibhav Sooryavanshi needs to waitThe batter has not scored a Test century since July 2023. Maddinson, meanwhile, contributed 0 and 8 at Gqeberha. Injury cover Maddinson’s presence in the squad has been questioned from day one, including by Aussie great Matthew Hayden. Before the first Test at Kingsmead, he had last represented Australia almost 10 years ago. Allrounder Webster came up with lowly scores of 13 and 8. In the first Test, he didn’t do much either.The third and final Test starts in Cape Town on October 27, and in the lead-up to the game, there will surely be a lot of conversations around who to keep and who to leave out. “It's always the challenge of, do you give someone one more game? Or do you feel like now is the right time to make a move?” Cummins said."So that's what will be spoken about over the next few days. I think we will probably have Cam Green and Josh Inglis be available — I'm sure their names will get thrown around when we try and work out an XI.“But it's always that delicate balance. Do we feel like someone's just about to turn the corner and they're going to be away? Or does it now feel like the right time for a change-up?” he added.'There'll be lots of conversations'Matt Renshaw scored his first Test ton in 10 years at Kingsmead to help the Aussies crush the Proteas by 214 runs. His innings was decisive in the context of the match. Cummins said that not only at Gqeberha but Australia were also not at their best in the first Test. And after a very poor performance in the second Test, the fears over their batting have grown."Renshaw had an amazing game (in Durban), but I still think we weren't at our best, particularly in the batting."Looking around the changeroom at how good our batters are, and the standards they all hold themselves to, I think we were probably a little bit short of runs of where we'd like to be."We're still finding ways to win. We make it hard for ourselves sometimes. But we've got three or four days to get it right for Cape Town."There'll be lots of conversations. Probably run through a few scenarios that we'll probably get in Cape Town again and (ask) what would we do differently? The good thing is most of our team is pretty experienced. We've done it in the past, but we’re not seeing it as often as we'd like."

title: Ishan Kishan ruled out of 2nd T20I, Sitanshu Kotak says Vaibhav Sooryavanshi might play in Christchurch | Cricket
description: Ishan Kishan was ruled out of the 2nd T20I against New Zealand. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi might replace him in the playing XI.   | Cricket
content: Wicketkeeper-batter Ishan Kishan has suffered a low-grade right adductor strain and is ruled out of the second T20I on Saturday at the Hagley Oval in Christchurch. The official update was provided by the BCCI on Friday morning, saying the medical team is monitoring his progress."Ishan Kishan is ruled out of the second T20I against New Zealand due to a low-grade right adductor strain, which he sustained during the first T20I of the series. The BCCI Medical Team is monitoring his progress,” the BCCI said in an official update. According to India batting coach Sitanshu Kotak, Kishan's injury was the main reason behind him coming out to bat at No.5 instead of his usual No.3 spot in the series opener against New Zealand in Christchurch on Thursday.Kotak also added that Vaibhav Sooryavanshi might replace Kishan in the second T20I of the five-match series.“There was a lot of speculation I have also seen, just because Ishan had a strain in his groin, the batting order was changed,” Kotak told reporters, adding that it is “unlikely he will play tomorrow’s match as well”.“If Ishan doesn’t play, unless he recovers completely, which the medical team will advise, Vaibhav could definitely step in for him. He is one of the strongest contenders," he added.Also Read: Class act: Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma show why Vaibhav Sooryavanshi needs to waitThe first T20I between India and New Zealand saw the former chasing down 226 with four wickets in hand and two balls to spare. However, Tilak Varma coming out to bat at No.3 ahead of Kishan raised a few eyebrows.Varma managed only 6 off 11 balls, while Kishan too failed to make an impact, lasting just three balls and scoring one. While Varma was dismissed by Michael Bracwell, Mitchell Santner got the better of Kishan.Sooryavanshi dilemmaThe 15-year-old Sooryavanshi last played for India at the Asian Games, where he featured in both the semi-final (against Sri Lanka) and the final (against Pakistan). He then warmed the bench for the five-match T20I series against the West Indies.Ahead of the series opener against New Zealand, skipper Shreyas Iyer had said that Sooryavanshi needs to wait for his opportunity as the team already has two consistent openers in the form of Abhishek Sharma and Sanju Samson.“He is very young; he has more years to get opportunities. It’s not like he can walk in right now, because our openers are scoring consistently, and they have won the World Cup,” Iyer had told reporters before the first T20I.“So, if you see, when he is coming overseas, he will get a fair idea how to play on these particular wickets. Next time, whenever he comes under these conditions, he will be very well prepared. And he can also instruct the other team members, whoever comes here for the first time,” he added.The youngster, who scored 776 runs in the IPL for the Rajasthan Royals, has so far played eight T20Is for India, amassing 246 runs at a strike rate of 186.36 with two half-centuries.

title: Prabhas Japan Fans: డార్లింగ్ ప్రభాస్.. పుట్టినరోజు శుభాకాంక్షలు.. తెలుగులో జపాన్ ఫ్యాన్స్ విషెస్.. ఇంటి ముందు హంగామా | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Prabhas Japan Fans: ప్రభాస్ అక్టోబర్ 23న తన 47వ పుట్టినరోజును జరుపుకుంటున్నారు. దీంతో హైదరాబాద్ జూబ్లీహిల్స్‌లోని ఆయన నివాసం వద్ద అర్ధరాత్రి వేల సంఖ్యలో అభిమానులు చేరుకుని బర్త్‌డే హంగామా సృష్టించారు. అటు జపాన్‌లోని అభిమానులు కేక్ కట్ చేసి, ప్రత్యేక వీడియో సందేశాన్ని విడుదల చేశారు.
content: Prabhas Japan Fans: 'పాన్ ఇండియా' అనే పదానికి నిలువెత్తు రూపంగా మారిన రెబెల్ స్టార్ ప్రభాస్ ఈరోజు (అక్టోబర్ 23) తన 47వ పుట్టినరోజును జరుపుకుంటున్నారు. ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా కోట్ల సంఖ్యలో ఉన్న ఆయన అభిమానులు గురువారం రాత్రి నుంచే పుట్టినరోజు సంబరాలను పండగలా ప్రారంభించారు. సోషల్ మీడియా వేదికగా హ్యాష్‌టాగ్స్ విపరీతంగా ట్రెండ్ అవుతుండగా, ఇటు ఇండియాలో, అటు విదేశాల్లోనూ ప్రభాస్ మానియా పీక్స్‌కు చేరింది. హైదరాబాద్‌లోని ఆయన నివాసం వద్ద మొదలుకొని జపాన్ వీధుల వరకు డార్లింగ్ బర్త్‌డే వేడుకలు అంబరాన్నంటాయి.జపాన్‌లో డార్లింగ్ మానియా.. 'ప్రభాస్-సాన్'కు స్పెషల్ వీడియో'బాహుబలి', 'సాహో' చిత్రాల నుంచి జపాన్‌లో ప్రభాస్‌కు మైండ్ బ్లాకింగ్ క్రేజ్ సొంతమైంది. గత ఏడాది ప్రభాస్ జపాన్ పర్యటన తర్వాత అక్కడి అభిమానులకు ఆయనపై ఉన్న ప్రేమ రెట్టింపైంది. ప్రభాస్ 47వ బర్త్‌డే సందర్భంగా జపాన్‌కు చెందిన అభిమానులు ప్రత్యేకంగా నలుపు, బంగారు వర్ణం (Black and Gold) దుస్తులను ధరించి బర్త్‌డే పార్టీ చేసుకున్నారు.పుట్టిన రోజు శుభాకాంక్షలు డార్లింగ్ ప్రభాస్ అంటూ వాళ్లు తెలుగులో విషెస్ చెప్పడం విశేషం. అంతేకాదు కేకులు, బెలూన్లు, డార్లింగ్ సినిమాల పోస్టర్లతో అలంకరించిన వేదికపై 'హ్యాపీ బర్త్‌డే ప్రభాస్-సాన్' అంటూ జపనీస్ భాషలో పాటలు పాడి శుభాకాంక్షలు తెలిపారు. "గత ఏడాది మీరు జపాన్ రావడం మా హృదయాలను తాకింది. మీ కొత్త సినిమా విడుదల కాగానే భారతదేశం వచ్చి థియేటర్లలో చూస్తాం" అంటూ నెట్టింట షేర్ చేసిన వీడియో ప్రస్తుతం విపరీతంగా వైరల్ అవుతోంది.జూబ్లీహిల్స్ నివాసం వద్ద ఫ్యాన్స్ రచ్చహైదరాబాద్ జూబ్లీహిల్స్‌లోని ప్రభాస్ నివాసం వద్ద అర్ధరాత్రి 12 గంటల ముందే వేల సంఖ్యలో అభిమానులు క్యూ కట్టారు. డార్లింగ్ ఫ్లాగ్‌లు, భారీ కటౌట్లతో జూబ్లీహిల్స్ వీధులన్నీ ప్రభాస్ నినాదాలతో హోరెత్తిపోయాయి. కొంతమంది అభిమానులు ఏకంగా కదులుతున్న ట్రక్కులపై నిలబడి ఫ్లాగ్‌లు ఊపుతూ సందడి చేయగా, భీమవరంలో అభిమానులు బ్లోటార్చ్‌లు, బైక్ ఇంజన్ల శబ్దాలతో వినూత్నంగా వేడుకలు నిర్వహించారు. జూబ్లీహిల్స్ పరిసరాల్లో ఎలాంటి అవాంఛనీయ సంఘటనలు జరగకుండా పోలీసులు భారీ బందోబస్తు ఏర్పాటు చేశారు.'ఈశ్వర్' నుంచి ప్రపంచ స్థాయి సూపర్ స్టార్ వరకు..2002లో 'ఈశ్వర్' సినిమాతో వెండితెరకు పరిచయమైన ప్రభాస్, 'వర్షం' (2004), 'ఛత్రపతి' (2005) చిత్రాలతో మాస్ హీరోగా తిరుగులేని గుర్తింపు తెచ్చుకున్నారు. ఆ తర్వాత 'బుజ్జిగాడు', 'బిల్లా', 'డార్లింగ్', 'మిస్టర్ పర్ఫెక్ట్', 'మిర్చి' వంటి చిత్రాలతో ఫ్యామిలీ, యూత్ ఆడియెన్స్‌కు దగ్గరయ్యారు.అయితే, దర్శకుడు ఎస్.ఎస్. రాజమౌళి తెరకెక్కించిన 'బాహుబలి' (2015, 2017) సిరీస్ ప్రభాస్ జీవితాన్నే మార్చేసింది. అంతర్జాతీయ స్థాయిలో భారతదేశ సినిమా స్థాయిని చాటిచెప్పిన తొలి నటుడిగా ఆయన చరిత్ర సృష్టించారు.ఈ ఏడాది 'ది రాజా సాబ్' చిత్రంతో అలరించిన ప్రభాస్.. గ్లోబల్ హిట్ 'కల్కి 2898 AD' సీక్వెల్‌లో అమితాబ్ బచ్చన్, కమల్ హాసన్‌లతో కలిసి నటించనున్నారు. అంతేకాకుండా, హను రాఘవపూడి దర్శకత్వంలో పీరియాడిక్ యాక్షన్ డ్రామా 'ఫౌజీ', సందీప్ రెడ్డి వంగా దర్శకత్వంలో మోస్ట్ అవేటెడ్ పోలీస్ డ్రామా 'స్పిరిట్' (2027) చిత్రాలతో పాన్ ఇండియా బాక్సాఫీస్ వద్ద రికార్డులు తిరగరాయడానికి సిద్ధమవుతున్నారు.

title: Indian winner of  ₹240 crore in UAE lottery says ‘excitement has faded’ after buying cars, properties, gold | Trending
description: An Indian expat who won 100 million dirham (approximately  ₹240 crore) in The UAE Lottery has opened up about how the money changed his life.  | Trending
content: An Indian expat who won 100 million dirham (approximately ₹240 crore) in The UAE Lottery has opened up about how the money changed his life. Abu Dhabi-based Anilkumar Bolla won the life-changing amount exactly one year ago. Since then, the 29-year-old techie has bought properties in India and the UAE, cars for himself and his brother, gold jewellery for his mother, and farmland for his father.How Anilkumar Bolla’s life changedA year ago, Anilkumar Bolla made history when he won the largest lottery prize ever awarded in the UAE. He won 100 million dirham in October 2025.Speaking about his life one year after the win, Bolla—a native of Telangana—said that the biggest change has been the ability to spend more time with his family.“The most important thing is that I am spending quality time with my family,” he was quoted as saying by Khaleej Times. He described the past year as “transformative” and said: “Winning the lottery reshaped my life and my ambitions as well.”(Also read: ₹240 crore UAE lottery won by 29-year-old Indian">All about the ₹240 crore UAE lottery won by 29-year-old Indian)The last 12 months have brought him greater freedom and also some material comforts. He has, for example, purchased an iPhone 17 Air, and four to five high-end watches. However, for the 29-year-old Indian lottery winner, the most important thing has been helping his family.Among the first things he did was buy gold jewellery for his mother.“It was her dream to have a few ornaments, so I brought it all together and gifted it to her,” he said, according to Gulf News. The gift brought tears to her eyes.Same house in IndiaAnilkumar Bolla belongs to a farming family from Telangana. Since winning the jackpot, he has purchased properties in India and the UAE.His family, however, still lives in the same house in India where they resided before his ₹250 crore win. Bolla describes the house as his father’s dream home.He has, however, gifted his father farmland where he can pursue his passion for organic farming."My happiness is always linked to my family," he said. "Whatever I've done for them, those things are really special to me, and those are the things that make me the happiest, more than what I do for myself."(Also read:₹240-crore UAE lottery pay taxes on it? It depends"> Does Indian who won ₹240-crore UAE lottery pay taxes on it? It depends)More investments, less excitementOne year on, Bolla no longer feels the same excitement for travel as he initially did.Over the past 12 months, he has travelled to different destinations and enjoyed new adventures with his family. Bali, Thailand and Amsterdam has been among the destinations he explored."Somehow, the excitement has faded away, but I'm really grateful for the opportunities I'm getting and the things I'm doing," he said.With many of his wishes ticked off, Bolla has now begun exploring potential business ideas and long-term financial planning. He has bought property near the airport in Abu Dhabi and at Dubai Marina as part of his investments.Asked if he had any words of advice for other lottery winners, the Indian techie said: “Welcome to the millionaires’ club. Stay humble, manage your money well, and spend it wisely and with discipline.”

title: Diwali investments : ఈ దీపావళికి ఎందులో ఇన్వెస్ట్​ చేస్తే అధిక లాభాలు? ప్లాన్ ఇలా ఉండాలి! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: దీపావళి బోనస్, పండుగ పొదుపు నిధులను మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్లలో ఇన్వెస్ట్ చేయాలనుకునే వారికి లార్జ్ క్యాప్, స్మాల్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్ల మధ్య ఏది ఎంచుకోవాలి? అనే సందేహం నెలకొంది. ఇటీవల స్మాల్ క్యాప్‌లు భారీగా నిధులను ఆకర్షిస్తున్నప్పటికీ, వ్యాల్యుయేషన్ల పరంగా లార్జ్ క్యాప్‌లు చౌకగా లభిస్తున్నాయి.
content: దీపావళి పండుగ వేళ బోనస్ డబ్బులు చేతికి అందడం లేదా కొత్తగా ఆర్థిక ప్రణాళికలు ప్రారంభించడం భారతీయులకు ఒక ఆనవాయితీ. రియల్ ఎస్టేట్, పసిడితో పాటు ఈసారి ఈక్విటీ మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్లలో ఇన్వెస్ట్ చేసేందుకు తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల్లోని చిన్న, పెద్ద మదుపరులు ఆసక్తి చూపుతున్నారు. అయితే, ప్రస్తుతం మార్కెట్‌లో ఇన్వెస్టర్లను ఒక ప్రధానమైన ప్రశ్న తొలిచేస్తోంది: గత కొన్ని నెలలుగా మంచి రాబడులు ఇస్తున్న స్మాల్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లలో ఇన్వెస్ట్ చేయాలా? లేదా చౌక ధరల్లో లభిస్తున్న లార్జ్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లను ఎంచుకోవాలా?అసోసియేషన్ ఆఫ్ మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్స్ ఇన్ ఇండియా (యాంఫీ) విడుదల చేసిన సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 గణాంకాలు ఈ రెండు వర్గాల వైపు మదుపరుల మొగ్గు ఎలా ఉందో స్పష్టంగా చూపుతున్నాయి.ఇన్​ఫ్లోస్, రాబడుల్లో ఎవరిది పైచేయి?జులై, ఆగస్టు నెలల్లో ఉపసంహరణలను ఎదుర్కొన్న లార్జ్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లకు సెప్టెంబర్ నాటికి మళ్లీ ఆదరణ పెరిగింది. ఈ విభాగంలోకి రూ.859 కోట్ల నిధులు వచ్చాయి. మరోవైపు, స్మాల్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లు తమ ఆధిపత్యాన్ని కొనసాగిస్తూ ఏకంగా రూ.9,039 కోట్ల కొత్త పెట్టుబడులను ఆకర్షించాయి. సెప్టెంబర్ నెలలోని మొత్తం ఈక్విటీ మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్ ఇన్‌ఫ్లోస్‌లో కేవలం స్మాల్ క్యాప్ వాటానే 23.6 శాతంగా నమోదవడం గమనార్హం.ఈ ఏడాది ఇప్పటివరకు వచ్చిన రాబడులను (వైటీడీ) పరిశీలిస్తే రెండు కేటగిరీల మధ్య స్పష్టమైన తేడా కనిపిస్తోంది. మార్నింగ్‌స్టార్ అక్టోబర్ 21, 2026 నాటి డేటా ప్రకారం, లార్జ్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లు సగటున -9.19 శాతం ప్రతికూల రాబడిని నమోదు చేయగా, స్మాల్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లు 6.87 శాతం సానుకూల రాబడిని అందించాయి.వ్యాల్యుయేషన్లు ఏం చెబుతున్నాయి?సెబీ నిబంధనల ప్రకారం.. లార్జ్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లు తమ నిధుల్లో కనీసం 80 శాతాన్ని దేశంలోని టాప్-100 దిగ్గజ కంపెనీలలోనే ఇన్వెస్ట్ చేయాలి. స్మాల్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లు తమ కేటాయింపుల్లో కనీసం 65 శాతాన్ని స్మాల్ క్యాప్ కంపెనీలలో ఉంచాలి. అందుకే ఆయా సూచీల కదలికలు ఈ ఫండ్ల రాబడులపై నేరుగా ప్రభావం చూపుతాయి.ట్రెండ్ లైన్ అక్టోబర్ 22 నాటి డేటా ప్రకారం:లార్జ్ క్యాప్ (నిఫ్టీ 100): ఈ బెంచ్ మార్క్ ప్రస్తుతం 18.9 ధర-ఆదాయ నిష్పత్తి (పీఈ రేషియో) వద్ద ట్రేడ్ అవుతోంది. ఇది దాని ఏడాది సగటు పీఈ అయిన 20.8 కంటే తక్కువ. అంటే లార్జ్ క్యాప్ షేర్లు ప్రస్తుతం ఆకర్షణీయమైన చౌక ధరల్లో అందుబాటులో ఉన్నాయి.స్మాల్ క్యాప్ (250): ఈ బెంచ్ మార్క్ పీఈ రేషియో 32.5 వద్ద ఉంది. ఇది దాని ఏడాది సగటు (30.7) కంటే ఎక్కువ. అంటే స్మాల్ క్యాప్ విభాగం ప్రస్తుతం కాస్త ఖరీదైన వ్యాల్యుయేషన్‌లో కొనసాగుతోంది.కొత్త పెట్టుబడులు ఎక్కడ పెట్టాలి? నిపుణుల విశ్లేషణ..ఇన్వెస్టింగ్ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్ 'ట్రాక్' (Trackk) సహ వ్యవస్థాపకుడు, సీఈఓ వేదాంత్ గుప్తే వ్యాల్యుయేషన్ల ఆధారంగా నిర్ణయం తీసుకోవాలని మదుపరులకు సూచిస్తున్నారు."కేవలం గాలి వార్తలు, ప్రచారాన్ని నమ్మితే స్మాల్ క్యాప్‌లను ఎంచుకుంటారు, ధరల వాస్తవికతను చూస్తే లార్జ్ క్యాప్‌ల వైపు వెళ్తారు. ఈ దీపావళికి ధరలకే ప్రథమ ప్రాధాన్యం ఇవ్వాలి. అందరూ ఒకే వైపు వెళ్తున్నప్పుడు, కొత్త పెట్టుబడులు వేరే దిశలో సాగాలి. లార్జ్ క్యాప్‌లు ప్రస్తుతం నిశ్శబ్దంగా దొరికే ఒక మంచి ఆఫర్ లాంటివి," అని వేదాంత్ గుప్తే స్పష్టం చేశారు.ఆనంద్ రాఠీ వెల్త్ ఎగ్జిక్యూటివ్ డైరెక్టర్ మనీష్ శ్రీవాత్సవ మాత్రం పోర్ట్‌ఫోలియో విస్తరణకు ప్రాధాన్యం ఇస్తున్నారు. మార్కెట్ ఒడుదొడుకులను తట్టుకోవడానికి కేవలం ఒక్క కేటగిరీకే పరిమితం కాకుండా లార్జ్, మిడ్, స్మాల్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లతో పాటు వ్యాల్యూ లేదా డివిడెండ్ యీల్డ్ ఫండ్లలోనూ పెట్టుబడులు పంపిణీ చేయాలని ఆయన చెబుతున్నారు."విభిన్న మార్కెట్ సైకిళ్లను తట్టుకోవడానికి లార్జ్ క్యాప్‌లలో 55 శాతం, మిడ్ క్యాప్‌లలో 23 శాతం, స్మాల్ క్యాప్‌లలో 22 శాతం నిధులను కేటాయించడం సమతుల్యమైన పద్ధతి," అని మనీష్ శ్రీవాత్సవ వివరించారు.మొదటిసారి ఇన్వెస్ట్ చేసేవారు ఏం చేయాలి?కొత్తగా మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్లలో అడుగుపెట్టే వారికి క్రమబద్ధమైన పెట్టుబడి విధానం (ఎస్​ఐపీ) ద్వారా లార్జ్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లను ఎంచుకోవడమే సురక్షితమని వేదాంత్ గుప్తే స్పష్టం చేశారు."మొదటి పెట్టుబడి మీ ఓర్పును పరీక్షించకూడదు, పెట్టుబడి అలవాటును పెంచాలి. తొలి ఏడాదే స్మాల్ క్యాప్‌లలో నష్టపోతే మదుపరి దశాబ్ద కాలం పాటు మార్కెట్‌కు దూరమయ్యే ప్రమాదం ఉంది," అని ఆయన హెచ్చరించారు.నెలకు రూ.1,000 నుంచి రూ.2,000 వరకు మాత్రమే చిన్న మొత్తాల్లో ఎస్‌ఐపీ చేయగలిగే కొత్త మదుపరులు మల్టీ అస్సెట్ అలొకేషన్ లేదా హైబ్రిడ్ ఫండ్లను పరిశీలించవచ్చని మనీష్ శ్రీవాత్సవ వెల్లడించారు.పెట్టుబడి పెట్టే ముందు గమనించాల్సిన 4 కీలక అంశాలు..కాలపరిమితి : ఐదేళ్ల కంటే తక్కువ వ్యవధికి డబ్బులు అవసరమైతే స్మాల్ క్యాప్ ఫండ్లకు దూరంగా ఉండటం మంచిది.రిస్క్ సామర్థ్యం: పెట్టుబడి విలువ ఒకానొక దశలో 30 శాతం వరకు పడిపోయినా ఆందోళన చెందకుండా ఉండే మనోధైర్యం ఉంటేనే స్మాల్ క్యాప్స్ ఎంచుకోవాలి.పోర్ట్‌ఫోలియో నిర్మాణం: మీ పెట్టుబడుల పునాది లార్జ్ క్యాప్ లేదా ఇండెక్స్ ఫండ్లతో ఉండాలి. స్మాల్ క్యాప్‌లను అదనపు ఆదాయం ఇచ్చే అనుబంధ భాగాలుగా మాత్రమే ఉంచాలి.వ్యాల్యుయేషన్లు: గత రాబడులను మాత్రమే చూడకుండా ప్రస్తుతం ఏ విభాగం చౌకగా ఉందో గమనించి కేటాయింపులు పెంచాలి.మొత్తంమీద, మార్కెట్ తీవ్ర అనిశ్చితిలో ఉన్నప్పుడు లార్జ్ క్యాప్‌లు రక్షణ కల్పిస్తే, స్మాల్ క్యాప్‌లు దీర్ఘకాలంలో వేగవంతమైన వృద్ధిని ఇస్తాయి. మీ ఆర్థిక లక్ష్యాలు, రిస్క్ తీసుకునే సామర్థ్యాన్ని బట్టి ఈ దీపావళికి సరైన ఫండ్‌ను ఎంచుకోవడమే సరైన వ్యూహం.(గమనిక- ఇది సమాచారం కోసం రూపొందించిన కథనం మాత్రమే. హిందుస్థాన్ టైమ్స్ తెలుగుకు ఎలాంటి సంబంధం లేదు. ఏదైనా ఇన్వెస్ట్​మెంట్ చేసే ముందు సెబీ రిజిస్టర్డ్ ఫైనాన్షియల్ అడ్వైజర్​ని సంప్రదించడం శ్రేయస్కరం.)

title: Jailer 2 worldwide box office collection: Rajinikanth-starrer mints  ₹600 crore; is 2nd highest-grossing Tamil film ever, beating Leo, Jailer, Coolie | Hindustan Times
description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 is now the second-biggest Tamil hit of all time, having earned over  ₹600 crore worldwide.
content: Jailer 2 has ended its first week on a stupendous note, crossing ₹600 crore worldwide and climbing to the second spot in the list of highest-grossing Tamil films. The Rajinikanth-starrer is now on course to dethrone 2.0 from the top spot. And judging by current earnings trends, it has enough left in the tank to surpass it pretty soon.Jailer 2 box office updateJailer 2 had already indicated its bumper start with record-breaking advance bookings. Prior to its release, the film earned ₹80 crore in gross from pre-sales for its opening weekend. This helped the film achieve a massive opening weekend, crossing the ₹400-crore mark in its first four days. The Rajinikanth-starrer then had a massive Monday, and continued its money-minting ways through the Dussehra holiday. The film finally saw its first big dip on Wednesday, its seventh day in theatres, followed by another drop on Thursday. On day 8, Jailer 2 earned ₹17 crore net in India, taking its domestic haul after its extended opening week to a staggering ₹334 crore net ( ₹391.55 crore gross).Overseas, too, Jailer 2 has been a massive success. On some days, it has matched, if not eclipsed, the domestic earnings. After eight days, the Nelson Dilipkumar film has amassed $22.6 million internationally. This takes the film’s worldwide gross to a staggering ₹606 crore.Jailer 2 is the second-highest-grossing Tamil film ever In just eight days, Jailer 2 has become the second-highest-grossing Tamil film ever. On Thursday, it became only the fourth Kollywood film to cross the ₹600-crore mark worldwide. An hour later, it climbed to the second spot in the list, eclipsing its own first part ( ₹604 crore) and Vijay’s Leo ( ₹605 crore). Earlier in the week, it had beaten another Rajinikanth blockbuster - Coolie ( ₹518 crore). The top spot belongs to Shankar’s 2.0, which starred Rajinikanth and Akshay Kumar. The sci-fi hit grossed ₹691 crore worldwide. As of now, these are the only Tamil films to have earned over ₹500 crore worldwide. Many do not regard 2.0 as ‘just’ a Tamil film, as it had a wide Hindi release and was shot in part in Hindi, owing to Akshay’s presence. However, it remains a film originally shot and produced in Tamil, which gives it the top spot on the list. Jailer 2 earned ₹30 crore gross worldwide on Thursday. It is expected to see a jump in its second weekend, with trade pundits predicting it will cross 2.0 by Sunday and, hopefully, become the first Tamil film to mint ₹700 crore.All about Jailer 2Jailer 2 is produced by Sun Pictures and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. The film is a rare sequel that Rajinikanth agreed to do. The superstar has, in the past, rejected sequels to his other blockbusters. Jailer 2 brings back Rajinikanth as his iconic character, 'Tiger' Muthuvel Pandian, who is going against a new legion of bad guys this time. Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa and Rithvik reprise their roles from the first part, with S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Vidya Balan, Anna Rajan and Jatin Sarna joining the cast. The film also features several high-profile cameos by Hrithik Roshan, Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, and Jackie Shroff. Anirudh Ravichander has composed the music for the film.

title: Made for $1.5M, China's first AI film, Sanxingdui: Future Past, finds no takers with just $10K gross in pre-sales | Hindustan Times
description: Sanxingdui: Future Past is a sci-fi thriller that has been made over a two-year period with 100 people working on it.
content: China's first fully AI-generated feature film opens in cinemas on Friday, in what promises to be a tough box-office test for the country's booming tech industry as advance ticket sales lag. More than 10,000 screenings of Sanxingdui: Future Past, a sci-fi thriller, are scheduled for Friday, according to ticketing platform Maoyan.However, public reception has been less than enthusiastic. Presale revenue as of Thursday evening stood at 65,000 yuan ($9,700), while total box-office takings were forecast to remain below 100,000 yuan, only a fraction of the reported production cost, according to Maoyan.Jiang Defu, CEO of the production company Bona Film Group, acknowledged the lukewarm reception in a recent interview, but said the film was pushing boundaries. “We are the first to try it, the first to get a theatrical release permit, and the first to be tested by the audience,” he told Chinese film industry outlet Yuli. ‘I think that is not easy at all’Nearly 100 people took more than two years to make the film, which cost more than 10 million yuan ($1.5 million), Bona said. But that was not enough to convince Iris Yang, who attended a free preview screening of the film on Thursday and said she would not have paid for a ticket, given the movie's quality.“If AI generation can match the theatrical experience of Avatar, I think I would be willing to pay for it,” Yang said, referring to the US franchise known for the quality of its animation.AI-generated video has gained popularity in the world's second-largest economy. On Douyin, the Chinese equivalent of TikTok, AI-generated short dramas garnered more than 200 billion views in September alone. But “the audience won't automatically pay for the tickets just because it's an AI-generated film”, independent AI director Zhang Jun told AFP.Online, Chinese social media users also seemed unconvinced by the launch of AI movies in cinemas. “If it's free to watch on streaming platforms, it could become legendary. But paying to watch? People are not going to accept it at this stage,” one user on Weibo commented.The rise of AI-generated filmsIn Hollywood, the rise of AI has sparked concern among film workers about the prospect of job losses. An AI-generated sci-fi feature called Gods Don't Give Gifts is scheduled for US release on December 4.And a virtual Hollywood actor called Tilly Norwood, whose interviews have gone viral while fuelling job fears, is also set to star in an upcoming movie called Misaligned.

title: Radhika Merchant poses with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in elegant floral midi dress worth  ₹2.39 lakh | Fashion Trends
description: Radhika Merchant poses with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in floral midi dress, pairing its indigo prints with classic ballet flats for a chic look.  | Fashion Trends
content: Radhika Merchant, the younger daughter-in-law of the Ambani family, is a true fashion enthusiast at heart. Whether she is sporting an exquisite saree or a relaxed casual ensemble, she knows how to make a style statement. Often spotted in high-fashion outfits and stunning jewellery, Radhika recently took a more understated approach, opting for a simple yet elegant look.Posing alongside US Ambassador Sergio Gor and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, along with Anant Ambani, Radhika wore a printed floral midi dress. Let’s decode her look and find out how much it costs. title: Kolkata stampede: Chorbagan Durga Puja treasurer held over ‘pandal collapsing’ announcement | Kolkata
description: Kolkata stampede: Chorbagan Durga Puja treasurer held over ‘pandal collapsing’ announcement  | Kolkata News
content: Kolkata, The treasurer of the Chorbagan Durga Puja was arrested for allegedly misleading revellers by announcing that a section of the pandal was collapsing, which appeared to have triggered panic among them and led to the stampede that claimed the lives of 19 people last week, police said on Friday.Sanjib Raha, alias Sentu, was initially detained from a hideout in Nadia district on Thursday and later arrested, a senior officer said."There were two persons who were making announcements at the Chorbagan Durga Puja. He was one of them. He had been absconding since the incident occurred in the evening of October 17. We initially detained him in Nadia and then arrested him after hours of questioning," he said.At least 19 people died, and 25 others were injured in the stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata following a crowd surge amid rain.The two persons, who had been making announcements at the puja pandal on the Maha Saptami day, were identified via CCTV footage, the officer said."This is part of our investigation into the circumstances that led to the stampede. Raha's mobile phone remained switched off since the incident, and he had tried to contact family members and friends using different numbers," the policeman said.Investigators were tracking eight suspected mobile numbers as part of their efforts to locate him, he said."One of the videos captured the two persons making announcements. They were heard warning revellers that the pandal was collapsing and asking visitors to leave the place immediately. It appeared that the announcements triggered panic and a fresh rush towards the exit point," the officer said.A special investigation team, formed to probe the tragedy, was also investigating whether lapses in crowd management or other acts of negligence contributed to the stampede, he said.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

title: Lord Ram, Lord Hanuman, Ram Temple take centrestage in Jacob & Co's new Shri Ramchandra limited edition watch; it's worth  ₹4.25 crore | Fashion Trends
description: There are only three copies of the Shri Ramchandra Limited Edition watch by Jacob & Co, which is based on their Astronomia Solar series.   | Fashion Trends
content: Ahead of Diwali, the luxury watchmaker Jacob and Co has unveiled their latest limited-edition watch inspired by the Ramayana. The brand shared the Shri Ramchandra Limited Edition watch on its Instagram account on October 22 in a carousel of images and clips that showed off the elegance of the timepiece as well as the delicate craftsmanship that has gone into its creation. Check out the watch below.Also Read | Rani Mukerji’s metallic grey saree look with bold statement glasses at Sabyasachi’s Diwali reception is a lesson in modern festive dressing About the Shri Ramchandra Limited Edition watchIn the caption of their Instagram post, Jacob and Co stated, “From the story of Ram Janmabhoomi to a new expression of devotion, Jacob & Co presents the Shri Ramchandra Limited Edition… Limited to just three pieces worldwide, the Shri Ramchandra is a deeply considered tribute expressed through the art of fine watchmaking.”The watch is based on the company’s earlier series, the Astronomia Solar. It has a vibrant blue hue, with a blue strap holding the even brighter blue dial with a mandala pattern on it. On the dial are wonderful miniature creations depicting Lord Ram and Lord Hanuman in intricate detail, along with the Ayodhya Ram Temple that was inaugurated in 2024.Between Lord Ram and Lord Hanuman is a blue Earth which rotates once every 60 seconds, mirrored by the flying tourbillon above. At the centre of the composition is a Jacob-cut orange cubic zirconia which represents the sun.“Housed in a 45.5-mm 18K rose gold case, the timepiece is powered by the hand-wound JCAM42 calibre, comprising 295 components and offering a 48-hour power reserve. The caseback bears a custom ‘Jai Shri Ram’ plate,” shared Jacob and Co.What is the price of the Shri Ramchandra Limited Edition watch?The Shri Ramchandra Limited Edition watch has been listed for sale on the website of Ethos watch boutique and is priced at 4,25,00,000 INR, which seems to make for a very expensive and very exclusive Diwali gift.About the original design inspirationJacob and Co has shared that the Shri Ramchandra Limited Edition watch is based on their original design, Astronomia Solar. The design was created in 2014 as Astronomia Solar Zodiac, modelled after an astronomer's observatory.The company website describes the design as: “A vibrant sun sits at the top of the movement, giving the collection its name. The rotating satellite holds three more planets. All four symbolic stellar bodies are made from Jacob-cut, 288-facet gems of intense colour, showcasing the unique Jacob & Co. signature shape. A starry night sky made of aventurine stone serves as a base underneath it all, inlaid with seven planets made of a selection of hard stone cabochons.”

title: Prabhas returns as Bhairava for Nag Ashwin's Kalki 2898 AD sequel; 1st look video out on his birthday | Hindustan Times
description: As Prabhas turned 47 on October 23, Nag Ashwin and the makers of Kalki 2898 AD released his first look from the sequel. Take a look.
content: Tollywood star Prabhas turned 47 on October 23, and wishes poured in from the filmmakers he’s collaborated with to fans from across the globe. Director Nag Ashwin, who directed him in the 2024 sci-fi film Kalki 2898 AD, had a surprise in store for fans. Releasing Prabhas’ return to the franchise as the bounty hunter Bhairava, Ashwin wished him a happy birthday.Prabhas’ first look from Kalki 2898 AD sequelOn Prabhas’ birthday, the team of Kalki 2898 AD posted a video to commemorate the actor. “To the superhero of Indian Cinema…Happy Birthday to the Darling of every generation, Rebel Star #Prabhas. We are excited to embark on another epic cinematic journey with you…#Kalki2898AD,” read the caption.The 32-second video shows the crew preparing a blue-screen set for Bhairava’s return. ‘Bhairava is back’ reads the text on screen as Prabhas sets foot on a carefully put-up set. He wears the armour that has now become his character’s trademark and sits in his vehicle, Bujji, as Ashwin says ‘action’. The promotional video does not reveal Prabhas’ look fully yet, showing him only in silhouette as he stands atop an elevated structure. ‘Happy Birthday Bhairava’ reads the text as we get a closer look. With long hair and a beard, Prabhas gets back into the skin of the bounty hunter.“Adi em screen presence ra babu (What is that screen presence),” commented one excited fan with a screenshot of Prabhas’ silhouette. “Aura chuduuuu asalaaaaa (Look at his aura),” wrote another. “Waiting eagerly for the rampage,” wrote an excited fan, while several others commented with GIFs of Prabhas as Karna in the first film.The Kalki 2898 AD sequelAmitabh Bachchan and Kamal Haasan, who play Ashwatthama and Supreme Yaskin, have also returned to sets for the Kalki 2898 AD sequel. Deepika Padukone, who played a pregnant test subject named SUM-80, aka Sumathi, in the first part, has since exited the project. While Sai Pallavi and Alia Bhatt’s names circulated as her replacements or for new parts, Ashwin clarified to Variety India in September that no new characters are being added, without revealing who replaced Deepika. Kalki 2898 AD is set in a dystopian future in which resources are pooled by the Supreme Yaskin while the rest of the world suffers. A utopia named Shambhala tries to fight against this, believing that the birth of a saviour will soon save the day. Ashwatthama protects SUM-80, believing her unborn child to be the future avatar of Kalki. The film ends with a major reveal: Bhairava is Karna reincarnated. The sequel will pick up where the first part left off.

title: Lucknow airport to see 24% rise in flights, Bangkok link resumes under winter schedule | Hindustan Times
description: The projected increase of 26 daily air traffic movements (ATMs) comes as the airport prepares for the winter travel season.
content: Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport in Lucknow is set to see a 24% increase in daily aircraft movements under the winter schedule, rising from 108 to 134 from the first week of November, according to the airport officials. The revised schedule will connect the city to 20 domestic and 10 international destinations, with direct flights to Bangkok set to resume on November 17.India’s winter flight schedule for 2026-27 will run from October 25, 2026, to April 1, 2027, they said.Also Read I Amit Shah’s likely Lucknow visit on October 30 may sharpen BJP’s 2027 campaignWinter flight scheduleThe projected increase of 26 daily air traffic movements (ATMs) comes as the airport prepares for the winter travel season, when passenger demand and fog-related operational challenges can affect flight schedules. The projections are based on schedules submitted by airlines, and actual flight movements may vary depending on operational requirements and decisions taken by individual carriers.A key addition to the winter schedule is the resumption of Thai AirAsia’s direct Lucknow-Bangkok service to Don Mueang International Airport (DMK) from November 17. The flight is scheduled to arrive in Lucknow at 10:35 pm and depart at 11:30 pm, providing passengers with a direct connection to the Thai capital. An airport official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said, “The final operational schedule remained subject to changes in flight frequencies and timings. Airline decisions, operational requirements and geopolitical developments, including the ongoing crisis in the Middle East, could affect services, particularly on international routes.”Focus on fog-related disruptionsAlongside the expansion in connectivity, the airport has stepped up preparations to manage operations during dense fog and low visibility, which can disrupt flight schedules across north India in winter.Lucknow airport recently held a pre-low visibility procedures (LVP) coordination meeting involving airline representatives, air traffic control (ATC), the Airports Authority of India (AAI) and other airport stakeholders. The meeting reviewed winter preparedness and coordination measures to maintain safe operations when visibility deteriorates.Also Read I Lucknow Development Authority seeks to bring 662 revenue villages under its ambitLow visibility can affect aircraft arrivals and departures, resulting in delays, diversions and schedule changes. Coordination among airlines, air traffic controllers and airport agencies is essential to managing disruptions and ensuring operational decisions comply with safety requirements. The official said Lucknow airport had handled around 149 flights diverted from other airports since January.

title: Gold Price Today: పసిడి ప్రియులకు ఊరట: భారీగా తగ్గిన బంగారం, వెండి ధరలు | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: దేశీయ మార్కెట్లో బంగారం, వెండి ధరలు భారీగా పడిపోయాయి. అక్టోబర్ 23న 24 క్యారెట్ల బంగారం 10 గ్రాములపై 0.61 శాతం తగ్గి  ₹1,42,750కి చేరగా, వెండి కిలోపై 1.93 శాతం క్షీణించి  ₹1,96,510కి చేరింది. హైదరాబాద్, ఢిల్లీ, ముంబై సహా ప్రధాన నగరాల్లో నేటి పసిడి, వెండి ధరల వివరాలు ఇవే.
content: దేశీయ బులియన్ మార్కెట్లో బంగారం, వెండి ధరలు శుక్రవారం భారీగా క్షీణించాయి. గత కొద్ది రోజులుగా చోటుచేసుకుంటున్న పతన బాటను కొనసాగిస్తూ పసిడి, వెండి రేట్లు మరింత దిగివచ్చాయి. అక్టోబర్ 23న 24 క్యారెట్ల బంగారం 10 గ్రాములకు 0.61 శాతం తగ్గి ₹1,42,750 స్థాయికి చేరుకుంది. అదే సమయంలో కేజీ వెండి ధర 1.93 శాతం మేర క్షీణించి ₹1,96,510గా నమోదైంది.అంతర్జాతీయ మార్కెట్ ప్రభావంఅంతర్జాతీయ మార్కెట్లో గురువారం చివరి సెషన్‌లో పసిడి ధరలు రెండు వారాల కనిష్ఠ స్థాయికి పడిపోయాయి. క్రూడాయిల్ ధరలు పెరగడంతో ద్రవ్యోల్బణ భయాలు మళ్లీ వ్యక్తమవుతున్నాయి. దీనికి తోడు వచ్చే వారం యూఎస్ ఫెడరల్ రిజర్వ్ (ఫెడ్) కీలక వడ్డీ రేట్ల నిర్ణయాన్ని వెల్లడించనుంది. ఈ పరిణామాల మధ్య స్పాట్ గోల్డ్ ధర 2.2 శాతం తగ్గి ఔన్సుకు $4,051.55 వద్ద ముగిసింది. అలాగే డిసెంబర్ డెలివరీకి సంబంధించిన యూఎస్ గోల్డ్ ఫ్యూచర్స్ 2 శాతం క్షీణించి ఔన్సుకు $4,066.20కి చేరింది.వచ్చే వారం అక్టోబర్ 27, 28 తేదీల్లో జరగనున్న యూఎస్ ఫెడరల్ రిజర్వ్ సమీక్షా సమావేశంపై పెట్టుబడిదారులు ఉత్కంఠతో ఉన్నారు. ఫెడ్ తీసుకునే నిర్ణయాలు డాలర్ బలంపై, బాండ్ ఈల్డ్స్‌పై ప్రత్యక్ష ప్రభావం చూపుతాయి. బాండ్ ఈల్డ్స్, వడ్డీ రేట్లు పెరిగితే బంగారంపై ఎలాంటి క్రమబద్ధమైన వడ్డీ ఆదాయం లభించదు కాబట్టి, పెట్టుబడిదారులకు పసిడి పట్ల ఆకర్షణ తగ్గుతుంది.ఎంసీఎక్స్ మార్కెట్ అప్‌డేట్స్దేశీయ ఫ్యూచర్స్ మార్కెట్ అయిన ఎంసీఎక్స్ (MCX) లోనూ పసిడి, వెండి కాంట్రాక్టులు నష్టాల్లోనే ట్రేడవుతున్నాయి. అక్టోబర్ 23న ఉదయం 9:13 గంటల ప్రాంతంలో ఎంసీఎక్స్ గోల్డ్ ఫ్యూచర్స్ 0.66 శాతం తగ్గి 10 గ్రాములకు ₹1,42,680 వద్ద ట్రేడయ్యాయి. అలాగే ఎంసీఎక్స్ సిల్వర్ ఫ్యూచర్స్ 1.99 శాతం క్షీణించి కేజీకి ₹1,96,390 వద్ద కొనసాగాయి.రిటైల్ మార్కెట్లో బంగారం విభిన్న స్వచ్ఛతలతో లభిస్తుంది. 24 క్యారెట్ల బంగారం అత్యంత స్వచ్ఛమైనది కాగా, ఆభరణాల తయారీకి మన్నికగా ఉండే 22 క్యారెట్ల బంగారాన్ని ఎక్కువగా ఉపయోగిస్తారు. అలాగే 999 స్వచ్ఛత కలిగిన వెండి (99.9% ప్యూర్)ని బిస్కెట్లు, నాణేల రూపంలో పెట్టుబడుల కోసం
