title: BMC flags sodium chloride as pollution contributor as Mumbai sees unhealthy air quality for 10 days this month | Mumbai news
description: Mumbai recorded an AQI of 102 on Thursday, placing it in the unhealthy category. The city has experienced unhealthy air quality on 10 days so far this month  | Mumbai news
content: Beyond established two factors contributing to Mumbai’s air pollution - vehicular emissions and construction dust – the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has identified sodium chloride particles originating from seawater as significant contributors to the city’s deteriorating air quality, saying they react with pollutants released by vehicles and industries to produce atmospheric haze.Mumbai recorded an AQI of 102 on Thursday, placing it in the unhealthy category. The city has experienced unhealthy air quality on 10 days so far this month. Of the 22 active monitoring stations, 10 reported unhealthy air quality on Thursday.Addressing a press conference on Thursday, additional municipal commissioner Avinash Dhakane, who oversees the civic body’s environment and climate change department, said a source identification study conducted by the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) had identified sodium chloride (NaCl) -- the salt compound present in seawater -- as one of the major pollutants. However, he clarified that particulate matter continues to be the primary concern, with PM2.5 and PM10, largely associated with vehicular emissions and construction dust, contributing 18% each to Mumbai’s air pollution.Also Read | GMLR project puts 1,524 trees on chopping block, activists warn of irreversible consequencesAn analysis of AQI data from the past two years by Hindustan Times indicates a seasonal deterioration in air quality, with Mumbai largely recording satisfactory air quality through much of the year before slipping into the moderate category between November and February. The civic administration also acknowledged the seasonal challenge, with pollution levels expected to require closer monitoring during the winter months. However, despite the current deterioration in air quality, the civic administration pointed to an improvement in the number of good and satisfactory air-quality days (see box), while data on the Union environment ministry’s PRANA portal shows that the city’s PM10 concentration declined by approximately 48% between 2017-18 and 2025-26.To tackle road dust, the BMC has procured dust-suction machines, and plans to wash the roads using non-potable water, given the low dam reserves owing to weak monsoons. Of the 26 dust-suction machines required, three are expected to arrive within a week, Dhakane said.Also Read | ₹35,000 penalty">Mumbai air pollution: BMC cracks down on construction sites, issues stop-work notice and ₹35,000 penaltyThe administration is also targeting emissions from bakeries, which account for approximately 3.5% of Mumbai’s PM emissions. Of the city’s 593 bakeries, 209 are already using cleaner fuels, while another 175 have converted to cleaner fuels. Sixty-nine are undergoing conversion, 87 remain non-compliant and eight have shut down. The BMC has made the use of green fuel mandatory for new bakery licences and permissions.Separately, the civic body is in the process of installing air pollution control devices (APCDs) at 10 crematoria. Civic officials said the administration was also exploring the possibility of transitioning all crematoria to electric ones.AI to flag construction-site sensor failuresBMC is planning to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) to analyse data from air-quality sensors installed at construction sites and identify suspicious interruptions in monitoring.So far, 3,166 construction sites have installed sensor-based air-quality monitors connected to the civic body’s central dashboard. Additional municipal commissioner Avinash Dhakane said officials found instances of sensors remaining switched off or non-functional for several days, forcing them to conduct physical inspections.The proposed AI system will analyse recurring shutdown patterns, frequency of interruptions and the last recorded readings to identify sites where data may be deliberately manipulated.The BMC has also deployed 76 ward-level mitigation squads, each required to conduct at least two surprise inspections of construction sites every day. Violations can attract show-cause notices, stop-work orders and sealing.

title: Attack on Tiger Shroff: 4 firearms suppliers remanded in police custody till October 26 | Mumbai news
description: The Mumbai police crime branch informed the court that Anil Pandit, an alleged key member of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, was the main accused in the attack.  | Mumbai news
content: A metropolitan magistrate court on Thursday remanded the two men and two women who allegedly supplied firearms and ammunition for the attack on actor Tiger Shroff to police custody till October 26.The quartet – Kunal Sanjay, 21, Sumit Soraliya, 19, Radha Verma, 23 and Babita Rao, 23 – was arrested by the Delhi police special cell on October 20, two days after the attack on Shroff in Juhu on October 18. They were brought to Mumbai on transit remand, and produced before the Esplanade metropolitan magistrate court on Thursday. ‘For financial and territorial dominance’During the hearing, the Mumbai police crime branch informed the court that Anil Pandit, an alleged key member of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, was the main accused in the attack on Shroff, and that sections 111 (organised crime) and 61 (criminal conspiracy) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita had been added to the case.The application seeking remand of the four accused said, “By hatching a premeditated criminal conspiracy and using unlawful lethal firearms, the accused launched this life-threatening attack on film actor Tiger Shroff for financial and territorial dominance, as well as to create terror in society.” The Anti-Extortion Cell (AEC) of the crime branch which is investigating the incident told the court that the four accused had played a crucial role in commission of the crime by supplying weapons to the two alleged shooters, who were arrested on October 19 along with the alleged getaway biker from a Jaipur-bound train at Kota station.The police told the court that custodial interrogation of the four alleged firearms suppliers was necessary to ascertain where they had procured the weapons from and how exactly they were delivered to the shooters. The quartet also needed to be confronted with the alleged shooters and getaway rider to verify certain aspects, the police told the court.Acquiring firearmsAccording to the police, Kunal Sanjay had procured a pistol and 20 rounds of ammunition from Amritsar and handed these over to Babita Rao and Radha Verma in Delhi, who in turn brought the pistol and ammunition to Mumbai and supplied them to the alleged shooters through a minor boy. The alleged shooters, who stayed in a hotel in Andheri East from October 14-18, till shortly before the firing incident, had provided forged documents to book the hotel room. They used to leave the hotel early in the morning and return late at night and did not talk much to anyone, investigators said.The alleged shooters also paid an auto driver ₹400 to take them to a forested area in Aarey Colony where they could practice firing the weapons, said an AEC officer who did not wish to be identified.“As one of the firearms jammed in the jungle, they returned to the hotel in Andheri East where they were putting up and tried to remove the stuck bullet. However, it misfired in the room, though nobody was injured,” the officer said.Also Read I Tiger Shroff shooting case: Shooters surveyed Salman, Aamir Khan, Ranbir Kapoor’s houses too, say policeInvestigators had conducted a panchanama at the hotel room and seized the premises, the officer noted, adding, “We will take the accused to the forest to identify the spot where they practised firing.”On October 20, three more accused were arrested from Sonipat in Haryana, taking the total number of arrests to 10. The trio is being brought to Mumbai on a transit remand and are likely to reach the city on Friday, investigators said.

title: Election Commission : ఈసీ వర్సెస్ ఈసీ! సీనియర్ అధికారిపై ఫిర్యాదు.. ఆర్టీఐతో బయటపడ్డ సంచలనం | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: కేంద్ర ఎన్నికల సంఘంలో ఉన్నతాధికారుల మధ్య విభేదాలు రచ్చకెక్కాయి! సీనియర్ డిప్యూటీ ఎలక్షన్ కమిషనర్ మనీష్ గార్గ్ తీరుపై ఎలక్షన్ కమిషనర్లు సుఖ్‌బీర్ సంధు, వివేక్ జోషి రాసిన రహస్య లేఖల వివరాలు సమాచార హక్కు చట్టం (ఆర్టీఐ) ద్వారా వెలుగుచూశాయి.
content: దేశంలో ఎన్నికలను పారదర్శకంగా నిర్వహించాల్సిన భారత ఎన్నికల సంఘం (ఈసీఐ)లో అంతర్గత విభేదాలు ఉన్నాయనే వార్తలను తాజా పరిణామాలు మరింత బలోపేతం చేస్తున్నాయి! సంస్థలోని ఉన్నతాధికారుల మధ్య విభేదాలు ఏ స్థాయికి చేరిందో ఒక సమాచార హక్కు చట్టం (ఆర్టీఐ) దరఖాస్తు స్పష్టం చేసింది. సీనియర్ డిప్యూటీ ఎలక్షన్ కమిషనర్ (డీఈసీ) మనీష్ గార్గ్ ఏకపక్ష నిర్ణయాలు, అనుచిత ప్రవర్తనపై ఎలక్షన్ కమిషనర్లు సుఖ్‌బీర్ సంధు, వివేక్ జోషి తీవ్ర ఆగ్రహం వ్యక్తం చేస్తూ రాసిన లేఖలు ఇప్పుడు సంచలనం సృష్టిస్తున్నాయి.రిటైర్డ్ కమడోర్ లోకేష్ బాత్రా దాఖలు చేసిన ఆర్టీఐ దరఖాస్తుకు కేబినెట్ సెక్రటేరియట్ ఇచ్చిన సమాధానం ద్వారా ఈ విషయాలు బయటకు వచ్చాయి. కమిషనర్లు రాసిన ఫిర్యాదు లేఖల ప్రతులను కేబినెట్ సెక్రటేరియట్ నేరుగా చీఫ్ ఎలక్షన్ కమిషనర్ (సీఈసీ) జ్ఞానేష్ కుమార్ కార్యాలయానికి, అలాగే సిబ్బంది-శిక్షణ శాఖకు పంపినట్లు వెల్లడైంది.అంతులేని అధికార పోరు.. అసలేం జరిగింది?ఈ వివాదానికి ప్రధాన కారణం అధికారుల విధుల పునర్విభజన! జులై 28న అడ్మినిస్ట్రేషన్ విభాగం అదనపు బాధ్యతలు చేపట్టిన మనీష్ గార్గ్, మరుసటి రోజే తనకంటే సీనియర్లు, సమాన హోదా ఉన్న అధికారుల పనివిభజనపై కొత్త ఉత్తర్వులు జారీ చేశారు. ఐటీ విభాగానికి చెందిన కీలక ఫైళ్ల రూటింగ్ ప్రక్రియను ఆయన ఏకపక్షంగా మార్చేశారు. గతంలో డిప్యూటీ కమిషనర్ సంజయ్ కుమార్ వద్దకు వెళ్లాల్సిన ఫైళ్లను వేరే మార్గానికి మళ్లించడంపై మిగతా కమిషనర్లు మండిపడ్డారు.తమను సంప్రదించకుండానే ఈ నిర్ణయం తీసుకున్నారని, 2023 సీఈసీ/ఈసీ చట్టంలోని సెక్షన్ 18(1), 18(2) నిబంధనలను ఉల్లంఘించారని జులై 29న కేబినెట్ కార్యదర్శి టీవీ సోమనాథన్‌కు రాసిన కాన్ఫిడెన్షియల్ లేఖల్లో సంధు, జోషి పేర్కొన్నారు. తమకు కావాల్సిన ఫైళ్లను కూడా అడ్మినిస్ట్రేషన్ విభాగం ఇవ్వకుండా నిలిపివేసిందని వివేక్ జోషి ఆరోపించారు.రాజ్యాంగ వ్యవస్థలో జోక్యమవుతుందనే వెనకడుగు..కేబినెట్ సెక్రటేరియట్ ఈ వ్యవహారంపై ఆగస్టు 4న ప్రత్యేక పరిశీలన జరిపింది. ఎన్నికల సంఘం స్వతంత్ర రాజ్యాంగ వ్యవస్థ కావడం వల్ల, ప్రభుత్వం నేరుగా ఎలాంటి చర్యలు తీసుకున్నా అది "వ్యవస్థాగత జోక్యం చేసుకున్నట్లు భావించే ప్రమాదం ఉందనడంలో సందేహం లేదు," అని సెక్రటేరియట్ తన నోట్‌లో స్పష్టం చేసింది.ఈ లేఖలు ఎన్నికల సంఘం అధికారికంగా పంపినవి కావు. కమిషనర్లు తమ వ్యక్తిగత హోదాలో రాసినందున ప్రభుత్వం నేరుగా చర్యలు తీసుకోలేమని భావించింది. అందుకే లేఖలు అందినట్లు ఆగస్టు 5న కమిషనర్లకు రసీదు పంపి, ఆ ప్రతులను సీఈసీ జ్ఞానేష్ కుమార్, సిబ్బందిశాఖ కార్యదర్శికి అందించింది.ఐటీ విభాగం వివాదం.. ఓటర్ల జాబితా లొసుగులుఈ అధికారుల వివాదం వెనుక ఐటీ విభాగానికి చెందిన ప్రధాన సమస్య ఉందనే ప్రచారం జరుగుతోంది. ఐటీ డైరెక్టర్ జనరల్ సీమా ఖన్నా ప్రవేశపెట్టిన కొత్త సాంకేతిక వ్యవస్థ వల్ల, ఓటర్ల నమోదు, పేర్ల తొలగింపు బాధ్యతలు చూసే ఓటర్ రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ అధికారులకు ఓటర్ల జాబితా డేటాబేస్ అందుబాటులో లేకుండా పోయిందనే ఆరోపణలు వచ్చాయి. ఈ వ్యవహారంపైనే అధికారుల మధ్య తీవ్రస్థాయిలో అభిప్రాయ భేదాలు తలెత్తినట్లు తెలుస్తోంది.ఈసీలో కమిషనర్ల మధ్య విభేదాలు ఉన్నాయనే వార్తలను ఎన్నికల సంఘం అధికారికంగా ఖండించింది. నిర్ణయాలన్నీ నిబంధనల ప్రకారమే ఏకగ్రీవంగా లేదా మెజారిటీ ప్రాతిపదికన తీసుకుంటున్నామని స్పష్టం చేసింది. అయితే, ఆర్టీఐ ద్వారా వెలుగుచూసిన ఈ లేఖలు మాత్రం మరోలా ఉన్నాయి.

title: 'Did not ask cops to detain': IIT Bombay admin after faculty raises 'forceful' detention of students | Mumbai news
description: The institute claimed the police were present on campus on Thursday due to the visit of Congress MP Varsha Gaikwad and MLA Aslam Shaikh.  | Mumbai news
content: The Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT-B) says it did not ask the police to detain the protesting parents of the student who died by suicide last month, or dismantle the protest site on campus on Sunday. Neither had it asked the police to detain the students “seeking justice” for the deceased boy.On Thursday, the institute claimed the police were present on campus due to the visit of Congress MP Varsha Gaikwad and MLA Aslam Shaikh, which coincided with the parents’ presence at the institute.Also Read I 'Difficult to accept': IIT Bombay faculty writes to director after protesting students 'forcefully' removedIIT-B responds after faculty's letterThe statement came after around 20 professors from IIT-B emailed the institute director on Wednesday, over the police intervention on campus on October 18.According to the administration, the protesting students behaved aggressively towards police and obstructed them from carrying out their duties shortly before both the MP and the parents arrived. Police detained the students and released them by evening.The incident also comes after the deceased students’ parents requested permission to visit the IIT-B campus, a wish that was granted. In its email to the professors, the IIT-B administration also said personal belongings of the students that were allegedly blocking the campus entrance would be returned.However, the professors claimed the institute’s response did not address the circumstances leading to the students’ detention and the handling of their belongings.

title: Religious conversion solely for marriage cannot be permitted, says Bombay High Court | Mumbai news
description: The bench said voluntary religious change is permitted, but conversion solely for marriage cannot be allowed, and gave the petitioner liberty to refile.  | Mumbai news
content: The Bombay High Court on Thursday held that while individuals are free to change their religion, conversion solely for the purpose of marriage cannot be permitted. The court also observed that a petition challenging the constitutional validity of the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Act, 2026, lacked the foundational facts necessary for judicial consideration.“This is just to maintain the secular fabric of society. The State is only concerned with coercion or religious conversion by force. Anyone has the freedom to change their religion. But just for the purpose of marriage, conversion cannot be permitted,” a division bench of Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna said while refusing to entertain a petition filed by a 70-year-old Islamic scholar.The bench declined to consider the petition in the absence of specific factual pleadings and granted the petitioner liberty to file a fresh plea supported by facts.Also Read | Hindu converts to Islam and Christianity can’t claim Muslim backward quota, rules Supreme CourtMaulana Halimullah Farooque Ahmed Khan had challenged the Act, arguing that while the state could legitimately enact measures to prevent conversions brought about by force, fraud or other means, certain provisions of the legislation “travel beyond this permissible objective”.Maharashtra in July became the 12th state to notify an anti-conversion law. The legislation criminalises religious conversions allegedly carried out through force, allurement, fraud, inducement or marriage, making such offences cognisable. Its provisions also cover interfaith marriages where conversion is alleged to have occurred through such means, particularly when objections are raised by either party’s family.The petition, filed through advocate Mateen Shaikh, contended that the Act’s definitions of “allurement” and “unlawful conversion” are vague and subjective, giving prosecuting authorities excessive discretion. It argued that this could lead to the criminalisation of legitimate charitable, educational, humanitarian and religious activities, while having a “chilling effect” on constitutionally protected speech, religious propagation and association.Also Read | Breaking down the share of social groups among religions | Number TheoryThe plea also argued that the state cannot subject consensual interfaith relationships, marriages or voluntary changes of faith to surveillance or heightened scrutiny merely because the individuals concerned profess different religions. “Choice of a life partner and the decision concerning one’s faith constitute facets of personal autonomy, dignity, privacy,” the petition adds.

title: Amid  ₹500 crore row, Maratha activist Manoj Jarange-Patil presents audio clip; Sena suggests BJP link | Mumbai news
description: BJP's Shweta Shalini and Atul Bhatkhalkar denied being involved in the conversations, with both alleging that the recordings could be fabricated or AI-generated  | Mumbai news
content: Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange-Patil accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of conspiring against him ahead of the 2024 elections, on Thursday. During a press conference in Jalna district – the seat of the quota activist’s many protests – he released purported audio clips of BJP leaders discussing money allegedly paid to him to control the political narrative.This follows his recent claim that deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde boasted to the BJP leadership about channelling ₹500 crore to the activist through his son, MP Shrikant Shinde. In response, the deputy chief minister denied the allegations and demanded a formal investigation to determine if the audio clips are AI-generated fakes.Jarange-Patil had previously challenged Shinde to clarify the financial allegations, threatening to make the audio recordings public if he failed to do so.Also read: Activist Jarange-Patil accuses BJP of conspiring against him, cites audio clipsRecordings contain alleged discussions on election narrativesIn one of the clips played in Jalna on Thursday, a woman is heard claiming that Jarange-Patil was paid ₹500 crore and that his stance will work to the BJP’s advantage in the 2024 assembly polls. “The amount has been given to Jarange-Patil through Shrikant Shinde. Now, Jarange-Patil will be beneficial for us... . I have a different opinion on this. If Jarange-Patil keeps targeting the BJP, it will help us in the assembly polls,” the woman is heard saying, suggesting in such a case the BJP will gain from OBC votes.Another BJP leader is purportedly heard saying that they have not been making enough noise over “love jihad cases” in Ahilyanagar and Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar, suggesting that local leaders, including Radhakrishna Vikhe-Patil, should have spoken up to set the narrative.Another person purportedly suggested discrediting those who were against the Vadhavan port in Palghar, saying they are anti-development as they could not make money from the land acquisition. In yet another clip, people are heard saying that the BJP should push the narrative about some foreign countries out to create anarchy in India, evidenced by their meeting with opposition leaders, including NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar.Also read: ₹500 crore payment claim">Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange-Patil asks Shinde to clarify ₹500 crore payment claimActivist warns of intensified campaign against ruling coalitionThe clips, said Jarange-Patil, expose the thought process of people working against a man who was fighting for the Marathas, adding that his life is under threat even as attempts were being made to suppress his voice. He said that he will intensify his attack on the government, making it difficult for the ruling coalition to make any gains in the 2029 assembly polls if they do not respond positively.“I would not name the people in the audio, as it is the chief minister’s job, and that of his two deputies, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi,” said Jarange-Patil.Sena leaders meet CM, demand probeMeanwhile, although Jarange-Patil hesitated to take names, at separate press meets on Thursday, two Shiv Sena leaders – MP Naresh Mhaske and industries minister Uday Samant -- said all the people in the tapes are related to BJP. They are Shweta Shalini, BJP’s state in-charge of social media and IT cell; Atul Bhatkhalkar, MLA of Kandivli East; and Youtuber Sushil Kulkarni.While Samant and Mhaske demanded a probe into the clips, a delegation of senior Shiv Sena leaders – Sachin Ahir, Milind Deora and Rahul Shewale -- met chief minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday seeking a probe into the episode.In the letter submitted to Fadnavis, the leaders listed the names of several BJP leaders that came up in the audio clips and demanded that a forensic investigation be initiated to check the authenticity of the clips. They also demanded that the same leaders be questioned by the police.Also read: ₹500 crore: Shinde seeks probe into Jarange’s allegations">Neither gave nor took ₹500 crore: Shinde seeks probe into Jarange’s allegationsSena seeks SIT probe into alleged conspiracy against ShindeEarlier, Samant sought investigation into whether there was a broader conspiracy to defame party chief Eknath Shinde.“Our leader and MP Shrikant Shinde has been named in the tape, which is damaging for the party. An SIT should be constituted to investigate the veracity of the tapes by using forensic and cyber technology. As the names emerging from the conversation in the tapes are linked to the BJP, one should also probe the intent behind the leaks,” said a Sena leader.Requesting Jarange-Patil to name people in the clips, Sena minister Sanjay Shirsat said: “Maharashtra will then know who is defaming Eknath Shinde and Jarange-Patil.”Also read: Jarange-Patil calls off stir after govt sets deadline on demandsBJP leaders deny involvement, question authenticity of recordingsIn response to the allegations, Shweta Shalini told media persons: “I have no relation with the tape, which appears to be fabricated. I was not a part of the media team for the Assembly polls after party’s debacle in the Lok Sabha elections.”“The voice in the clip is not mine. I have never been a part of such a conversation,” said Bhatkhalkar, alleging that it may have been created using AI. “The clip is part of a well-planned political conspiracy aimed at creating a rift within the Mahayuti alliance (BJP and Shiv Sena) and tarnishing the image of our leaders ahead of the upcoming elections.”Sushil Kulkarni did not respond to HT’s calls for a response.Also read: Certificates issues, records collated: What Marathas gained from Manoj Jarange-Patil's stirBJP leader and cultural affairs minister Ashish Shelar added: “No BJP leader is related to these clips and the conversation. The authenticity of the clips needs to be verified; in fact, Jarange-Patil should have done so himself. We also need to establish who were behind leaking the tapes, and condemn the attempt to defame our deputy chief minister.”Promising an inquiry into the clips, BJP spokesperson Navnath Ban said while fabricated audio and video clips are often known to surface, “the home department should conduct a probe to establish whether the clips are genuine or AI-generated”.

title: Haiku Review: హైకూ రివ్యూ- ప్రేమికులకు కొత్త పాఠం నేర్పే ప్రేమకథ-కోర్ట్ హీరోయిన్ శ్రీదేవి తమిళ ఎంట్రీ సినిమా ఎలా ఉందంటే? | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Haiku Review And Rating In Telugu: తొలి ప్రేమలో ఓడిపోయిన వ్యక్తి రెండోసారి ప్రేమలో పడితే ఏం జరుగుతుంది? అతిగా ఆధిపత్యం చెలాయించే ధోరణి ప్రేమను ఎలా అంతం చేస్తుందో చూపిస్తూ తెరకెక్కిన చిత్రం హైకూ. కోర్ట్ హీరోయిన్ శ్రీదేవి తమిళంలో ఎంట్రీ ఇచ్చిన ఈ సినిమా ఎలా ఉందో నేటి హైకూ రివ్యూలో చూద్దాం.
content: Haiku Movie Review And Rating In Telugu:టైటిల్: హైకూనటీనటులు: శ్రీదేవి అపల్ల, ఏగన్, పెమీనా జార్జ్, మైమ్ గోపి, ఇందుమతి మణికందన్, అధిర్చి అరుణ్, సుబ్రమణ్య సేతు తదితరులుదర్శకత్వం: యువరాజ్ చిన్నస్వామిసంగీతం: సిద్దూ కుమార్,సినిమాటోగ్రఫి: పియూష్ గురుస్వామిఎడిటింగ్: శకత్తి ప్రణేష్ పీనిర్మాతలు: డాక్టర్ అరుళానంధు, మ్యాథ్యూ అరుళానంధుబ్యానర్: విజన్ సినిమా హౌస్విడుదల తేది: 23 అక్టోబర్ 2026సినిమా రంగంలో ప్రేమకథలకు కొదవలేదు. అయితే, బ్రేకప్ తర్వాత ఒక మనిషి ఆలోచనా విధానంలో వచ్చే మార్పులను, మానసిక పరిపక్వతను స్పృశిస్తూ సినిమాలు రావడం అరుదు. 'కోళిపణ్ణై చెల్లదురై' సినిమాలో పల్లెటూరి యువకుడిగా అలరించిన నటుడు ఏగన్.. ఈసారి సరికొత్త గ్లామరస్ లుక్‌తో హీరోగా చేసిన సినిమా 'హైకూ'.కోర్ట్ హీరోయిన్ శ్రీదేవి తమిళ డెబ్యూకోర్ట్ మూవీ ఫేమ్ శ్రీదేవి అపల్ల హీరోయిన్‌గా చేసింది. ఈ సినిమాతో తమిళ సినీ ఇండస్ట్రీలోకి శ్రీదేవి అడుగుపెట్టింది. ఆమెతోపాటు మరో హీరోయిన్‌గా ఫెమీనా జార్జ్ చేసింది. ఈ సినిమాకు యువరాజ్ చిన్నస్వామి దర్శకత్వం వహించారు. "తొలి ప్రేమలో విఫలమైన వ్యక్తి, తన తప్పులను దిద్దుకుని రెండో ప్రేమలో మంచి భాగస్వామిగా మారగలడా?" అనే కథాంశంతో ఈ సినిమాను తెరకెక్కించారు.ఇవాళ (అక్టోబర్ 23) థియేటర్లలో హైకూ మూవీ విడుదల కానుంది. అయితే, రిలీజ్‌కు ఒకరోజు ముందే హైకూ ప్రీమియర్ షోలు పడ్డాయి. మరి ఈ సినిమా ఎలా ఉందో నేటి హైకూ రివ్యూలో తెలుసుకుందాం.కథ:కోయంబత్తూర్‌కు చెందిన మనోహరన్ అలియాస్ మనో (ఏగన్) కథ ఇది. మనోహర్ గర్ల్స్ కాలేజీలో చేరతాడు. ఆ కాలేజీలో ఏకైక అబ్బాయి కావడంతో మనోను అమ్మాయిలు ర్యాగింగ్‌కు గురవుతాడు. ఈ క్రమంలో అదే కాలేజీలో చదువుకుంటున్న జాబిలి అలియాస్ కోడి (శ్రీదేవి అపల్ల)తో పరిచయం ఏర్పడుతుంది. ఆ పరిచయం కాస్తా స్నేహంగా, ప్రేమగా మారి పెళ్లి వరకు వెళ్లి బ్రేక్ పడుతుంది.బ్రేకప్ తర్వాత జాబిలి జ్ఞాపకాలతో జీవిస్తున్న మనోకు తన కంపెనీలో అంప్రెటీస్‌గా చేరిన నివేదా (ఫెమినా జార్జ్) పరిచయం అవుతుంది. వీరి వర్క్ రిలేషన్ స్నేహంగా మారుతుంది. అప్పటికే లవ్ రిలేషన్‌షిప్ బ్రేకప్‌తో కుమిలిపోతున్న నివేదా, మనో ఇద్దరు లవ్‌లో పడుతారు.ఆ తర్వాత ఏమైంది? నివేదాతో మనో సంతోషంగా ఉన్నాడా? ఇద్దరి ప్రేమ పెళ్లి వరకు వెళ్లిందా? అసలు జాబిలితో మనో లవ్‌కు ఎందుకు బ్రేక్ పడింది? అంతకుముందు వారిద్దరి ప్రేమ బలపడటానికి కారణాలు ఏంటీ? అసలు గర్ల్స్ కాలేజీలో మనో ఒక్కడే ఎందుకు చేరాల్సి వచ్చింది? రెండో లవ్ అయిన నివేదా కూడా మనోకు ఎందుకు దూరం కావాలనుకుంది? చివరికి జాబిలి, మనో, నివేదా బంధం ఎలా ముగిసింది? అనేదే హైకూ సినిమా.విశ్లేషణ:సాధారణంగా చాలా మంది జీవితాల్లో ప్రేమ, బ్రేకప్ వంటి ఘట్టాలు ఎదురవుతాయి. ఫస్ట్ లవ్, సెకండ్ లవ్ అంటూ పేర్లతో వివిధ రకాలుగా జీవితాలు గడిపేస్తుంటారు. అలా బ్రేకప్‌తో కొట్టుమిట్టాడుతున్న ఓ అబ్బాయి, ఓ అమ్మాయి తిరిగి ప్రేమలో పడితే ఏంటనేదే ఈ సినిమా కథ.స్టోరీ పరంగా కొన్ని సన్నివేశాలు సాధారణంగా అనిపించినప్పటికీ, రిలేషన్‌షిప్‌ను దర్శకుడు యువరాజ్ చిన్నస్వామి చూపించిన విధానం ఆకట్టుకుంటుంది. ఫస్టాఫ్‌లో మనోహర్, జాబిలిల కాలేజ్ ప్రేమకథ, ర్యాగింగ్, గర్ల్స్ కాలేజీలో మనో చేరడానికి కారణాలను, సామాజిక కట్టుబాట్ల నడుమ మనో, జాబిలి ఆలోచనలను బాగా ఆవిష్కరించారు.ఎమోషనల్ గ్రాఫ్‌తో సెకండాఫ్అందంగా సాగుతున్న మనో, జాబిలి ప్రేమలో ప్రతి జంటకు ఎదురయ్యే డామినేషన్ పాయింట్ తలెత్తుతుంది. ప్రతి ప్రేమకథలో బ్రేకప్ పడేందుకు కారణమయ్యే అదే పాయింట్‌ను ఇందులో కూడా డైరెక్టర్ చూపించారు. అయితే, మొదటి ప్రేమలో చేసిన తప్పులు రిపీట్ కాకుండా రెండో ప్రేమను హీరో ఎలా నిలబెట్టుకున్నాడన్నది ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్‌గా చూపించారు.సెకండాఫ్‌లో నివేదా పాత్ర ప్రవేశంతో కథలోని ఎమోషనల్ గ్రాఫ్ పెరుగుతుంది. గతంలో ఎదురైన ప్రేమ వైఫల్యాలు మనుషులను ఏ స్థాయిలో భయపెడతాయో, కొత్త బంధంలోకి వెళ్లకుండా ఎలా అడ్డుపడతాయో చాలా సహజంగా చూపించారు. పెళ్లి దాకా వెళ్లిన బంధం తెగిపోవడం, ఆ తర్వాత ఏర్పడే కొత్త పరిచయం మధ్య నలిగే ఒక యువకుడి మానసిక స్థితిని చక్కగా ఆవిష్కరించారు. క్లైమాక్స్ బాగుంది.ఆకట్టుకునే విజువల్స్, సంగీతంసినిమాటోగ్రాఫర్ పియూష్ గురుస్వామి విజువల్స్ ప్లజెంట్‌గా బాగున్నాయి. సిద్దూ కుమార్ అందించిన నేపథ్య సంగీతం కథలోని ఎమోషన్‌ను మరింత ముందుకు తీసుకెళ్లింది. సంక్లిష్టమైన పాత్రలు, విభిన్నమైన టైమ్‌లైన్స్ ఉన్నప్పటికీ ఎడిటర్ శకత్తి ప్రణేష్ ఎక్కడా గందరగోళం లేకుండా సన్నివేశాలను సమర్థవంతంగా కూర్చారు.విజన్ సినిమా హౌస్ బ్యానర్‌పై నిర్మాతలు డాక్టర్ అరుళానంధు, మ్యాథ్యూ అరుళానంధు పాటించిన నిర్మాణ విలువలు బాగున్నాయి. ఇకపోతే యంగ్ హీరో ఏగన్ తన పాత్రలో ఒదిగిపోయాడు. ఇద్దరు ప్రియురాళ్ల మధ్య నలిగిపోయే భగ్న ప్రేమికుడిగా, నటనలో ఎంతో పరిణతి చూపించాడు.ఎవరెలా చేశారంటే?శ్రీదేవి తన పాత్ర పరిధి మేర ఎంతో పద్ధతిగా, మెచ్యూర్డ్‌గా నటించి మెప్పించింది. రెండో భాగంలో ఫెమీనా జార్జ్ ఎంట్రీ సినిమాకు పెద్ద ప్లస్ పాయింట్‌గా మారింది. గత బంధం నుంచి బయటపడలేక, కొత్త ప్రేమను స్వీకరించలేక తల్లడిల్లే యువతిగా ఆమె పండించిన భావోద్వేగాలు థియేటర్లో కూర్చున్న ప్రేక్షకుడిని కట్టిపడేస్తాయి. ముగ్గురు నటీనటులు తమ క్యారెక్టర్లకు పూర్తి న్యాయం చేశారు.ఫైనల్‌గా చెప్పాలంటే సహజమైన ప్రేమకథలు, నేటితరం బంధాలలో ఎదురయ్యే సమస్యల ఆధారంగా రూపుదిద్దుకున్న 'హైకూ' ఒక మంచి యూత్‌ఫుల్ ఎంటర్‌టైనర్. బ్రేకప్ అనేది జీవితానికి ముగింపు కాదు, అది అనుభవాల పాఠం అని చాటిచెప్పే హైకూ నేటితరం ప్రేక్షకులకు తప్పక నచ్చుతుంది.రేటింగ్: 2.75/5

title: Mumbai male nurse gets 5-year jail term for molesting patient in ICU | Mumbai news
description: The sessions court rejected the defence’s plea for leniency, citing the patient’s vulnerable condition and the breach of trust involved in the 2016 incident.  | Mumbai news
content: A male nurse who molested a woman patient while she was being treated for acute abdominal pain in the intensive care unit (ICU) of Joy Hospital in Chembur has been sentenced to five years’ rigorous imprisonment by a sessions court, which held that he had exploited her vulnerable condition and abused the trust placed in healthcare workers.Additional sessions judge VB Bohra convicted Sanjay Mahesh Yadav of sexual harassment and assault with the intention of disrobing a woman in connection with the October 2016 incident. The court relied on the patient’s testimony, corroborative evidence from witnesses and CCTV footage that captured the nurse molesting her inside the ICU. The sentences of three and five years will run concurrently.According to the prosecution, the woman had initially visited the hospital for acute abdominal pain but began vomiting on her way home following the consultation. She returned to the hospital and was admitted to the ICU for further treatment, continuing to suffer pain through the night.Also read: Swaroop Nagar gangrape: Two rare DNA tests confirm sexual assault by four peoplePatient recounts alleged assault after becoming drowsyShe told the court that after a doctor visited her at around 1.30 am, she became unconscious or drowsy. She later felt someone touching her breast and other parts of her body. When she opened her eyes, she saw Yadav with her T-shirt pulled upwards and liquid being applied to her stomach.Yadav allegedly told her that he was preparing to conduct an electrocardiogram (ECG) and gave her a tablet, after which she again became unconscious or drowsy, the woman testified. She alleged that he subsequently removed her T-shirt and touched her body.The following morning, the woman reported the incident to her treating doctors, including Dr Vikrant and Dr Sakshi. On checking her medical records, they found no entry documenting an ECG or the administration of a tablet at the relevant time. After reviewing the CCTV footage, hospital staff informed Chembur police with the woman’s consent.Also read: Doctor arrested for assaulting police after ganja seized from hotel roomFriend and hospital staff corroborate patient’s accountUpholding the woman’s account, the court found her testimony credible and noted that the defence had failed to establish any material contradiction or omission during cross-examination. Her account was also supported by the doctors, hospital staff and a friend who had waited outside the ICU through the night.The friend told the court that the woman had disclosed the incident to her at around 7 am. She appeared traumatised and was unwilling to continue her stay in the hospital, the friend said.The judge also relied on CCTV footage recorded between 3.30 am and 3.50 am, which showed Yadav molesting the patient. Rejecting the defence’s claim that the footage had been fabricated or edited, the court observed that there was no evidence of any prior enmity between Yadav and the hospital management. It held that the woman’s testimony, supported by the other evidence, was sufficient to establish the offences.Yadav denied the allegations and claimed that the footage was false. Seeking leniency, his lawyer told the court that Yadav was young and unmarried, and had recently lost his father. His mother, who suffered from paralysis, depended on him, as did his divorced sister and her young child.Also read: POCSO court acquits labourer in rape, sexual assault caseCourt rejects plea for leniency despite family circumstancesThe court, however, rejected the plea for a lenient sentence, underscoring the seriousness of the offence and the breach of trust involved. Yadav had abused his position as a healthcare worker to target a patient who was receiving treatment in an ICU, the judge observed. The woman was already suffering from pain and was under medication, and the incident had left her traumatised and prompted her to seek an early discharge, the court noted.Yadav was sentenced to three years’ rigorous imprisonment and fined ₹5,000 for sexual harassment. He was also sentenced to five years’ rigorous imprisonment and fined ₹20,000 for assault with the intention of disrobing the woman.The court directed that ₹20,000 be paid to the woman as compensation from the fine, subject to the appeal period and the outcome of any appeal.

title: Kareena Kapoor greets Shahid Kapoor with a warm hug at IIFA 2027 event; fans reminded of their ‘Aditya-Geet’ chemistry | Bollywood
description: Kareena Kapoor and Shahid Kapoor attended the same event in Mumbai on Thursday evening. They greeted each other with warmth.   | Bollywood
content: Ever since the firing attack on Tiger Shroff in Mumbai, security has been boosted for several stars in Bollywood. Salman Khan was spotted arriving at an event announcing IIFA 2027, escorted by heavy security. Kareena Kapoor greeted him and her ex-boyfriend Shahid Kapoor there with warm hugs, making for a sweet moment.Kareena Kapoor hugs Shahid KapoorA video posted by a paparazzo page shows Kareena all smiles as she hugs Shahid in greeting at the event in Mumbai. Shahid also seems to ask about her well-being, and she responds affirmatively. Kareena opted for a black leather skirt suit, while Shahid wore a white suit for the event. The duo later shared the stage with other celebrities present at the event, like Rashmika Mandanna and Varun Dhawan. Fans could not keep calm as they were hit by a wave of nostalgia. “Why am I getting emotional seeing this?” read one fan comment. “Why are we so happy?” wrote another. Numerous other comments reflected a similar sentiment. Kareena and Shahid dated for two years and broke up in 2007, during the filming of Jab We Met. Recently, Shahid’s wife, Mira Rajput, also appeared on Kareena’s What Women Want podcast.Kareena also greeted Salman with a sweet hug, and the duo later posed for pictures. The Maatrubhumi star, dressed in a dark blazer and jeans, arrived at the event with heavy security. He was seen interacting with the management and greeting other celebrities present at the event. This comes amid the attack on Tiger by Lawrence Bishnoi’s aide. However, Salman's security has been strengthened now following the attack, especially after the alleged attacker’s social media post named him. Kareena Kapoor, Shahid Kapoor, Salman Khan’s recent workAfter the 2024 films Crew and Singham Again, Kareena starred in Meghna Gulzar’s Daayra this year. Prithviraj Sukumaran was her co-star in the film. She has yet to announce her upcoming projects, though reports state she will make a special appearance in Sidharth Anand’s King, starring Shah Rukh Khan and Suhana Khan. Shahid starred in O’Romeo and Cocktail 2 this year. In the former film, he played a gangster; in the latter, he played a man caught between two women. Both films failed to make a mark. After the 2025 film Sikandar, Salman played cameos in Raja Shivaji and the Saudi Arabian film 7 Dogs. He will soon star in Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace, and a yet-to-be-titled film by Vamshi Paidipally.

title: Up to 500,000 may be excluded from final Maharashtra voters list over non-submission of documents | Mumbai news
description: The November 10 deadline for submitting eligibility documents applies to electors whose details could not be mapped to the 2002 rolls or contained discrepancies  | Mumbai news
content: Up to 5% of the 12.2 million electors across Maharashtra flagged for discrepancies or non-mapping with the 2002 Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls may have their names deleted from the final voters’ list as they are yet to submit the required documents, officials in the poll body told Hindustan Times. The number of potential deletions has dropped significantly because of revised guidelines, the officials said.Notices have been served to all the 12.2 million electors across constituencies, asking them to submit documents to establish their eligibility and resolve discrepancies, officials said. Those whose details could not be mapped with the 2002 SIR rolls have been asked to submit documents to establish their eligibility for inclusion in the voters’ list, whereas those whose details contained discrepancies have been asked to submit documents to substantiate the corrections sought in notices issued to them.Also read: Same voter ID, different names: Congress alleges voter list tamperingNovember 10 set as deadline to submit supporting documentsThe last date for submission of documents is November 10.Election officials have prepared lists of electors who have been unable to submit the required documents despite repeated follow-ups, and the office of the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), Maharashtra, has begun publishing details of such electors on its website, officials said. Thus far, details have been published for more than 50 assembly constituencies across 12 districts, the officials noted.In Mumbai, names of electors from four assembly constituencies have been published on the poll panel website. Among these, Malabar Hill has around 2,800 electors (against 39,054 served notices), Byculla has 1,460 (against 25,461 served notices), Dharavi has 1,420 (against 79,676 served notices), and Dahisar has more than 5,500 electors (against 68,927 served notices) who have yet to submit the required documents. In Amravati district, Badnera has 5,600 such electors (against 123,233 served notices), while Daryapur has 1,550 (against 56,456 served notices).Also read: Post-SIR electoral roll in UP under first major scrutinyBooth-level agents asked to help electors meet deadlineLists of electors who are yet to submit documents are also being shared with booth-level agents (BLAs) appointed by political parties, who can help such electors submit the necessary documents by November 10, a senior official said, requesting anonymity.“We expect a maximum of 5% of the 12.2 million electors flagged in these categories – that is up to 500,000 electors – to be unable to submit the required documents and subsequently have their names deleted from the electoral rolls. Deletion from these categories has reduced significantly after we revised the guidelines for compliance,” the official added.According to the official, more than 90% of the 12.2 million electors had been flagged for discrepancies or anomalies in their details, while the remaining could not be mapped to the 2002 SIR rolls.Also read: Poll body orders Special Summary Revision of voter lists in 17 states: What is SSR, how it differs from SIRSandesh Kondvilkar, Maharashtra Congress general secretary, said political parties could have helped electors secure their inclusion in the electoral rolls if lists of those flagged for discrepancies or non-mapping had been shared with them earlier.“Initially, we were denied access to the lists of electors who had been served notices over concerns regarding the confidentiality of personal information. Later, on September 22, the Chief Electoral Officer assured us that the lists would be shared within 15 days, but it took more than a month for them to be made available. Had the names been shared on time, our booth-level agents could have helped electors resolve the discrepancies,” he said.

title: 2016 Murud drowning case: HC quashes FIR against Pune college teacher, management | Mumbai news
description: 2016 Murud drowning case: HC quashes FIR against Pune college teacher, management  | Mumbai news
content: Mumbai, The Bombay High Court has quashed a 2016 FIR against a teacher and the management of a Pune college in connection with the drowning of 14 students off the Murud beach, holding that the victims were adults capable of understanding the consequences of their actions.The incident occurred on February 1, 2016, when a group of 116 students and staff from Abeda Inamdar Senior College of Arts, Science and Commerce in Pune went on a picnic to Murud in Raigad district. While at the beach, 41 third-year students ventured into the sea, 14 of whom were swept away and drowned.Nearly 80 days after the incident, an FIR was registered under sections 304A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code against 17 individuals, including college trustees, the principal, teachers, and staff.In his ruling, Justice Milind Jadhav held there was no material on record to establish any gross or high degree of negligence on the part of teachers accompanying the students.The court asserted that the victims, being third-year BSc students "possessing a reasonable degree of life experience", could be expected to understand the distinction between right and wrong and to appreciate the likely consequences of their own actions and conduct."It is seen that it was in this context that these applicants permitted them to enjoy the fun and frolic on the beach," the court noted, adding that the death of 14 students by drowning was an accident.In the absence of any incriminating material establishing a direct or proximate connection with any negligent act leading to the deaths by drowning, liability or criminal act cannot be attributed to negligence on their part, the court ruled.Calling for effective implementation of safety norms, the HC said, "It is unfortunate that every time a tragedy involving the loss of multiple lives occurs, it is followed by widespread public outcry."However, effective implementation of safety norms and other preventive measures continue to remain a matter of serious concern, the bench said."We cannot have a knee jerk reaction after every mishap," the bench said while asking the government to consider taking or fortifying measures at beaches in the larger interest of society.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

content: Brahma Mudi Serial Today Episode: స్టార్ మా సీరియల్ బ్రహ్మముడి ఈరోజు ఎపిసోడ్ లో ఇందు చెప్పినా వినకుండా రాజు తొందరపడటంతో ప్లాన్ అంతా చెడిపోతుంది. అటు ఐశ్వర్య, రేఖకు చేజేతులా అవకాశం ఇచ్చినట్లు అవుతుంది. దీంతో రాజు, వెంకీ ఇద్దరినీ ఒకే దెబ్బతో ఇంటికి దూరం చేయాలని రేఖ, ఐషూ ప్లాన్ చేస్తారు.రాజుకి ఫ్రాడ్ గురించి చెప్పిన వెంకీ.. సైలెంట్‌గా ఉండాలన్న రాజురాజుకి తన కంపెనీలో ఫ్రాడ్ గురించి చెప్పడానికి వెంకీ వచ్చే సీన్ తో సీరియల్ శుక్రవారం (అక్టోబర్ 23) ఎపిసోడ్ మొదలైంది. నీ కంపెనీలో మోసం జరిగితే నేనేం చేయాలని రాజు అంటే.. అది ఐశ్వర్య కంపెనీకి కూడా సంబంధం ఉన్న మోసం.. ఆమె అంత తక్కువకే టెండర్ దక్కించుకోవడం వెనుక పెద్ద మోసం ఉంది.. అదేంటో కనిపెట్టాలని వెంకీ అంటాడు. తనకు ముందు నుంచీ దీనిపై డౌట్ గానే ఉందని, ఈ విషయం తాను చూసుకుంటానని నువ్వు జోక్యం చేసుకోవద్దని వెంకీకి రాజు చెబుతాడు.ఐశ్వర్యకే స్వరాజ్ గ్రూపు కాంట్రాక్టులుఅటు ఐశ్వర్య కంపెనీ చేసిన డిజైన్లు నచ్చడంతో క్లైంట్ ఆమెకు సగం అమౌంట్ చెక్కు రూపంలో ఇస్తాడు. ఆమె చేసి పనిని మెచ్చుకుంటాడు. స్వరాజ్ గ్రూపుకి ఇద్దామనుకున్న నాలుగు కాంట్రాక్టులను కూడా మీకే ఇస్తానని చెబుతాడు. దీంతో ఐషూ ఆనందానికి అవధుల్లేకుండా పోతాయి. తొలిసారి వచ్చిన చెక్కు చూసి మురిసిపోతుంది. ఇంట్లో చూపించాలని అనుకుంటుంది.ఐశ్వర్య గురించి ఇందుకి చెప్పిన రాజుఅటు రాజు విషయం తెలియగానే ఇంటికి పరుగెత్తుకొస్తాడు. అప్పటికే రాజు ప్రాణాల గురించి ఇందు భయపడుతూ ఉంటుంది. రాజు రాగానే పెళ్లి గురించి మాట్లాడాలని అనుకుంటుంది. కానీ రాజు కంగారుగా రావడం చూసి ఆ విషయం ముందే తెలిసిపోయిందా అని అనుకుంటుంది.అయితే రాజు మాత్రం ఐశ్వర్య చేస్తున్న మోసం గురించి చెబుతాడు. ఆ విషయం బావకు తెలియదైతే అని ఇందు మనసులో అనుకుంటుంది. అదే జరిగితే ఐషూ పరువు కాదు.. ఇన్నేళ్లుగా కాపాడుకుంటూ వస్తున్న స్వరాజ్ గ్రూపు పరువు పోతుందని రాజు ఆందోళన వ్యక్తం చేస్తాడు.చెక్కుతో ఐశ్వర్య బిల్డప్.. అన్ని ప్రాజెక్టులూ తనకే అంటూ..ఇంతలో ఐశ్వర్య చెక్కుతో ఇంటికి వస్తుంది. హడావిడి చేస్తుంది. అందరినీ పిలుస్తుంది. దీంతో రాజు, ఇందు కూడా కిందికి వస్తారు. తన డిజైన్లు నచ్చి రూ.2 కోట్ల చెక్కు ఇచ్చారని గొప్పగా చెప్పుకుంటుంది. అంతేకాదు స్వరాజ్ గ్రూపుకి వెళ్లాల్సిన నాలుగు కాంట్రాక్టులు కూడా తనవే అని ఐశ్వర్య అంటుంది. రాజు మాత్రం ఆవేశంతో రగిలిపోతుంటాడు. మోసం చేసి ఈ కాంట్రాక్టు సంపాదించిందని, ఇందుని నిలదీయాలని అడుగుతాడు. ఐషూ సక్సెస్ చూసి రేఖ, భ్రమరాంబ సంతోషిస్తారు.ఐషూని నిలదీయాలన్న రాజు.. ప్రూఫ్స్ లేవన్న ఇందుఅటు ఐషూ తన జోలికి ఇక ఎవరూ రావద్దని వార్నింగ్ ఇచ్చి వెళ్తుంది. ఆమె చేసిన పని గురించి నిలదీయాలని ఇందుని రాజు అడిగినా ఆమె వినదు. వెంకీ చెప్పాడని చెప్పి ఆమెను నిలదీస్తే లాభం లేదు.. సరైన ఆధారాలు కావాలి కదా.. సరైన టైమ్ వచ్చినప్పుడు అడుగుదాం అని చెప్పి ఇందు వెళ్లిపోతుంది.ఐషూని నిలదీసిన రాజు.. పరువు తీసిన ఐశ్వర్యకానీ రాజు మాత్రం వినడు. ఇందు ప్లాన్ చెడగొడతాడు. ఇప్పుడే ఐషూని నిలదీస్తానంటూ ఆమె గదిలోకి వెళ్తాడు. కాంట్రాక్ట్ ఎలా వచ్చిందో తనకు తెలుసని, నీ కంపెనీలో మోసం జరుగుతోందని తెలిసిపోయిందని అంటాడు. నా కంపెనీ నా ఇష్టం.. నువ్వెవరు అడగడానికి.. అయినా ఇందుకి కేవలం అద్దె మొగుడివి.. కిడ్నాప్ లు చేసుకుంటూ బతికేవాడివి.. నీకు అడిగే అర్హత లేదు.. ముందు బయటకు వెళ్లు అని రాజుని అవమానించి పంపిస్తుంది ఐశ్వర్య.వెంకీని ఇరికించాలన్న రేఖరాజు వెళ్లిన వెంటనే రేఖ, భ్రమరాంబ వస్తారు. ఐషూని అభినందించి.. తన అనుభవం వాడుకో అని రేఖ అంటుంది. రాజు అడ్డు ఎలా తొలగించుకోవాలో చెప్పమని ఐషూ అడుగుతుంది. నువ్వు దొంగ బంగారంతో ఈ డీల్ కుదుర్చుకున్నావని నాకు తెలుసు.. ఆ కంపెనీలో వెంకీ కూడా ఉన్నాడనీ తెలుసు.. అతన్ని ఈ కేసులో ఇరికించి నువ్వు తప్పించుకో అని ఐషూకి చెప్పడంతో ఆమె సరే అని వెళ్లిపోతుంది.ముసలోడిని చంపి రాజుని వదిలించుకుందామన్న రేఖఇటు అదే సమయంలో రాజు అడ్డు తొలగించుకోవడానికి కూడా రేఖ ప్లాన్ చేస్తుంది. వేసిన అది జరగదు అని అతడు అంటాడు.వెంకీ బాస్‌కు ఐషూ ఫోన్.. జైలుకి వెంకీమరోవైపు ఐశ్వర్య వెళ్లి వెంకీ బాస్ కు ఫోన్ చేస్తుంది. మనం భయపడినట్లే జరిగింది.. వెంకీ మన ఫ్రాడ్ గురించి ఇంట్లో చెప్పేశాడు అని అడుగుతుంది. దీంతో ఇందు ఇంజెక్షన్ తీసుకురావడానికి వెళ్తుంది. అక్కడితో బ్రహ్మముడి సీరియల్ ఈరోజు ఎపిసోడ్ ముగుస్తుంది.

title: Class act: Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma show why Vaibhav Sooryavanshi needs to wait | Cricket
description: India’s record chase in Christchurch was built on an opening pair that has kept answering the only question that matters – why change?  | Cricket
content: At one point during the sixth over in Christchurch on Thursday, a target of 226 no longer looked daunting. Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma had put on 93 runs in the first 35 balls, leaving New Zealand’s new-ball plans in tatters.India eventually chased down 226 in 19.4 overs at Hagley Oval, completing their highest successful chase in T20I cricket. Their previous best was 209 against Australia in Visakhapatnam in 2023, a target they matched against New Zealand in Raipur earlier this year. The Christchurch chase was also the second-highest successful chase against New Zealand in T20Is.Also Read: Ishan Kishan has groin niggle, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi might play in 2nd T20I against New Zealand: Sitanshu KotakSamson top-scored for India with his 33-ball 67, laced with eight fours and four maximums, while Abhishek made 29 off 12. Captain Shreyas Iyer and Naman Dhir then took charge of the finish with scores in the forties. But the foundation for the record chase had been laid by the openers.Samson later explained the thinking behind their approach.“Even if you’re chasing 170 and if you’ve got (off) to a flyer, we make sure that we kill the game in the Powerplay itself,” he said. “That’s what we have been doing really well in the last couple of years.”The timing of the performance mattered. A day before the start of the five-match series, Iyer had been asked the Vaibhav Sooryavanshi question again.The 15-year-old has been one of the talking points of the summer, particularly after his spectacular IPL 2026 campaign prompted the selectors to hand him an international call-up. He made his debut on the tour of England but has since had to wait for another opportunity. Iyer was direct when asked when the teenager might play again.“He is very young, he has more years to get opportunities. It’s not like he can walk in right now, because our openers are scoring consistently, and they have won the World Cup.”The numbers support the captain’s argument. Over their last six T20Is, including five against the West Indies at home, Samson and Abhishek have opened together in every match. Their partnerships read 29, 42, 7, 60, 13 and 93.Only two partnerships have passed 50, and yet in four of those matches, at least one of them made a half-century. Samson hit 82 in Ranchi, Abhishek 69 in Indore, Samson 56 in Hyderabad, and 67 on Thursday. Across the six innings, Samson has 235 runs at a strike rate of 197.5, and Abhishek has 174 at 177.6. This combination may not always click, but one of the two usually does, which is what has kept management invested in them.It hasn't quite been a straight road. Not for Abhishek, who has been the primary opener for India over the last two years. Samson’s place, however, has fluctuated.After scoring three T20I centuries in 2024, Samson appeared to have secured his place in India’s plans. His fortunes changed during the home series against England in 2025, when he managed just 51 runs in five innings and struggled against short-pitched bowling.By September 2025, with India entering the final stretch of preparations for the 2026 T20 World Cup, the selectors had lost faith in Samson and brought Shubman Gill into the opening role. Gill was also named vice-captain for the Asia Cup. The experiment failed, and by the end of the year, the BCCI had abandoned the plan, bringing Samson back into the fold and including him in the World Cup squad. However, low scores continued into the home series against New Zealand in January 2026.Samson played only one match in the preliminary stage of the World Cup, against Namibia, before being sidelined when Abhishek returned. But when India faced a crisis over their left-hander heavy batting line-up's struggles against off-spin, Samson emerged as their unlikely saviour.He responded with an unbeaten 97 against the West Indies, followed by 89 in the semifinal against England and another 89 in the final against New Zealand. He finished the tournament with 321 runs at a strike rate of 199.37 and was named Player of the Tournament.The summer brought another test. A string of low scores on the tour of England saw Samson make way for Sooryavanshi, who made his debut at Old Trafford on July 4. Samson was subsequently left out of the Zimbabwe tour, where the teenager impressed with scores of 50, 20 and 81 to claim the Player of the Series award.When the team assembled for the series against Afghanistan in September, Samson was given another opportunity. He responded with consecutive half-centuries in the final two matches, with opening partnerships of 88 and 142.Sooryavanshi’s performances in Zimbabwe showed that he was more than capable of staying in the conversation. But Samson and Abhishek have done enough to keep that conversation from becoming a selection imperative, for now.The teenager’s presence has undoubtedly raised the stakes. With a ready replacement waiting, neither opener can afford an extended lean patch. Both have responded with runs so far.The next T20 World Cup is in 2028 and that leaves India enough time to continue testing their options. Sooryavanshi will get his opportunities but right now, India shouldn't mess with an opening pair that keeps delivering.

title: Varun Dhawan laments lack of recognition for technicians in Bollywood awards at IIFA 2027 press meet, says ‘we talk about everything but films’ | Bollywood
description: Varun Dhawan, who is set to host IIFA Awards 2027, raised concerns over the recognition given to film technicians at award shows in Bollywood.  | Bollywood
content: Actor Varun Dhawan has raised the issue of film technicians not getting the kind of recognition they should at Bollywood award shows. The actor, who is set to make his hosting debut at Indian International Film Academy (IIFA) Awards 2027, spoke about the issue at the IIFA Awards press conference in Mumbai on Thursday.Varun Dhawan on recognition for techniciansOn Thursday, the IIFA 2027 officially kicked off with its star-studded press meet at a Mumbai hotel, attended by Salman Khan, Kareena Kapoor, Shahid Kapoor, and Rashmika Mandanna, among others. While discussing the grand event, Varun shared that award shows should focus on celebrating films, performances, and the technicians behind them.“I feel today at film awards we talk about everything but films. We are here to celebrate films, actors, performances, and technicians. I am a technician’s son. I always feel that the importance we gave to technicians before, we don’t give them that respect today.” Varun said. However, Salman, who was also on stage at the time, quickly rebutted Varun, saying that things had changed. Agreeing with him, Varun added, “Now it is given more credit. This time, Salman Bhai has made sure that it will be given respect.”Varun will be hosting the 27th IIFA Awards, alongside Ananya Panday, Karan Johar, and Maniesh Paul. The actor added that he plans to bring focus ‘back to films’ as the host of the prestigious awards. “We will make sure IIFA 2027 is only about films. We have to bring it back to films. I have to be a little unhinged, and honest this time,” he said.Varun sought advice from Salman Khan, known for hosting the reality show Bigg Boss, on how he should approach hosting the awards ceremony. “Don’t host. Six hours go into hosting. Best is to perform and leave,” Salman quipped. All about IIFA 2027The IIFA 2027 ceremony is expected to feature performances by Bollywood stars Salman Khan, Kareena Kapoor Khan and Janhvi Kapoor. As per a press release, the event will mark IIFA’s fourth showcase in Abu Dhabi and will be held in partnership with the Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi and Miral. The return of IIFA to Abu Dhabi was announced at the Arabian Travel Market 2026.The 27th IIFA Weekend & Awards will take place on January 22–23, 2027, honouring the best Hindi films of the 2026 calendar year.

title: Cops grill Shraddha Dubey, 2 others; sent to 10-day judicial custody in Lucknow cafe owner death case | Hindustan Times
description: Investigators prepared around 120 questions to establish the circumstances of Shiva Sharma’s fatal fall, examine whether others were involved.
content: Nearly seven hours of questioning, a list of 120 questions and a series of unresolved details surrounding the death of Lucknow cafe owner Shiva Sharma marked an intense round of interrogation at the Hazratganj police station on Thursday, before a local court sent main accused Shraddha Dubey and two others to judicial custody until October 31.Shraddha, 31, her sister Rashmi Dubey and driver Danish, who were arrested in Nagpur, were brought to Lucknow on transit remand and quizzed by the investigating team. The trio was produced before a Lucknow court that remanded them in judicial custody for 10 days, said officials.Dubey reached the police station around 9.45am and was taken for medical examination at about 4.31pm, marking the end of the day’s first major round of questioning.Also read: Model Shraddha Dubey, sister and driver arrested in Lucknow cafe owner Shiva Sharma's death caseInvestigators prepare 120 questions on circumstances of fatal fallA team of investigators, ranging from the DCP to personnel who had earlier been removed from the probe, prepared roughly 120 questions focusing on the mystery of Sharma’s fatal fall from the building.Investigators sought to establish what happened before the fall, whether it was murder or suicide, who else may have been involved and why Shraddha fled after the incident.Among the questions investigators sought answers to were: Who allegedly helped her evade the police during her run. Investigators also questioned her about the circumstances leading to the death and the reasons behind her escape.Police questioned Shraddha, her sister Rashmi and driver Danish alias Tanveer Ali separately, DCP Central Arpit Vijayvargiya said, to prevent them from coordinating their accounts and to identify discrepancies in their statements.Also read: Cafe owner’s death: Model Shraddha Dubey, 2 others sent to UP on transit remandTwo phones and ₹25,000 recovered from ShraddhaInvestigators also recovered two mobile phones and ₹25,000 in cash from Shraddha, the DCP added. One of the phones is significant because she had earlier told police that she had lost it in Nepal. The devices and other seized material have been sent for forensic examination.The three accused were brought to the court amid heavy police deployment. They were produced at around 5.30 pm after undergoing questioning for hours and a medical examination. The court subsequently ordered that Shraddha Dubey, Rashmi Dubey and Tanveer Ali be placed in judicial custody from October 22 to October 31.The court rejected the defence counsel’s objection to the remand after examining the case diary and other documents submitted by the investigating officer. The order was passed by additional chief judicial magistrate (ACJM)-7 Balwant Kumar Bharti under Sections 103(1) (murder) and 3(5) (common intention) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The next date of hearing has been fixed for October 31.During the proceedings, the defence counsel had submitted a ‘vakalatnama’ and orally sought rejection of the remand application. After hearing both the prosecution and defence and examining the case diary, the court rejected the objection.The investigating officer sought judicial remand of the accused, citing the need for further investigation, collection of evidence and recovery of material relevant to the case.Also read: Cafe owner death: Prime suspect model, 2 others brought to Lucknow from NagpurDomestic help among those questioned by investigatorsDCP (Central) Arpit Vijayvargiya said police had questioned six to seven people so far, apart from Shraddha, Rashmi and Danish, to piece together the sequence of events. Those questioned included the domestic help who was present at the time of the incident and reportedly told investigators that the couple had fought during the day.“We are investigating their statements. They have told us who helped them in all these 10 days and we are going to identify all of them and take action against them. Phones and other material seized have been sent to forensics,” Vijayvargiya told reporters.According to the court order, the CJM, Lucknow, issued non-bailable warrants against the three accused on October 16. They were subsequently produced before the CJM court in Nagpur on October 21, which granted transit remand for their production before the Lucknow court.

title: Scottish museum removes Egyptian mummies from exhibition over lack of ‘consent from the deceased individual' | Trending
description: Critics have branded the Scottish museum’s decision to remove the mummies as “woke madness”.  | Trending
content: In a move that has sparked widespread public debate, Glasgow’s Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum has pulled centuries-old Egyptian mummies from public view, citing a lack of "informed consent" from the deceased. Guided by a new policy, museum authorities determined that displaying preserved body parts, including a mummified head, foot, and hand, without documented permission from the individuals fails to meet modern ethical standards. However, the decision has ignited fierce backlash online, with people questioning the logic of seeking consent from people who died thousands of years ago.The matter came into public view through a tweet. A father claimed that he visited the museum to show his daughter the mummies but was met with a note stating that the displays had been removed.He also shared a picture of the note that read, “We have removed human remains from this display as a mark of respect.”Glasgow Life, the charitable organisation behind the museum, told the Scottish Sun that the decision “reflects contemporary museum practice”. The human remains were once among the main attractions at the Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum in Glasgow.Why did the museum remove the display?“The removal of human remains from display at Glasgow Life museums reflects contemporary museum practice,” said a Glasgow Life spokesman.“Glasgow Life Museums’ draft Human Remains Policy proposes that human remains should only be displayed where there is documented and informed consent from the deceased individual or, in appropriate circumstances, their descendants.”The spokesperson stated, “In the absence of such consent, we believe removing ancient Egyptian human remains from display is more respectful to the deceased individuals.”Critics slam decision“This is more virtue-signalling, woke nonsense,” Chris McGovern, chairman of the Campaign for Real Education and a former adviser to the Policy Unit at 10 Downing Street, told the Daily Mail.McGovern continued, “‘It represents the triumph of educational stupidity and ignorance. It is not possible to seek permission from those who died thousands of years ago,” adding, “Visitors to Scottish museums, children in particular, deserve better – they are being short-changed.”Scottish Conservative culture spokesman, Murdo Frase, told the Scottish Sun, “This is woke madness at its most ridiculous.”“Even Egyptian mummies are now being cancelled by a society so obsessed with modern sensibilities that it has lost all sense of perspective.”Frase pointed out that people visit museums to learn about ancient civilisations, not to see history hidden away.“Glasgow’s museums should be showcasing our history, not quietly removing it to appease the latest trend in political correctness.”What was removed?The items that were removed from public view included a painted sarcophagus containing the skeletal remains of the priest Nekht. It also had a mummified head and a mummified right hand.

title: Asian Para Games: Harvinder Singh, Vijay Sundi bring gold in archery recurve; Nitesh Kumar beats Pramod Bhagat in all-Indian badminton final | Hindustan Times
description: India's gold medal tally at the ongoing Asian Para Games has risen to 25. They have also won 32 silver medals and 42 bronze medals.
content: The gold rush for India at the Asian Para Games continues. On Friday morning, Harvinder Singh and debutant Vijay Sundi created history by clinching the gold medal in the men's recurve doubles event. The pair defeated the Chinese duo of Yun Duo and Zhao Lixue 5-1. Minutes later, Nitesh Kumar brought another gold medal by beating Pramod Bhagat in the all-Indian men's singles SL3 badminton final. Naveen Sivakumar also clinched gold in his SL4 badminton contest.Meanwhile, in the men's 400m T64 final, Sandeep set a new record with a time of 52.28 seconds to take gold.India's gold medal tally at the ongoing Asian Para Games has risen to 25. They have also won 32 silver medals and 42 bronze medals. Speaking of the recurve final, India and China shared the opening set after both sides shot 35. However, the Indian pair took control from there on, winning the second set 37-36 and the third 38-36 to seal the title and win the contest 5-1 on set points.Also Read: Anahat Singh beats sixth-seed Salma Hany in a thrilling match to reach Silicon Valley Open semifinalsThe Chinese pair proved no match for the Indian duo, and Harvinder and Vijay had no trouble in sealing the gold medal. Harvinder had lost the use of his legs due to complications from dengue treatment. He was inspired by the 2012 London Paralympics and decided to take up archery. His international debut came in the 2017 Para Archery World Championship, where he finished seventh. His first major achievement came in 2018, when he won gold at the Para Asian Games.Harvinder then made history by winning India’s first Paralympic archery medal (bronze) in Tokyo, and later improved the colour of his medal at the next Paralympics by clinching gold in Paris. He was also honoured with the Padma Shri award in 2025.Nitesh prevailsIn the badminton final between Nitesh and Pramod, the former came out on top 21-18, 21-16 to clinch gold. With the loss, Pramod took home silver, making it a one-two finish for India. On the other hand, Naveen defeated Indonesia's Fredy Setiawan 21-9, 21-17 in 36 minutes to claim the top prize.Earlier, Bhawna and Pooja had secured India’s first-ever medal in the Women’s Recurve Doubles event at the Asian Para Games. The duo lost 0-6 to China in the gold medal match, going down 31-38, 30-35, 29-39 in the three-set encounter. India's Parmod also added another silver, clocking 4:09.65 to finish second in the men’s 1500m T46. This was his second successive silver at the Asian Para Games.

title: Rani Mukerji’s metallic grey saree look with bold statement glasses at Sabyasachi’s Diwali reception is a lesson in modern festive dressing | Fashion Trends
description: At Sabyasachi’s Diwali reception in New York, Rani Mukerji paired a fluid metallic-grey saree with a matching plunging-neck blouse and chic accessories.  | Fashion Trends
content: Rani Mukerji is here to show us how to drape a saree with a touch of contemporary glamour this festive season. The actor attended Sabyasachi’s Diwali reception at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City, serving a look that was nothing short of breathtaking. In pictures shared on Instagram by anonymous fashion critic Diet Sabya and American actor and author Kal Penn, Rani can be seen looking radiant in a metallic grey saree. Understated yet striking, her ensemble is a masterclass in festive dressing. Let’s decode her look and take away a few style notes for the season. (Also read: Nita Ambani and Radhika Merchant embrace Gujarat’s rich textile heritage in vibrant Bandhani outfits at Jamnagar Navratri celebration )Rani Mukerji stuns in metallic grey sareeOpting for a monochromatic metallic-grey palette, Rani made a striking style statement. She wore a liquid-grey satin saree that stood out for its lustrous finish and fluid drape. The fabric’s subtle sheen lent the classic six-yard silhouette a sleek, modern edge. She paired it with a sleeveless blouse featuring a plunging V-neckline in a matching steel-grey hue, creating a seamless monochromatic look. Rani’s accessories added an eclectic touch to the otherwise understated ensemble, striking a balance between vintage charm and modern styling. Bold, thick-framed black square glasses emerged as the defining accessory of her look. Adding a distinctive, intellectual edge, they offered an unexpected twist to traditional festive dressing. An ornate silver-embellished mini bag with a delicate chain strap added a hint of glamour, while delicate drop earrings, layered bracelets and a metallic wristwatch completed the look with just the right amount of shimmer.Beauty notes and fashion takeawaysRani’s beauty look complemented the cool-toned ensemble. A vibrant red lip added warmth and drama, standing out beautifully against the metallic-grey saree. Her brown-highlighted hair was styled in loose, voluminous waves with a side parting, cascading over one shoulder. A softly glowing complexion and neutral eye makeup kept the overall look polished.With this appearance, Rani makes a compelling case for giving traditional sarees a contemporary update. A fluid metallic drape, thoughtfully chosen accessories and classic beauty details are all it takes to create a look that feels sophisticated without being overdone. Her ensemble is a reminder that festive dressing need not rely on heavy embellishments to make an impact; sometimes, a striking silhouette and considered styling do all the talking.

title: New GRAP actions failed to curb Delhi-NCR pollution in 10 of 12 episodes, reveals study | Latest News Delhi
description: Winter AQI has also shown no consistent improvement, raising concerns about the plan’s effectiveness and the timing of its measures.  | Latest News Delhi
content: A day after stage-1 of the Graded Response Action Plan (Grap) was invoked across Delhi NCR, an analysis of the revised Grap since 2022 has shown the emergency-based plan has failed to curb episodic spikes across Delhi-NCR – with pollution levels rising in 10 out of the 12 instances since 2022 when stages 3 and 4 of the plan were invoked.Carried out by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA), the assessment looked at the mean air quality index (AQI) in the seven days before the episode began and compared it with the mean in the seven days after it – finding the AQI was higher in the following week in 10 of the 12 episodes and it declined in only two instances. Essentially, pollution spikes from dangerously alarming levels – over 400, start to dip a week after strict emergency-based measures are invoked. To be sure, the report does not take into account fluctuations in weather that may have improved or worsened the pollution crisis.Stage 3 of Grap is supposed to be invoked when the AQI is forecast to cross 400, while stage 4 measures are supposed to kick in ahead of the AQI touching 450. The stages – Grap has four in all – involve progressively stricter curbs, such as raising parking fees and staggered office timings in stage 2; halting non-essential construction and the plying of private four-wheelers that are BS-3 petrol and BS-4 diesel or lower in stage 3; and the toughest -- banning entry of trucks into Delhi, heavy goods vehicles below BS-4 and stopping all construction or demolition at the highest stage.Also Read | Entry restrictions, WhatsApp group: Delhi traffic police plans to curb air pollution“The largest increase followed the November 2, 2023 episode, when mean AQI rose from 317 the before November 2 – to 431 after it, an increase of 114 points,” said the analysis, flagging other substantial increases on October 29, 2022 episode (+100 points), on January 3, 2025 (+94 points) and the January 28, 2025 episode, when the AQI rose by an average of 92 points in the subsequent seven days.“The broader pattern is that pollution often remained high or increased in the week after Delhi entered the severe Grap stages. The day-by-day analysis tells a similar story. Across the 12 episodes, average AQI reached around 25% above the preceding seven-day average on the first and second days after escalation. By the seventh day, it remained around 15% above that baseline,” it added.Manoj Kumar, analyst at CREA, who led the analyis, said the entire premise of Grap remains to control episodic events but data suggests it has failed to do that. “The immediate dip in AQI, which is envisaged around Grap does not happen, as data shows AQI in most cases, even after upgrading to a higher stage of Grap, has not yielded positive results immediately. This happens only after a week or so has passed,” he said, stating exposure by then remains fairly high and can impact people’s health both in the short and long-term.Also Read | Delhi winter pollution curbs: Real estate developers seek balanced approach to construction bans, warn of project delays and rising costsThe assessment also looked at the pollution levels across the winter period from 2022 till 2026, finding no significant change in AQI, or improvement in the longer-term.“Delhi’s winter AQI has fluctuated over the past four years, with no consistent improvement. The mean AQI rose from 280 in winter 2022–23 to 304 in 2023–24, fell to 285 in 2024–25 and increased again to 295 in 2025–26. The median AQI followed a similar pattern, rising from 294 to 324, falling to 289 and then increasing to 305,” the assessment said, flagging the highest pollution levels to still be a concern, despite Grap being in place. “The 90th-percentile AQI, which indicates the level below which 90% of daily readings fall, was 377 in 2022–23, 400 in 2023–24, 396 in 2024–25 and 390 in 2025–26,” it said.Grap saw a major overhaul in 2022, with an aim to turn a reactive tool into a preventive framework. It introduced four AQI-based stages – Stage 1 (Poor), Stage 2 (Very Poor), Stage 3 (Severe) and Stage 4 (Severe Plus) – and required pre-emptive action. It is invoked by a sub-committee under the Commision for Air Quality Management (CAQM) in NCR.Experts have consistently held that Grap continues to falter on the pre-emptive action aspect. Complicating timely announcement is the lack of accurate forecasting. HT had last winter, flagged multiple instances of the Air Quality Early Warning System (AQEWS) failing to predict accurately for the next day.Also Read | BMC flags sodium chloride as pollution contributor; city records unhealthy air 10 days this month“The problem around efficacy remains as Grap and its stages are not imposed three days in advance. At the same time, since forecasts are not accurate and one sees AQI deteriorating suddenly, even when the forecast tells a different story,” said Sunil Dahiya, founder and lead analyst at Envirocatalyts. Dahiya added with meteorological conditions remaining unfavourable and wind speed slow during the winter months, it can take days for pollutants to disperse around the larger airshed. “This is why we need more measures in NCR and not just Delhi. At the same time, we need measures in advance. This winter, we have seen the Delhi government announce a host of measures in advance, but at the same time, we need similar action in NCR,” he added.

title: Yamuna toxic foam: Why is the river covered with glacier-like layers of froth? | India News
description: The Delhi Jal Board (DJB) will initiate the spraying of chemical defoaming agents in the coming weeks to control froth formation ahead of the Chhath festival. | India News
content: A thick layer of toxic white froth has once again covered stretches of the Yamuna near Kalindi Kunj as falling temperatures and churning of water intensify foaming on the river’s surface.As the wind blows, cloud-like segments of froth roll over the surface, while devotees could be seen praying along the banks of the highly polluted river on Thursday, once again highlighting the plight of the dying river. Over the next month, froth formation, as well as the politics around the phenomenon, will intensify as Delhi approaches Chhath festival.Also Read I Toxic froth returns to Yamuna, AAP alleges tender irregularities in anti-froth driveWhat causes the froth?The froth bubbles are caused by surfactant (soap-like) molecules. When water falls from a height at the nearby Okhla barrage, it leads to the churning of polluted water and increased frothing. Froth formation in the Yamuna intensifies during winter, when temperatures drop and the bubbles formed by the churning of polluted water at the Okhla barrage become much more stable.There are biological, physical and chemical causes behind the formation. They can originate from detergents and surfactants in untreated domestic sewage, industrial pollutants, dhobi ghats, as well as materials released by the decomposition of dying water hyacinth weeds. Bhim Singh Rawat, a Yamuna activist and member of the South Asia Network on Dams, Rivers and People (SANDRP), said that low temperatures and the stabilisation of froth were among the factors behind the intensification of foam formation. However, he said, the phenomenon reflected the extremely poor state of the Yamuna.Chemical defoaming and the state of the riverThe Delhi Jal Board (DJB) will initiate the spraying of chemical defoaming agents in the coming weeks to control froth formation ahead of the Chhath festival.The defoaming drive was started four years ago, following a joint meeting with the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) to control froth formation in October 2022. However, there have been controversies over its use. A defoamer, or an anti-foaming agent, is a chemical additive that reduces foam formation in industrial process liquids. Rawat said that attempts to spray defoaming agents were merely an effort to treat the symptoms. “The reality is that the river water is extremely polluted and the river is ecologically dead at this point. From the rampant use of surfactants to industrial waste, the problem has only become more aggravated over the last decade,” he added.Last year, a study conducted by The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) and commissioned by the Delhi government to identify the reasons and sources behind excessive froth formation in the river also flagged the poor functioning of the city’s existing sewage treatment plants (STPs) and common effluent treatment plants (CETPs).Also Read I Union minister Shah launches 43 projects aimed at Yamuna clean-upThe report stated that surfactants from known anthropogenic sources, along with saponins released by water hyacinth (Eichhornia crassipes), were combining to create froth in the river. During the last winter season, the DJB used a record 48,000 kilograms of defoaming chemicals over a period of 63 days between October and December 2025 as part of the Delhi government’s anti-froth drive around the Chhath festival.
