title: CJP leaders skip police probe summons, likely to get fresh notice | Latest News Delhi
description: Police plan to issue fresh notices. Ranka and Das were released after agreeing to conditions, including no protests at the site until it is re-notified.  | Latest News Delhi
content: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-convenors Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das did not appear after being summoned to join the police probe in two cases against them and will be issued another notice in the matter, said officials aware of the matter.A senior police officer said that the Delhi Police crime branch had issued a notice to Das, Ranka, and CJP member Ajinkya Shinde to join the probe on Thursday. “Earlier, they asked for a time extension and later, they didn’t come,” said one officer.“Another notice to join the probe will be sent to all three of them,” the officer added without giving details on when that might happen.CJP did not respond to HT’s requests for comment.Also Read | 'Not involved with CJP's protest call': Neha Bora to Delhi HC on Oct 16 detentionJantar Mantar Protest and FIRsOn October 13, Ranka, Das, and Shinde, along with 10 other CJP members, scaled an iron gate and entered the de-notified Jantar Mantar protest site. They were detained within minutes. While the others were released within 24 hours, Das and Ranka were arrested in connection with a bond they had signed on October 11, which required them to maintain peace for a year, police said.HT had reported that one FIR had been registered at Connaught Place police station because Janpath Lane, from where they entered, is under the jurisdiction of the station. The second FIR has been registered at Parliament Street police station because that’s where the breach and alleged assault on police officials trying to stop them took place.Also Read | 'Barricades have a purpose': Delhi HC pulls up Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, cites arson outside IndiaCustody and Release UndertakingsOn October 14, SEM sent the duo to five days of judicial custody after the Delhi Police argued that “there was a presumption that the accused might carry out a crime” if released. Their custody was extended for another two days on Monday and the SEM ordered their release on Wednesday after they signed an undertaking not to call any protests at Jantar Mantar until the site is re-notified as a designated protest site.In it, they also promised “not to commit any breach of peace” and expressed “full faith” in the judiciary and the SEM court. The undertakings further reiterated that any protest undertaken by them would be done “within the four corners of the constitution”.The magistrate directed the two leaders to strictly comply with their undertakings and bonds and appear at every hearing. They have also been asked to appear with their sureties on October 23, when the police must submit a verification report on the sureties furnished by them.

title: Stock market : ట్రేడర్స్ అలర్ట్- నేటి స్టాక్స్ టు బై లిస్ట్ ఇదే.. | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: అక్టోబర్ 23, 2026 ట్రేడర్లు నేడు ట్రాక్​ చేయాల్సిన స్టాక్స్​ టు బై  లిస్ట్​ని నిపుణులు వెల్లడించారు. వీటితో పాటు లేటెస్ట్​ స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​ అప్డేట్స్​, ముడి చమురు ధర వివరాలను ఇక్కడ తెలుసుకోండి..
content: గురువారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​ని దేశీయ స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు స్వల్ప నష్టాల్లో ముగించాయి. బీఎస్​ఈ సెన్సెక్స్​ 460 పాయింట్లు పడి 73,249 వద్ద స్థిరపడింది. నిఫ్టీ50.. 124 పాయింట్లు కోల్పోయి 22,688 వద్ద సెషన్​ని ముగించింది. ఇక బ్యాంక్​ నిఫ్టీ 51 పాయింట్లు పడి 54,926 వద్దకు చేరింది.ఎఫ్​ఐఐలు.. డీఐఐలు..గురువారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​లో ఎఫ్​ఐఐలు రూ. 3,458.70 కోట్లు విలువ చేసే షేర్లను విక్రయించారు. అదే సమయంలో డీఐఐలు రూ. 2,891.32 కోట్లు విలువ చేసే షేర్లను కొనుగోలు చేశారు.ఈరోజు స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​ ఎలా ఉండబోతోంది?ఇక శుక్రవారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​ని దేశీయ స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​ లాభాల్లో ప్రారంభించే అవకాశం ఉంది. గిఫ్ట్​ నిఫ్టీ దాదాపు 165 పాయింట్ల లాభంలో ఉండటం ఇందుకు కారణం.“నిఫ్టీ50కి కీలకమైన 20-డీఎంఏ వద్ద బలమైన అమ్మకాల ఒత్తిడి ఎదురవుతోంది. దానిని సూచీ అధిగమించలేకపోతోంది. ప్రస్తుతం నిఫ్టీ50కి 22,600 వద్ద కీలకమైన సపోర్ట్ ఉంది. అది బ్రేక్ అయితే ఇంకా పడే అవకాశం ఉంది. ప్రస్తుతం ట్రేడర్లు జాగ్రత్త వహించి, లెవల్ అధారిత ట్రేడింగ్​ చేయాలి,” అని ఎల్​కేపీ సెక్యూరిటీస్​కి చెందిన టెక్నికల్ ఎనలిస్ట్ వత్సల్ భువ తెలిపారు.Emergency fund investment : రూ. 10లక్షల ఎమర్జెన్సీ ఫండ్.. ఎక్కడ ఇన్వెస్ట్​ చేయడం బెటర్?అమెరికా స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు..గురువారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​ని అమెరికా స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు ఫ్లాట్​గా ముగించాయి. డౌ జోన్స్​ 0.02 శాతం పెరిగింది. కానీ ఎస్​ అండ్​ పీ 500​ 1.21శాతం పడింది. టెక్​ ఇండెక్స్​ నాస్​డాక్ 2.6 శాతం డౌన్​ అయ్యింది.ఆసియా స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు శుక్రవారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​లో నష్టాల్లో కొనసాగుతున్నాయి.ముడి చమురు ధర..అంతర్జాతీయ మార్కెట్​లో ముడి చమురు ధర భగభగలాడుతోంది. బ్రెంట్ క్రూడ్ 0.8శాతం పెరిగి బ్యారెల్​కు 114 డాలర్ల వద్ద కొనసాగుతోంది.స్టాక్స్​ టు బై..ఇండ్​హోటల్- బై రూ. 785, స్టాప్​ లాస్​ రూ. 750, టార్గెట్​ రూ. 855క్రిసిల్- బై రూ. 4780, స్టాప్​ లాస్​ రూ. 4550, టార్గెట్​ రూ. 5280ఫెడరల్ బ్యాంక్- బై సీఎంపీ, స్టాప్​ లాస్​ రూ. 336, టార్గెట్​ రూ. 368(గమనిక:- ఇవి నిపుణుల అభిప్రాయాలు మాత్రమే. హిందుస్థాన్​ టైమ్స్​ తెలుగుకు ఎలాంటి సంబంధం లేదు. ఏదైనా ట్రేడ్​ తీసుకునే ముందు ట్రేడర్లకు సొంతంగా ఎనాలసిస్​ ఉండటం శ్రేయస్కరం.)

title: అక్టోబర్ 30న కేంద్రం దృష్టి యోగంతో డబుల్ బెనిఫిట్స్ పొందనున్న 5 రాశులు | Hindustan Times Telugu

విజయవంతంగా పూర్తి చేస్తారు. అంతేకాకుండా మేష రాశి వారికి వారు ఇష్టపడే ఉద్యోగం పొందే అవకాశం ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. దీనితో పాటు వ్యాపారం చేసే మేష రాశి వారికి కూడా కొన్ని మంచి అవకాశాలు లభించే అవకాశం ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. అలాగే ఈ కాలంలో మేష రాశి వారు సంపద నుండి అద్భుతమైన లాభాలను పొందగలుగుతారు.మిథున రాశిమిథున రాశిలో జన్మించిన వారికి కేంద్ర దృష్టి యోగం ఏర్పడటం చాలా శుభప్రదం. ఈ సందర్భంలో మీడియా, మార్కెటింగ్, ఐటీ, బ్యాంకింగ్ రంగాలలో పనిచేసే మిథున రాశి వారు అపారమైన విజయాన్ని సాధిస్తారు. అంతేకాకుండా ఈ కాలంలో మీ జీతం పెరగడానికి చాలా మంచి అవకాశం లభిస్తుంది. మీకు మంచి ఉద్యోగం చేసే అవకాశం కూడా లభిస్తుంది. దీనితో పాటు మీ గౌరవం, కీర్తి బాగా పెరుగుతాయి. అదేవిధంగా మిథున రాశి వారికి ఈ కాలంలో కొత్త వాహనం కొనుగోలు చేసే అవకాశం కూడా లభిస్తుంది.కన్యా రాశిబుధ, కుజ గ్రహాల వల్ల ఏర్పడే ప్రత్యేక కేంద్ర దృష్టి యోగం కన్యారాశిలో జన్మించిన వారికి అద్భుతమైన ప్రయోజనాలను చేకూరుస్తుంది. ఈ నేపథ్యంలో కన్యారాశిలో జన్మించిన వారు చాలా కాలంగా పదోన్నతి కోసం ఎదురుచూస్తుంటే ఈ కాలంలో వారికి పదోన్నతికి సంబంధించిన శుభవార్త అందే అవకాశాలు పెరుగుతాయి. అదేవిధంగా కేంద్ర దృష్టి యోగం ప్రత్యేక అనుగ్రహం వల్ల కన్యారాశిలో జన్మించిన వారు తమ ఆదాయాన్ని పెంచుకోవడానికి కొత్త మార్గాలను కనుగొంటారు. ఈ కాలంలో మీ జీతంలో గణనీయమైన పెరుగుదలతో పాటు అనేక శుభ ఫలితాలు పొందే అవకాశం ఉంటుంది. అంతేకాకుండా బుధ, కుజ గ్రహాల ఆశీస్సుల వల్ల, కన్యారాశిలో జన్మించిన వారికి ఈ కాలంలో ఆకస్మిక ఆర్థిక లాభాలు పొందే అవకాశం కూడా లభిస్తుంది.వృశ్చిక రాశివృశ్చిక రాశిలో జన్మించిన వారికి కేంద్ర దృష్టి యోగం ఏర్పడటం ఒక వరం వంటిది. బుధ, కుజ గ్రహాల ప్రత్యేక కలయిక వల్ల ఏర్పడే ఈ యోగం, పని ప్రదేశంలో మీ పనిని అందరూ ప్రశంసించేలా చేస్తుంది. అందువల్ల వృశ్చిక రాశిలో జన్మించిన వారికి వారి కార్యాలయంలో ఉన్నత పదవిని సాధించే అవకాశం ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. అంతేకాకుండా ఈ కాలంలో ఏదైనా ఒక పెద్ద కోరిక నెరవేరడం వల్ల వృశ్చిక రాశి వారికి మనసు మరింత ఆనందంగా ఉంటుంది. ఈ కాలంలో ప్రయాణాలు చేయడం ద్వారా మంచి లాభాలు సంపాదించడంలో కూడా మీరు గొప్ప విజయాన్ని పొందుతారు. అంతేకాకుండా వృశ్చిక రాశి వారికి వ్యాపారం, వాణిజ్యానికి సంబంధించిన ఏదైనా పెద్ద అవకాశం లభించే అవకాశం ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. దీనితో పాటు ఈ కాలంలో వృశ్చిక రాశి వారు మరింత ఆనందాన్ని పొందగలుగుతారు.మకర రాశిమకర రాశిలో జన్మించిన వారికి బుధ, కుజ గ్రహాల కలయిక కారణంగా ఏర్పడే కేంద్ర దృష్టి యోగం, కొత్త వ్యాపార వాణిజ్య రంగంలో అనేక మంచి అవకాశాలను కల్పిస్తుంది. అంతేకాకుండా ఈ యోగం శుభ ప్రభావం వల్ల మీలో ధైర్యం, ఆత్మవిశ్వాసం పెరుగుతాయి. దీనికి అదనంగా పాత పెట్టుబడులు లేదా పని నుండి ఆకస్మిక ఆర్థిక లాభాలు వచ్చే అవకాశం ఉంటుంది. అంతేకాక కార్యాలయంలో సహోద్యోగులు, ఉన్నతాధికారుల నుండి పూర్తి మద్దతు లభించడం వల్ల మీరు అసంపూర్తిగా ఉన్న పనిని విజయవంతంగా పూర్తి చేయగలుగుతారు. దీనితో పాటు మీ కొత్త ఆదాయాన్ని పెంచుకోవడానికి అనేక కొత్త మార్గాలు లభించడం వల్ల description: Illu Illalu Pillalu Serial October 23rd Episode: ఇల్లు ఇల్లాలు పిల్లలు సీరియల్ టుడే అక్టోబర్ 23వ ఎపిసోడ్‌లో 30 లక్షల ఒక్క రూపాయికి ట్రావెల్ ఏజెన్సీ ధీరజ్‌కు వస్తుంది. 12 లక్షల ప్రాపర్టీని 30 లక్షలకు పాడించానని భద్రావతి చెబుతుంది. చందుకు భోజనం తీసుకెళ్లిన వల్లి క్షమించమని కాళ్లు పట్టుకుంటుంది.
content: Illu Illalu Pillalu Serial Today Episode: ఇల్లు ఇల్లాలు పిల్లలు ఈరోజు ఎపిసోడ్‌లో వేలం పాటలో రూ. 30 లక్షల ఒక్క రూపాయికి ధీరజ్ సొంతం చేసుకున్నట్లు ప్రకటిస్తారు. అంతా చప్పట్లు కొడతారు. ధీరజ్ మనం గెలిచామురా అని ప్రేమ గొప్పలు పోతుంది. నా భర్తను ఎవరిముందు ఓడిపోనివ్వను. గెలిపించాను అని భద్రావతితో అంటుంది ప్రేమ.12 లక్షలదానికి 30 లక్షలునేను ఓడిపోవడం కాదే కావాలనే ఇరికించాను. రూ. 12 లక్షలు కూడా విలువ చేయనిదాన్ని 30 లక్షలు కట్టేలా చేశాను. వీడి మొహానికి ఎక్కడి నుంచి కడతాడు 30 లక్షలు. అంటే 18 లక్షలు నష్టం. నేనే గెలిచినట్లుగా అని భద్రావతి అంటుంది. సర్ క్యాష్ ఎలా ఇస్తారు అని వేలం పాట వాళ్లు అడుగుతారు. కట్టేందుకు టైమ్ ఉంటుంది కదా అని ప్రేమ అంటుంది.ఉంటుంది కానీ చూసుకోవాలి. ఆలోపు కట్టకపోతే ఐదు లక్షలు పెనాల్టీ పడుతుందని వాళ్లు చెబుతారు. ధీరజ్, ప్రేమ వెళ్లిపోతారు. భద్రావతి మరో కొత్త ఆట మొదలుపెడుతుంది. సరికొత్త ఆట అని అనుకుంటుంది. రైస్ మిల్లుకు శ్రీవల్లి లంచ్ తీసుకొస్తుంది. వల్లిని చూసి చందు కోపంతో ఊగిపోతాడు. నిన్ను చిన్న మాట అంటేనే తిండితిప్పలు మానేస్తావ్. నీకోసం భోజనం తెచ్చాను తిందువురా బావ అని వల్లి అంటుంది.నన్ను చంపేందుకు భోజనంలో విషం కలిపావా అని చందు అంటాడు. వల్లి షాక్ అవుతుంది. ధీరజ్, ప్రేమలను విడగొట్టావ్. ఎన్నో చేశావ్. ఇన్ని చేసిన నీకు నా ప్రాణాలు తీయడం పెద్ద లెక్కా అని చందు అంటాడు. అలా అనకు బా నువ్వంటే నాకు ప్రాణం. అవసరం అయితే నీకోసం చస్తాను బావ అని వల్లి అంటుంది. నీ మీద కోపంతో చంపినా చంపేస్తాను. వెళ్లిపో అని చందు అంటాడు.చందు కాళ్లు పట్టుకున్న వల్లిచంపేయ్ బావ. కానీ, చంపేముందు నన్ను క్షమించు. ముఖ్యంగా నేను ఎన్ని తప్పులు చేసిన సరే నీ మీద ప్రేమ ఉందని గుర్తించు అని చందు కాళ్లు పట్టుకుంటుంది వల్లి. కోపంతో శ్రీవల్లిని పక్కకు తోసేస్తాడు చందు. అంతా చూస్తారు. రామరాజు, తిరుపతి వస్తారు. వల్లిని లేపుతారు. అందరిని పంపిస్తాడు రామరాజు. ఆయన తినకుండా బాధపడతారని భోజనం తీసుకొచ్చానని వల్లి ఏడుస్తుంది.ఏడుస్తూ నటిస్తున్నావా. తడిగుడ్డతో గొంతు కోసే రకమే నువ్వు. ఇంకోసారి ఇలా వస్తే ఊరుకోను అని వార్నింగ్ ఇచ్చి వెళ్లిపోతాడు చందు. నేను చేసిన తప్పులకు పశ్చాత్తాప పడుతున్నాను. అందుకే కేసు వాపసు తీసుకున్నా. కన్నీళ్లతో కాలిపోతున్నాను. ఒక తండ్రిగా నాకు అవకాశం ఇవ్వండని వల్లి వేడుకుంటుంది. ఎలా అమ్మా. ఇప్పటికే నావాళ్లు రెండుసార్లు అవకాశం ఇచ్చారు. దానిని నిలబెట్టుకోలేదని రామరాజు అంటాడు.నా పెద్ద కోడలు దేవత అని పిచ్చోడిలా నమ్మాను. నిన్ను పెళ్లి చేసి నా పెద్ద కొడుకుకు బాధ కలిగించానని ఇప్పటికీ ఉంది అని రామరాజు అంటాడు. తిరుపతికి చెప్పి ఇంటిదగ్గర వదిలేయమంటాడు రామరాజు. మరోవైపు కూరగాయలు తీసుకొస్తాడు ఇడ్లీ బాబాయ్. ఏయ్ లుంగీ మాస్టర్ త్వరగా వంట చేయమని భాగ్యం అంటుంది. వల్లి ఎక్కడికెళ్లిందని ఇడ్లీ బాబాయ్ అడుగుతాడు.నా లుంగీ చిరిగిపోతుందిపోయినదానికి తెలియదా రావడం అని భాగ్యం అంటుంది. నీకేంటే ఆ ఎస్సై వస్తే నా లుంగీ చిరిగిపోతుందని ఇడ్లీ బాబాయ్ భయపడతాడు. వస్తే రానివ్వు ఏమవుద్దని భాగ్యం అంటుంది. ఇంతలోనే ఎస్సై వస్తుంది. వల్లి ఉందా. ఓసారి పిలవండని ఎస్సై అడుగుతుంది. నేను కూరగాయలకు వెళ్లాను. ఈయనే ఉన్నారు. ఏమయ్యా అమ్మడిని పిలు అని భర్తనే ఇరికిస్తుంది భాగ్యం.నేను ఎన్నో మోసాలు చూశాను కానీ ఇది చూల్లేదని ఇడ్లీ బాబాయ్ గొణుగుతాడు. మా వల్లి లోపల రెస్ట్ తీసుకుంటుంది. డిస్టర్బ్ చేయకండని మరీ మరీ చెప్పిందని ఇడ్లీ బాబాయ్ అంటాడు. వల్లిని ఓసారి చూసి వెళ్తానని లోపలికి వెళ్తుంది ఎస్సై. శ్రీవల్లిని తిరుపతి దింపుతాడు. మీరు చాలా మంచి మనిషి. నా స్వార్థానికి మిమ్మల్ని కూడా బలి చేశాను. రూ. 6 లక్షల విషయంలో మిమ్మల్ని దొంగను చేశాను. వీలైతే క్షమించండని వల్లి అంటుంది.నాకు అక్క బావే దేవుడు. వాళ్లను మోసం చేశావన్న బాధ తప్పితే నన్ను దొంగని చేశావనే కోపం లేదు. వీలైతే మారు. అప్పుడప్పుడు నర్మదకు కనిపించు. తనే నీ విషయంలో హెల్ప్ చేయగలదు. నా పెద్ద అల్లుడు జీవితాంతం ఒంటరిగా మిగిలిపోకూడదని అని తిరుపతి చెబుతాడు. వల్లి ఇంట్లోకి వెళ్తుంది. ఇడ్లీ బాబాయ్‌ని కొట్టి వల్లి ఎక్కడ అని కోప్పడుతుంది ఎస్సై.ప్రేమను గెంటేసిన ధీరజ్ఇంతలో వల్లి వస్తుంది. రైస్ మిల్లుకు వెళ్లినట్లు చెబుతుంది. అర్థం చేసుకోగలనని ఎస్సై అంటుంది. ఇడ్లీ బాబాయ్‌కి వార్నింగ్ ఇచ్చి వెళ్లిపోతుంది ఎస్సై. మరోవైపు లగేజ్ సర్ది ప్రేమను గెంటేస్తాడు ధీరజ్. మొన్న వల్లిని, ఇవాళ ప్రేమను. రేపు నర్మదను గెంటేస్తారా. ఈ ఇల్లు కోడళ్లను గెంటేసే ఇల్లుగా మారుతోందని సుకన్య గోల చేస్తుంది.వేదవతి ఒక్కటిచ్చి అశుభాలు మాట్లాడకని తిడుతుంది. ఏమైందని ధీరజ్‌ను అడుగుతుంది వేదవతి. దాని తింగరితనంతో ఏం చేసిందో దాన్నే అడగండని ధీరజ్ అంటాడు. పాటపాడినందుకే చిందులు తొక్కుతున్నాడు. అద్భుతంగా పాడాను. ట్రావెల్ ఏజెన్సీ మనకే వచ్చిందని ప్రేమ చెబుతుంది. ధీరజ్‌ని తిడుతుంది వేదవతి. రూ. 12 లక్షల ప్రాపర్టీని 30 లక్షలకు పాడిందని ధీరజ్ చెబుతాడు.ఈ బేబీ చూసుకుంటుందిగాదాంతో అంతా షాక్ అవుతారు. వేదవతి కళ్లుతిరిగిపోతుంది. చూడు ధీరజ్ వామ్మో 30 లక్షలా అంటే భయమేస్తుంది. 30 లక్షలు అంతేనా అనుకుంటే ఏం కాదని ప్రేమ చెబుతుంది. ఇది వీళ్ల బాదంకాయ్ భద్రావతి కచేరి పాడినట్లు పోటీగా పాడుకుంటూ వెళ్లారు. నేను చెప్పినా వినలేదు. అంత డబ్బు ఎవరు కడతారు. దీని బాబు ఆ అని ధీరజ్ అంటాడు. బాబుదాకా అవసరం లేదు. ఈ బేబీ చాలని ప్రేమ అంటుంది. అక్కడితో నేటి ఇల్లు ఇల్లాలు పిల్లలు సీరియల్ ఎపిసోడ్ ముగుస్తుంది.

title: Water supply to south, central Delhi may be disrupted due to annual canal maintenance | Latest News Delhi
description: NDMC warns that several south and central Delhi areas may see reduced or disrupted supply, and changes in water taste, until November 8, 2026.  | Latest News Delhi
content: Water supply to parts of south and central Delhi may be disrupted up to November 8 due to annual maintenance and repair of the Upper Ganga Canal, which supplies raw water to two key water treatment plants, senior officials of the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) said on Thursday.Areas that may be impacted include Bharti Nagar, Golf Links, Lodhi Estate, Khan Market, Rabindra Nagar, parts of Lodhi Road, High Court, Bapa Nagar, Pandara Road, Jor Bagh, parts of Lodhi Colony, BK Dutt Colony, Amrita Shergil Marg, parts of Janpath, Aliganj, parts of Prithviraj Road, Kidwai Nagar, Laxmibai Nagar, The President’s Estate, new PMO, and Kaka Nagar, the civic body stated.In an advisory, NDMC said water supply from Sonia Vihar WTP will be shut. “During this closure period, water will be supplied from the Yamuna River. Consequently, the taste of the supplied water may vary. Additionally, a reduction in water supply is expected in the affected areas and may continue until 8 November 2026,” it said.Also Read | Ganga Canal Undergoes 20-Day Cleaning Drive Ahead Of Kumbh Mela Festivities | HT IndiaOfficials said the annual work, carried out ahead of Diwali, also leads to increased turbidity in the water. The canal carries raw water to the Sonia Vihar and Bhagirathi water treatment plants, which supply 140 million gallon per day (mgd) and 110mgd water to central and south Delhi.A senior DJB official, who did not wish to be named, said, “People are still advised to keep back up as there may be occasional disruptions during the maintenance period. The taste of water can also witness a perceived change.”A second official, who also requested not to be named, said that over the past few days, the Uttar Pradesh irrigation department has been cleaning the Upper Ganga Canal, which has led to the suspension of raw water supply from the canal. “The maintenance usually lasts up to Diwali and fluctuation in water supply can be observed during this period. During this period, a small amount of raw water would still flow from the canal. We are in touch with the UP Irrigation Department to expedite the work,” the official said.Also Read | Ganga Canal to remain closed till Nov 8 for maintenance work, affecting water supply in UP, NCRDelhi receives a total of 256mgd of raw water from the Upper Ganga Canal in Uttar Pradesh, which flows from the Muradnagar regulator. Of this, 144mgd is supplied to the Sonia Vihar plant and 112mgd to the Bhagirathi plant.

title: Rakhi Sawant gets relief from UP court in 2010 abetment of suicide case, non-bailable warrant cancelled | Hindustan Times
description: The case against Rakhi Sawant relates to a man who appeared on her Rakhi Ka Insaaf show allegedly dying by suicide after she made remarks.
content: On Thursday, a court in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, cancelled a non-bailable warrant issued against Rakhi Sawant in a case related to alleged abetment of suicide. The actor and TV personality received relief after the court issued a warrant last week for failing to appear at hearings. The case relates to remarks made on her Rakhi Ka Insaaf TV show more than a decade ago.Non-bailable warrant on Rakhi Sawant cancelledAccording to PTI, a non-bailable warrant issued against Rakhi in a case related to the alleged abetment of the suicide of a 24-year-old man was cancelled on Thursday. It was following a plea citing a stay order passed by the Allahabad High Court. Advocate Ashu Singh, representing Rakhi, said the warrant was issued against her on October 16 by the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division).The defence subsequently moved an application seeking the cancellation of the warrant, submitting a copy of the high court order staying further proceedings in the matter, he said. The court of Civil Judge (Junior Division), Fast Track Court, cancelled the warrant based on the high court order, he added.Details of the case24-year-old Laxman Ahirwar, a resident of the Hansari area of Jhansi, allegedly died by suicide on November 10, 2010. His mother lodged a complaint against Rakhi at the Prem Nagar police station, alleging abetment to suicide. She claimed that her son was distressed following objectionable and humiliating remarks made by Rakhi on her show. The Allahabad High Court had stayed further proceedings in the case on December 7, 2011, until further orders, advocate Singh said.According to the prosecution, Laxman and his wife, Anita, who hailed from Rajgarh, had been invited to the show following marital discord. Anita had returned to her parental home after disputes between the couple. On October 16, a non-bailable warrant was issued against Rakhi in the case. District Government Counsel (Crime) Mridul Kant Srivastava said Civil Judge (Junior Division) Anjali had issued the warrant after Sawant repeatedly failed to appear before the court. The next hearing in the case had been scheduled for December 1.Rakhi was in the news lately for taking Sunita Ahuja’s side in her tiff with husband Govinda. She also remarked on his alleged relationship with co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar and said, “The woman who married you and gave birth to your two kids, who has been with you for 40 years, you left her. And who is this Komal?”

description: Podarillu Serial October 23rd Episode: పొదరిల్లు సీరియల్ అక్టోబర్ 23 ఎపిసోడ్ లో మహాకు కన్నా గురించి షాకింగ్ నిజం తెలుస్తుంది. అసలు నారాయణ అతని తండ్రే కాదని జమున చెబుతుంది. అటు నారాయణ విషయంలో దురుసుగా ఉన్న కన్నాకు మహా క్లాస్ పీకుతుంది.
content: Podarillu Serial Today Episode: స్టార్ మా సీరియల్ పొదరిల్లు ఈరోజు ఎపిసోడ్ మరోసారి రక్తి కట్టించేలా సాగింది. కన్నతల్లి కోసం పరితపించిపోతున్న కన్నాకు అసలు నిజం చెప్పకపోయినా.. నారాయణ విషయంలో అతడు చేస్తున్న తప్పు గురించి చెబుతూ మహా క్లాస్ పీకడం, చివరికి అసలు నారాయణ అతని తండ్రే కాదన్న నిజం మహా తెలుసుకోవడం పెద్ద ట్విస్టే ఇచ్చింది.కన్నాకు క్లాస్ పీకిన మహాఅందరూ బిర్యానీ పార్టీ చేసుకోవడంతో నారాయణకు కూడా మహా బిర్యానీ తీసుకెళ్లి ఇచ్చే సీన్ తో సీరియల్ శుక్రవారం (అక్టోబర్ 23) ఎపిసోడ్ మొదలైంది. కేశవ షాపు ఓనర్ కు డబ్బులివ్వడానికి అందరం వెళ్లాం.. నువ్వెందుకు రాలేదంటే నారాయణను మహా నిలదీస్తుంది. రూ.30 వేలు ఇచ్చి ఎందుకు బిల్డప్ ఇవ్వడమని నారాయణ అంటాడు. ఇద్దరూ కలిసి నవ్వుతూ మాట్లాడుకుంటుండగా కన్నా వస్తాడు.నారాయణ తన తల్లిని ఇంట్లో నుంచి వెళ్లగొట్టాడని, అలాంటి మనిషికి బిర్యానీ ఎందుకు అంటూ చేతిలోని ప్లేటు లాక్కొని పడేయడానికి వెళ్తాడు. దీంతో మహా అతనికి క్లాస్ పీకుతుంది. ఒక్క మెతుకు కింద పడినా.. నీకు మామూలుగా ఉండదు.. మీ అమ్మ వెళ్లిపోవడానికి ఆయనకు సంబంధం లేదని చెప్పాను కదా.. ఇంట్లోకి వెళ్లు అని అనడంతో కన్నా ప్లేటు తిరిగి ఇచ్చి వెళ్లిపోతాడు.మహాను నిలదీసిన కన్నా.. తిట్టిన అన్నలువాడి మాటలేమీ పట్టించుకోకు అని నారాయణకు చెప్పి మహా ఇంట్లోకి వెళ్తుంది. లోనికి వెళ్లగానే కన్నా ఆమెను నిలదీస్తాడు. నా బాధను నువ్వు అర్థం చేసుకోవడం లేదు.. నారాయణనే సపోర్ట్ చేస్తున్నావ్.. ఈ ఇంట్లో అందరికంటే నేనంటేనే నీకు ఇష్టమని అనుకున్నాను.. కానీ ఇలా చేస్తావని అనుకోలేదు అని కన్నా అంటాడు.మీ అమ్మ వెళ్లిపోవడానికి నారాయణకు ఎలాంటి సంబంధం లేదని ముందే చెప్పాను.. ఆమెను పంపించడం నువ్వు చూశావా.. నీకు తండ్రి అంటే గౌరవం లేదు.. అని మహా కూడా అంటుంది. అటు పెద్ది, చక్రి, కేశవ కూడా కన్నానే తిడతారు. వదినకే ఎదురు తిరిగి మాట్లాడతావా అని అంటారు. దీంతో కోపంతో మహా, ఆ తర్వాత కన్నా చెరో దిక్కుకి వెళ్లిపోతారు.కన్నాను ఓదార్చిన మాధవపెరట్లోకి వెళ్లిన కన్నా దగ్గరికి మాధవ వెళ్తాడు. అతన్ని ఓదారుస్తాడు. వదినతో అలా మాట్లాడటం తప్పు అని అంటాడు. వదిన మాత్రం నారాయణకే సపోర్ట్ చేస్తోంది.. నా బాధను అర్థం చేసుకోవడం లేదు.. ఆయన ఆ అమ్మను కూడా చంపాడు కదా అని కన్నా అంటాడు. నువ్వు చూశావా అని మాధవ అడుగుతాడు.అందరూ అనుకుంటున్నారు కదా అని కన్నా అంటాడు. అనుకోవడం వేరు, చూడటం వేరు.. అయినా చక్రి అన్నయ్య, మహా వదిన ఎప్పుడూ నీ ఆనందం కోసం ఆలోచిస్తారు.. నీకు సర్‌ప్రైజ్ ఇవ్వాలనే వెళ్లి మీ అమ్మను తీసుకొచ్చారు అని మాధవ సర్ది చెబుతాడు. అదంతా మహా వింటుంది.మహాకు జమున, ముకేష్ గురించి చెప్పిన చక్రిఇటు మహా గదిలోకి వెళ్లిన తర్వాత చక్రి ఆమె దగ్గరికి వెళ్తాడు. కన్నా మాటల గురించి పట్టించుకోవద్దని ఆమెకు చెబుతాడు. అదే సమయంలో జమున గురించి మరో షాకింగ్ నిజం చెబుతాడు. ఆమెతో పాటు ఓ వ్యక్తి ఉన్నాడని చెప్పాను కదా.. అతడు ఎవరో కాదు ఆమె భర్తే.. అతడు అస్సలు మంచివాడు కాదు.. ఆమెను కొడుతూనే ఉంటాడు.. ఊరంతా అప్పులు చేస్తాడని అక్కడి వాళ్లు చెప్పారు.. అసలు ఆ ఇద్దరి గురించి ఒక్కరు కూడా మంచిగా చెప్పలేదని చక్రి అంటాడు.దీంతో మహా షాక్ తింటుంది. ఇళ్లలో పనులు చేసుకుంటూ బతుకుతోంది.. ఇక్కడికి తీసుకొస్తే అందరితో ఆనందంగా ఉంటుంది కదా అనుకుంటే.. మరీ కొడుకు ఇంట్లోనే దొంగతనం చేసేంతలా దిగజారింది అని మహా అసహ్యించుకుంటుంది. ఆ తర్వాత చక్రి వెళ్లిపోతాడు.కేశవకు శైలు ఫోన్.. మళ్లీ క్లాస్అటు కేశవకు శైలు ఫోన్ చేస్తుంది. షాపు కోసం డబ్బులు ఇవ్వడానికి మీ ఫ్యామిలీ మొత్తాన్ని తీసుకెళ్లావ్.. నన్ను ఎందుకు తీసుకెళ్లలేదు.. అంటే నేను నీ ఫ్యామిలీ కాదా.. నీ కోసం ఇక్కడ ఇంట్లో వీళ్లతో తిట్టించుకుంటున్నాను.. కానీ నువ్వు మాత్రం నన్ను పట్టించుకోలేదు అని క్లాస్ పీకుతుంది. ఇక ఫ్యామిలీ అందరం కలిసి బయటకు వెళ్లి లంచ్ చేశామని కేశవ చెప్పడంతో శైలు మరింత మండిపడుతుంది. అతన్ని తిట్టి ఫోన్ పెట్టేస్తుంది.వదినను బతిమాలిన కన్నా.. తండ్రి గురించి చెప్పిన మహామరుసటి రోజు ఉదయం కన్నా మెల్లగా వదిన దగ్గరికి వెళ్తాడు. వెళ్దామా అని అడుగుతాడు. నీతో మాట్లాడను.. నీలాంటి మెచ్చూరిటీ లేనివాళ్లతో ఫ్రెండ్షిప్ చేయను అని మహా బెట్టు చేస్తుంది.తండ్రంటే నీకు గౌరవం లేదు.. ఎలా మాట్లాడాలో తెలియదు.. నన్ను కూడా మాటలన్నావ్.. 20 ఏళ్ల వయసు లేదు.. 60 ఏళ్ల వయసున్న వ్యక్తితో అలాగేనా మాట్లాడేది.. అయినా నీపై మీ అమ్మకు ప్రేమ ఉంటే నిన్ను వదిలేసి మళ్లీ ఎందుకు వెళ్తుంది.. నువ్వు పుట్టగానే వదిలేసి వెళ్లి 20 ఏళ్లకు తిరిగొస్తే ఆయన ఆ మాత్రం మాటలు అనడా.. ఆయనను అర్థం చేసుకోవడం నీవల్ల కాదు.. మొదటి భార్యను చంపాడన్నారు.. మీ అమ్మను కూడా చంపాడన్నారు.. అది నిజమా.. ఆయనను తాగుతాడు అని అంటారు.. తాగి నిన్నేమైనా అన్నాడా.. నీ అన్నలను ఏమైనా అన్నాడా అని మహా నిలదీస్తుంది.వీటికి కన్నా దగ్గర సమాధానం ఉండదు. నీలాంటివాడితో నేను మాట్లాడను అని కన్నాను మళ్లీ మహా తిట్టి పంపిస్తుంది.మాధవ ఎమోషనల్.. కంటతడిఅటు ఇదంతా దూరం నుంచి వింటూ ఉంటారు మాధవ, చక్రి, కేశవ. కన్నా తిరిగి వస్తుండటంతో అందరూ లోనికి వెళ్తారు. మహా మాటలు విని మాధవ ఎమోషనల్ అవుతాడు. కన్నీళ్లతో దేవుడికి దండం పెట్టుకుంటాడు. ఎందుకు ఏడుస్తున్నావని చక్రి అడుగుతాడు. నా తర్వాత నాన్ను బాగా అర్థం చేసుకున్నది మహానే.. ఆమెను చూస్తుంటే గత జన్మలో ఆమే మనకు అమ్మనేమో అని మాధవ అంటాడు. దీంతో చక్రి షాకవుతాడు. నారాయణ కూడా ఆమెను అమ్మ అంటాడు.. నువ్వూ అమ్మ అంటే.. నాకు వరసలు మారిపోతాయ్.. ఆమె నా భార్య అని చక్రి అనడంతో అందరూ నవ్వుకుంటారు.కన్నా తండ్రి నారాయణ కాదు..ఆ తరవాత జమునను వెతుక్కుంటూ వెళ్తుంది మహా. రోడ్డుపై ఆమెను అడ్డగించి కన్న కొడుకు ఇంట్లో దొంగతనం ఎందుకు చేశారని నిలదీస్తుంది. అసలు నారాయణ మిమ్మల్ని ఇంట్లో నుంచి ఎందుకు వెళ్లగొట్టాడని అడుగుతుంది. దీంతో కన్నా తండ్రి నారాయణ కాదు అని జమున అసలు నిజం చెబుతుంది. మహా షాకవుతుంది. అక్కడితో పొదరిల్లు సీరియల్ ఈరోజు ఎపిసోడ్ ముగుస్తుంది.

title: Jailer 2 box office collection day 8: Rajinikanth film crosses  ₹334 crore, sees 25% dip after bumper seven days | Hindustan Times
description: Jailer 2 box office collection day 8: The film is directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. Anirudh Ravichander has composed the music.
content: Jailer 2 box office collection day 8: The huge hype surrounding the release of Jailer 2 made sure that the Rajinikanth film scored a record-breaking opening at the box office. The action drama was released in theatres on October 15 and within a week it has become the highest-grossing Tamil film of 2026 so far. After its first week, the film has seen a dip in numbers. Let's take a look.Jailer 2 box office updateOn release day, Jailer earned ₹59.70 crore net at the domestic box office across 15,887 shows. Advance bookings for Jailer 2 began in India on October 10, five days before release. They had already begun in select overseas territories a day prior. By the end of October 14 (Wednesday), the advance bookings for the film had crossed ₹80 crore worldwide. For opening day in India alone, the film sold 18 lakh tickets in pre-sales, grossing ₹37 crore.The film saw a slight dip on Monday, collecting ₹42.35 crore. But it stayed steady on Tuesday again, managing ₹46.80 crore owing to Dussehra holiday. Wednesday ended with a haul of ₹28.15 crore, and the dip continued on Thursday. As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Jailer 2 has managed to collect ₹17.15 crore on its eighth day of release, taking its total net collection to ₹334.35 crore.All about Jailer 2The film kicks off after the events of the first film, in which Muthu (Rajinikanth) killed Varman (Vinayakan) and was warned that a network of idol smugglers would soon be on his trail. Dileep (Suraj Venjaramoodu) would like to know who would dare disrupt their smuggling ring’s operations. Muthu’s family still doesn’t know that he went to the extent of killing his son Arjun (Vasanth Ravi) to keep them all safe. He’s busy trying to give them some normalcy while working as a supermarket supervisor. Unfortunately, the past catches up to him at one point, and new threats loom. Muthu seeks help from some new and old friends.On Thursday, Telugu superstar Allu Arjun hailed the film on his X account and praised Rajinikanth. He wrote, “#Jailer2 is (fire emoticons) A true showcase of @rajinikanth sir’s star power, swag & aura! A Commercial Entertainer that keeps the adrenaline pumping!” He went on to shower particular praise for music composer Anirudh Ravichander and wrote, “Brother… @anirudhofficial KILLED IT! All the artists, technicians & the producer have poured their hearts into this film. The Showman @Nelsondilpkumar garu delivers the coolest hit with a BANG!” “Only Rajinikanth can hit 500 crore+ without getting his shirt torn,” he concluded in Telugu, and congratulated the entire team of Sun Pictures.

title: US visa bulletin November 2026: Latest update brings selective progress for Indian green card applicants | Hindustan Times
description: The November 2026 Visa Bulletin brings limited employment-based progress for Indians.
content: The US State Department’s November 2026 Visa Bulletin brings limited progress for Indian employment-based green card applicants, with the EB-3 category advancing by three weeks, while EB-1, EB-2 and EB-5 remain unchanged. Family-sponsored categories also show movement, with cut-off dates advancing for some applicants seeking to reunite with relatives in the United States.The bulletin, published in October, outlines the dates governing employment-based and family-sponsored immigrant visa availability. US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) will accept employment-based adjustment of status applications using the Dates for Filing chart in November.EB-3 advances for Indian green card applicantsThe Final Action Date for Indian applicants in the EB-3 Professionals and Skilled Workers category advances by three weeks to January 22, 2014. The category covers eligible professionals and skilled workers seeking US permanent residency through employment.Also Read: Trump administration warns H-1B, J-1 visa fraud threatens American jobs and securityHowever, the EB-1 category remains at February 1, 2023, while EB-2 India stays at November 1, 2013. The EB-5 unreserved category, which covers eligible immigrant investors, also remains unchanged at December 1, 2023.The Dates for Filing chart for employment-based categories remains unchanged for India. Applicants must check the applicable chart and their priority dates to determine whether they can file or receive final approval.Family-sponsored green card dates for IndiansThe November bulletin also lists cut-off dates for family-sponsored immigration, which allows eligible US citizens and permanent residents to sponsor certain relatives.For Indian applicants, the F1 category, covering unmarried sons and daughters of US citizens, has a Final Action Date of January 22, 2021. The F2B category, for unmarried sons and daughters aged 21 or older of permanent residents, advances to August 22, 2020.The F3 category, covering married sons and daughters of US citizens, moves to October 22, 2015. The F4 category, for brothers and sisters of adult US citizens, remains at December 15, 2006.Also Read: US visa wait times for Indians rise; Mumbai, Delhi see longest visitor visa appointment delaysThe F2A category, covering spouses and children of permanent residents, has a Final Action Date of October 22, 2026, for India. The bulletin also lists the F2A Dates for Filing category as current for all countries, including India.What applicants should knowFinal Action Dates determine when an immigrant visa can be issued or an eligible adjustment of status application can be approved. Dates for Filing indicate when applicants may begin submitting documentation, subject to the applicable filing rules.A current listing in the Dates for Filing chart does not guarantee immediate approval. Applicants must still meet the relevant eligibility requirements, and visa availability is governed by the applicable rules and cut-off dates.For Indian families and employment-based applicants, the November bulletin brings selective progress rather than a broad reduction in green card backlogs. Applicants should check the official November 2026 Visa Bulletin and USCIS filing guidance before submitting applications.

title: Why NorthEast United look good | Sports News
description: Ajaraie’s back, the defence should be stronger and they have the ISL’s longest-serving coach | Sports News
content: There are clubs that spend like Real Madrid and Barcelona and there are others who try to be competitive. After three years in India and at the beginning of his journey with FC Goa, that was how Manolo Marquez evaluated the Indian Super League (ISL). For Marquez, Mohun Bagan Super Giant and Mumbai City FC were the top dogs.Things have changed since. Marquez is the head coach at Mumbai this term but the club aren’t among the heaviest spenders. Mohun Bagan retain that tag with Bengaluru FC and East Bengal being the others who have loosened purse strings more than most. When Marquez made the comment, East Bengal were near or at the bottom of the standings. They went into this season as defending champions and India’s only representative in the Asian Champions League 2. That has taken some activity in the transfer market over the years.Joining on a freeAmid all this, NorthEast United began a rebuild. One of the original eight, they were used to bottom-of-the-table or lower-half finishes with the odd semi-final berth. In 2023-24, Juan Pedro Benali’s first season in charge as head coach and Mandar Tamhane’s as CEO, NorthEast United played the Durand Cup semi-final. Meghalaya Tourism, Coal India and Indian Oil came on board as sponsors and they even have a company from Isle of Mann on their shirts.Next term, they won the Durand Cup and finished third in ISL. In 2025-26, NorthEast United retained the title but, having loaned their best player in a bid to cut costs, finished ninth in a truncated season.Alaaeddine Ajaraie’s back and scoring. He was involved in three of the four goals against Kerala Blasters. Benali is the league’s longest-serving coach. NorthEast United have retained the core of Indian players and strengthened the defence by signing Pramveer, Nikhil Barla and Abdul Rabeeh. They are among the five new Indian players to join the club, all of them on a free. That is also true for the four foreigners they have signed.Without getting into specifics, Tamhane said the club operates well within the salary cap. ISL capped the players’ salaries at ₹18 crore with provision to sign two players outside the budget. And yet, between 2023 and now, the number of India players across age-groups has gone up to 18, said Tamhane.An early markerNorthEast began with two wins, one of them against Mohun Bagan Super Giant. That can be an important marker early in the season. Ajaraie will be on the books till June 2028. His first goal against Blasters came by staying on-side before bursting into space to meet a long ball from the back. The second was a powerful drive on the turn. The Moroccan scored 23 goals in 25 matches to win the golden boot and the golden ball awards in 2024-25. He is crucial to the team’s chances but this time they also have more options when it comes to Indians. A good start can go a long way in the race to the play-off round. This is a short league and as East Bengal showed in 2024-25, starting trouble can be too difficult to turn around. At some point, NorthEast not completing their quota of six foreigners could hurt. But they can sign one in January.NorthEast, who travel to Odisha next, played the Durand Cup and the IFA Shield. Inter Kashi had one training session before ISL started, Mumbai City FC’s pre-season was hit by not getting the kind of friendlies they would have liked, Kerala Blasters had to deal with the distraction of a takeover; and Churchill Brothers with settling-down pangs. If NorthEast are able to use these to their advantage, this could be the season where they are in the same bracket as the Kolkata teams and Bengaluru FC.PLAY OF THE WEEK

title: అక్టోబర్ 24 నుంచి బుధుడి వక్ర సంచారం.. ఈ 3 రాశులకు ఉద్యోగ, వ్యాపారంలో లాభాలు! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: జ్యోతిష్య శాస్త్రంలో బుధుడిని బుద్ధి, వాక్చాతుర్యం, వ్యాపారం, ఆర్థిక లావాదేవీలకు కారకుడిగా భావిస్తారు. అందించిన వివరాల ప్రకారం, 2026 అక్టోబర్ 24 మధ్యాహ్నం 12:41 గంటలకు బుధుడు తులా రాశిలో వక్రగమనాన్ని ప్రారంభించి, నవంబర్ 13 వరకు కొనసాగనున్నట్లు పేర్కొన్నారు.
content: జ్యోతిష్య శాస్త్రంలో బుధుడిని బుద్ధి, వాక్చాతుర్యం, వ్యాపారం మరియు ఆర్థిక లావాదేవీలకు కారకుడిగా భావిస్తారు. ప్రతి గ్రహం నిర్దిష్ట సమయంలో తన గమనాన్ని మారుస్తుంటుంది. ఇందులో భాగంగానే రాబోయే అక్టోబర్ 24, 2026 మధ్యాహ్నం 12:41 గంటలకు బుధుడు తులా రాశిలో వక్రీకరించనున్నారు.ఈ గ్రహ సంచార మార్పు మానవ జీవితాలపై, ముఖ్యంగా ఉద్యోగ, వ్యాపార రంగాలపై తీవ్ర ప్రభావం చూపుతుంది. ముఖ్యంగా మేష, కర్కాటక, వృశ్చిక రాశుల వారికి ఈ కాలం ఎంతో కీలకమని జ్యోతిష్య నిపుణులు స్పష్టం చేస్తున్నారు.మేష రాశి:మేష రాశి వారికి బుధుడి వక్రీకరణ వృత్తిపరంగా నూతన ఆశలను చిగురింపజేస్తుంది. ఎప్పటి నుంచో ఉద్యోగ మార్పు కోసం ప్రయత్నిస్తున్న వారికి పాత పరిచయాల ద్వారా విలువైన సమాచారం అందుతుంది.వ్యాపారస్తులు గతంలో చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలు ఇప్పుడు సత్ఫలితాలను ఇస్తాయి. ఎంతో కాలంగా నిలిచిపోయిన వ్యాపార చర్చలు మళ్లీ మొదలవుతాయి లేదా పాత కస్టమర్లు మిమ్మల్ని సంప్రదిస్తారు. అయితే, ఏ చిన్న ఒప్పందంపై అయినా సంతకం చేసే ముందు నిబంధనలను క్షుణ్ణంగా చదవాలని గుర్తుంచుకోండి.కర్కాటక రాశి:ఉద్యోగ మరియు వ్యాపార రంగాల్లో స్థిరపడాలనుకునే కర్కాటక రాశి వారికి ఈ కాలం చక్కటి అవకాశాలను తెస్తుంది. కార్యాలయంలో దీర్ఘకాలంగా ఎదురుచూస్తున్న బాధ్యతలు మీ చేతికి అందే అవకాశం ఉంది.నూతన వ్యాపారం ప్రారంభించాలని ఆలోచించేవారు తమ ప్రణాళికలను మరోసారి సమీక్షించుకోవడానికి ఇది సరైన సమయం. అయితే, ఆర్థిక వ్యవహారాల్లో అప్రమత్తత అవసరం. ఆదాయం పెరుగుతుందన్న ఆశతో ఎటువంటి తొందరపాటు నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకోవద్దు, లేదంటే భవిష్యత్తులో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదురవుతాయి.వృశ్చిక రాశి:వృశ్చిక రాశి వారికి ఇది గతంలో నిలిచిపోయిన పనులను మళ్లీ పట్టాలెక్కించే తరుణం. కొత్త ఉద్యోగం కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేసుకున్న వారికి పాత దరఖాస్తుల నుంచి సానుకూల స్పందన లభిస్తుంది.వ్యాపారస్తులు పేరుకుపోయిన బకాయిలు రాబట్టడంపై, అసంపూర్తిగా ఉన్న ఒప్పందాలపై దృష్టి పెట్టాలి. తొందరపాటు నిర్ణయాలకు బదులుగా చర్చల ద్వారా సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకోవడం మంచిది. ఎవరిపైనో గుడ్డిగా నమ్మి ఆర్థిక పరమైన పెద్ద నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకోవద్దని హెచ్చరిస్తున్నారు.బుధ సంచార సమయం మరియు ప్రాముఖ్యతపంచాంగ గణనల ప్రకారం అక్టోబర్ 24న ప్రారంభమయ్యే ఈ వక్రీకరణ నవంబర్ 13 వరకు కొనసాగుతుంది. ఆ తర్వాత బుధుడు తిరిగి మార్గస్థితుడవుతాడు. ఈ కాలమంతా పాత పనులను సరిదిద్దుకోవడం, ముఖ్యమైన పత్రాలను క్షుణ్ణంగా పరిశీలించడం చాలా ముఖ్యం. ఏ పనైనా ఆచితూచి అడుగు వేయడం వల్ల సత్ఫలితాలు సాధించవచ్చు.

title: Chandigarh: Teen killed, friend hurt in Sector 22 shooting; 2 juveniles detained | Hindustan Times
description: The deceased, identified as Naitik, a resident of Sector 22, was sitting inside an autorickshaw in the temple parking lot with two others when the assailants arrived on a motorcycle and opened fire
content: A 17-year-old boy was killed and another person injured after two juveniles allegedly opened fire outside Sanatan Dharam Temple in Sector 22 on Thursday night. Police have detained the two accused, who are said to be school students.This is the second murder involving juveniles in the city in a week.The deceased, identified as Naitik, a resident of Sector 22, was sitting inside an autorickshaw in the temple parking lot with two others when the assailants arrived on a motorcycle and opened fire around 9.30 pm, police said. One of the victims was declared dead after being taken to Government Multi-Specialty Hospital (GMSH), Sector 16.According to a senior police official, the accused allegedly had a dispute with the victims’ group. The victims had reportedly recorded a video of themselves assaulting the accused and uploaded it on Instagram, following which the rivalry escalated.Police teams reached the spot soon after the incident and sealed the area. Around three shots were fired, according to preliminary information. Further investigation is underway.Earlier on October 15, a 17-year-old boy was stabbed to death following an altercation between two groups at a Ramlila event in Sector 41 on Thursday night. Police nabbed a 16-year-old boy for the crime while they are on a lookout for his five to six accomplices – also believed to be minors. A friend of the victim had objected to the other group’s presence, questioning why boys from outside the locality had come there. The next day, the accused followed the victim to a nearby market, assaulted him before eventually stabbing him to death.

title: Vice president to chair Panjab University’s convocation on December 5 | Hindustan Times
description: His visit comes at a time when the university is still functioning without a regular vice-chancellor (V-C) and is preparing to convene its newly elected senate for the first time in December
content: It’s official. Vice-President CP Radhakrishnan, who is the ex officio chancellor of Panjab University (PU), will chair the 74th convocation of the varsity, to be held on December 5.This will be his second visit to the university after assuming office. This comes less than three months after his first visit, which was in the first week of September for the inauguration of infrastructural projects.His visit comes at a time when the university is still functioning without a regular vice-chancellor (V-C) and is preparing to convene its newly elected senate for the first time in December.The senate is the varsity’s apex policy-making and governing body. The formation of the new syndicate – the executive arm of the university, responsible for day-to-day administrative, operational, and financial management – is also pending.During the convocation, at least 1,000 students, including 450 PhD scholars, are expected to receive their degrees. Toppers from different departments will get gold medals, while the V-P is expected to personally present medals to select students.The university will also confer its Ratna awards, including Sports Ratna, Vigyan Ratna and Industry Ratna, on individuals recognised for their contributions in their respective fields. The list of recipients is yet to be finalised.In the absence of a regular V-C – pending appointment – acting V-C Prof Meenakshi Goyal is handling the responsibilities. Registrar YP Verma had earlier indicated that the process of constituting the syndicate was expected to be completed by December 31, although the appointment of a regular V-C is beyond the university’s direct control.Security arrangements for the Vice-President’s visit will follow the established protocol in coordination with the UT administration.

title: Parts of Panchkula hit by power cuts amid staff strike against privatisation | Hindustan Times
description: The strike, called by the Haryana Bijli Karamchari and Engineers Sanyukt Sangharsh Morcha from October 22 to 24, is opposing the  decision to grant power distribution licence to Eleven Power
content: Several parts of Panchkula faced power cuts on Wednesday as Haryana power utility employees began a three-day strike against the privatisation of power distribution.The strike, called by the Haryana Bijli Karamchari and Engineers Sanyukt Sangharsh Morcha from October 22 to 24, is opposing the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission’s (HERC) decision to grant a 25-year parallel power distribution licence to Eleven Power Private Limited, a private company, for Gurugram and Nuh revenue districts.Power cuts were reported between 10 am and 6 pm, although the impact varied across the city. Residents of some sectors, including Sector 2, said they remained largely unaffected.Sector 25 was among the worst-hit areas, with resident KR Kohli stating that the entire sector remained without electricity from morning until evening. Residents also lodged complaints with the district administration. The disruption affected water supply as well, particularly in the morning.According to Citizen Welfare Association (CWA) president SK Nayar, power supply was disrupted in small pockets of sectors, including Sectors 7 and 15, while some transformers and substations continued to function normally. “It is unacceptable for people to remain without power for the whole day, and the onus is on the authorities to manage the situation. With the protest set to continue for two more days, alternative arrangements must be made,” Nayar said.Control room set upThe district administration has set up a control room at the deputy commissioner’s camp office in Sector 1 to monitor the strike and coordinate responses to disruptions.The control room will remain operational until October 24 or until normalcy is restored. It will receive information about law-and-order incidents, disruptions to essential power services, the security of critical power installations and other matters requiring administrative intervention.It will coordinate with the sub-divisional magistrates, duty magistrates, police authorities, tehsildars, block development and panchayat officers, power utilities and other departments to ensure timely communication and appropriate action.Residents can contact the control room at 0172-2585777.Eleven Power, chaired by Sunil Sachdeva, is the first private player to receive a parallel power distribution licence in Haryana. Under Section 14 of the Electricity Act, 2003, the company plans to invest ₹4,716 crore over five years to develop a parallel distribution network, giving more than 8.3 lakh consumers the option to choose between the private company and state-run Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam.

title: PU okays  ₹942-cr budget for next academic year | Hindustan Times
description: PU expects to generate  ₹185 crore from examination fees in the coming year, compared with  ₹174 crore in the previous year’s budget. This is an increase of  ₹11 crore, or around 6.4%
content: Panjab University (PU) has approved a revenue budget of ₹942 crore for 2027-28, an increase of ₹40 crore, or 4.5%, over the ₹901-crore budget for the ongoing year (2026-27).The budget was approved at a meeting of the university’s Board of Finance (BoF) chaired by vice-chancellor Prof Meenakshi Goyal on Thursday. PU expects to generate ₹185 crore from examination fees in the coming year, compared with ₹174 crore in the previous year’s budget. This is an increase of ₹11 crore, or around 6.4%. The projected income from partially self-financed courses has also increased from ₹100 crore in 2026-27 to ₹107 crore, a rise of ₹7.20 crore. From registration, certificate and common entrance test (CET), however, it expects to see a decline (see box). The higher revenue projections do not necessarily indicate an increase in student fees, as the figures may also reflect changes in enrolment and other factors.UGC grant increases by ₹24 croreOf the total budget, PU expects ₹436 crore from the University Grants Commission (UGC), ₹107 crore from the Punjab government and ₹397 crore through its own revenue sources. These account for approximately 46%, 11% and 42% of the total budget, respectively. Compared with the previous year’s budget, the projected UGC grant has increased by ₹24 crore – from ₹412 crore to ₹436 crore. The Punjab government’s contribution is expected to rise by ₹6 crore, from ₹101 crore to ₹107 crore.The university’s projected internal income has increased by ₹9.98 crore.Mental health counselling support expandedRecognising the importance of students’ psychological and emotional well-being, the university has increased the number of part-time mental health counsellors from two to four. Their monthly remuneration has also been raised by ₹5,000 per person, from ₹20,000 to ₹25,000.Hostel renovations, sports facilitiesThe approved budget includes ₹2 crore for renovating washrooms in Boys’ Hostels 3 and 7, ₹3 crore for repairing the roofs of non-residential buildings and ₹2 crore for renovating toilets in residential houses. Another ₹40 lakh has been allocated for electronic targets at the Captain Vikram Batra Shooting Range.Scribe remuneration revisedThe Board of Finance has also approved remuneration for scribes assisting students with disabilities during examinations. For the May 2025, December 2025 and May 2026 end-semester examinations, scribes will receive ₹400 per examination. From the end-semester examinations of 2026 onwards, the rate will increase to ₹500 per examination, subject to a ceiling of ₹5,000 per scribe per semester examination. For mid-term examinations, the approved rate is ₹150 per examination, subject to a ceiling of ₹1,000 per scribe per mid-semester examination.

title: Consumer panel tells retail store to refund 70% to Chandigarh resident over defective washing machine | Hindustan Times
description: The complainant alleged that the washing machine developed defects and that repeated complaints to the service centre failed to resolve the problem
content: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Chandigarh, has directed a LIQO Store in Sector 35 and Reliance Digital service centre to refund 70% of the cost of a defective washing machine to a city resident, along with 9% annual interest.The commission also ordered the two parties to pay ₹10,000 as compensation for mental agony and harassment, including litigation expenses.In his complaint, Saravjeet Kumar, a resident of Sector 43-A, said he purchased a Hyundai washing machine from LIQO Store for ₹13,000 on February 1, 2023. The machine was installed by representatives of Reliance Digital service centre.On March 2, 2023, he was informed that the warranty would expire on January 30, 2025. He subsequently paid ₹989 for an extended warranty until January 30, 2026.Kumar alleged that the washing machine developed defects and that repeated complaints to the service centre failed to resolve the problem. Despite assurances, his complaints were allegedly closed without the defects being rectified. He also approached the service centre in Kharar, but his grievance remained unaddressed.Seeking redressal, Kumar approached the commission, seeking replacement of the washing machine or a refund of ₹13,000, besides the extended warranty charges, interest and compensation.The opposite parties did not contest the complaint and were proceeded against ex parte.The commission found deficiency in service but took into account that the washing machine remained in the complainant’s possession and use for a considerable period before the defects were reported. It accordingly directed a refund of 70% of the purchase price, allowing a 30% deduction towards usage and depreciation, along with 9% annual interest.The commission also directed the store and service centre to pay ₹10,000 towards compensation and litigation expenses.

title: Mohali: Two dead in separate hit-and-run cases | Hindustan Times
description: Rohan Kumar, who worked as a pharmacist at Sub-Divisional Hospital (SDH), Kharar, was riding his Bajaj CT 100 motorcycle towards his home in Sekhan Majra after finishing his shift on October 14
content: A 24-year-old government hospital pharmacist died five days after a hit-and-run on the Landran-Lakhnaur road. Police has registered a case against an unidentified driver of the car involved in the crash.Rohan Kumar, who worked as a pharmacist at Sub-Divisional Hospital (SDH), Kharar, was riding his Bajaj CT 100 motorcycle towards his home in Sekhan Majra after finishing his shift on October 14. His younger brother, Raman Kumar, a student, was driving behind him when a white Kia car allegedly hit Rohan near Balaji Marble Shop around 2.30 pm and fled.Raman said the collision threw his brother off the motorcycle. He alleged that the Kia’s tyre punctured after the crash and that the driver changed it a few kilometres away before fleeing. Raman noted the car’s registration number, PB-11CY-0450.Rohan suffered head injuries and remained under treatment for five days. He died around 6 pm on October 19, his family said.Raman said he witnessed the crash and followed his injured brother as the family sought medical care. He also alleged that the driver changed the car’s punctured tyre a few kilometres from the collision site before fleeing.Sohana police registered a case against the unidentified driver under Sections 106(1) (causing death by negligence), 281 (rash driving) and 324(4) (mischief) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.In another case, a 37-year-old plumber, Jaswinder Singh, died after a car hit his scooter from behind on the Rora-Bajheri road .Kharar police registered a case on a complaint by the victim’s sister, Paramjit Kaur, under Sections 281(rash driving), 106 (causing death by negligence) and 125(a) (act endangering life) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. The collision occurred about 10 kilometres from the police station.According to the complaint, Paramjit and family members were walking from Rora towards Bajheri for work, while her brother Jaswinder Singh followed them on an Activa scooter, registration number PB 24 L 3657, to pick them up.When Jaswinder was about 100 metres behind the family, a car bearing registration number PB 65 P 8095 allegedly approached from behind and struck the scooter. The complaint states that the driver did not sound the horn or dip the headlights before the collision. The impact threw Jaswinder onto the road. He suffered head injuries, according to the complaint. The driver stopped ahead, allowing Paramjit to note the registration number, but then drove away.On receiving the information, police reached the spot and arranged an ambulance to take Jaswinder to Civil Hospital, Kharar. Doctors declared him brought dead. Hospital staff later moved his body to the mortuary at Civil Hospital, Phase 6, Mohali. Further investigation is underway to establish the circumstances of the collision and identify the driver.

title: Mohali: 20 booked for pelting stones at family; father, daughter injured | Hindustan Times
description: The Zirakpur police registered a case on Wednesday against a local resident, Dushar, and 15 to 20 unidentified people for allegedly assaulting the family, damaging their house and threatening to kill them
content: A 61-year-old shopkeeper and his daughter were injured after a group allegedly pelted their house with bricks and stones following a dispute over the timing of Ravana effigy burning in Baltana on Tuesday, police said.The Zirakpur police registered a case on Wednesday against a local resident, Dushar, and 15 to 20 unidentified people for allegedly assaulting the family, damaging their house and threatening to kill them.According to the complaint filed by Mohammad Shakir, a resident of Saini Vihar, Peer Baba Road, the dispute began around 12.30 pm on October 20. Shakir told police that children in the neighbourhood gather in a park every Dussehra to burn Ravana’s effigy. His son Kaif and another youth, Roshan, were standing near the effigy with their friends when Dushar, who lives in the same locality, arrived with five to six associates and insisted on setting it on fire immediately. Roshan objected, saying they should wait until the evening.Around 6.30 pm, Kaif left with friends Sanjay and Gautam to visit the Dussehra fair in Sector 19, Panchkula. Shakir alleged that Dushar and his associates stopped them and threatened to kill anyone seen with Roshan. Kaif ran home, with the group following him. After he entered the house, the men allegedly threw bricks at the residence and left.Shakir alleged that Dushar returned around 11 pm with a group of 15 to 20 people. They pelted the house with stones and bricks, damaging windows, doors and floor tiles. Shakir suffered injuries to his left knee and back, while a stone struck his daughter Ariba on her right foot.The family raised an alarm, prompting neighbours to come outside. The group then fled, allegedly threatening to kill the family.Shakir and Ariba received treatment at the Civil Hospital in Dhakoli. After the hospital sent a medical memo to the police, assistant sub-inspector Major Singh visited the hospital and recorded Shakir’s statement. Zirakpur police registered a case under Sections 115(2) (voluntarily causing hurt), 126(2) (wrongful restraint), 351(2) (criminal intimidation), 324(4) (mischief), 190 (unlawful assembly guilty of offence), and 191(3) (rioting) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Police are trying to identify and arrest the suspects.

title: At PGI, wait for kidney transplant may stretch up to 8 years | Hindustan Times
description: Speaking at the event, Dr Ashish Sharma, head of the department of renal transplant surgery, said more than 80,000 patients are listed for kidney transplant on the national registry of organ transplant
content: Around 6,000 kidney failure patients, awaiting transplant from outside the family, are currently on the waitlist at the Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) due to difficulty in finding a match. What’s more shocking is that the average wait time for such patients may stretch up to eight years.This was revealed during a training programme on deceased (cadaveric) organ donation, titled ‘Continuum - The Continuity of Life’, organised by the Regional Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisation North (ROTTO-N) and PGIMER on Thursday.Speaking at the event, Dr Ashish Sharma, head of the department of renal transplant surgery, said more than 80,000 patients are listed for kidney transplant on the national registry of organ transplant. For other organs too, the wait list is almost the same. For kidney failure patients, a longer waiting period means a constant battle for survival while also dealing with the mounting financial burden due to treatment costs and other challenges.Dr Sharma said that although the number of transplants has increased over the years, the long waiting list continues to remain a challenge. He added that around 9,000 patients had been registered in PGIMER’s kidney transplant waiting registry over the years. Of these, approximately 3,000 had undergone transplants, while 6,000 are still awaiting suitable donors.Only government hospital carrying out transplant in cityOf all the government hospitals in Chandigarh, PGIMER is the only institution currently carrying out organ transplants. The Government Medical College and Hospital (GMCH), Sector 32, has a licence for organ retrieval but does not perform transplants, while the Government Multi-Specialty Hospital, Sector 16, carries out neither organ retrieval nor transplantation.Better identification of donors, timely action needed To fill the gap, Dr Sharma called for strengthening the organ donation and transplant programme through better identification of potential donors, timely certification of brain-stem death and improved coordination between hospitals for organ retrieval and transplantation.ROTTO-N nodal officer Dr Vijay Tadia said Thursday’s training programme aimed to strengthen the preparedness of resident doctors and nursing officers and translate their knowledge into action.The family of Surinder Kaur, a youngster whose family consented to donating her organs after she was declared brain dead, was felicitated during the event. Her uncle, Jaspal Singh, said, “It is a noble cause that our daughter was able to save lives even when her own couldn’t be. We hope more such programmes can be organised at the village and town levels to make everyone aware of the noble cause of organ donation.”Meanwhile, PGIMER director Dr Vivek Lal shared a personal story. “My maternal uncle underwent a heart transplant and he lived 15 years after. So I know what a transplant means. I thank these families who have gone out of the way to rise above their grief. This movement of organ donation and transplant has been possible due to these families who saved many lives. We will try to take this movement to the village panchayats and gurudwaras where people can learn about organ donation and transplant.”

title: Mohali: Tribunal awards  ₹13 lakh to kin of woman killed in road mishap | Hindustan Times
description: The victim, Manjeet Kaur, worked as a domestic worker in four houses, was hit by a car while walking in TDI City, Sector 111
content: The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal has awarded ₹13 lakh in compensation to the family of a 52-year-old woman who died after a car hit her while she was walking in TDI City, Sector 111, on April 25, 2025. The tribunal held the car’s driver, owner and insurer jointly and severally liable and directed them to pay the amount with 7.5% annual interest from the date, the family filed the claim until realisation.The victim, Manjeet Kaur, worked as a domestic worker in four houses, her husband, Balwinder Singh, told the tribunal. He claimed she earned ₹30,000 a month. However, as he could not produce evidence to establish her occupation and income, the tribunal assessed her notional monthly income at ₹15,000, treating her as a homemaker.In its award, the tribunal recognised her contribution to the household and said the family lost her domestic care and support. It added 10% to her assessed income towards future prospects, calculated the family’s annual dependency at ₹99,000 after deducting half for personal expenses, and applied a multiplier of 11 to arrive at ₹11 lakh.The tribunal added ₹2 lakh for loss of consortium to her husband and three children, ₹18,150 for loss of estate and ₹18,150 for funeral expenses, taking the total compensation to ₹13,18,900.The family had sought ₹30 lakh, claiming Manjeet was 50 at the time of the accident and that her income supported the household. The tribunal, however, relied on her Aadhaar card to determine that she was 52.The accident took place around 7am when Manjeet was walking in TDI City. An eyewitness, Gurmeet Singh, told the tribunal that a car bearing registration number CH-01-CX-0607 hit her from behind, causing head and other injuries. She was taken to Civil Hospital in Phase 6, Mohali, where she died during treatment.The tribunal relied on the eyewitness’s testimony, the police report and other records to hold Anita, the driver, responsible for the accident. The vehicle belonged to Sonu Singh and was insured with Magma HDI General Insurance Company.The insurer disputed the vehicle’s involvement and alleged that the driver lacked a valid licence and that the deceased contributed to the accident by walking in the middle of the road. The tribunal rejected these objections, noting that the insurer produced no evidence to establish the alleged breaches or contributory negligence.The award apportions 47% of the compensation to the husband and 17% each to the son and two daughters.

title: Non-bailable warrant against accused issued after repeated absence in Chandigarh kidney transplant racket | Hindustan Times
description: According to the police, the gang allegedly lured economically disadvantaged people into donating their kidneys in exchange for money
content: The court has issued a non-bailable warrant against Ebam Devi, the main accused in the 2019 Chandigarh kidney transplant racket, after she repeatedly failed to appear for hearings following her release on bail last year.Devi, a resident of Manipur, was arrested in connection with the case nearly seven years ago, where she tried to sell a woman’s kidney to another person. Despite being summoned several times, she has not appeared before the court since securing bail, according to the report.The court has also issued a notice to the person who stood surety for her bail, seeking a response over her continued absence. Further action against the surety is being considered.Gang allegedly targeted economically vulnerable peopleAccording to the police, the gang allegedly lured economically disadvantaged people into donating their kidneys in exchange for money. Investigators alleged that Devi herself received ₹2 lakh for donating a kidney before becoming involved in the racket.Accused brought woman to UT on pretext of job Police alleged that Devi brought a woman from Manipur to Chandigarh on the pretext of arranging a job for her. She allegedly planned to facilitate the woman’s kidney donation to another person and prepared forged documents for the purpose.Devi allegedly received ₹2 lakh for the arrangement. After the racket came to light, police arrested her, while other alleged members of the gang fled.The court’s latest action comes amid continued efforts to secure Devi’s appearance for the next hearing. Further proceedings will also determine what action, if any, is taken against her bail surety.

title: Congress leaders join AAP in Chandigarh ahead of municipal elections | Hindustan Times
description: Ahead of the upcoming municipal corporation elections, the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), Chandigarh, welcomed several leaders and office-bearers associated with the Congress into its ranks
content: Former women’s Congress president Deepa Ashdhir Dubey, along with office-bearers from women’s Congress, youth Congress and block-level organisations joined the Aam Aadmi Party on Thursday.Ahead of the upcoming municipal corporation elections, the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), Chandigarh, welcomed several leaders and office-bearers associated with the Congress into its ranks. Jarnail Singh, AAP Chandigarh in-charge, formally inducted the new members and welcomed them to the party. Party leaders said the new members would contribute their experience and local connections to strengthen the organisation in Chandigarh.Among the leaders who AAP, include former women’s Congress president Deepa Ashdhir Dubey, state secretary Sahil Dubey, youth congress general secretary Madhavi Dubey, Ward 13 block president Umesh Sethi, Ward 13 women’s Congress block president Anju Sethi, and Ward 12 vice-president Guru Lal. In addition, Tarsem Mittal from Ward 10 facilitated the joining of Mohammad Vishal, Bhima and Manjeet Malik into the party.Were already expelled: Cong presidentHS Lucky, president of the Chandigarh Pradesh Congress Committee, strongly reacted to the Aam Aadmi Party’s claims regarding Deepa Dubey and her family members leaving Congress and joining AAP. He said that AAP should present the correct facts before the public and refrain from making misleading claims for political gain.Lucky clarified that Deepa Dubey and her son, Sahil Dubey, had already been expelled from the Congress party for six years during the Lok Sabha elections. He said that despite their efforts to return to the party, Congress had not readmitted either of them. Under these circumstances, portraying them as leaders who have now left Congress to join AAP amounts to presenting the facts in a misleading manner.

title: Chandigarh: Two weeks into 2nd term, Class 9 students await textbooks | Hindustan Times
description: The delay comes in a year when the UT education department decided to provide free textbooks to students from Classes 9 to 12
content: More than two weeks into the second term, Class 9 students in Chandigarh government schools are still waiting for their NCERT textbooks for all subjects, with the delay raising concerns over teaching and learning as the academic year progresses. The second term began on October 3, but the books are yet to be delivered to government schools, leaving students dependent on photocopies and online study material.According to the current system, students are given different textbooks for different terms.The delay comes in a year when the UT education department decided to provide free textbooks to students from Classes 9 to 12. Until last year, Class 9 students had to purchase their books themselves. However, despite the department placing an order with the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT), the textbooks have not arrived, putting students at a disadvantage compared with those who have access to the prescribed books.The issue has also been compounded by NCERT’s revision of the Class 9 syllabus this year. The first part of the textbooks arrived in August 2026, but the delay in the availability of books has created difficulties for both teachers and students in following the revised curriculum.When contacted, director of school education Nitish Singla said the delay was on NCERT’s part and maintained that students were not losing out academically.“The delay is on the part of NCERT, but we have provided photocopies and online material to the students. There is no loss to the students. The office payment and order for supply have already been sent to NCERT,” Singla said.However, a teacher from a private school, requesting anonymity, pointed to the difference in how students in government and private schools are managing the situation.“Books are available in the market since October, and private-school students are purchasing them. This year, the education department announced that it would provide free books to Class 9 students in government schools, but these have not been supplied yet. The order has been placed with NCERT, but there has been no delivery,” the teacher said.While photocopies and digital material may help teachers continue lessons, access to complete textbooks remains important for students to follow the curriculum and study independently.

title: Chandigarh: Autopsy inconclusive, viscera sample sent to forensics in businessman’s death at hotel | Hindustan Times
description: The deceased, Deepak Mittal, was found “unconscious but breathing” in his room at Hotel Taj on Wednesday morning
content: The post-mortem examination of a 56-year-old businessman from Raipur, Chhattisgarh, who died during a business trip to the city, remained inconclusive, police said on Thursday. His viscera samples have been sent for analysis as police suspect possible alcohol poisoning.A viscera sample refers to a collection of soft internal organs and body fluids (such as the stomach, intestines, liver, kidneys, and blood) harvested during an autopsy and sent to a forensic science laboratory for toxicological analysis.The deceased, Deepak Mittal, was found “unconscious but breathing” in his room at Hotel Taj on Wednesday morning. Hotel staff rushed him to Government Multi-Specialty Hospital, Sector 16, where doctors declared him brought dead.Mittal had some underlying health conditions, including hypertension, police said. Some liquor bottles were also found in his room.A woman who had allegedly visited him at the hotel on Tuesday night was questioned but later cleared of suspicion. An official said she had alerted hotel staff about Mittal feeling unwell, following which a waiter went to check on him.After the post-mortem examination, the body was handed over to his family, who took it to his hometown for cremation.Mittal, a contractor with the Punjab government, had arrived in Chandigarh on Tuesday to attend a meeting with Markfed officials scheduled for Wednesday. He had recently secured a contract to package flour and pulses and supply ration kits. He was also a director of Sanjay Grain Products Private Limited, a rice-exporting company.

title: Chandigarh: Captain’s 18 book knockout berth, race intensifies for final spots | Hindustan Times
description: Captain’s 18 finished their group campaign with 22 points, while GB Legends have 19.5 and face an anxious wait for the outcome of Moksha Royals’ final match against TAC Eagles. Moksha, on 16 points
content: Two-time champions Captain’s 18 clinched a knockout berth with a 4–3 win over GB Legends, while Hunting Hawks completed their round-robin campaign with a 6–1 victory over Partee Panthers in the GB Realty Chandigarh Golf League 2026 at The Chandigarh Golf Club on Thursday.Empire registered their first win, beating Chandigarh Gladiators 4-3, while Tee Birds defeated Chiefs 4.5-2.5.Captain’s 18 finished their group campaign with 22 points, while GB Legends have 19.5 and face an anxious wait for the outcome of Moksha Royals’ final match against TAC Eagles. Moksha, on 16 points, need at least a 4–3 win to move above the Legends, while TAC Eagles, on 13.5, must secure 6.5 points or more to overtake them outright.Captain’s 18 are assured of qualification, though top spot remains within Moksha’s reach.In all, 24 teams are contesting, which have been divided into four groups – A, B, C & D – for the round-robin stage, with the top two teams from each group set to advance to the quarter-finals.Teams earn points based on individual singles and pairs results: a win carries one point, a tied match earns half a point, and a loss yields no points.The contest between Captain’s 18 and the Legends went down to the wire. Naunihal Singh won 4&2 and H S Kang edged Balpreet Ghuman 1 Up to keep the singles level.Captain’s 18 then took control through pairs victories by Y S Bains and Saurabh Nagpal (4&3), Paramjit Sandhu and Pukhraj Singh Brar (2-up), and Phulbagh Sodhi and Bani Rai (4&3). The Legends fought back through Arjun Singh Rai and Dr Ravi Sher Toor (5&3), and Pankaj Nain and Dr Jaspreet Batth (4&3), but fell short.Empire recovered from losing both singles against Chandigarh Gladiators to win four pairs matches. Chanbir Mann and Col Sunil Khorana led the charge with a 7&5 victory, helping Empire finish their campaign on a winning note.Tee Birds also signed off with a victory, winning three pairs matches to overcome Chiefs. Col A S Bajwa and Brig H P S Dhillon recorded the day’s biggest win for their team, 7&5, as Tee Birds finished on 16.5 points.Group D remains wide open, with Sultans of Swing leading on 19.5 points, followed by Golf Ninjas (15.5), Golf Masters (15), Capital Golfers (14) and Seven Iron (14). All five remain in contention for the two knockout places, while Green Gators are out of the race.

title: Rafale wows Kashi with breathtaking aerial display | Hindustan Times
description: The air show, themed “Wings over the Ganges,” commemorates the 94th anniversary of the Indian Air Force (IAF).
content: The roar of the Rafale drew all eyes skyward as the much-awaited three-day aerial display opened at Namo Ghat on Thursday. Spectators were thrilled by a spectacular demonstration of precision and daring maneuvers.The aircraft climbed steeply, plunged sharply and rolled with astonishing precision. Every maneuver drew thunderous applause, while chants of “Bharat Mata Ki Jai” and “Har Har Mahadev” reverberated along the ghats, creating an electric atmosphere.The air show, themed “Wings over the Ganges,” commemorates the 94th anniversary of the Indian Air Force (IAF). Prime Minister Narendra Modi along with Union defence minister Rajnath Singh and chief minister Yogi Adityanath is likely to attend the concluding show on October 25.The show highlighted the indomitable valor of the IAF as air warriors made history with their aerobatics. The Rafale performed vertical loops at a low altitude above the Ganges, cutting through the air with 180-degree dives.The Air Force’s renowned Sarang helicopter display team, flying indigenous “Dhruv” helicopters, demonstrated aerial superiority. The team performed a mesmerising “criss-cross” formation, leaving spectators breathless.The performance featuring the Rafale, Tejas, Sukhoi and Sarang helicopters highlighted the event’s significance. This display showcased the country’s military might while presenting a unique confluence of modernity and nationalism in Kashi. Hundreds of thousands of people gathered on the banks of the Ganges to witness the historic spectacle.“The aerial display featured 25 formations, including Kashi Varuna, Kedar, Hanuman, Omkar, Rudra Bhagirathi, Tridev, Alaknanda, Bhairav, Kailash, Natraj, Vishwanath, and Prachanda,” said Wg Cdr Debartho Dhar, PRO and spokesperson for the ministry of defence in Prayagraj.The lineup included the Tejas, Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) Prachand, IL-76, IL-78, C-295, and AN-32, alongside frontline fighters like the SU-30MKI and Rafale. Aircraft from the Indian Navy and Army also participated, showcasing joint operations, added Wg Cdr Dhar.Varanasi divisional commissioner S Rajalingam remarked, “It is a joy to see the public watching with such enthusiasm. Arrangements have been made to ensure everyone can view the show conveniently.”Police commissioner Mohit Agarwal confirmed that tight security is in place, saying “79 temporary police stations have been established, and the area has been divided into 32 zones, 50 sectors and 80 sub-sectors. Sixteen superintendents of police and 16 additional superintendents of police have been deployed to ensure safety.” Officials noted that approximately 11,500 police personnel are on duty.-----BoxA memorable experience for all agesSpectators described the event as a landmark occasion for Kashi. A large number of schoolchildren attended, deeply impressed by the speed and performance of the fighter jets. The air show, which continues on October 22, 24 and 25, drew immense enthusiasm and patriotic fervor.Attendees Shweta Poddar and Asha Agarwal shared, “I am 76, and I attended with a family member. We didn’t expect to watch the air show in Kashi with such ease. Seeing the fighter jets filled us with pride. The Yogi government made excellent arrangements for senior citizens, allowing us to enjoy the show without difficulty.”Attendee Suman remarked, “When the roar of fighter jets echoes through the sky, one truly realises the nation’s strength. Chants of ‘Bharat Mata Ki Jai’ are everywhere. Thanks to Prime Minister Modi and chief minister Adityanath, we are enjoying this memorable experience.”Student Om Singh Ravani said, “The air show was incredibly thrilling. Seeing this display has inspired me to join the Indian Air Force and serve the country.”Another student, Aryan, added, “I had been eagerly looking forward to this. Seeing the speed of the fighter jets and their breathtaking stunts has fueled a desire in me to join the Armed Forces and serve my country.”

title: Eight-year-old crushed to death by reversing school van in Prayagraj | Hindustan Times
description: ARTO (Enforcement) SP Singh stated that preliminary findings indicate the van was operating without a helper, despite regulations mandating an attendant in vehicles transporting schoolchildren.
content: An eight-year-old girl was killed Thursday afternoon after being run over by her school van in Naini, shortly after arriving home. The accident sparked outrage among local residents, who allegedly assaulted the driver before handing him over to the police.According to family members, the victim, Taswani Udyanshi Pathak, a Class III student of Delhi Public School, reached home in the school van at around 3:30 pm. After exiting the van, she reportedly became trapped when the strap of her school bag caught in the vehicle’s door. The driver, assuming the child had already reached safety, allegedly reversed the van without checking, pinning her between the vehicle and the boundary wall of her home.Neighbours and passersby, alerted by the screams of other children inside the van, rushed to the scene and extricated the girl. She was rushed to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared her dead on arrival.The victim was an only child of her parents. Originally from the Mirzapur district, the family resides in Prayagpuram, Naini. Taswani lived with her grandparents, Surendra Pathak, a retired section engineer, and Kadambini Pathak. Her father, Manish Pathak, works in a private firm in Delhi, while her mother, Aarti Dubey, is a government school teacher posted in Gorakhpur.The tragedy has devastated the family. Her grandparents and uncle, Pushpendra Pathak, were left inconsolable, while her parents travelled to Prayagraj immediately upon receiving the news.Naini SHO Avinash Singh confirmed that the driver, identified as Satyapal, has been taken into custody. He noted that the body has not yet been sent for a postmortem, as the family is awaiting the arrival of the parents. Formal legal action will proceed once a complaint is lodged.Recalling the incident, her grandmother, Kadambini Pathak, who was waiting at the gate, described the harrowing moments. “Taswani got down from the rear of the van and was trying to free her bag strap, which had caught in the door. Without checking if she was clear, the driver suddenly reversed at speed. She was crushed between the van and the wall. We screamed and tried to stop him, but it was too late,” she said.Meanwhile, ARTO (Enforcement) SP Singh stated that preliminary findings indicate the van was operating without a helper, despite regulations mandating an attendant in vehicles transporting schoolchildren.“The absence of a helper appears to be a serious lapse,” he said. “A comprehensive inspection of the school’s fleet will be conducted on Friday.” Authorities are also investigating whether the vehicle complied with other mandatory safety norms for school transport.School authorities could not be reached for comment.

title: Property row no reason to deny power supply: HC | Hindustan Times
description: A division bench of Justice Alok Mathur and Justice Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary made the observation while allowing a petition filed by Rae Bareli resident Rakesh Kumar Mishra, who had sought a new domestic electricity connection for his house in Kranti Puri on Jail Garden Road.
content: The Lucknow bench of Allahabad high court has ruled that a pending civil dispute over property ownership cannot, by itself, be a ground to deny an electricity connection, observing that access to power is integral to the right to life and dignity under Article 21 of the Constitution.A division bench of Justice Alok Mathur and Justice Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary made the observation while allowing a petition filed by Rae Bareli resident Rakesh Kumar Mishra, who had sought a new domestic electricity connection for his house in Kranti Puri on Jail Garden Road.In its recent judgment, the court said Clause 4.4 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, allows an applicant to submit an indemnity form as an alternative document for obtaining a new connection. An application cannot be rejected solely because of a pending ownership dispute if the applicant is willing to furnish the prescribed indemnity bond, it said.The electricity department had rejected Mishra’s application on July 28, 2026, citing the absence of the required ownership documents.
