title: Suriya Scene: సీరియల్ కిల్లర్‌గా వస్తున్న మలయాళ లవర్ బాయ్.. సూర్య ‘సీన్’లో ఈశ్వరన్‌గా నస్లేన్ | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Suriya Scene: 'ప్రేమలు' చిత్రంతో సౌత్ ఇండియా వ్యాప్తంగా యూత్ హృదయాలను కొల్లగొట్టిన మలయాళ యంగ్ స్టార్ నస్లేన్ కే గఫూర్ తమిళ చిత్రసీమలోకి గ్రాండ్‌గా ఎంట్రీ ఇస్తున్నారు. సూర్య, నజ్రియా నజీమ్ ప్రధాన పాత్రల్లో వస్తున్న ప్రతిష్టాత్మక యాక్షన్ మూవీ 'సీన్' (Scene)లో నస్లేన్ భయంకరమైన విలన్‌గా కనిపించనున్నారు.
content: Suriya Scene: మలయాళంలో వచ్చిన లవ్ అండ్ కామెడీ డ్రామా 'ప్రేమలు' (Premalu) సినిమాతో పాన్-ఇండియా స్థాయిలో విపరీతమైన క్రేజ్ సంపాదించుకున్న యంగ్ అండ్ టాలెంటెడ్ యాక్టర్ నస్లేన్ (Naslen) తన కెరీర్‌లో ఊహించని నిర్ణయం తీసుకున్నారు. ఇప్పటివరకు పక్కింటి కుర్రాడు, లవర్ బాయ్ పాత్రలతో, అమాయకపు నటనతో ప్రేక్షకులను నవ్వించిన నస్లేన్.. ఇప్పుడు కోలీవుడ్ ఎంట్రీలోనే అత్యంత భయంకరమైన నెగెటివ్ పాత్రలో అలరించడానికి సిద్ధమయ్యారు.కోలీవుడ్ స్టార్ హీరో సూర్య (Suriya), హీరోయిన్ నజ్రియా నజీమ్ జంటగా తెరకెక్కుతున్న చిత్రం 'సీన్' (Scene). ఈ సినిమాతోనే నస్లేన్ తమిళ తెరకు పరిచయమవుతుండగా, ఈ విషయాన్ని సూర్య స్వయంగా అధికారికంగా వెల్లడించారు. నస్లేన్ క్యారెక్టర్ ప్రోమోను హీరో సూర్య స్వయంగా సోషల్ మీడియాలో పంచుకుంటూ, "కోలీవుడ్‌లోకి గ్రాండ్ వెల్‌కమ్" అంటూ ప్రశంసల వర్షం కురిపించారు.సూర్య ట్వీట్ వైరల్.. 'ఈశ్వ‌ర‌న్'గా నస్లేన్ మాస్ అవతార్గురువారం (అక్టోబర్ 22) సూర్య తన అధికారిక సోషల్ మీడియా అకౌంట్ ద్వారా నస్లేన్ క్యారెక్టర్ ప్రోమోను విడుదల చేస్తూ.. "కొన్ని పరిచయాలు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైనవి. ఎంతో ప్రతిభావంతుడైన నస్లేన్ 'సీన్' సినిమా ద్వారా తమిళ ఇండస్ట్రీకి పరిచయం కావడం నాకు చాలా గర్వంగా ఉంది. 'ఈశ్వరన్' పాత్రను మీకు పరిచయం చేస్తున్నాం.. తమిళ సినిమాలోకి హృదయపూర్వక స్వాగతం!" అని రాసుకొచ్చారు.ఈ క్యారెక్టర్ ప్రోమోలో నస్లేన్ నటన చూసి సినీ ప్రియులు, అభిమానులు షాక్‌కు గురవుతున్నారు. ఒక వ్యక్తిని అత్యంత దారుణంగా హత్య చేసిన తర్వాత, ఏమీ తెలియనట్లు నస్లేన్ చాలా ప్రశాంతంగా ఫోన్‌లో ఇన్‌స్టాగ్రామ్ స్క్రోల్ చేస్తూ తదుపరి హత్యకు ప్లాన్ చేస్తుంటాడు. మరోవైపు పోలీస్ ఆఫీసర్‌గా నటించిన సూర్య (ఇన్‌బరాజ్) "మనం వెతుకుతున్నది అసలు మానవత్వమే లేని, ఎమోషన్స్ లేని ఒక రాక్షసుడి కోసం" అని చెప్పే డైలాగ్ నస్లేన్ క్యారెక్టర్ ఎంత పవర్‌ఫుల్‌గా ఉందో స్పష్టం చేస్తోంది.రఫ్ అండ్ టఫ్ పోలీస్‌గా సూర్య.. 'ఆవేశం' డైరెక్టర్ మ్యాజిక్'సీన్' చిత్రానికి 'ఆవేశం' (Aavesham) ఫేమ్ జితూ మాధవన్ (Jithu Madhavan) దర్శకత్వం వహిస్తున్నారు. ఫహద్ ఫాసిల్‌తో తెరకెక్కించిన 'ఆవేశం' చిత్రం బాక్సాఫీస్ వద్ద రూ. 150 కోట్లకు పైగా వసూలు చేసి ఎంతటి సంచలనం సృష్టించిందో అందరికీ తెలిసిందే. ఆ బ్లాక్‌బస్టర్ తర్వాత జితూ మాధవన్ చేస్తున్న ప్రాజెక్ట్ కావడంతో ఈ సినిమాపై ట్రేడ్ వర్గాల్లో భారీ అంచనాలు నెలకొన్నాయి.ఇప్పటికే విడుదలైన టీజర్‌లో సూర్య ఒక పవర్‌ఫుల్ పోలీస్ ఆఫీసర్‌గా కనిపించి మెప్పించారు. జైల్లో ఉన్న నేరస్థుల గుండెల్లో రైళ్లు పరిగెత్తించే క్రూరమైన కేస్‌ను ఛేదించడానికి ఇన్బరాజ్ రంగంలోకి దిగుతాడు. ఆ కేస్‌లో సైకో కిల్లర్ 'ఈశ్వరన్' (నస్లేన్) కు సూర్యకు మధ్య జరిగే మైండ్ గేమ్‌లు, యాక్షన్ సీక్వెన్సెస్ ఈ సినిమాకు ప్రధాన ఆకర్షణగా నిలవనున్నాయి.ఈ దీపావళికి బాక్సాఫీస్ వద్ద రచ్చ2019లో 'తన్నీర్ మథన్ దినంగల్' సినిమాతో చైల్డ్/యంగ్ ఆర్టిస్ట్‌గా కెరీర్ ప్రారంభించిన నస్లేన్.. 'సూపర్ శరణ్య', 'జో అండ్ జో', 'అలప్పుళ జింఖానా' వంటి వరుస హిట్లతో మలయాళంలో లీడింగ్ యంగ్ హీరోగా ఎదిగారు. ఇప్పుడు నేరుగా సూర్య లాంటి గ్లోబల్ స్టార్ సినిమాలో మెయిన్ విలన్‌గా నటిస్తుండటంతో ఆయన కెరీర్ మరో మలుపు తిరగడం ఖాయంగా కనిపిస్తోంది.అన్ని కార్యక్రమాలను వేగంగా పూర్తి చేసుకుంటున్న 'సీన్' చిత్రం ఈ ఏడాది దీపావళి కానుకగా ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా భారీ స్థాయిలో థియేటర్లలోకి రానుంది. ఈ మైండ్ బ్లాకింగ్ యాక్షన్ థ్రిల్లర్ బాక్సాఫీస్ వద్ద ఎలాంటి రికార్డులను సృష్టిస్తుందో చూడాలి.

title: 9 eye makeup mistakes that may damage your eyes: From tightlining to sharing mascara | Health
description: Some eye makeup techniques and practices make your eyes vulnerable to irritations and infections. Learn from an expert what you need to avoid.   | Health
content: From smoky eyes and sharp cat-eye wings to glittery cut creases and softly smudged kohl, eye makeup can transform your look. But behind the blending and precision, hygiene is important for your eye health. Many eye makeup habits can actually increase the risk of irritation and infections.ALSO READ: Eye injury first aid: Doctor shares steps to take if dust gets in your eye or a ball hits itDr Janhvi Mehta, consultant in opthalmology at Jaslok Hospital and Research Centre Mumbai, highlighted common eye makeup mistakes and shared ways to make your routine safer.She described the potential risks: “Eye makeup can enhance your appearance, but incorrect use or poor hygiene can increase the risk of eye irritation, infections, allergies, and even damage to the delicate structures of the eye.”Here are some common mistakes she flagged that you need to avoid:1. Using expired eye makeup productsMascara, eyeliner, and eyeshadows can become breeding grounds for bacteria over time.Using old products may lead to conjunctivitis, eyelid infections, or inflammation.Mascara should ideally be replaced every three months, while eyeliners and eyeshadows should be changed regularly according to their condition.2. Sharing eye makeup Sharing mascara, eyeliner, or brushes can transfer bacteria and viruses between people.Even a single use of someone else’s eye product can increase the risk of infections.3. Applying eyeliner on the inner eyelineTightlining or applying kajal on the inner rim of the eyelid can block the openings of the meibomian glands, which produce the oily layer of tears.This may worsen dry eye symptoms, irritation, and fluctuating vision, especially in people prone to dry eyes.4. Sleeping with eye makeup onLeaving makeup overnight can clog eyelid glands, irritate the eye surface, and increase the risk of blepharitis (eyelid inflammation).Always remove eye makeup gently before sleeping.5. Applying makeup too close to the eye surfaceLoose glitter, pigments, or poorly formulated products can enter the eye and cause scratches on the cornea or allergic reactions.Avoid products that shed particles easily, especially near the lash line.6. Using dirty brushes and applicatorsMakeup brushes collect oil, dead skin cells, and bacteria.Clean brushes regularly and allow them to dry completely before use.7. Using waterproof makeup excessivelyWaterproof mascara and liners require stronger makeup removers and more rubbing during removal.They can irritate the eyelids and contribute to lash breakage.Finally, the expert warned that redness, itching, swelling, burning or excessive watering after applying makeup should not be ignored. Stop using the suspected product and see a doctor if symptoms persist. She also recommended choosing ophthalmologically tested products. As a rule of thumb, never use products past their expiry date, avoid applying makeup when you have an eye infection, and always remove makeup gently with a clean makeup remover.Note to readers: This article is for informational purposes only and not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always seek the advice of your doctor with any questions about a medical condition.

title: UP human rights panel asks PAC chief to examine recruit’s death during PET | Hindustan Times
description: In an order dated October 12, 2026, the Commission forwarded a copy of the complaint to the director general of police (DGP), PAC, Uttar Pradesh, in Lucknow, directing him to look into the matter and take necessary steps as per rules.
content: The Uttar Pradesh State Human Rights Commission has directed the state’s Provincial Armed Constabulary (PAC) chief to examine the circumstances surrounding the death of police recruitment candidate Atul Kumar during a physical efficiency test (PET) in Ghaziabad and take necessary action in accordance with the law.The Commission registered the case on October 7 following a complaint by Delhi-based social activist Krishna Rajput.According to Commission records, Atul Kumar was a resident of Karab village under Mahavan police station in Mathura district.In an order dated October 12, 2026, the Commission forwarded a copy of the complaint to the director general of police (DGP), PAC, Uttar Pradesh, in Lucknow, directing him to look into the matter and take necessary steps as per rules.The Commission clarified that the concerned officer should take action at his level in accordance with the law.Reportedly, Atul Kumar, 27, and Vivek Kumar, 23, died within a short span of time during the physical efficiency test conducted for UP Police recruitment at the 47th Battalion PAC campus in Govindpuram, Ghaziabad.The Commission’s directive calls for examining the circumstances surrounding Kumar’s death and taking action as required under the law. The order does not specify any particular action against an individual or official.The incident has also brought attention to the arrangements for candidates’ safety during physically demanding recruitment tests, including the availability of medical teams, ambulances and emergency care at test venues.The case concerns the circumstances of Kumar’s death during the recruitment process. The Commission has asked the PAC chief to examine the complaint and proceed in accordance with the applicable rules.

title:
OPPO Find X10 series makes its debut alongside a new tablet and earbuds built for a connected experience | Technology News
(HT Tech)
description: OPPO unveils its Find X10 flagships with triple 200MP cameras, agentic AI and bigger batteries, alongside a new tablet and wireless earbuds. | Technology News
content: October shines as a month that feels no less than a festival for mobile enthusiasts, as major brands gear up to unveil their big guns and set the tone for the coming year’s flagships. Leading the league is OPPO, which has now refreshed its premium Find series with the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max.With an upgraded proprietary LUMO Image Engine and camera hardware, these devices are reportedly designed to push the envelope of how lifelike smartphone photos can be. OPPO has also equipped its new flagship smartphones with the latest flagship-grade MediaTek chipsets, bringing a new AI trick to the table. The battery and display have received their share of upgrades, making them class-leading on paper.Beyond the Find X10 series, the Shenzhen-based tech giant has lifted the curtain on more devices at the launch event on 22 October.But ahead of the launch, OPPO hosted a roundtable discussion with journalists. The company's camera and software heads, joined by the head of marketing India, briefed attendees on the key upgrades in the new Find X10 series. Here’s everything you need to know about the new Find series upgrades, the discussion's key revelations, and the new devices OPPO has in store.Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max CamerasAs with previous generations, the camera remains OPPO’s primary focus for its new flagship Find X10 series. This year, the Shenzhen-based tech giant has introduced the world’s first triple 200MP camera setup on the Find X10 Pro Max, housed within a squircle camera island.During the roundtable, a question was raised about why the brand moved back from the circular island on the Find X9 Ultra to the squircle camera housing on the Find X10 Pro Max. In response, Simon Liu, Director of Imaging Technology, explained that the new Find X10 Pro Max features much larger sensors than the former. He added that the squircle design let engineers fit these larger sensors more efficiently without increasing the camera bump's height, with camera quality taking precedence over in-hand comfort.How much bigger are all three sensors, you ask? The primary 200MP camera features a 1/1.28-inch ISOCELL HPC sensor, developed in collaboration with Samsung specifically for the Find X10 Pro Max, with an f/1.5 aperture.The 200MP telephoto camera uses a 1/1.56-inch Sensor with an f/2.1 aperture and a 10cm minimum focusing distance. The ultra-wide camera isn't left behind, pairing 200MP resolution with a large 1/1.56-inch sensor, an f/2.2 aperture, and a 124° ultra-wide autofocus lens. Meanwhile, the base Find X10's primary camera combines 200MP resolution with a 1/1.4-inch sensor and an f/1.6 aperture. Its 50MP ultra-wide camera features a 1/2.75-inch sensor with an f/2.0 aperture. The Find X10’s telephoto shares nearly every aspect with that of the Find X10 Pro Max. It just has a narrower f/1.6 aperture.On paper, both smartphones have remarkable camera hardware. While most mid-range devices, including the Vivo V80, use a 1/1.56-inch sensor for the main camera, OPPO has used that size for the telephoto and ultra-wide cameras in its lineup, a rare move.That said, a larger camera sensor doesn’t guarantee you'll take amazing photos. Image processing and optics hardware tuning are what determine the image quality. With that in mind, OPPO has upgraded the Lumo Engine, which debuted with the Find X9 series, for the Find X10 series.When asked about these changes, Simon Liu explained the new system relies on a true-to-life philosophy. The previous generation focused heavily on the camera's scientific and physical capabilities. Now, the upgraded software tunes photos to reflect a user's memories and emotions.The human brain often remembers an idealised version of a scene. Therefore, the image processing recreates that mental image instead of just capturing literal physical accuracy.Liu added that an industry-first triple 200-megapixel camera setup supports this new tuning approach. This gives the device the flexibility needed for high resolution and better light intake across the zoom range. Faster on-device processing can also stack more frames.This gives the system the power to fine-tune photos so they look exactly how the user experienced the moment.Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max Processor and SoftwareWhile the camera could be the headline feature of the Find X10 series, OPPO has also paid significant attention to the processors in its latest flagship smartphones. The base Find X10 is powered by the Dimensity 9600M SoC, while the Find X10 Pro Max runs on the Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. MediaTek, the chipset manufacturer, claims that both processors receive software support for Agentic AI.Having AI on your smartphone that performs tasks on your behalf, beyond simply clearing your doubts, sounds no less than a scene taken from a sci-fi film. When asked how OPPO integrated it into the Find X10 series, Ellis Tai, OPPO's Software Product Director, explained that the company focused on two main directions: agentic and proactive AI.Rather than just answering queries, the new AI Agent mode is designed to execute real tasks. By leveraging on-device processing, the assistant can intelligently understand photos and local files across your apps. Users can organise files and perform complex follow-up operations using just a single prompt. Processing this sensitive data locally also ensures better privacy and battery efficiency. Tai also highlighted a proactive feature called AI Mind Suggest. This tool seamlessly tracks daily schedules, such as flights and train journeys, and provides timely reminders. It integrates with local partners to deliver personalised, context-aware suggestions directly to users. This eliminates the need to constantly switch between multiple applications for updates.These AI features are part of ColorOS 17, which debuts with the Find X10 series. The latest software delivers a smoother interface, faster app loading, and more intelligent, system-level AI capabilities. OPPO has also highlighted privacy and security improvements, including on-device fraud detection and safeguards for cloud-based AI processing.For a closer look at the new interface, AI tools, and other changes, read our detailed ColorOS 17 coverage.However, as AI increasingly relies on personal data to deliver this convenience, questions about cloud-based processing, data privacy, and security remain hard to ignore. Addressing this concern during the roundtable, Ellis said OPPO prefers on-device AI for sensitive personal information, including users' photos and passport details. However, when on-device processing cannot strike the right balance between performance and privacy, the company adopts a hybrid approach. In such cases, the company anonymises the data before sending it to the cloud for processing.Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max Display and BatteryBeyond camera and processor upgrades, OPPO has also significantly improved the displays on its latest flagship smartphones. The Find X10 features a 6.59-inch screen, while the Find X10 Pro Max gets a larger 6.78-inch panel. Both support a 144Hz LTPO adaptive refresh rate, 3,600 nits peak brightness, and Dolby Vision. The displays also support the BT.2020 colour gamut, which covers about 40% more colour than DCI-P3, potentially letting the phones reproduce a wider range of colours in HDR content.Battery capacity is another area where OPPO has raised the bar with the Find X10 series. Both smartphones pack an 8,000mAh silicon-carbon battery and support 80W wired and 50W wireless charging. This combination promises longer usage between charges and faster top-ups when the battery runs low.OPPO expands its connected ecosystem with Pad Mini and Enco X4Beyond its new flagship smartphones, OPPO has expanded its ecosystem with the Pad Mini Matte Display Edition tablet and Enco X4 wireless earbuds. Together, these products make it easier for users to move between capturing content, editing photos, and enjoying media across devices.The Pad Mini is especially appealing to users who enjoy mobile photography. It features an 8.8-inch 2.5K OLED matte display with a 144Hz refresh rate and up to 3,200 nits of peak local brightness. Its anti-reflection technology improves visibility in bright environments, while the compact 282g body makes it easier to carry. The tablet is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and runs ColorOS 16.The tablet also supports cross-device file transfers, enabling users to move photos and videos between compatible Android and iOS devices. This could allow Find X10 series users to transfer their shots to the Pad Mini for editing on its larger display. Tools such as AI Eraser, AI Portrait Glow and AI Remix Collage offer additional ways to refine photos, while the OPPO Pencil 3 supports sketching and other creative tasks. The 8,000mAh battery and 67W fast charging are designed to keep the tablet running through longer editing sessions.Completing the lineup, the Enco X4 earbuds feature an acoustic system co-tuned with Dynaudio, dual dynamic drivers and AI-powered adaptive noise cancellation. They also support lossless audio transmission at up to 2.3 Mbps when paired with compatible Find X10 series smartphones powered by MediaTek processors. Other features include spatial audio, AI-assisted call noise cancellation and real-time translation.Together, the Find X10 series, Pad Mini, and Enco X4 reflect OPPO's broader push toward a connected ecosystem: the smartphone handles photography, the tablet offers a portable space for editing and creative work, and the earbuds complete the entertainment experience.OPPO Find X10 series, Pad Mini and Enco X4: Price in IndiaOPPO has positioned its new flagship smartphones in the premium segment, with the Find X10 starting at 1,39,999 rupees for the 12GB RAM and 256GB storage variant. The 12GB RAM and 512GB storage model costs 1,69,999 rupees. Meanwhile, the Find X10 Pro Max costs 1,99,999 rupees for its 12GB RAM and 512GB storage configuration.Alongside the smartphones, the OPPO Pad Mini Matte Display Edition costs 94,999 rupees for the 8GB RAM and 256GB storage variant. The Enco X4 wireless earbuds are priced at 19,999 rupees.

title: 'Photos inconsistent with policy': Bikaner House on Raihan Vadra's exhibit amid row | India News
description: The exhibition featured wildlife and street photography. Vadra said he was asked to remove images documenting recent protests in the Capital. | India News
content: The management of Bikaner House in the Capital on Thursday said Raihan Vadra – Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and businessman Robert Vadra’s son – was asked to remove “certain photographs” from his solo exhibition after they were found “inconsistent with the policy” of the venue.The development came as the request sparked a political row, with Priyanka alleging that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) at the Centre was “afraid” and hit out at Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The BJP lashed back, alleging the Gandhi family was willing to do anything to regain power.The photographs in question are of the recent protests against the Election Commission that had gripped Delhi.“Certain photographs displayed … (were) found to be inconsistent with the policy of the Bikaner House Management Society. Accordingly, their removal was requested,” the management said.Also read | ‘They’re just pictures of Indian flag': Raihan Vadra questions removal of protest photos from Delhi exhibition“Bikaner House is a public cultural institution dedicated to the promotion of art and culture. The exhibition and associated activities must comply with Bikaner House Management Society Policy. The photographs that are consistent with the Society’s policy have been continued to be displayed,” it added.Bikaner House is owned and managed by the Rajasthan government.Raihan was ordered to take down images from his solo exhibition, No Idea is Final, which opened on Wednesday. In a statement, he alleged he was told to remove the photos only hours before the event was to begin. The exhibition ultimately featured wildlife and street photography.“Yesterday [Tuesday] I was contacted by the management of Bikaner House raising objections towards the ‘political nature’ of the protest images and was requested to remove them,” the 26-year-old said in the statement that was circulated at the opening of the exhibition.Also read | Priyanka Gandhi's son Raihan says asked to remove protest photos from Delhi exhibition: '50% of artworks'Raihan said the proposal approved by the Bikaner House management on June 30, 2025, clearly stated the exhibition would feature images depicting “themes of choice, control, and unity”. “The photos are simply a visual documentation of the people and the armed forces at the protests with no added commentary. Not a single photograph taken by me contains any derogatory or inflammatory comment of any kind,” he said.Despite this, Raihan alleged, he was asked to remove “50% of the artworks”.He also alleged that Rohit Kumar, the principal resident commissioner of Bikaner House, toured the rooms where the photographs were displayed before purportedly “calling the Rajasthan chief secretary” and another officer at the Chief Minister’s Office.“(They) finally informed me that I would have to remove all works deemed by him to be political by 3.30pm today, failing which the show would stand cancelled,” he alleged.On Thursday, Raihan said any curtailment of freedom of expression and art was wrong. "I don't know if there was any pressure or anything from anywhere else. I know that if it was the management here that decided to take that decision," he told ANI.Also read | 'Raihan was under lot of pressure': Robert Vadra, Priyanka Gandhi on son's Delhi exhibition rowPriyanka termed the move ridiculous and "muzzling" of the voice of the youth across the nation. "Today it's him, tomorrow it'll be another artist," she told news agency PTI.In a post on Instagram on Thursday, the Congress MP tagged Raihan and took a veiled jibe at the Narendra Modi-led government, saying, "When someone with power becomes afraid of the expression of another, he doesn't know it, but he has already lost the very power he is trying to protect.”Congress leader Pawan Khera also questioned the government's stance on artistic expression. "Raihan Vadra is an artist. We can't understand why this government is against the expression of art by an artist. Every day we see examples of how this government is against the youth voicing their opinions using different mediums, including art," he told news agency ANI.BJP national spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia, however, targeted the Congress leadership, alleging the Gandhi family was focused on regaining power."This fake Gandhi family wants power every time, and as soon as they are out of power, they will do anything. They can do anything for power. The law will prevail in the country, be it the defective product Rahul Gandhi or the future president of Congress, Raihan Vadra. Priyanka mummy is now on a new mission. After the launch of Rahul Gandhi, Raihan will be launched,” he said.

title: Teja Sajja Wedding: అవును పెళ్లి చేసుకోబోతున్నా.. అమ్మానాన్నలు చూసిన అమ్మాయి.. డెస్టినేషన్ వెడ్డింగే: తేజ సజ్జా | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Teja Sajja Wedding: 'హనుమాన్' చిత్రంతో పాన్ ఇండియా స్థాయిలో సంచలనం సృష్టించిన యంగ్ హీరో తేజ సజ్జా త్వరలోనే ఒక ఇంటివాడు కాబోతున్నారు. తన వివాహ నిశ్చితార్థం నవంబర్‌లో, పెళ్లి వేడుక డిసెంబర్‌లో రాజస్థాన్‌లోని రాజసింహ నగరం ఉదయ్‌పూర్‌లో జరగనుందని స్వయంగా స్పష్టం చేశారు.
content: Teja Sajja Wedding: బాలనటుడిగా టాలీవుడ్ తెరపై తన ముద్దు ముద్దు మాటలతో మురిపించి, ఇప్పుడు 'హనుమాన్' చిత్రంతో పాన్ ఇండియా రేంజ్‌లో బాక్సాఫీస్ వద్ద సరికొత్త రికార్డులను తిరగరాసిన యంగ్ హీరో తేజ సజ్జా త్వరలోనే ఒక ఇంటివాడు కాబోతున్నారు. గత కొన్ని రోజులుగా సోషల్ మీడియాలో ఆయన పెళ్లికి సంబంధించి వస్తున్న ఊహాగానాలకు తెరదించుతూ, తన వివాహ వార్తను స్వయంగా అధికారికంగా ధృవీకరించారు.తన వ్యక్తిగత జీవితంలో కొత్త అధ్యాయాన్ని ప్రారంభిస్తున్న తరుణంలో, అభిమానులకు, మీడియాకు తన పెళ్లి ముహూర్తం వివరాలను పంచుకున్నారు. పెద్దలు కుదిర్చిన ఈ పెళ్లిని అత్యంత సన్నిహితులు, కుటుంబ సభ్యుల సమక్షంలో ప్రైవేట్ వేడుకగా నిర్వహించనున్నట్లు తెలిపారు.పెద్దలు కుదిర్చిన బంధం.. నవంబర్‌లో ఎంగేజ్‌మెంట్!తన పెళ్లికి సంబంధించి వస్తున్న వార్తలపై స్పందించిన తేజ సజ్జా.. ఇది పూర్తిస్థాయిలో పెద్దలు కుదిర్చిన వివాహం (Arranged Marriage) అని స్పష్టం చేశారు. "ఈ వివాహాన్ని మా తల్లిదండ్రులు నిశ్చయించారు. పెద్దల సమక్షంలో కుదిరిన సంబంధం ఇది" అని ఆయన వెల్లడించారు.అందుతున్న సమాచారం ప్రకారం.. ఈ ఏడాది నవంబర్ నెలలో అత్యంత వైభవంగా నిశ్చితార్థ వేడుక (Engagement) జరగనుంది. ఆ తర్వాత డిసెంబర్‌లో పెళ్లి వేడుకలు జరగనున్నాయి. అయితే హడావుడి లేకుండా, ఆర్భాటాలకు దూరంగా కుటుంబ సభ్యులు, అత్యంత సన్నిహితుల సమక్షంలో మాత్రమే ఈ వేడుకలను నిర్వహించాలని భావిస్తున్నట్లు ఆయన తెలిపారు.రాజస్థాన్ సరస్సుల నగరం ఉదయ్‌పూర్‌లో డెస్టినేషన్ వెడ్డింగ్తేజ సజ్జా వివాహ మహోత్సవం రాజస్థాన్‌లోని రాయల్ సిటీ, సరస్సుల నగరంగా పేరుగాంచిన ఉదయ్‌పూర్ (Udaipur) లో జరగనుంది. రాజసానికి, ఐకానిక్ ప్యాలెస్‌లకు పుట్టినిల్లయిన ఉదయ్‌పూర్‌లోని ఒక ప్రముఖ ప్యాలెస్ వేదికగా గ్రాండ్ డెస్టినేషన్ వెడ్డింగ్ (Destination Wedding) ప్లాన్ చేస్తున్నారు. లైమ్‌లైట్, మీడియా హడావుడికి దూరంగా, ప్రశాంతమైన వాతావరణంలో తన వివాహ సంబరాలు జరగాలని కోరుకుంటున్నట్లు తేజ తెలిపారు.పెళ్లికూతురు ఎవరంటే?తేజ సజ్జా పెళ్లి చేసుకోబోతున్నాడంటే సహజంగానే అమ్మాయి ఎవరో అన్న కుతూహలం అందరిలోనూ ఉంటుంది. ఈ విషయాన్ని కూడా అతడు వెల్లడించాడు. అమ్మాయికి ఎలాంటి సినిమా బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్ లేదని, బిజినెస్ ఫ్యామిలీ అని, అమెరికాలో పెరిగిందని తేజ తెలిపాడు. అయితే ఆమె పేరును మాత్రం వెల్లడించలేదు.బాక్సాఫీస్ 'సూపర్ హీరో' ప్రయాణంకెరీర్ పరంగా తేజ సజ్జా ప్రస్తుతం టాలీవుడ్‌లో అత్యంత వేగంగా ఎదుగుతున్న యంగ్ స్టార్లలో ఒకరిగా నిలిచారు. ప్రశాంత్ వర్మ దర్శకత్వంలో వచ్చిన 'హనుమాన్' (Hanu-Man) చిత్రంతో అంతర్జాతీయ స్థాయిలో భారీ విజయం సొంతం చేసుకున్న ఆయన, ఇటీవల 'మిరాయ్' (Mirai) సినిమాతో తన బాక్సాఫీస్ స్టామినాను మరోసారి నిరూపించుకున్నారు.కేవలం వెండితెరపైనే కాకుండా అమెజాన్ ప్రైమ్ వీడియో ప్రతిష్టాత్మక షో 'ది ట్రైటర్స్' (The Traitors) తో పాటు, తన కెరీర్ బిగ్గెస్ట్ హిట్ సీక్వెల్ 'జాంబీ రెడ్డి NXT LVL' తోనూ ప్రేక్షకుల ముందుకు రాబోతున్నారు. ఒకవైపు వరుస ప్రాజెక్ట్‌లతో దూసుకుపోతూనే, మరోవైపు ఉదయ్‌పూర్ డెస్టినేషన్ వెడ్డింగ్‌తో కొత్త జీవితంలోకి అడుగుపెడుతున్న తేజ సజ్జాకు సినీ ప్రముఖులు, అభిమానులు సోషల్ మీడియా వేదికగా హృదయపూర్వక శుభాకాంక్షలు తెలుపుతున్నారు.

title: Sheetal Devi shows why she is the gold standard | Hindustan Times
description: The archer clinched two gold medals at the Asian Para Games as India climbed to 4th in the medal standings
content: In the Round of 16, Sheetal Devi scored 149 out of a possible 150. This score was one no one had achieved in an individual women’s para compound archery match. Yet here was the 19-year-old from Jammu and Kashmir, who took up the sport barely five years ago, setting yet another milestone in a journey of milestones.In 2023, she became the first armless woman to win a World Para Archery Championship medal when she clinched a silver. Last year, she became the first to win gold. At the Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Multipurpose Square, however, that 149 helped her set a new world record.Even before the tournament began, she was the player to beat. After all, the Paris Paralympic bronze-medallist was the defending champion in the individual women’s compound archery event at the Asian Para Games. On Thursday, though, as Sheetal competed in the final at the ongoing edition in Aichi-Nagoya, the elements started to play a few tricks. After the second End, Sheetal was trailing by four points against Singapore’s Syahidah Nur. Then, despite the tricky conditions, she fired six consecutive 10s – four in the inner 10 circle – to take a lead she would not relinquish, as she went on to win gold by a score of 142-139.This was her third medal at the 2026 Asian Para Games, having won silver in the women’s compound doubles event with Payal Nag, and a gold earlier in the day with Toman Kumar in the mixed compound event.“There was some pressure (I felt) because of the wind,” she later said to the media. “But my coach told me not to worry and just reset for the next End.“The silver yesterday was very good for me. But the gold I got today, I'm happy that what I had set to do, I have done. We work hard the entire year and you get to see only in one day how much you have worked and what you have done. That we can see today.”Sheetal will leave Japan with two golds and a silver medal to add to her constantly growing list of accolades. Interestingly, she won an identical tally in the exact same events from the previous edition at the delayed 2023 Games in Hangzhou, China.Her two gold medals on Thursday were a part of the 24 more medals won by the Indian contingent on the day, as the country’s total medal tally now stands at 88 (21 gold, 26 silver, 41 bronze) at the end of the fourth day of the quadrennial competition.Like Sheetal, Dilip Gavit also clinched his second gold medal of the ongoing Games. A day earlier, the 23-year-old from Nashik won the men’s 100m T47 race. And on Thursday defended his 400m T47 gold medal by clocking 48.27s, a full 1.31 seconds faster than second placed Kakeru Ishida of Japan.Ravanni Valasanaini also won her second medal of the current edition, picking up bronze in the women’s 400m T11 event, just days after she won bronze in the women’s 1500m T11 race.India added three more medals in the men’s high jump T63 event, as Shailesh Kumar, Varun Bhati and Rahul Saroha won gold, silver and bronze respectively to make it a clean sweep in an event that involved six competitors. In the process, Shailesh, the reigning world champion, also managed to defend his title with a Games record attempt of 1.89m.Also leaping his way to a second consecutive gold medal at the Asian Para Games was Solairaj Dharmaraj, who defended his crown in the men’s long jump T44/T62/T64 event, with an attempt of 7.15m.Gold medals also came through Suvarna Raj in the women’s discus throw F54, while Anjanaben Bumbadiya finished first and compatriot Jayanti Behera won silver in the women’s 400m T47.In archery, Swati Chaudhary took home the silver after losing a tight final in the women’s individual W1 to China’s Mengkan Cen 4-6. There were also silver medals from Tejalben Damor in the women’s 400m T12, and para swimmer Kapil Kumar in the men’s 400m freestyle S10.A few bronze medals came in from para swimming events. Ravi Budigina finished third in the men’s 50m freestyle S13 final, Swatik Patil won bronze men’s 100m breaststroke SB9, while Tejas Nandakumar also took the bronze in the men’s 100m backstroke S7.After winning bronze in the women’s individual Class 4/5 table tennis event, Bhavina Patel paired up with Shubham Wadhwa to win bronze in the mixed doubles class 7 event.The badminton contingent also started to win medals, with seven bronze medals coming in on Thursday.Manisha Ramdass lost to compatriot Thulasimathi Murugesan (who will compete in the gold medal match) in the women’s singles SU5 semi-final to secure bronze. Ramdass also won bronze with Pramod Bhagat after they lost their semi-final to Indonesia’s Leani Oktila and Hikmat Ramdani in the mixed doubles SL3-SU5 event.There were also bronze medals for Abhijeet Sakhuja (men’s singles SL4), Sanjana Kumari (women’s singles SL3), Suhas Yathiraj (men’s singles SL4), Suryakant Yadav and Naveen Sivakumar (men’s doubles SL3-SU5) and Nithya Sre Sivan and Krishna Nagar (mixed doubles SH6).

title: Harry Brook breaks Shubman Gill's world record with 114-ball double ton | Cricket
description: England captain Harry Brook blasted 202 off 116 balls against Sri Lanka, reaching his double century in a record 114 deliveries.  | Cricket
content: England captain Harry Brook tore apart the Sri Lankan attack in the third match of the tri-nation series which also features Pakistan at the Rawalpindi Cricket Association Stadium, as he smashed the fastest double century in ODI cricket.He reached the milestone in just 114 balls, breaking Shubman Gill's record of 117 deliveries, which was achieved against West Indies last month.During the course of his knock, Brook also became the first England player to score a double century, passing Ben Stokes' previous record of 182 against New Zealand in 2023. His gargantuan effort is the 14th double century in men's ODI history, and the 12th highest individual score ever recorded in the ODI format. Brook also became only the second player after Chris Gayle to achieve the rare triumvirate of scoring a 300 in Tests, 200 in ODIs and a century in T20Is.Following England's tri-series opening defeat to Pakistan, the 27-year-old captain led from the front against Sri Lanka, as he powered England to a massive total of 429-4, the highest ODI team total ever scored on Pakistani soil.Here is a list of the fastest double centuries in ODI history: ALSO READ: Samson, Iyer and Dhir fashion record win for IndiaFrom slow start to record-breaking pace Harry Brook started his innings cautiously, scoring 13 runs in his first 24 balls before slightly picking up pace. He reached his fifty in 42 balls, and then accelerated a bit to score his century in 75 deliveries. Once he was past three figures, he cut loose, as he tore apart the Sri Lankan bowling attack. He needed only 39 more balls to race from 100 to 200.England's marathon innings was set up by opener Tom Banton (50) and Ben Duckett (29), before Brook and Joe Root (69) added 159 runs for the third wicket.After Root fell, Will Jacks was promoted to number five and joined his captain for a breathtaking 185-run partnership off just 79 balls. Will Jacks hit an unbeaten 66 from 25 balls as England piled on 156 runs in the final 10 overs.This innings continues Brook's remarkable form in Pakistan, where he also averages over 80 in six Test matches, including a 317 in Multan two years ago. In fact, statistics show that Brook thrives more with the mantle of England captain on his head. As ODI captain, Brook averages 56.04 compared to 25.20 when not leading the side. In T20Is too, he averages 47.57 as captain, compared to 28.50 when he is not captaining the side.

title: Tiger Shroff's team shares video of his burn marks after firing, explaining his bandages in first pictures after attack | Bollywood
description: On October 18, three assailants attacked Tiger Shroff and fired gunshots at him, leaving his driver and a bystander injured.   | Bollywood
content: On October 18, three assailants publicly fired guns at Tiger Shroff in the Juhu area in Mumbai. The actor did not sustain any bullet wounds, while his driver and a bystander did. However, in his first pictures after the incident, Tiger was seen wearing bandages on his arm and shoulder, which worried his fans. His team posted a video showing burn marks on his skin, which seemed to explain the bandages.Tiger Shroff sustains burn marks after firingThe official Team Tiger Shroff page posted a short video on their Instagram on Thursday. The video shows the inside of the actor’s arm, completely speckled with brown dots that resemble burn marks. It looks consistent with gunshot or gunpowder residue, which is caused by flying debris, leaving dark specks known as powder tattooing. The areas shown in the video are consistent with where Tiger was wearing bandages during his meeting with Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde. This comes after many wondered why Tiger was wearing bandages when the police had not reported any injuries to the actor. His father, Jackie, and sister, Krishna, commented under the video with folded hands and other emojis. His mother, Ayesha, wrote, “God is great,” in response to the team’s caption, “God is kind.”Tiger Shroff’s team warns against AI videosTiger’s team also put out a statement after the firing attack, warning against the circulation of misinformation and AI videos. “We would like to categorically clarify that Tiger Shroff has made no statements, released no videos, and authorised no communication regarding the recent incident or any related developments,” read a portion of their statement.They also wrote, “It has come to our attention that several social media pages and digital platforms are circulating fabricated stories, AI-generated videos and scripted narratives, falsely attributed to Tiger. These are completely false, unauthorised and intended to mislead the public.” The team warned of legal consequences for those continuing to spread misinformation. Arrests in firing caseArrests in Tiger’s case were made within hours of the incident, with three suspects being picked up in Kota and brought to Mumbai. Gangster Anil Pandit, a close aide of Lawrence Bishnoi, claimed responsibility for the firing in a social media post. Four suspects in the case have been identified as Kunal (21) and Sumit (19), both residents of Haryana's Sonipat district, and Radha (23) and Babita (23), both from Uttar Pradesh. A total of 10 persons have been arrested in the case so far.

title: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon urges CEOs to ditch ‘autocratic’ leadership and learn from Ted Lasso | Trending
description: Jamie Dimon sees Ted Lasso as an example of how leaders can bring people together, listen and learn without pretending to know everything.   | Trending
content: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon believes corporate bosses can learn a thing or two from Ted Lasso, the fictional football coach known for his optimism and people-first approach. Dimon says leaders should focus on building trust, addressing poor behaviour and bringing teams together to achieve common goals, rather than acting like autocrats.Why Jamie Dimon admires Ted Lasso’s leadership“I love Ted Lasso,” Dimon told The Wall Street Journal, according to Fortune.In the Apple TV+ series, Lasso takes charge of AFC Richmond despite having little knowledge of English football. Instead of pretending to know everything, he approaches his players with humility, learns from others and works to understand their personal struggles.Dimon believes this approach offers a lesson for corporate leaders. He has criticised companies where politics and bureaucracy prevent employees from doing their best work.(Also Read: At St Andrews University in Scotland, students hold a shaving-foam fight to thank senior mentors)“Some of the bad people want to keep it that way, like autocrats,” he said, referring to individuals who benefit from keeping others suppressed.Dimon added that effective leaders must recognise damaging behaviour, address it and help their organisations improve. This may take time, particularly when employees who undermine the workplace have been doing so for years.Chevron CEO Mike Wirth also backs the approachDimon is not the only business leader who sees value in Lasso’s methods. Chevron CEO Mike Wirth has also highlighted the importance of curiosity and listening before making decisions.In comments reported by The Wall Street Journal, Wirth said the best leaders he had worked with asked questions, listened to others and tried to understand a situation before deciding what to do.This approach reflects Lasso’s experience at AFC Richmond. Although he begins as an outsider, he earns the players’ trust by acknowledging what he does not know and drawing on the strengths of those around him.What business leaders can learn from Ted LassoLeadership experts have also pointed to the character’s emphasis on humility and learning. In an interview with the University of Washington’s Foster School of Business, management professor Bruce Avolio highlighted Lasso’s curiosity and willingness to delay judgement.(Also Read: 'I don't know what will happen 5 years from now': Nikhil Kamath on whether he would marry someday)Dimon’s message is that good leadership goes beyond targets and authority. It means building trust, encouraging learning and balancing empathy with accountability.

title: The rise of eco-centric horizontal design: How low-impact architecture is reshaping sustainable living | Hindustan Times
description: This article is authored by Ashwin Kumar, founder & managing director, Vibez Estates.
content: For many years, the high-rise buildings in cities were the ultimate representation of luxury living in India. But now, with increasing environmental challenges such as urban heat islands, higher carbon footprints, and extreme spatial congestion in the city, there is a paradigm shift taking place in the way we plan our habitats. Eco-conscious home builders and environmentally-minded people are turning their back on the vertical density of concrete buildings and focusing on horizontal living spaces.This shift is not merely an inclination towards more open space but rather is a part of a larger trend toward eco-centric master planning. This trend toward low density, resort-linked estates is based on three fundamental principles of sustainability: Regenerative land stewardship, biophilia, and environmental viability.1. Regenerative land stewardship and active conservation: Previously, any development or conservation of rural areas has caused fragmentation of the ecosystem where any unplanned clearing has negatively affected the local ecosystem and hydrological properties of the soil. On the contrary, low density horizontal estates emphasise land stewardship via effective environmental management.With the inclusion of residential areas in planned natural reserves, a large area of land is left unspoiled and teeming with life. Professional property management takes care of harvesting of rain water, conservation of soil, conservation of micro forests, and organic land management. The man-made structures adjust themselves to the existing landscape rather than making any change in the natural landscape.2. Biophilic architecture and low-impact vernacular design: In contrast to high-rises in cities that make use of artificial material along with air-conditioning, biophilic design makes use of ideas derived out of local wisdom. Biophilic design is all about designing buildings in harmony with nature.These constructions have been able to provide natural insulation and protection from weather conditions using environmentally friendly materials like unplastered local laterite stones, local wood, and terracotta tiled roofs with low slopes. Big verandas and sit out spaces offer maximum cross ventilation and entry of sunlight, resulting in little need for artificial cooling and energy usage. It is evident that architectural brilliance is not about creating big carbon footprints but about having an intimate connection with nature.3. Circular micro-ecosystems and sustainable asset care: Apart from structure design, sustainable living is also based on efficiency of resources. Structures that exist in isolation often have problems with inefficiency of energy usage, improper waste disposal, and high consumption of water.The inclusion of living spaces within a larger eco-reserve managed by professionals results in the formation of micro-ecosystems. The integration of solar energy, decentralised waste disposal, organic composting, and water treatment ensures that the property operates in an environmentally-friendly way. With uniform eco-sensitive standards for all spaces, efficient use of resources is guaranteed, without the wastage found in individual rural lands.As urban environmental pressures rise in intensity, the very idea of luxury is being permanently redefined. Sustainable architecture does not merely involve the creation of artificial structures within nature but also of environments that touch the earth lightly. Low density and biophilic horizontal design principles are the signs of rising environmental consciousness, where spatial well-being, architectural humility, and environmental responsibility blend to create sustainable sanctuaries for future generations to come.Another important aspect of eco-centric horizontal design is its potential to strengthen the relationship between communities and their surrounding environment. Unlike conventional urban developments, which often prioritise built-up space over shared natural areas, low-density planning creates opportunities for residents to engage with landscapes, gardens and open spaces as part of their everyday lives. This can encourage outdoor activity, improve psychological well-being and foster a stronger sense of belonging. However, these benefits depend on responsible planning, accessibility and the long-term preservation of natural resources.The success of this approach also rests on how sustainability is measured beyond the initial construction phase. Factors such as land-use efficiency, the availability of essential services, transportation requirements and the ecological impact of development must be considered before adopting horizontal expansion as a preferred model. Without careful planning, low-density housing can contribute to urban sprawl, increased dependence on private vehicles and the loss of agricultural land. Therefore, the objective should not simply be to build horizontally but to ensure that every development has a clearly defined environmental responsibility.For India's rapidly urbanising landscape, the future of sustainable housing will depend on balancing human aspirations with ecological limits. By combining thoughtful master planning, locally appropriate architecture and accountable resource management, eco-centric horizontal developments can offer an alternative that places environmental resilience and quality of life at the centre of modern living.(The views expressed are personal)This article is authored by Ashwin Kumar, founder & managing director, Vibez Estates.

title: Switching between wet and dry pet food: Expert shares how to adjust portions and ease the transition | Hindustan Times
description: Pets may need time to adapt to new textures and nutrient profiles, especially when switching from home-cooked meals to packaged food.
content: Are you looking to change your pet's food or unsure where to begin? Whether you are trying a new brand or moving from home-cooked meals to packaged food, your pet may need time to adjust. Introducing the change gradually can help make the transition smoother and keep digestive discomfort at bay.ALSO READ: Pet hair and paw marks ruining your furniture? 5 expert-approved ways to protect your interiorsDr Ashok Pattanaik, head of R&D at Godrej Pet Care, walked us through the essentials of changing a pet's diet, for moving from home-cooked meals to packaged food and adjusting portion sizes.Why do you need to take care when switching your pet's food? He explained, "Pet owners often assume switching food is as simple as swapping one bowl for another. It isn't. A pet's gut hosts a stable population of bacteria calibrated to their current diet, and abrupt changes can disrupt this balance, leading to vomiting, diarrhoea, or a sudden refusal to eat, according to feline health experts at Cornell University's College of Veterinary Medicine.”So, even if your pet readily accepts the new food, it is better if you introduce it gradually. They may be willing to eat, but it does not mean that their digestive system has been fully adjusted. How to switch from home-cooked food to packaged food?But why does switching from home-cooked meals to packaged food require particular care? Why can't you switch altogether? The expert attributed this to differences in texture and moisture content.Home-cooked food is usually soft and moist, but dry pet food has 10 percent less moisture. A pet accustomed to soft food may continue gulping down dry kibble rather than chewing it properly.He also added, “When the habit of gulping carries over to dry kibble, which needs to be chewed, it can lead to reflux and vomiting. A pet's digestive system also needs time to adjust to a different overall nutrient profile between home-cooked and packaged food, which is another reason this particular switch benefits from a slower pace than an abrupt change between two packaged foods."Instead, Pattanaik recommended introducing new food gradually by mixing a small amount into the existing diet and slowly increasing the proportion over time, rather than switching all at once. How to adjust portions when switching between wet and dry foods?Here's a set of tips from the expert on how to introduce new pet food gradually:Spread the transition over 7 to 10 days for most pets.Start by mixing 10 to 25 percent new food into the existing food.Increase the proportion of new food every two or three days, reducing the old food by the same amount.By the end of the transition, the new food should completely replace the old food.Cats may need longer than dogs to adjust, so allow more time if needed. Which format: dry or wet?Next, the format was addressed as there are different types, like wet, dry and mixed.The expert described, “Moving from dry to wet food requires portion adjustment, since wet food is high in water (sometimes up to 80 percent or more) your pet will need a larger volume to get the same calories. Moving the other way, from wet to dry, means smaller portions, since dry food is more calorie-dense.”Some pets also resist a new texture altogether; in that case, lightly moistening dry kibble with a little warm water or broth can ease the transition.How to check food label?Before you buy any pet food, Pattanaik asked to check the ingredient list. He advised looking for named protein sources such as chicken or fish, rather than generic terms like ‘meat and animal derivatives.’What are the signs that indicate discomfort?The expert advised monitoring your pet for loose stools, vomiting, or loss of appetite during the transition. If a mild digestive problem occurs, slow the transition and return to the previous food ratio. But, make sure to seek prompt vet advice if pet stops eating or symptoms persist or worsen, rather than pushing ahead with the switch.Note to readers: This article is for informational purposes only and not a substitute for professional medical advice.

title: OTT Malayalam: ఓటీటీలోకి తెలుగులో మలయాళం థ్రిల్లర్ మూవీ.. మళ్లీ మళ్లీ పెళ్లి.. శోభనం ఆపే తోకచుక్క.. టైమ్ లూప్ థ్రిల్లర్ | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: OTT Malayalam: మలయాళంలో వినూత్న టైమ్-లూప్ కామెడీ థ్రిల్లర్‌గా రూపొందిన 'ధూమకేతు' (Dhoomakethu) మూవీ మరికొన్ని గంటల్లో ఓటీటీలోకి రాబోతోంది. సజిన్ గోపు, నిఖిలా విమల్ ప్రధాన పాత్రల్లో నటించిన ఈ సినిమా రేపటి నుంచి అంటే అక్టోబర్ 23 నుంచి ప్రముఖ ఓటీటీ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్ నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్ లో స్ట్రీమింగ్ కానుంది.
content: OTT Malayalam: సస్పెన్స్, క్రైమ్, థ్రిల్లర్ కాన్సెప్ట్‌లను కామెడీతో మేళవించి తెరకెక్కించడంలో మలయాళ చిత్ర పరిశ్రమ ఎప్పుడూ ముందే ఉంటుంది. వినూత్నమైన కథాంశాలతో ప్రేక్షకులు, విమర్శకుల ప్రశంసలు అందుకునే మాలీవుడ్ చిత్రాలకు తెలుగు ఓటీటీ ప్రియుల్లోనూ విశేష ఆదరణ ఉంది. అదే కోవలో సెప్టెంబర్ 25న థియేటర్లలోకి వచ్చి ఆకట్టుకున్న వైవిధ్యభరితమైన టైమ్-లూప్ కామెడీ థ్రిల్లర్ 'ధూమకేతు' (Dhoomakethu). థియేట్రికల్ రన్ ముగించుకున్న ఈ చిత్రం డిజిటల్ ప్రీమియర్ కోసం సిద్ధమైంది.దర్శకుడు సుధీ మాడిసన్ (Sudhi Maddison) తెరకెక్కించిన ఈ వినూత్న చిత్రాన్ని ప్రముఖ డిజిటల్ దిగ్గజం నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్ (Netflix) కొనుగోలు చేసింది. ఈ శుక్రవారం అంటే అక్టోబర్ 23 నుంచి ఈ సినిమా ఓటీటీలో స్ట్రీమింగ్ కానున్నట్లు నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్ సంస్థ అధికారికంగా వెల్లడించింది. ఈ చిత్రాన్ని మలయాళంతో పాటు తెలుగు, తమిళం, కన్నడ, హిందీ భాషల్లో కూడా అందుబాటులోకి తీసుకొస్తున్నారు.ధూమకేతు.. శోభనం ఆపే తోకచుక్కమలయాళ కామెడీ థ్రిల్లర్ మూవీ 'ధూమకేతు' స్టోరీ అంతా కుట్టన్ (సజిన్ గోపు) అనే వ్యక్తి చుట్టూ తిరుగుతుంది. షర్మిల (నిఖిలా విమల్) అనే యువతిని ఇష్టపడి పెళ్లి చేసుకున్న కుట్టన్‌కి, తన పెళ్లి రోజే ఒక భయంకరమైన పీడకల వస్తుంది. తాను దారుణంగా హత్యకు గురైనట్లు అతనికి కల వస్తుంది.అయితే తీరా నిద్ర లేచాక పెళ్లి పనులు ప్రారంభం కాగానే, అంతకు ముందు జరిగిన ఘటనలే మళ్లీ మళ్లీ జరుగుతున్నట్లు అతనికి అనిపిస్తుంది (Deja vu). కేరళపై నుంచి వెళ్లే ఓ తోకచుక్క ఈ టైమ్ లూప్ కు కారణమవుతుంది. తను ఒక టైమ్-లూప్‌లో చిక్కుకున్నానని, ప్రతీ రాత్రి తను చనిపోతూ మళ్లీ అదే రోజు ఉదయానికి చేరుకుంటున్నానని అతను గ్రహిస్తాడు.శోభనానికి ముందే ఇలా జరగడంతో కుట్టన్ తీవ్ర నిరాశలో కూరుకుపోతాడు. ఈ వింత చక్రం నుంచి బయటపడటానికి, తన మరణం వెనుక ఉన్న అసలు నిజాన్ని ఛేదించడానికి కుట్టన్ చేసే ప్రయత్నాలే ఈ సినిమా ప్రధాన కథాంశం.ధూమకేతు మూవీ విశేషాలుఈ ధూమకేతు చిత్రంలో సజిన్ గోపు, నిఖిలా విమల్ జంటగా నటించగా.. గణపతి, మంజు పిళ్లై, షైన్ టామ్ చాకో ఇతర కీలక పాత్రల్లో కనిపించారు. సాంకేతిక విభాగంలో అంకిత్ మీనన్ సంగీతాన్ని అందించగా, జింటో జార్జ్ ఛాయాగ్రహణం, వివేక్ హర్షన్ ఎడిటింగ్ బాధ్యతలను నిర్వర్తించారు.ఈ మూవీకి క్రిటిక్స్ నుంచి సానుకూల ప్రశంసలు దక్కినప్పటికీ, ఈ చిత్రం థియేటర్ల వద్ద ఆశించిన స్థాయిలో వసూళ్లను సాధించలేకపోయింది. దాదాపు రూ. 1.65 కోట్ల గ్రాస్ వసూళ్లతో బాక్సాఫీస్ వద్ద నిరాశపరిచింది. సాధారణంగా టైమ్-లూప్ కాన్సెప్ట్ సైన్స్ ఫిక్షన్‌ను సంక్లిష్టంగా మార్చకుండా, ఇందులోని కామెడీ ఎలిమెంట్స్, మిస్టరీ డ్రామాను ప్రధానంగా హైలైట్ చేస్తూ దర్శకుడు సుధీ మాడిసన్ దీనిని రక్తికట్టించారు.డిజిటల్ వేదికపై ఈ టైమ్-లూప్ కామెడీ థ్రిల్లర్‌కు విశేష ఆదరణ లభిస్తుందని మేకర్స్ భావిస్తున్నారు. వీకెండ్‌లో మైండ్ బ్లాకింగ్ అండ్ ఎంటర్‌టైనింగ్ థ్రిల్లర్ చూడాలనుకునే తెలుగు ఓటీటీ ప్రియులకు 'ధూమకేతు' మంచి ఛాయిస్ కానుంది.

title: Saif Ali Khan sells 797 sq ft flat in Mumbai’s Bandra West for  ₹4.11 crore | Bollywood
description: Mumbai real estate: Saif Ali Khan Pataudi has completed the sale of a 797 sq ft apartment in Bandra West for  ₹4.11 crore  | Bollywood
content: Saif Ali Khan Pataudi has completed the sale of a 797 sq ft carpet-area flat in Mumbai’s Bandra West for ₹4.11 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.The sale deed was executed and registered on October 19, 2026. The agreement to sell was dated March 7, 2024, and registered on March 11, 2024, the documents show. The buyers paid ₹24.66 lakh in stamp duty for the transaction.The actor could not be reached for comment.According to property registration records, Khan purchased a 6,000 sq ft carpet-area unit spanning two higher floors of Hi-Cons Residency from developer Hi-Con Constructions on March 30, 2007, for ₹9.7 crore.The unit, which came with parking spaces, was formally divided into three apartments on June 19, 2014: a 2,997 sq ft flat on a lower floor, a second flat on the same floor measuring 2,205 sq ft, and the 797 sq ft flat on a higher floor that is the subject of the current sale. According to CRE Matrix, the original purchase price of ₹9.7 crore covered all three apartments.Saif Ali Khan’s other real estate transactionsIn a separate transaction, Khan leased two commercial units spanning 5,692 sq ft of RERA carpet area on Andheri Kurla Road in Mumbai to Durva Fintech Private Limited for a monthly rent of ₹22.76 lakh, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.The leave and licence agreement was registered on September 29, 2026, for a five-year term running from May 10, 2026, to May 9, 2031. The documents identify Vikaas Mohan Sachdeva, a director of Durva Fintech, as the licensee and Khan, acting through his constituted attorney, as the licensor.Also Read: ₹711 crore tower to ₹294 crore apartments: Mumbai’s sea-facing versus sea-view luxury homes premium explained">From a ₹711 crore tower to ₹294 crore apartments: Mumbai’s sea-facing versus sea-view luxury homes premium explainedKhan also owns an apartment in Mumbai’s Satguru Sharan building, where he lives with his family. The over 6,500 sq ft apartment was purchased in April 2012 for ₹23.50 crore from real estate developer Satguru Builders, according to property index-2 documents accessed by IndexTap.com.Before moving to Satguru Sharan, Khan and his wife, Kareena Kapoor Khan, lived in the Fortune Heights apartment complex in Bandra. In April 2016, Khan purchased an apartment measuring more than 950 sq ft in the complex for ₹7 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by Zapkey.com.Earlier, Khan had leased commercial office space in Andheri to a fintech firm for a monthly rent of ₹22.76 lakh.Read more:₹22.76 lakh monthly rent"> Saif Ali Khan leases office space in Mumbai's Andheri to a fintech firm for ₹22.76 lakh monthly rent.

title: India’s POSH compliance gap: Why workplace awareness must go beyond policies | Hindustan Times
description: This article is authored by Sidra Javed, lawyer, The Legal Swan.
content: India’s workplace sexual harassment framework has made significant strides in establishing institutional accountability. Yet, the presence of policies, Internal Committees and mandatory training programmes does not necessarily mean that employees understand their rights or know how to respond when faced with inappropriate behaviour. The real challenge lies in translating legal compliance into everyday workplace awareness.New research by Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) at Work, the dedicated practise of The Legal Swan (TLS), highlights this disconnect. Drawing on two reports, The Quiet Crisis and The Silent Gap, the findings examine 103 workplace sexual harassment complaints handled in 2025 and survey responses from 6,353 participants, including employees, students, managers, Internal Committee members and trainers. Together, the reports offer insights into the challenges organisations continue to face in implementing the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, commonly known as the POSH Act.One of the most striking findings is that 24.86% of employees surveyed were unaware that their organisation had a POSH policy. This raises an important question: How effective can a workplace protection mechanism be if a significant proportion of employees do not even know it exists? A POSH policy is not merely a document to be maintained for compliance purposes. It should help employees understand what constitutes sexual harassment, where they can seek assistance, how complaints are handled and what safeguards are available to protect the confidentiality of the process.The findings also indicate that 38.45% of respondents did not recognise abusive or vulgar language in the workplace as a form of sexual harassment. While the legal assessment of any incident depends on its specific circumstances and the applicable statutory requirements, the finding points to a broader problem: Employees may not always recognise inappropriate conduct or understand when it warrants intervention.This gap in understanding can affect both reporting and prevention. Behaviour that makes an individual uncomfortable may go unreported because the person is uncertain whether it qualifies as misconduct, while others may fail to recognise the seriousness of their own actions. For organisations, the implication is clear. Communicating the existence of a policy is only the first step; ensuring that employees understand its practical application is equally important.The research also highlights concerns around confidentiality during the complaint-handling process. According to the survey, 54.27% of employees and 41.14% of managers said they would discuss an ongoing harassment complaint with colleagues. This finding deserves particular attention because confidentiality is fundamental to a fair and credible redressal mechanism. The POSH Act places specific confidentiality obligations on those involved in the complaint process, including restrictions on the publication or communication of information relating to complaints, proceedings and the identities of the parties, subject to the applicable legal provisions.Workplace discussions about an ongoing complaint can expose individuals to speculation, social pressure and reputational harm. They may also undermine confidence in the internal committee and discourage others from reporting incidents. Organisations must therefore treat confidentiality as a practical responsibility rather than a clause in a policy. Employees and managers need to understand what information can be shared, with whom, and under what circumstances. Internal Committees must also follow appropriate procedures to safeguard sensitive information throughout the inquiry. A workplace that cannot protect the privacy of people involved in a complaint risks weakening the very system designed to provide them with recourse.Another important insight from The Quiet Crisis concerns where incidents occur. The analysis found that 43.69% of the incidents examined did not occur within office premises. Instead, they took place in extended workplace settings, including company offsites, business travel, hotel rooms and after-hours gatherings. A further 25.24% of complaints involved both office and non-office settings. These findings challenge the assumption that workplace safety is limited to an organisation's physical premises. Professional relationships frequently extend beyond regular office hours. Employees travel together for business, attend conferences, participate in team-building activities and interact at company-sponsored social gatherings. Such interactions can form part of the broader employment environment, even when they take place away from the workplace.The POSH Act recognises this broader context through its definition of the workplace, which includes certain locations visited by an employee during or arising out of employment. Whether a particular incident falls within the Act's scope depends on the circumstances and the applicable legal provisions. For employers, this means that prevention measures cannot be confined to office buildings. Workplace conduct policies, awareness sessions and reporting mechanisms must also address professional travel, offsite events and other employment-related settings. Managers should be equipped to recognise inappropriate behaviour in these environments, while employees must know that organisational standards of conduct do not disappear when a professional event moves outside the office.The complaint analysis further found that 90.20% of the complaints examined involved hostile work environment harassment. The concerns included persistent comments, unwanted messages, inappropriate jokes and repeated boundary violations. The finding highlights the importance of examining workplace behaviour beyond isolated incidents. Repeated comments or unwanted communications can create an uncomfortable professional environment, particularly when individuals feel unable to object because of hierarchical relationships, fear of retaliation or uncertainty about the available complaint mechanisms.At the same time, the legal classification of conduct depends on the facts of each case and the requirements of the POSH Act. Not every instance of inappropriate language automatically constitutes sexual harassment under the statute. The context, nature of the conduct and applicable legal criteria must be carefully assessed. Nevertheless, organisations should not wait until behaviour escalates into a formal complaint before addressing concerns about workplace culture. Clear behavioural expectations, accessible reporting channels and appropriate managerial intervention can help identify problems at an earlier stage. The objective should be to create an environment in which employees understand professional boundaries and feel confident seeking guidance when those boundaries are crossed.A recurring challenge in workplace compliance is the tendency to measure success through activities completed rather than understanding achieved. A training session may be conducted, attendance recorded and a compliance report filed, but these steps alone cannot establish whether employees know how to apply the law. The findings of The Silent Gap suggest that awareness and practical understanding do not always move together. Employees may have heard of the POSH Act without understanding its scope, managers may be unsure about their responsibilities, and Internal Committee members may require continuing support to navigate complex situations. Effective training should therefore be tailored to the responsibilities of different stakeholder groups.Employees need to understand acceptable workplace conduct, reporting options and the safeguards available under the law. Managers require guidance on responding appropriately to disclosures, avoiding informal investigations and preserving confidentiality. Internal Committee members need role-specific training on inquiry procedures, natural justice, documentation and the statutory framework.Organisations should also periodically assess whether their training programmes are producing measurable improvements in understanding. Scenario-based exercises, knowledge assessments and feedback mechanisms can help identify gaps that conventional presentations may overlook. The objective is not simply to demonstrate that training has taken place, but to establish whether employees can recognise concerns and respond appropriately.As scrutiny of workplace compliance continues, organisations must recognise that effective POSH implementation involves more than maintaining policies and constituting Internal Committees. It requires a sustained commitment to prevention, awareness, procedural fairness and accountability. The findings of The Quiet Crisis and The Silent Gap point towards a common concern: The distance between having a legal framework in place and ensuring that people understand how to use it. Adv. Shivangi Prasad, founder, The Legal Swan, emphasises this distinction, “Attendance in a training room does not guarantee awareness, and awareness does not always translate into understanding.” Her observation captures a central challenge for employers. Compliance must be assessed not only by the existence of institutional mechanisms but also by whether employees know where to turn, whether complaints can be handled confidentially and whether workplace conduct is consistent with the standards organisations claim to uphold.A credible POSH framework should enable employees to raise concerns without unnecessary barriers, ensure that complaints are examined through appropriate procedures and encourage organisations to address behavioural risks before they become entrenched. Ultimately, workplace safety cannot be achieved through documentation alone. It depends on whether the law's principles are reflected in everyday interactions, managerial decisions and organisational culture.India's next phase of POSH compliance must therefore focus on making awareness meaningful, training practical and accountability consistent. The measure of success is not simply whether an organisation has fulfilled its formal obligations, but whether its people understand the protections available to them and whether its systems are equipped to respond when those protections are needed.(The views expressed are personal)This article is authored by Sidra Javed, lawyer, The Legal Swan.

title: Namo Narayana left lucrative job as business consultant to pursue acting 17 years ago; stole the show from Rajinikanth in Jailer 2 | Hindustan Times
description: Namo Narayana worked in Bahrain, Dubai, Malaysia and even gave up a US visa to return to India and work in films. Know all about him.
content: If you’ve watched any Nelson Dilipkumar film, even before Jailer 2, you know that he likes to fill his films with quirky characters who outdo one another when it comes to being oddballs. So, in a film practically designed to celebrate Rajinikanth’s 50-year legacy, it’s hard for a character to stand out, no matter how funny they are. But Namo Narayana managed to do that with his role. At one point in the film, you even worry if his character, Moorthi, will make it.Namo Narayana as Moorthi annaEarly on in Jailer 2, Rajinikanth’s Tiger Muthuvel Pandian is sent to work for Moorthi anna (elder brother) as a form of punishment. A fruit juice seller who fashions himself to be a dreaded goon, he displays the kind of self-confidence that’s hard for anyone to match. Be it while negotiating with an actual gangster or getting convinced that he’s feared just because Muthu said so, Moorthi could easily come across as a caricature. But he doesn’t.Everything from Narayana’s hilarious delivery of dialogue to the self-important air he carries himself with makes Moorthi so lovable. In one scene, he even calls Muthu his Mjölnir (the legendary hammer), believing that he himself is no less than Thor. There’s even a Harry Potter dialogue that’s best not repeated here. Moorthi is the personification of the saying ‘ignorance is bliss’ In a meta scene, he’s confidently making chess moves without even knowing the first thing about the players or the game. So, it’s no wonder that since Jailer 2’s release, Moorthi has become a fan-favourite with memes featuring his dialogues and characters doing the rounds. Even Rajinikanth couldn't help but praise Narayana even before the film's release. But did you know that the man playing the character has been in the film industry for 17 years, having quit a lucrative career in software to pursue acting?Namo Narayana’s careerOn comedian Manobala’s Waste Paper YouTube channel in 2020, Narayana spoke about how he has been close friends with actor Samuthirakani since before he entered the film industry. He worked as a business consultant for software companies in Bahrain, Dubai, Malaysia and the US before making the switch. The actor even recalled obtaining a US visa valid for 10 years, which he later decided not to pursue. Narayana’s plan was to work as an assistant director or executive producer. But life had other plans, and in 2009, he debuted on-screen as a supporting actor in his friend Samuthirakani’s directorial Naadodigal. The film also earned him a friendship with the lead star Sasikumar. Since then, he has worked with the duo in Easan (2010), Poraali (2011), Kutti Puli (2013) and Nimirndhu Nil (2014). In 2015, Narayana called Komban the breakthrough role of his career. This year, Narayana also starred in Karuppu and Lucky the Superstar, but it was Moorthi and Jailer 2 that got him much-deserved love.

title: Tom Cruise to receive AFI Life Achievement Award for his contribution to cinema | Hollywood
description: Tom Cruise was recently seen in Digger, directed by Alejandro González Iñárritu.   | Hollywood
content: Tom Cruise will receive the 52nd AFI Life Achievement Award. It was announced by the American Film Institute Board of Trustees. The award will be presented to the Mission: Impossible star during a gala tribute at the Dolby Theatre in in Los Angeles on April 24, 2027, the AFI Board of Trustees announced on Wednesday.The official statementIn a statement, Kathleen Kennedy, chair of the AFI Board of Trustees said, “Tom Cruise is a global icon. As an actor and producer, he brings an extraordinary commitment to everything he does. What I especially admire is his deep belief in movies and their ability to bring people together. That passion has made him an extraordinary ambassador for American film around the world.” Tom Cruise is one of the most recognisable stars in the world, with a career spanning more than five decades as an actor and producer. Some of his films include Top Gun, Rain Man, A Few Good Men, Jerry Maguire, Minority Report, The Last Samurai and the Mission: Impossible franchise. He also earned Academy Award nominations for Best Actor for Born on the Fourth of July and Jerry Maguire, and for Best Supporting Actor for Magnolia. He was also nominated as a producer for Best Picture for Top Gun: Maverick at the 2022 Oscars.In 2025, he received an honorary Oscar at the Academy's Governors Awards in recognition of his contributions to cinema.Some of the past recipients of this honour include Eddie Murphy, Nicole Kidman, Julie Andrews, Denzel Washington and George Clooney.About DiggerTom recently starred in the much-talked about release, Digger. Ever since Tom Cruise’s look in Digger was revealed, the film has been a talking point, with the actor looking almost unrecognisable as Digger Rockwell, a wealthy, swaggering and eccentric oil tycoon whose offshore drilling disaster in Greenland triggers a global environmental crisis. The film is structured as a complex play within a film and explores themes of corporate greed, climate change and narrative control. It also stars Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg and Jesse Plemons. Besides playing the lead role, Tom also bankrolled the film. Digger is among the biggest box-office flops in Hollywood history. As per AFP, after two weeks in theaters, the film has grossed just $14.4 million in North America and $35.3 million globally tiny numbers for a big-budget movie that points to cumulative losses in the region of $245 million.

title:
Apple Music is remixing its identity, and here's what's changing | Technology News
(HT Tech)
description: Apple’s new Apple Music identity transforms musical frequencies into waves, ripples, and light. The logo also draws on Apple's Liquid Glass design. | Technology News
content: Apple today unveiled a brand new identity of its music streaming service, Apple Music. The new identity includes a new mnemonic logo and it's built around the idea of 'made by sound'. The visuals used in Apple Music's fresh identity is based on turning musical frequencies into patterns of waves, ripples and light. Apple said that it used physical vibrations to create visuals that reflect the movement of sound instead of relying only on graphics as was the case with its older logo.It is worth mentioning that the unveiling of the new brand identity comes nearly a month after the company teased the new word mark while opening the Apple Music Hall in London last year.Apple Music's new logoTo create Apple Music's new logo, the company took a frequency and played it through a rig, which then moved a large amount of liquid at the frequency of the notes. The rig used by Apple was basically a transducer, which is a device that converts an audio signal into physical vibration, and it moved through a shallow bath of mineral oil for creating the motion effect. The waves and ripples created by this motion were then filmed to create the final mark, which is a physical record of the music. To achieve this, the company partnered with music producer Fred again.., his collaborator NEST Acoustics.For creating the final brand identity of Apple Music, the company paired its symbol with a custom version of SF Pro, Apple’s typeface. The company said that the bold, lowercase letterforms of the new Apple Music brand identity give the logo a vibrant personality, which in turn reflect the energy of music while remaining unmistakably Apple. Apple's Liquid Glass design meets signAnother interesting aspect of Apple Music's new brand identity is that it draws on Apple's Liquid Glass design, which the company introduced at WWDC 2025 and started rolling out to all its devices with the launch of iOS 26, iPadOS 26, macOS Tahoe 26, watchOS 26, and tvOS 261. This takes Apple a step closer to having a unified design language across its platforms and services.Apple says that the waves and vibrations of Apple Music's new brand identity unite with the optical qualities of glass creating a visual language that carries through the wider identity.

title: Emissions didn't spike in 2025. That doesn't mean climate crisis has been stopped in its tracks | HT Explainers
description: Global emissions flattened in 2025, but the UN says deeper cuts are needed to limit warming and return to 1.5°C by 2100. | HT Explainers
content: Global greenhouse gas emissions flattened out in 2025, with a slight estimated decline from the previous year, but this is not enough to establish that emissions have peaked. The world remains on track for 2.8°C of warming this century if current climate policies continue, according to a United Nations report published on October 21, 2026.The United Nations Environment Programme’s (UNEP) Emissions Gap Report 2026: The Point of Return estimates that global greenhouse gas emissions totalled 58.4 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (GtCO₂e) in 2025, around 0.16 GtCO₂e lower than in 2024. The report cautions that the figures carry considerable uncertainty, and the available estimates do not establish the overall direction of emissions.The findings highlight the gap between the current pace of climate action and the cuts needed to limit global warming. UNEP says the world has lost the opportunity to keep warming to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels without, or with only limited, overshoot. However, steep emissions reductions could still limit how far temperatures rise above that threshold and help bring them back to 1.5°C by the end of the century.Have global emissions peaked?The near-flat emissions estimate for 2025 does not necessarily signal a lasting reversal in the global trend.According to the report, the slight decline in total emissions was driven partly by lower emissions from land use, land-use change and forestry. This was associated in part with a decline in wildfire emissions, which offset a small increase in emissions from fossil fuels and other greenhouse gases.Emissions from fossil fuels increased slightly between 2024 and 2025, even as the overall figure remained broadly stable. The data therefore do not establish that the world has reached a sustained peak in greenhouse gas emissions.The distinction matters because emissions need to decline substantially, rather than merely stop growing, to limit further warming.UNEP estimates that continued implementation of current policies could lead to global temperatures reaching 2.8°C above pre-industrial levels this century, with warming increasing thereafter. If countries fully implement their existing climate pledges and sustain similar efforts, warming could be limited to 2.6°C.Even in the most optimistic scenario assessed by UNEP, which combines the full implementation of national commitments with additional net-zero targets, global warming would reach around 2.1°C this century.These projections show the gap between the emissions reductions countries have promised and the scale of action needed to meet the Paris Agreement’s temperature goals.Why is the 1.5°C target slipping out of reach?The Paris Agreement, adopted in 2015, commits countries to holding the increase in global average temperature to well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.UNEP’s latest report says keeping warming below 1.5°C without significant overshoot is no longer achievable. The focus has therefore shifted to limiting the overshoot and returning temperatures to the threshold by the end of the century.The report’s “lowest possible” overshoot scenario would limit peak warming to around 1.7°C to 1.8°C by the middle of the century, before bringing global temperatures back to or below 1.5°C by 2100.
