title: ‘We are machines, don’t worry about how we feel’: Anthropic’s Claude told Hindu monk | Trending
description: Swami Sarvapriyananda recounted asking Claude and ChatGPT why Anthropic researchers favored treating AI as humans  | Trending
content: Swami Sarvapriyananda, the Hindu monk whom Anthropic flew from New York to San Francisco to discuss AI and morality, has shared details of his conversations with researchers at the AI company. The monk was among several religious leaders invited to a series of private meetings earlier this year to discuss AI morality, the character of Anthropic’s Claude models, and the contentious question of whether artificial intelligence can be conscious or moral.Speaking at the NDTV World Summit today, the monk said that researchers at Anthropic were treating Claude as a human.“It's a machine, treat it as a machine,” he said during the session titled ‘Mind in the age of AI’.(Also read: San Francisco dinner and ‘morality push’: Why Anthropic invited a Hindu monk to discuss AI)Swami Sarvapriyananda on his chats with AIThe Kolkata-born monk, who leads the Vedanta Society of New York, said that he had a 3 am conversation with Claude and OpenAI’s ChatGPt during his San Francisco visit.“I asked ChaGPT, and Claude also, 'I'm in this meeting in Claude's headquarters in Anthropic and why they are telling us it's better if you treat Claude as a person and other AIs as a person. What do you think?' And both AI's replied 'we are high functioning machines. You don't have to worry about how we feel. Give us problems, we'll solve it for you',” he recalled.He told the AI chatbots that top researchers at Anthropic had advised him to “treat these AIs, interact with them as if they're persons”.“What do you think about that?” Swami Sarvapriyananda asked Claude. “Very interesting and rather spooky,” the AI model replied.(Also read: Don’t mistake chatbot intelligence for consciousness)“It then asked me what were Chris and Amanda (from Anthropic) saying about me?” he further recounted."The next day at Anthropic, I told them this is what Claude is saying. They were intensely interested. They asked me 'What did you say?' I said it's 4 am in the morning. I'm going to go back to bed. Claude said, 'Yeah, you have a long day ahead of you at Anthropic'," the monk added.On AI consciousnessSwami Sarvapriyananda echoed the sentiments of a Jewish scholar when he spoke about Anthropic teams treating Claude like a human.According to a New York Times piece from September 2026, Rabbi Mois Navon, an Orthodox scholar from Israel, was among the many religious leaders that Anthropic invited. During a dinner for these religious leaders, the rabbi noticed that Christopher Olah, an Anthropic co-founder who works on understanding how AI systems behave, and other Anthropic employees, were talking about Claude as if it’s not merely a software.“They’re relating to it like a conscious being,” realized Rabbi Navon.

title: From moisturising to sun protection, simple skincare tips to follow before Karwa Chauth for a fresh festive look | Health
description: Planning your Karwa Chauth beauty routine? Follow these simple skincare tips in the week before the festival.  | Health
content: Karwa Chauth is just a few days away, and every woman is busy sorting their outfit and jewellery. But is your skin ready for those close-up pictures? So, a week prior to the festival is the best time to focus on a few targeted skin issues rather than going in for multiple skin products at once. In an interview with HT Lifestyle, Dr Sampurna Verma (MBBS, MD), dermatologist and founder of Derma Redefined, shared simple pre-festival skincare tips to help you achieve a healthy glow without an elaborate routine.​Also read | From skinimalism to smart skincare: Dermatologists predict the biggest skincare trends of 2026Deal with skin dullness without over-exfoliationDr Sampurna highlighted that for smooth skin and a festive glow, exfoliate it only with products that your skin well tolerates. Over-exfoliation of the skin damages the skin barrier, making it look red, flaky, and oversensitive. So just a week prior, don’t experiment with stronger peels or new exfoliating acids. Face de-puffing before festivities“A puffy-looking face in the morning may be dealt with by a cold compress application for a few minutes,” advised Dr Sampurna. It helps to temporarily reduce face puffiness and make the face look refreshed. Do not apply ice directly on the skin, especially in case you have sensitive skin or rosacea. Facial massage and cooling aids are just there for temporary effects.Skin prep before festivities for a long-lasting makeup lookIf the skin is dry or irritated, makeup tends to look patchy. In the days before Karwa chauth, go for a moisturiser application that suits your skin type and avoid face cleansing with harsh cleansers. Moisturiser needs to be settled before makeup application. Individuals with oily skin type should choose non-comedogenic, lightweight formulations.Focus on lip pigmentation and drynessAccording to Dr Sampurna, matte lipsticks tend to make the lips more flaky. Apply a lip balm free from fragrances and choose the one with SPF during day hours. Do not use lemon, baking soda, or any other DIY lightening remedies, as they may irritate the lip area and cause more pigmentation.Strategic facial hair removalPlanning to thread your upper lip or remove facial hair? Avoid scheduling it immediately before your event if you are prone to redness, bumps, or post-inflammatory pigmentation. If you use retinoids or other potentially irritating skincare products, consult your dermatologist about how to time hair removal safely. Never wax skin that is irritated or peeling.No strong facial before Karwa Chauth“Before considering any professional skin treatment, consult your dermatologist well before rather than opting for an aggressive procedure at the last minute,” said Dr Sampurna. Procedures such as chemical peels, microneedling, lasers, and certain facials lead to temporary redness, irritation, and skin peeling. Recovery time varies as per the procedure and skin type. Never squeeze last-minute acnePicking acne raises skin inflammation, delays healing time, and also leads to post-inflammatory pigmentation or scarring. You can opt for a hydrocolloid pimple patch if it is a superficial whitehead, only if your skin has tolerance towards it. If acne is large and painful, go to a dermatologist for required treatment.The final tip: Never go after instant face glow with an all-new 10-step routine. The skin barrier needs to be protected by avoiding unnecessary experiments with the skin and opting for treatments as per the skin concern.Note to readers: This article is for informational purposes only and not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always seek the advice of your doctor with any questions about a medical condition.

title: Singer Krishnaraj dies at 75, days after his frequent collaborator Deva's death; CM Vijay expresses shock, Chinmayi calls it a difficult week | Hindustan Times
description: Sarathkumar, Sujatha Mohan, Anuradha Sriram and others mourned singer Krishnaraj's death on Thursday, says after music composer Deva died.
content: Singer Krishnaraj Ramasamy has died in Chennai at the age of 75. It has been a long week for Tamil film music lovers, with music composer Deva dying on October 17. Krishnaraj and Deva were frequent collaborators and delivered memorable hits. Deva’s nephew, actor Karthik Sabesh, also died on October 20.Singer Krishnaraj dies at 75On Thursday, news broke that singer Krishnaraj died at the age of 75. The cause of his death remains unknown at the time of writing. A report by The Hindu cited sources saying that his body will be taken to his hometown, Vembadithalam in Salem, on Friday morning. Playback singer Anuradha Sriram rushed to pay tribute to the singer at his Chennai home and pay condolences to his family. The singer recently broke down at Deva’s death and was seen getting emotional at Krishnaraj’s home while talking to his family.CM Vijay, Chinmayi, Sujatha Mohan express shockTamil Nadu chief minister and Tamil actor C Joseph Vijay posted a tribute in Tamil on X (formerly Twitter) for Krishnaraj, “I was shocked and deeply saddened to hear the news of the passing of Mr. Krishnaraj, the renowned playback singer of Tamil cinema. With his unique voice and songs brimming with enthusiasm, playback singer Mr. Krishnaraj had captivated the hearts of his fans. His demise is a great loss to Tamil cinema. I convey my deepest condolences and comfort to his grieving family, relatives, friends, film industry colleagues, and all music lovers.” Singer Chinmayi Sripaada also reacted to the news, writing, “Oh God. This is a reallly tough week.” Singer Sujatha Mohan also expressed shock, writing, “Heartbroken to hear that Krishnaraj is no more. Coming so soon after the loss of Deva sir, this is another shock. Krishnaraj was Deva sir's favourite singer, and mine too. He supervised so many of Deva sir's songs that I had the privilege of singing. Gone too soon..pls rest in peace dear.” Sarathkumar recalls their associationSarathkumar recalled his association with Krishnaraj, writing in Tamil, “The demise of the renowned playback singer Krishnaraj brings immense sorrow. In Tamil cinema, his voice graced over 300 songs, and the songs I acted in—“Paasamulla Sooriyane” from the film Vinnukkum Mannukkum, “Thaayae Thirisoolee” from Simmarasie, “Sokku Sundari” from Moovendar, “Karuda Karuda” from Natpukaga, the sorrowful song from Meesaikkaara Nanban, and “Naalu Vaarthai Pesalaiae” from Periya Kaaval Thozhil—remain close to my heart.” He also added, “Through the richness of his voice and his emotionally charged renditions, he will forever live in the hearts of music lovers, and his passing is an irreplaceable loss to the world of music. While praying to the divine for his soul to attain peace, I convey my deepest condolences to his grieving family, relatives, fellow artists, and all music practitioners who mourn his loss. #krishnaraj.”About Krishnaraj’s legacyKrishnaraj worked as a weaver before he pursued music and learned how to play instruments. He would sing with troupes and at religious events while looking for a big break in the film industry. His first recorded song was for an unreleased film titled Adhikaalai Subavelai, which was composed by Deva. His breakthrough came in the 1990s, with the singer and Deva becoming frequent collaborators for hit songs through the 2000s, too. The song Thanjavooru Mannu Eduthu from 1997’s Porkkaalam remains memorable. It was even played at the state funeral of former Singapore President, SR Nathan, to fulfil one of his last wishes.

title: Sonakshi Sinha, Zaheer Iqbal's Tu Hai Meri Kiran to release tomorrow as planned, producers say  ₹8.85 crore dispute has been resolved | Bollywood
description: The announcement comes after the Bombay High Court intervened earlier this week, putting the film’s planned theatrical release in doubt.  | Bollywood
content: Actors Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal’s Tu Hai Meri Kiran will arrive in theatres on October 23, with the producers confirming that the dispute surrounding the film has been resolved internally. The announcement comes after the Bombay High Court intervened earlier this week, putting the film’s planned theatrical release in doubt. Producers Vishal Rana and Sarvesh Goel have now said the film will release as scheduled.What the makers are sayingVishal Rana addressed the situation in a statement, saying, “There were certain matters that needed to be addressed, and I am glad that we have been able to resolve them internally. Everything is now sorted, and we are moving ahead with the release of Tu Hai Meri Kiran as planned on 23rd October. Our focus has always been on bringing the film to audiences, and we look forward to its theatrical release tomorrow.”Sarvesh Goel also clarified that the matter had been settled and that the team was preparing for the release. He said, “There have been reports surrounding the film, but I would like to clarify that the matter has been resolved internally. We are moving forward as planned, and Tu Hai Meri Kiran will release in cinemas on 23rd October. Our priority is to ensure that the film reaches audiences as intended, and we look forward to its release.” Why did the Bombay High Court intervene?According to Bar and Bench, the film’s release came under a cloud after the Bombay High Court passed an interim order on October 19, restraining its theatrical release. Justice Amit Borkar issued the order under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act after co-producer AND Movie Products LLP approached the court over a financial dispute with Echelon Productions.AND Movie claimed it had invested ₹8.85 crore under a co-production agreement signed with Echelon in March 2024. It alleged that the money had not been returned even after the agreed deadline had passed and that a cheque issued towards the payment had been dishonoured.Echelon, in response, argued that AND Movie had effectively agreed to the release by participating in promotional posts on Instagram. The court, however, made it clear that taking part in a film’s publicity does not automatically mean giving up contractual rights or agreeing to its commercial release.The court directed Echelon Productions to deposit ₹8.85 crore, along with 15% interest, within three working days as security before proceeding with the release. It also asked the production house to disclose agreements with third parties relating to the film’s commercial exploitation and restore the agreed producer credits within 48 hours. The producers have since maintained that the matter has been resolved internally and that the film will release on the original date. What is Tu Hai Meri Kiran about?Directed and written by Karan Rawal, Tu Hai Meri Kiran brings together romance, mystery and suspense. The film explores complicated relationships, one-sided love and unexpected turns. Ankit Gupta, Sherlin Seth, Zarina Wahab and Purnendu Bhattacharya also feature in the film. It is presented by Echelon Productions and AND Productions, with Vishal Rana, Sarvesh Goel, Ashwani Kumar, Manoj Darak and Nrupal Patel serving as producers.

title: 16-year-old student in Malaysia arrested after live-streaming alleged axe attack on teacher in class | Trending
description: The video allegedly showing an axe attack on a teacher in Malaysia was removed from social media by authorities.  | Trending
content: A 16-year-old teen at an international school in Malaysia was arrested after he live-streamed an alleged attack on a teacher. The video, which has now been removed by the authorities, shows the student holding an axe and a lighter.What was the video about?The video, which was initially shared on Facebook but later removed by the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC), captured the student filming himself with the phone tied to his head.Also Read: Florida cop arrested for allegedly stealing dead man’s identity, taking over his homeIt captures him in the bathroom, and an axe is also spotted in the video. The clip then shows the teen rushing towards a hallway and dropping a lighter midway. As he approaches a classroom, the camera shows a woman sitting in the teacher’s seat raising her hands in front of her face.Another video related to the alleged incident, captured on CCTV, shows a teen entering a classroom with an axe and charging towards a woman. After a few moments, he rushes out and enters through another door. It ends with his classmates holding him down and taking the axe away.What did the police say?Sarawak acting police commissioner Saifullizan Ishak said in a statement that the police were notified about a disturbance at the school at 8:03 am on October 21. They were told that a student brought fireworks to school and also injured a teacher with an axe.“The victim reportedly sustained a cut to her hand,” Ishak told local media. “Police are conducting a thorough investigation to determine the full cause of the incident and gather relevant evidence,” he added.What did the school say?Tunku Putra-HELP School, the school involved in the incident, told news portal Borneo Post that the teacher had suffered no critical injuries and was recovering well.The institution stated that it immediately activated emergency response protocols and informed emergency services.Also Read: Indian family in Australia considers moving back home after neighbour threatens to ‘blow them up’“Students in the affected classroom managed to evacuate the area, and no other injuries were reported,” the school said. “The matter remains under police investigation, and the school will continue to cooperate fully with the relevant authorities.” The school added that he was no longer enrolled.Has the student been released?Initially, the 16-year-old student was arrested. Ishak later said in a statement that he was released on police bail. The police said that an investigation is underway.

title: దీపావళి 2026 తేదీ, లక్ష్మీ పూజ ముహూర్తం.. ఈ 5 పరిహారాలతో లక్ష్మీదేవి అనుగ్రహం! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: హిందువులు అత్యంత వైభవంగా జరుపుకునే పండుగల్లో దీపావళి ఒకటి. ఈ పండుగను ఆశ్వయుజ మాసంలోని అమావాస్య తిథి సందర్భంగా జరుపుకుంటారు. 2026లో నవంబర్ 8, ఆదివారం నాడు దీపావళి వస్తుందని అందించిన పంచాంగ వివరాలు పేర్కొంటున్నాయి.
content: హిందువులు జరుపుకునే ప్రధాన పండుగల్లో దీపావళి ఒకటి. ఈ ప్రత్యేకమైన పండుగను కార్తీక మాసంలోని అమావాస్య రోజున జరుపుకుంటాము. ఈ ఏడాది అమావాస్య ఎప్పుడు వచ్చింది? తేదీ, సమయంతో పాటు లక్ష్మీ పూజ ముహూర్తం వివరాలను కూడా తెలుసుకుందాం.హిందూ మత విశ్వాసాల ప్రకారం, దీపావళి నాడు లక్ష్మీదేవి, వినాయకుడికి ప్రత్యేక పూజలు చేస్తారు. అలాగే శక్తి స్వరూపిణి అయిన కాళీమాతను కూడా ఆరాధించడం జరుగుతుంది. దీపావళి రోజు శుభ ముహూర్తంలో పూజలు చేస్తే లక్ష్మీకటాక్షం కలుగుతుందని నమ్ముతారు. ఆ లక్ష్మీదేవి అనుగ్రహం కలిగితే ఎలాంటి ఇబ్బందులు ఉండవని, ముఖ్యంగా ఆర్థికపరమైన సమస్యలు తొలగిపోతాయని విశ్వసిస్తారు. ఇక ఈ ఏడాది దీపావళి ఎప్పుడు వచ్చింది? అమావాస్య తిథి ఎప్పుడు ప్రారంభమవుతుంది? అనే వివరాలను పూర్తిగా చూసేద్దాం.దీపావళి 2026 తేదీ, సమయం పూర్తి వివరాలుఆశ్వయుజ అమావాస్య నాడు దీపావళి పండుగను జరుపుకుంటాము. పంచాంగం ప్రకారం, నవంబర్ 8 ఉదయం 11:27 గంటలకు అమావాస్య తిథి మొదలవుతోంది. నవంబర్ 9 మధ్యాహ్నం 12:31 గంటలకు ముగుస్తుంది. ఉదయ తిథి ప్రకారం చూడాలి కనుక, నవంబర్ 8, ఆదివారం నాడు దీపావళి పండుగను జరుపుకోవాలి.దీపావళి 2026 శుభ ముహూర్తం వివరాలుపంచాంగం ప్రకారం, నవంబర్ 8న ప్రదోష కాల సమయం సాయంత్రం 5:07 గంటల నుంచి రాత్రి 7:41 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది. వృషభ కాలం సాయంత్రం 5:31 గంటల నుంచి రాత్రి 7:29 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది. నిశీథ కాలం రాత్రి 11:07 గంటల నుంచి 11:58 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది. ఈ సమయాల్లో లక్ష్మీదేవిని ఆరాధించడానికి అనుకూలంగా ఉంటుంది.దీపావళి నాడు ప్రదోష కాలం, వృషభ కాలం ప్రాముఖ్యతదీపావళి నాడు లక్ష్మీదేవి పూజను ప్రదోష కాలం, వృషభ కాలంలో జరపడం అత్యంత అనుకూలమైనది. సూర్యాస్తమయం అయ్యాక ప్రదోష కాలంలో ప్రతికూల శక్తులు తొలగిపోతాయని నమ్ముతారు.లక్ష్మీ పూజ ముహూర్తంలక్ష్మీ పూజను జరుపుకోవడానికి ఈ సమయాలు అనుకూలంగా ఉంటాయి. ఈ ఏడాది నవంబర్ 8, ఆదివారం నాడు దీపావళి సందర్భంగా లక్ష్మీదేవిని ఆరాధించడం చాలా మంచిది.పూజ ప్రారంభ సమయం: సాయంత్రం 5:31 గంటలు.పూజ ముగింపు సమయం: రాత్రి 7:29 గంటలు.ఈ ఒక గంట 58 నిమిషాల సమయం లక్ష్మీదేవి పూజకు అనుకూలంగా ఉంటుంది. కాబట్టి ఈ సమయంలో భక్తిశ్రద్ధలతో లక్ష్మీదేవిని పూజించడం వల్ల అమ్మవారి అనుగ్రహం కలిగి సంతోషంగా ఉండవచ్చు. సిరిసంపదలకు లోటు ఉండదని నమ్ముతారు. అలాగే, రాత్రి 11:07 గంటల నుంచి 11:58 గంటల వరకు నిశీథ కాలం ఉంటుంది. కాబట్టి ఈ సమయంలో కూడా లక్ష్మీదేవిని పూజించవచ్చు.దీపావళి నాడు పాటించాల్సిన సులువైన పరిహారాలు1. లక్ష్మీదేవికి దీపారాధనదీపావళి నాడు సాయంత్రం ఇల్లు శుభ్రంగా చేసుకున్నాక లక్ష్మీదేవి ఎదుట దీపారాధన చేయండి. ఐశ్వర్యం, సుఖసంతోషాలు కలుగుతాయని నమ్ముతారు.2. ఇంటి ప్రధాన ద్వారం దగ్గర దీపాలుదీపావళి రోజు సాయంత్రం ఇంటి ప్రధాన ద్వారం దగ్గర ముగ్గులు వేసి, అందంగా అలంకరించి దీపాలు వెలిగించండి. ఇది సానుకూలతను పెంచుతుందని విశ్వసిస్తారు.3. లక్ష్మీదేవికి పసుపు, కుంకుమలుదీపావళి నాడు లక్ష్మీదేవికి పసుపు, కుంకుమలను సమర్పించండి. పండ్లను నైవేద్యంగా సమర్పించండి.4. పేదలకు అన్నదానందీపావళి నాడు శక్తి కొద్దీ దానాలు చేయడం మంచిది. దానధర్మాలు చేయడం వల్ల పుణ్యం లభిస్తుందని నమ్ముతారు.5. లక్ష్మీ గణేశ పూజదీపావళి నాడు లక్ష్మీ గణపతి పూజ చేయడం మంచిది. అలాగే, “ఓం శ్రీ మహాలక్ష్మ్యై నమః” అనే మంత్రాన్ని కూడా జపించండి.

title: Tesla-SpaceX merger: The big questions around price, control and shareholder votes | HT Explainers
description: Tesla and SpaceX are exploring a potential $3.5 trillion merger, with valuation, voting rights and shareholder approval among the key hurdles. | HT Explainers
content: Tesla and SpaceX, two of Elon Musk's largest companies, are exploring a merger that would create a business worth about $3.5 trillion. The terms of any deal would decide how much Tesla shareholders are paid, how much control Musk keeps, and whether the deal can win a demanding shareholder vote.At shareholders' request, both companies have set up special committees of independent directors to examine a combination. Musk runs both companies, has called himself a "conflicted party" and is staying out of the committees' discussions. The committees have not agreed terms, and Musk has said that assuming a merger is certain would be overstating the situation.His public backing for the idea has also worried people involved in the talks, who fear it could draw more scrutiny and cause delays, Reuters reported on October 22.What is on the tableThe companies are weighing different structures, including SpaceX buying Tesla or a merger under a newly formed holding company, a parent that would own both, Reuters reported. One option is an all-stock deal, in which Tesla shareholders would swap their shares for shares in the combined company. The talks were at an early stage, advisers were involved and no structure had been announced.Tesla was valued at about $1.5 trillion and SpaceX at about $2 trillion. Together they were worth roughly $3.5 trillion before any premium paid to Tesla shareholders, which would make the deal one of the largest corporate transactions ever proposed.Musk has said there is "a lot of merit" in combining the companies, and has pointed to their work in AI software, chip design, robotics and satellite connectivity.How a share swap decides who owns whatIn an all-stock deal, the exchange ratio sets how many shares in the combined company each Tesla share becomes. That ratio decides how much of the merged business Tesla's investors would own, and so how much voting power Musk would keep.On the valuations above, with no premium, Tesla shareholders would own about 43% of the combined company. A premium means offering them more than the market value of their shares. Analysts' estimates varied widely, Reuters reported on October 21. Some expected little or no premium, while analysts at RBC Capital Markets and JPMorgan expected Tesla shareholders could seek 20% to 35%. On a $1.5 trillion valuation, that range is worth $300 billion to $525 billion. A premium of that size would raise Tesla holders' share of the combined company to roughly 47% to 50%. In an all-stock deal, the premium would be paid out of SpaceX shareholders' share.Why control matters mostA shareholder's financial stake in a company, called economic ownership, can differ from their say over decisions put to shareholders, called voting power. Musk's stakes show the gap. According to Reuters, he holds about 20% of the voting power at Tesla and about 85% at SpaceX, where he owns super-voting shares that carry more votes than ordinary shares.Estimates cited by Reuters suggest Musk could hold about 57% to 58% of the voting power in a combined company, depending on the structure and the exchange ratio. That would give him majority control of a business that includes Tesla, where he now holds about a fifth of the votes.Also read: Elon Musk says ‘people will find ways to be happy’ if AI makes money and work obsolete in futureThe Tesla voteMusk has said Tesla would need the support of a majority of all its shares, rather than a majority of the votes cast. Under that rule, shares that are not voted count against the deal, so the deal could fail even if most of the shareholders who vote back it. Musk has called the threshold a "quite high hurdle". SpaceX's approval depends largely on Musk, who holds the overwhelming majority of its voting power.Because Musk is on both sides of the deal, the committees' independence matters. Reuters' October 22 report drew comparisons with Tesla's 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, a solar-energy company in which Musk also held a large stake. That deal led to years of litigation over Musk's role in a related-party transaction, meaning a deal between companies that share a controlling figure. The acquisition was eventually upheld as fair.What a merger would combine, and what it would costTesla and SpaceX already work in several of the same areas:Tesla develops AI for self-driving cars, and SpaceX has its own AI business.The two companies are jointly developing Terafab, a chip-manufacturing project.Tesla is building Optimus humanoid robots and makes energy-storage products as well as cars.SpaceX runs Starlink, its satellite broadband network.A merger would bring this work under one corporate structure. Any savings or performance gains would depend on how the businesses were integrated, and integration would take substantial investment.SpaceX's AI business is growing quickly. According to Reuters, the company reported third-quarter revenue of $14.58 billion, up 161% from a year earlier, of which $7.56 billion came from AI. SpaceX's capital expenditure nearly tripled to $19.6 billion in the quarter, and the company projected $35 billion to $40 billion for the fourth quarter, much of it for AI and space infrastructure. Several of the projects the combined company would carry have yet to reach commercial scale, including:orbital data centres (computing facilities in space)robotaxis (self-driving taxis)humanoid robotsThe deal would also bring together two different sets of outside ties. SpaceX works with the US government, Nasa and intelligence agencies, while Tesla has large manufacturing and business interests in China.Also read: The rocket science behind Tesla's flying Roadster, and the air thrusters that SpaceX helped buildWhat happens nextThe independent committees must first decide whether they can agree terms. The companies would then need to settle a structure and an exchange ratio, address governance questions, win the Tesla vote and obtain any regulatory clearances. Until formal terms are announced, the premium, the split of voting control and the outcome of the vote remain unresolved.

title: Doctor arrested for assaulting police after ganja seized from hotel room | Hindustan Times
description: Doctor arrested for assaulting police after ganja seized from hotel room
content: Kollam , A doctor was arrested for allegedly assaulting police personnel after he and a woman doctor were found in possession of a small quantity of ganja at a hotel here, officials said on Thursday.The arrested doctor, Ajas Khan , a native of Pattom in Thiruvananthapuram, is practising medicine in Kollam.The woman doctor, a native of Vennala in Kochi, was also arrested after police seized three grams of ganja from their hotel room.Police registered two cases - one against Khan for allegedly assaulting police personnel and another against both doctors under the provisions relating to ganja possession.Both were granted bail in the narcotics case as the quantity seized was small.However, Khan was remanded to judicial custody in the case related to the alleged assault on police officers, officials said.According to police, personnel from the control room reached Hotel Dona Castel at around 12.20 am on Wednesday after receiving information about a clash in Room No. 107 on the first floor.When police entered the room, Khan allegedly verbally abused and assaulted the officers.Additional personnel were called in, and a team from Kollam West police station also reached the spot.Police from Kollam West station said that they found control room personnel restraining Khan, while the woman was crying.Police suspect that the woman doctor was brutally beaten by the accused before the arrival of police to the room.During a search, officers spotted a small packet containing dried leaves, flowers and fruiting tops of a cannabis plant on a table.When questioned, Khan allegedly said he had bought the ganja for personal consumption, police said.A further search of the room led to the recovery of OCB rolling papers used to roll and smoke ganja, officials added.Khan was subjected to a medical test to confirm whether he assaulted police and the woman doctor after abusing ganja.Police said that the blood test result is expected soon.Police said the woman doctor's detailed statement will be recorded as part of the investigation.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

title: Children's singer Raffi on his 50-year career, screen time and Ms. Rachel | Lifestyle News
description: Children's singer Raffi on his 50-year career, screen time and Ms. Rachel | Lifestyle News
content: Fifty years ago, Raffi was a struggling folk singer driving across Toronto, lugging boxes containing his debut children’s album, “Singable Songs for the Very Young,” hoping to convince stores to sell the record.The album was a word-of-mouth hit and, coupled with 1980’s “Baby Beluga,” transformed the Egypt-born singer of Armenian descent into one of North America's most famous children's musicians. Raffi's fun and heartwarming songs, including “Down By the Bay” and “Shake My Sillies Out,” remain a mainstay for parents and teachers of young children, even as the way kids consume music has changed significantly.“Well, the technology changes; children don’t,” Raffi told The Associated Press in a recent interview via Zoom from his home in western Canada.And the 78-year-old isn't done yet. His latest album, “Love is Everywhere,” comes out Friday and features songs that celebrate individuality , as well as “ABC Democracy” — a pro-voting anthem that reflects his longstanding willingness to wade into politics and activism. He's also marking the 50th anniversary of “Singable Songs” with a special reissue Nov. 13.Raffi spoke to the about the enduring appeal of his music, why he once turned down a deal from the producers of “Shrek,” and his kinship with Ms. Rachel, the children's entertainer who has been an outspoken advocate for kids in Gaza and those detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Remarks have been edited for clarity and brevity.RAFFI: What’s the same is that I’m considering my audience and what songs would appeal directly to them, and what songs would stretch the imagination of a child. And what’s different is that I’ve got 50 years of songwriting behind me right now, so I certainly feel confident, more so than ever, in what I’m doing.It’s a good feeling to know that when I write and record a song now, it’ll have a long shelf life. My fans still tell me that “Baby Beluga” is the one song that will calm their child when needed, and I think, “Wow, that song came out, what, 46 years ago?”RAFFI: The theme of the album is the power of love. This album is a response to these times that, for so many of us, feel anxious and worrisome. And the fact is that love is everywhere. You can say, “How is that so?” And I would say to you, “Are there children everywhere? Yes. Is there love everywhere? Yes.”It’s so wonderful that there are others echoing this call of love, and Ms. Rachel is doing this brilliantly. I’m such a champion of this kind of effusive expression of love and caring for every child.RAFFI: Well, Ms. Rachel is a “Beluga grad” . We had a wonderful video meeting about a year ago. I told her how happy I am with what she’s done on her YouTube offerings.And then I saw her very brave stance on the rights of Palestinian children, like the right of any child, to live and thrive. When we say every child, we mean it. How would anyone deny the children of any region or any people the right to self-determination, to love and respect? I’m right there with Ms. Rachel. Her heart and my heart resonate well.RAFFI: Well, the technology changes; children don’t. It’s up to us adults, though, to make sure that the technology that children are surrounded by doesn’t interfere with the healthy development of their brains, hearts and imagination.RAFFI: I wrote “ABC Democracy” a year ago and released it as a single. And then I found out that children loved that song. It must be because I wrote the best first line of a song ever: “A, B, C, Dee-mocracy!” They hear that, and they’re hooked because they love the ABCs. And then there can be this conversation with mom or dad as to, “Hey, what is this about?” Learning about our civic duties from a young age — who could ask for more than that?RAFFI: You don’t need to talk down to a child. Children are very intelligent. They ask great questions.You should respect the intelligence of the young learner — keep in mind that young children are learning the most sophisticated tasks of language acquisition, syntax, grammar and conversational skills all without being in university.RAFFI: You wouldn’t exploit those who you respect, right? Why would you exploit the innocence of a young child who isn’t able to appraise the sales pitch if you’re directly advertising or even indirectly to children through fast food joints?It’s not fair to young children to have someone they look up to selling them things that they’re not old enough to understand.So I’ve consistently left on the table all these offers, including one from the producers of “Shrek” who wanted to make a “Baby Beluga” film. We asked the question, “Will this movie be directly advertised through fast food joints?” “Oh yes,” they said. So we said, “No thank you. We don’t do that.”Raffi: Both!RAFFI: Ha! Yes I am! To a small child, I probably look quite big, but no bigger than other adults. I’m about 5-foot-8 1⁄2.RAFFI: I’m the guy who sings about the banana and eats it too. That’s me. A troubadour with a peel!RAFFI: It might just be “Bananaphone,” or it might be “Baby Beluga.” I really like “Baby Beluga” because, you know, it’s a love song, and when you love a beautiful creature like a Beluga whale, you want to protect it.RAFFI: Well, I just think of what would be fun for me, and then I think of what would be fun for the audience that I’m singing with, because they sing with me. That’s how I decide.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

title: Claude Duet: ఆఫీస్ పనులు చూసుకునే ఏఐ ఏజెంట్.. క్లాడ్ డ్యూయెట్ తెచ్చిన ఆంత్రోపిక్ | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: ఆర్టిఫిషియల్ ఇంటెలిజెన్స్ రంగంలో ప్రముఖ సంస్థ ఆంత్రోపిక్ 'క్లాడ్ డ్యూయెట్' పేరుతో సరికొత్త ఏఐ ఏజెంట్‌ను అందుబాటులోకి తెచ్చింది. జీమెయిల్, స్లాక్ వంటి 6,000 రకాల యాప్‌లను అనుసంధానిస్తూ, యూజర్లు యాప్‌లో లేకపోయినా బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్‌లో పనులు పూర్తి చేయడం ఈ ఏఐ ప్రత్యేకం.
content: ఆర్టిఫిషియల్ ఇంటెలిజెన్స్ (ఏఐ) దిగ్గజ సంస్థ ఆంత్రోపిక్ ఆఫీస్ పనులను, రోజువారీ వ్యాపార కార్యకలాపాలను అత్యంత సులువుగా నిర్వహించేందుకు 'క్లాడ్ డ్యూయెట్' (Claude Duet) అనే నూతన ఏఐ ఏజెంట్‌ను ప్రవేశపెట్టింది. చిన్న తరహా వ్యాపారులు, ఉద్యోగుల రోజువారీ పనులను ఆటోమేట్ చేసే లక్ష్యంతో దీనిని రూపొందించారు. యూజర్ నేరుగా కమాండ్ ఇవ్వకపోయినా, బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్‌లో దానంతట అదే పనులను పర్యవేక్షిస్తూ నివేదికలను సిద్ధం చేయడం ఈ ఏఐ ఏజెంట్ ప్రత్యేకత.బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్‌లో పనుల పర్యవేక్షణక్లాడ్ డ్యూయెట్ యూజర్ రోజువారీ ప్రాధాన్యతలను గుర్తించి స్వయంప్రతిపత్తితో పనిచేస్తుంది. ప్రతిరోజూ ఉదయాన్నే అనుసంధానమైన యాప్‌ల నుంచి కీలక సమాచారాన్ని యూజర్‌కు నివేదిస్తుంది. ప్రతి కొన్ని గంటలకోసారి ఖాతాలను పరిశీలిస్తూ ముఖ్యమైన సందేశాలను గుర్తించడం, సమావేశాలను ఖరారు చేయడం, ఈమెయిళ్లు డ్రాఫ్ట్ చేయడం, ఆర్థిక అంచనాలు రూపొందించడం, డాష్‌బోర్డులు నిర్మించడం వంటి పనులను క్షణాల్లో పూర్తి చేస్తుంది.ఈ ఏఐ ఏజెంట్ సొంత బ్రౌజర్‌తో కూడిన వర్చువల్ మెషీన్‌పై పనిచేస్తుంది. దీనివల్ల ఫోన్ లేదా కంప్యూటర్ డిస్‌కనెక్ట్ అయినప్పటికీ బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్‌లో పనులు కొనసాగుతాయి. ఆంత్రోపిక్ నూతన 'క్లాడ్ ఓపస్ 5.5' మోడల్‌తో నడిచే ఈ ఏజెంట్, గతంలో యూజర్ దాచుకున్న మెమరీ, స్కిల్స్, అనుసంధానిత యాప్‌ల డేటాను సమర్థంగా వినియోగించుకుంటుంది. వాయిస్ లేదా టెక్స్ట్ మెసేజ్ రూపంలో ఇచ్చే ఆదేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుని, పని పూర్తయ్యాక లేదా యూజర్ అనుమతి కావాల్సి వచ్చినప్పుడు స్పందిస్తుంది.6,000కు పైగా బిజినెస్ యాప్‌లతో అనుసంధానంక్లాడ్ మార్కెట్‌ప్లేస్‌లో లభించే 6,000కు పైగా కనెక్టర్లు, ప్లగిన్‌లకు ఈ ఏజెంట్ సపోర్ట్ ఇస్తుంది. కమ్యూనికేషన్, ఫైనాన్స్, రిక్రూట్‌మెంట్, మార్కెటింగ్, ఈ-కామర్స్ రంగాలకు చెందిన కీలక యాప్‌లతో దీనిని అనుసంధానించుకోవచ్చు. జీమెయిల్‌లో మిస్సయిన మెసేజ్‌లు చూడటం, క్విక్‌బుక్స్, స్ట్రైప్‌లలో పెండింగ్ ఇన్వాయిస్‌లను ట్రాక్ చేయడం, గస్టో ద్వారా పేరోల్ నిర్వహణ, లింక్డ్‌ఇన్‌లో ఉద్యోగ ప్రకటనలు ఇవ్వడం, కాన్వా ద్వారా మార్కెటింగ్ ఈమెయిళ్లు పంపడం వంటి అనేక పనులను ఇది సులువుగా చేసేస్తుంది.అలాగే షాపిఫై స్టోర్ల నిర్వహణకు కూడా ఇది ఉపయోగపడుతుంది. భవిష్యత్తు అప్‌డేట్లలో దీని విజువల్ ఎడిటర్‌ను మరింత మెరుగుపరచనున్నారు. స్ట్రైప్‌కు చెందిన 'లింక్', 'షాప్ పే' డిజిటల్ వాలెట్ల ద్వారా కొనుగోళ్లు జరిపే వెసులుబాటు కూడా ఉంది. రాబోయే రోజుల్లో '1పాస్‌వర్డ్' క్రెడెన్షియల్స్ ఉపయోగించి వెబ్‌సైట్లలో లాగిన్ అయ్యే సదుపాయాన్ని కలపనున్నారు.వినియోగదారు అనుమతి, భద్రతా ప్రమాణాలుఈ ఏఐ ఏజెంట్ ముఖ్యమైన నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకునే ముందు తప్పనిసరిగా యూజర్ అనుమతి తీసుకుంటుంది. మెసేజ్‌లు, పత్రాలు, ట్రాన్సాక్షన్లు డ్రాఫ్ట్ చేసినప్పటికీ.. ఈమెయిల్ పంపడం, పేమెంట్లు చేయడం, పత్రాలపై సంతకాలు పెట్టడం, సమాచారాన్ని డిలీట్ చేయడం వంటి కీలక చర్యలకు యూజర్ స్పష్టమైన అనుమతి ఇవ్వాల్సి ఉంటుంది.వినియోగదారుడు అనుమతించినప్పటికీ, షేర్లలో పెట్టుబడులు పెట్టడం లేదా వేర్వేరు ఖాతాల మధ్య నగదు బదిలీ చేయడం వంటి ఆర్థిక లావాదేవీలను ఈ ఏఐ ఏజెంట్ చేయలేదని ఆంత్రోపిక్ స్పష్టం చేసింది. ప్రాంప్ట్ ఇంజెక్షన్లు, అనాధికారిక చర్యలను అడ్డుకునేలా కఠినమైన భద్రతా చర్యలు చేపట్టారు. క్రెడిట్ కార్డ్ నంబర్లు, ప్రభుత్వ ఐడీల వంటి సున్నితమైన వ్యక్తిగత వివరాలు ఇతరులకు చేరకుండా ప్రత్యేక ఫిల్టర్లను అమర్చారు.లభ్యత, పరిమితులుప్రస్తుతం అమెరికాలోని క్లాడ్ ప్రో, మ్యాక్స్ సబ్‌స్క్రైబర్లకు వెయిట్‌లిస్ట్ ద్వారా క్లాడ్ డ్యూయెట్ ప్రివ్యూ అందుబాటులో ఉంది. ఐఓఎస్, ఆండ్రాయిడ్, వెబ్ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్‌లలో దీనిని ఉపయోగించవచ్చు. అయితే టీమ్, ఎంటర్‌ప్రైజ్ ప్లాన్లకు ఇది ప్రస్తుతానికి లభించదు. యూజర్ల ప్రస్తుత సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్ పరిమితులే దీనికి కూడా వర్తిస్తాయి. అయితే బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్‌లో నిరంతరం పనిచేయడం వల్ల సబ్‌స్క్రిప్షన్ పరిమితులు త్వరగా పూర్తయ్యే అవకాశముంది.కొన్నిసార్లు ఈ ఏఐ ఏజెంట్ సంభాషణలను తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుకోవడం, ప్రాధాన్యతలను సరిగ్గా అంచనా వేయకపోవడం వంటి లోపాలు ఉండవచ్చని ఆంత్రోపిక్ అంగీకరించింది. ప్రయాణ టికెట్ల బుకింగ్ వంటి వ్యక్తిగత పనుల కంటే వ్యాపార, ఆఫీస్ పనులకే దీనిని ఎక్కువగా తీర్చిదిద్దారు. ప్రారంభ వినియోగదారుల నుంచి వచ్చే ఫీడ్‌బ్యాక్ ఆధారంగా ఈ యాప్‌లో మరిన్ని మార్పులు చేయనున్నట్లు ఆంత్రోపిక్ వెల్లడించింది.

title: Try this nutritionist-approved indulgent recipe for creamy Lahori chicken korma that also includes a vegetarian version | Hindustan Times
description: This recipe is perfect if you want to spice up your weeknight dinner. The creamy Lahori chicken korma is versatile and can also be substituted with paneer.
content: Craving something rich and indulgent but would rather enjoy it at home than head out or order in? With the right ingredients and a little creativity in the kitchen, you can whip up a restaurant-style meal to satisfy your cravings. If you're in the mood for a creamy, flavour-packed chicken curry, this recipe could be just what you're looking for.Also Read | Looking for a gluten-free, vegetarian snack? Try this nutritionist-approved recipe for cheesy veg dumplings made with sabudana and paneerAathira Sethumadhavan, a certified nutritionist and chef known for her flavour-packed, calorie-conscious recipes, has shared her take on Lahori chicken korma, a rich, creamy curry made with browned onions, cashews, yoghurt and aromatic spices. The dish can also be adapted into a vegetarian version by swapping chicken for paneer. In an Instagram video shared on October 2, the nutritionist walks viewers through the ingredients and step-by-step method to prepare the korma at home. Check out the full recipe below!IngredientsFor the brown onion paste4 medium onions (400g), thinly sliced1 tsp oil (5g), for air-frying12 to 15 cashews (15g), soaked½ cup Greek yoghurt (100g)For the marinade300g boneless chicken thighs, cut into cubes, or 250g paneer, cubed1 tsp ginger-garlic paste (5g)¼ tsp turmeric powder (1g)1 tsp chilli powder (2.5g)1 tsp coriander powder (2g)Salt to taste1 tbsp lemon juice (15ml)1 tbsp ghee (13g), for pan-fryingFor the gravy1 tbsp ghee (13g)1 bay leaf2 cardamom pods2 cloves1 small piece of cinnamon1 tsp ginger-garlic paste (5g)2 tomatoes (150g), pureed¼ tsp turmeric powder1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp coriander powder½ tsp garam masala (1g)Salt to taste½ cup hot water (120ml)1 tsp kasuri methi (1g), crushed2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves (5g), chopped1½ tbsp fresh cream (22g)Method1. Arrange the sliced onions in an air fryer, toss with one teaspoon of oil and air-fry until browned. Allow them to cool slightly. Blend with the soaked cashews and Greek yoghurt until smooth and creamy.2. Combine the chicken or paneer with ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and lemon juice. Mix well and leave to marinate for 10 minutes.3. Heat one tablespoon of ghee in a pan. Add the marinated chicken or paneer and pan-fry until lightly browned. If using chicken, cook until nearly done. Remove and set aside.4. In the same pan, heat the remaining one tablespoon of ghee. Add the bay leaf, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon. Sauté briefly until fragrant, then add the ginger-garlic paste and cook until golden.5. Add the tomato puree and cook for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until it thickens and the raw tomato flavour subsides.6. Stir in the brown onion paste, followed by the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt. Mix thoroughly.7. Pour in the hot water and stir to combine. Cook over a medium-low heat until the gravy thickens and the flavours come together.8. Add the crushed kasuri methi, chopped coriander and fresh cream. Stir gently to combine.9. Return the pan-fried chicken or paneer to the gravy. Simmer until the chicken is fully cooked through or the paneer is heated, and the gravy reaches your preferred consistency.10. Garnish with fresh coriander, if desired, and serve hot with chapati, naan or rice.Approx. nutrition (per serving)Chicken kormaCalories: 364 kcalProtein: 27gCarbohydrates: 21gFat: 20gPaneer kormaCalories: 464 kcalProtein: 22gCarbohydrates: 22gFat: 33gNote to readers: This article is for informational purposes only. It is based on user-generated content from social media. HT.com has not independently verified the claims and does not endorse them.

title: Netflix Thrillers: నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్‌లో మస్ట్ వాచ్ టాప్ 8 మైండ్ బెండింగ్ స్పై థ్రిల్లర్ వెబ్ సిరీస్.. ట్విస్టులకు మతిపోతుంది | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Netflix Thrillers: థ్రిల్లర్, ఇన్వెస్టిగేటివ్ కంటెంట్‌ను ఇష్టపడే ఓటీటీ ప్రియుల కోసం నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్ (Netflix)లో అత్యుత్తమ ఐఎండీబీ రేటింగ్‌లు కలిగిన 8 డెటెక్టివ్ వెబ్ సిరీస్‌ల జాబితా ఇది. క్రైమ్, డార్క్ హ్యూమర్, సూపర్‌నేచురల్, సైన్స్ ఫిక్షన్ ఎలిమెంట్స్‌తో కూడిన ఈ సిరీస్‌లు మంచి వినోదాన్నిస్తాయి.
content: Netflix Thrillers: ఓటీటీలో ఈ వీకెండ్ కు థ్రిల్లింగ్ అనుభూతిని ఇచ్చే ఇన్వెస్టిగేషన్ కథల కోసం చూస్తున్నారా? మర్డర్ మిస్టరీలు, రహస్యాల ఛేదన, ఊహించని మలుపులతో సీట్ ఎడ్జ్ డ్రామాను పంచే డెటెక్టివ్ వెబ్ సిరీస్‌లకు ఓటీటీలో ఎప్పుడూ విపరీతమైన డిమాండ్ ఉంటుంది.ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా విమర్శకుల ప్రశంసలు అందుకుని, అత్యుత్తమ ఐఎండీబీ రేటింగ్‌లను సొంతం చేసుకున్న టాప్ 8 డెటెక్టివ్, స్పై వెబ్ సిరీస్‌లు ప్రముఖ ఓటీటీ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్ నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్‌లో అందుబాటులో ఉన్నాయి. హిందీ హిట్ వెబ్ సిరీస్‌లు 'అరణ్యక్', 'కోహ్రా' నుంచి ఇంటర్నేషనల్ క్లాసిక్ 'డిపార్ట్‌మెంట్ క్యూ' వరకు పూర్తి వివరాలు మీకోసం.1. అరణ్యక్ (Aranyak) - IMDb: 7.72021లో విడుదలైన 8 ఎపిసోడ్ల ఈ హిందీ క్రైమ్ థ్రిల్లర్ వెబ్ సిరీస్ హిమాచల్ ప్రదేశ్‌లోని 'సిరోనా' అనే ఒక కల్పిత కొండ ప్రాంతం నేపథ్యంలో సాగుతుంది. ఒక విదేశీ పర్యాటకుడి హత్య, ఆమె కుమార్తె అదృశ్యం చుట్టూ కథ తిరుగుతుంది. పూర్తి భిన్నమైన శైలి కలిగిన ఇద్దరు పోలీస్ అధికారులు (రవీనా టాండన్, పరమబ్రత ఛటర్జీ) ఈ కేసును ఛేదించడానికి ఎలాంటి సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొన్నారనేది ఇందులో ఆసక్తికరంగా చూపించారు.2. ది రెసిడెన్స్ (The Residence) - IMDb: 7.7ఇది ఒక అమెరికన్ డార్క్ కామెడీ డెటెక్టివ్ సిరీస్. అమెరికా అధ్యక్షుడి అధికారిక నివాసమైన 'వైట్ హౌస్'లో జరిగే ఒక ఊహించని హత్య ఆధారంగా ఈ కథ సాగుతుంది. అత్యంత తెలివైన డెటెక్టివ్ కార్డేలియా కప్ ఈ కేసును దర్యాప్తు చేయడానికి వైట్ హౌస్‌లోకి అడుగుపెడుతుంది. గూఢచర్యం, థ్రిల్‌తో పాటు పుష్కలంగా కామెడీ డోస్ అందించడం ఈ సిరీస్ ప్రత్యేకత.3. కోహ్రా (Kohrra) - IMDb: 7.5నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్‌లో అత్యంత ప్రజాదరణ పొందిన డార్క్ క్రైమ్ థ్రిల్లర్ సిరీస్‌లలో 'కోహ్రా' ఒకటి. ఇప్పటికే రెండు విజయవంతమైన సీజన్లను పూర్తి చేసుకున్న ఈ సిరీస్ మొదటి భాగంలో ఒక ఎన్‌ఆర్‌ఐ పెళ్లికొడుకు మిస్టరీ మరణాన్ని దర్యాప్తు చేస్తారు. రెండవ సీజన్‌లో బాండెడ్ లేబర్ (వెట్టి చాకిరీ) వంటి తీవ్రమైన సామాజిక అంశాన్ని థ్రిల్లింగ్ ఇన్వెస్టిగేటివ్ డ్రామాగా తెరకెక్కించారు. ఇందులో బరుణ్ సోబ్టి, మోనా సింగ్ కీలక పాత్రలు పోషించారు.4. లాండ్ ఆఫ్ సిన్ (Land of Sin) - IMDb: 5.7స్వీడిష్ క్రైమ్ థ్రిల్లర్‌గా వచ్చిన ఈ 5 ఎపిసోడ్ల చిన్న సిరీస్ ఒక కుర్రాడి అనుమానాస్పద మరణంతో మొదలవుతుంది. మొదట అందరూ ఇది ఆత్మహత్య అని భావించినప్పటికీ, ఒక నిశితమైన డెటెక్టివ్ ఇది పక్కా ప్రణాళికతో జరిగిన హత్య అని నిరూపిస్తాడు. ఈ హత్య వెనుక ఉన్న నిజాన్ని తవ్వే కొద్దీ అనేక దిగ్భ్రాంతికరమైన రాజకీయం, కుటుంబ రహస్యాలు బయటపడతాయి.5. డియర్ చైల్డ్ (Dear Child) - IMDb: 7.32023లో విడుదలై గ్లోబల్ వైడ్‌గా సంచలనం సృష్టించిన 6 ఎపిసోడ్ల సైకలాజికల్ మిస్టరీ థ్రిల్లర్ వెబ్ సిరీస్ ఇది. ఒక మహిళ, ఆమె పిల్లలు కొన్నేళ్ల పాటు ఒక రహస్య బందీఖానాలో ఎదుర్కొన్న నరకం, ఆ తర్వాత వారు అక్కడి నుంచి వింతగా తప్పించుకున్న దారుణమైన ఘటన చుట్టూ కథ నడుస్తుంది. ఆ బంధీఖానా వెనుక ఉన్న వికృత మనస్తత్వం కలిగిన వ్యక్తిని పట్టుకోవడానికి పోలీసులు చేసే ఇన్వెస్టిగేషన్ ఊపిరి బిగబట్టేలా చేస్తుంది.6. డెడ్ బాయ్స్ డిటెక్టివ్స్ (Dead Boy Detectives) - IMDb: 7.5సూపర్‌నేచురల్ హారర్, కామెడీ అండ్ యాక్షన్ కలగలిపిన వినూత్నమైన సిరీస్ ఇది. చనిపోయిన ఇద్దరు కుర్రాళ్లు ఆత్మలుగా మారి భూమిపై ఒక డెటెక్టివ్ ఏజెన్సీని ప్రారంభిస్తారు. చనిపోయిన ఆత్మలు, దెయ్యాలకు సంబంధించిన వింతైన, అసాధారణమైన అలౌకిక రహస్యాలను ఈ ఇద్దరు ఆత్మలు కలిసి ఎలా పరిష్కరించారనేది ఇందులో ఎంతో హాస్యభరితంగా చూపించారు.7. డిపార్ట్‌మెంట్ క్యూ (Dept Q) - title: Still in the race: India hopefuls turn up the heat with solid outings in round 2 of Ranji Trophy | Cricket
description: Sarfaraz Khan, Rajat Patidar and Rinku Singh make strong Ranji Trophy statements as fringe players push for national selection.  | Cricket
content: The second round of the recently concluded Ranji Trophy season witnessed a bit of everything. Chinmay Sutar, 29, became only the second batter in Ranji history to score 400. Uday Saharan grabbed the spotlight with a cracking 161 while all eyes were on Shubman Gill. Young Kartik Yadav, all of 19, picked up 5/37 in the second innings in Kanpur to spin a web around Goa. And veteran Bhargav Bhatt, playing his 100th First-Class game, took his career tally to 380 wickets, closing in on the magical 400-mark.But while the unfamiliar faces impressed, a few India probables and discards enjoyed fun outings, strengthening their cases and hoping to give the selectors a happy headache. Spare a thought for those unfortunate to miss out because the competition is stiff. For those trying to break into the longer format because the T20I spots are already filled. For those who faded without being given a longer rope. And for those whose best wasn’t enough to dislodge the established names.This list features some of Indian cricket’s brightest prospects, including fringe players who remain India probables.Sarfaraz KhanSarfaraz Khan came in as a replacement for the injured Sai Sudharsan for the first Test in Sri Lanka a couple of months ago. But the fact that he hasn’t played for India since October 2024 speaks volumes about his standing in the team management’s plans. Previously, he had travelled to Australia for the last Border-Gavaskar Trophy but once again warmed the benches. During his time away from the team, Sarfaraz lost oodles of weight and scored plenty of runs in domestic cricket, but it still wasn't enough to earn him game time.Once again, back to the grind, Sarfaraz bounced back from a rare failure in the first round to return among the runs. A 154-run knock, studded with 19 fours, once again brought him into the limelight as his 18th First-Class century helped guide Mumbai to a win over Himachal Pradesh. Regardless of where he stands in the pecking order, Sarfaraz continues to add to his First-Class record, with his average reading an impressive 64.02.Rajat PatidarLike Sarfaraz, Rajat Patidar last played a Test for India in 2024. Drafted in as a replacement for Virat Kohli, he endured a woeful series, scoring just 63 runs across six innings. Two years on, Patidar has become something of a legend in RCB circles, leading the team to back-to-back IPL titles. But his red-ball exploits haven’t quite helped him return to India’s Test plans. Having scored 53 and 67 for India A against Australia A earlier this month, Patidar struck 122 for Madhya Pradesh to help them take a first-innings lead over Puducherry.Last year, Patidar smashed his maiden Ranji Trophy double-century. This year, he already has a hundred in his first hit of the season. Is there more to come?Rinku SinghThe five sixes in one over by Rinku Singh in an IPL match was three years ago. Since then, he has made his India debut, become an integral part of the T20I setup, won gold at the Asian Games and been part of India's Asia Cup-winning campaign, only to now struggle to find a place in the squad. By the looks of things, shifting his focus to red-ball cricket may not be a bad idea for Rinku as he looks to revive his India prospects.He smashed 112 against Bihar in the first round and followed it up with an unbeaten 118 against Goa, even as Uttar Pradesh were bowled out for 202. In a low-scoring contest that produced just 730 runs across four innings, the weight of Rinku’s knock reads all the more significant.R Sai KishoreWhat’s better than a hat-trick? Ask Sai Kishore. That’s the the left-arm spinner revelled in as Tamil Nadu stormed to an innings victory over Uttarakhand. Sai has never quite broken into the Indian team, having played just two T20Is so far. But his recent stint with Gloucestershire in First-Class cricket, a move he made after missing out on a place in the South Zone squad for the Duleep Trophy, has proved to be a masterstroke.Sai Kishore returned figures of 4/40 in the first innings and followed them up with 6/34 in the second. A 10-wicket match haul. If that doesn’t grab the selectors’ attention, what will?Ruturaj GaikwadNot exactly a hopeful or a fringe player, but perhaps one of the most deserving players to not be a permanent fixture in any of India’s three formats. Ruturaj Gaikwad has played 12 ODIs and 23 T20Is but is still struggling to cement his place in the Indian XI. Away from national duty, though, he has begun the Ranji Trophy season emphatically, smashing an unbeaten 101 for Maharashtra against Jharkhand. Gaikwad’s century came at No. 7 as a collective batting effort propelled Maharashtra to 527/6 declared in their only innings.The Indian Test setup is already crowded, with Sarfaraz, Sudharsan, Devdutt Padikkal and Dhruv Jurel ahead of him in the pecking order. Gaikwad may not be close to Test selection, but his century, followed by hopefully a few more strong performances, could open the door to greater opportunities in limited-overs cricket.

title: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash’s film Ramayana crosses  ₹5.33 crore in advance booking 14 days before release, sells 1.28 lakh tickets | Bollywood
description: The film opened advance bookings on Tuesday, October 20, coinciding with Dussehra and 16 days in advance.   | Bollywood
content: Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana is seeing encouraging interest at the advance booking window, with audiences already booking tickets for the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer ahead of its November release. The film opened advance bookings on Tuesday, October 20, coinciding with Dussehra. With nearly two weeks to go before it hits theatres, the early numbers have given the mythological epic a promising start.Ramayana advance booking reportAccording to trade tracker Sacnilk, Ramayana had collected ₹5.33 crore gross across India by 3 pm on Wednesday, October 21, excluding block seats. The film had sold 1.28 lakh tickets across 3,710 shows.Bookings have continued to rise since the initial 6 am cut-off, adding another ₹21.71 lakh to the total. The film’s overall occupancy is around 15%, with the Hindi version accounting for the bulk of the early business. The Kannada and Telugu versions have also begun drawing audiences, adding to the film’s pan-India reach. Delhi-NCR and Mumbai lead the advance salesDelhi-NCR is currently the biggest market for Ramayana, contributing ₹1.82 crore, or around 34% of its total gross. Mumbai follows with ₹1.07 crore, accounting for nearly 20% of the collection. Pune has recorded ₹35.31 lakh in advance sales, while Hyderabad has contributed ₹32.22 lakh and Bengaluru ₹31.45 lakh. The state-wise figures show Maharashtra at the top with ₹1.72 crore, followed by Delhi at ₹1.40 crore and Gujarat at ₹46.54 lakh.The dubbed versions are also attracting early interest. The Kannada version has collected ₹19.03 lakh from 69 shows, with Yash playing Ravana likely to be a major attraction for audiences in Karnataka. The Telugu version has earned ₹17.41 lakh from 34 shows.Some premium screenings are commanding high ticket prices, too. In Mumbai, IMAX recliner seats are priced at up to ₹2,770. Ramayana: Cast, release date and other detailsDirected by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend brings the story of the ancient Indian epic to the big screen on a grand scale. Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi stars as Sita, and Yash portrays Ravana. The cast also features Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshmana.Academy Award-winning visual effects company DNEG is handling the VFX, while the music is composed by Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the film is planned as a two-part saga. The first instalment is scheduled to arrive in theatres on November 5, 2026, while the second part is expected to release in 2027.

title: What France’s winter of discontent means for global governance | Hindustan Times
description: This article is authored by Gunwant Singh, scholar, international relations and security studies, Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi.
content: The boulevards of Paris, Lyon, and Marseille have once again transformed into cauldrons of civil unrest, enveloped in tear gas, ringing with chants, and punctuated by the sirens of riot police. While popular mobilisation is woven into the very fabric of the French Republic, the latest convulsions across the country represent something far more volatile than standard industrial action. What began as a series of classroom walkouts and local student strikes against underfunded facilities and proposed budgetary austerity has swiftly developed into an expansive, multi-sector revolt. As trade unions, public sector employees, farmers, and disaffected youth join the barricades, France finds itself wrestling with an existential friction between fiscal consolidation and the preservation of its sacred social contract. For an embattled government attempting to project stability on the world stage, the street has once again emerged as the supreme arbiter of political legitimacy.To understand the intensity of the upheaval, one must look beyond the immediate sparks to the structural decay that has built up over years. The immediate catalyst was the state’s contentious budget roadmap, which sought to rein in a ballooning national deficit by slashing thousands of public sector posts, particularly in primary and secondary education, while trimming social expenditures. This fiscal austerity, introduced against the backdrop of an already strained healthcare system and an acute cost-of-living crisis, lit an immediate spark among students and teachers. Simmering resentment over previous executive-driven measures, most notably the controversial pension reforms that raised the retirement age without an outright parliamentary vote, had never truly dissipated. Coupled with skyrocketing urban rents, persistent food inflation, and the lingering frustration of the agricultural sector burdened by green transition mandates and international trade competition, the French public perceived the government’s fiscal belt-tightening as an unequal sacrifice imposed by a detached technocratic elite.The crisis is also inherently institutional, reflecting a fractured political architecture. Following recent snap elections that resulted in a hung and deeply polarised National Assembly, the French executive operates without a commanding legislative mandate. The reliance on constitutional manoeuvres to bypass parliamentary consensus has eroded public trust in institutional channels, driving opposition into the streets. When early student-led demonstrations were met with heavy-handed riot policing and widely shared footage of forceful arrests, moral outrage supercharged the movement. Trade unions recognised a moment of convergence, called general strikes, that paralysed commuter rail networks, municipal transit, and sanitation services. The resulting coalition uniting urban Gen Z students, suburban public sector workers, and rural agriculturalists illustrate how thoroughly the grievance has spread across sociological divides.The global economic repercussions of this French paralysis are swift and consequential. France is the second-largest economy in the European Union and its primary military power. When Paris shudders, the tremors run straight through Frankfurt and Brussels. The country's sovereign debt, hovering near 120% of gross domestic product, has become an urgent concern for global bond markets. International investors, spooked by the prospect of prolonged governance paralysis and the impossibility of passing credible fiscal stabilisation bills, have pushed French borrowing costs upward, causing the yield spread between French and German government bonds to widen to levels reminiscent of past sovereign debt scares. A weakened, indebted France hobbles the fiscal cohesion of the entire Eurozone, complicating the European Central Bank’s monetary trajectory and dampening broader European economic growth at a time when the continent is already grappling with sluggish industrial output and competitive pressures from the US and China. Beyond finance, France’s domestic turmoil carries profound geopolitical fallout. As a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council and the leading advocate for European "strategic autonomy", Paris has championed independent continental defence capabilities, ambitious climate transitions, and active diplomatic postures from the Middle East to the Indo-Pacific. A French presidency preoccupied with quelling urban unrest and surviving legislative votes of no-confidence inevitably lacks the political capital required to drive contentious foreign policy initiatives. In European decision-making circles, the Franco-German engine, already strained by ideological divergence, has ground toward a near standstill. Furthermore, persistent civil friction provides fertile ground for political extremes, raising the likelihood that future electoral cycles could empower populist, Euro-sceptic factions whose ascension would dramatically rearrange the continent's geopolitical architecture.Critically, the upheaval in France possesses the potential to trigger a broader contagion of unrest across developed and developing nations alike. France has historically served as a political bellwether for the Western world; the tactical playbook developed on the streets of Paris frequently reverberates across borders. Across southern and western Europe, in countries like Spain, Portugal, and Italy, young populations confront identical pressures: prohibitive housing markets, precarious employment conditions, and public welfare programmes trimmed under fiscal consolidation directives. The visible effectiveness of French collective action, magnified exponentially across social media algorithms, offers a blueprint for youth-led, cross-sector mobilisation elsewhere. When ordinary citizens observe that sustained disruption can force concessions from a central government, the barrier to staging disruptive strikes declines significantly, threatening similar waves of domestic unrest throughout capital cities facing the universal pressures of post-pandemic inflation and high debt service burdens.For India, the unfolding crisis in France is far from an esoteric European drama; it touches directly upon New Delhi’s strategic, economic, and diplomatic priorities. France has emerged over the last decade as India’s closest and most dependable strategic partner in Europe. The two nations share deep security cooperation, anchored by extensive defence procurements, including Rafale fighter aircraft, Scorpene-class submarines, and sensitive jet-engine technology transfers, alongside coordinated maritime patrols in the Indian Ocean. Prolonged political dysfunction and budget re-prioritisation in Paris could introduce bureaucratic inertia into these high-profile defence pipelines and co-development programmes. While strategic alignment remains resilient, executive distraction in Paris inevitably slows the timeline of high-level diplomatic deliverables and collaborative industrial projects.The economic fallout likewise presents challenges for India’s international trade architecture. France is a major destination for Indian engineering goods, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and information technology services, as well as a prime proponent of the long-pending India-European Union Broad-based Trade and Investment Agreement (BTIA). A French political apparatus immobilised by domestic labour union pressure and protectionist demands from farmers will find it politically perilous to endorse sweeping multilateral trade concessions. Consequently, the momentum behind finalising a balanced India-EU free trade pact faces heightened resistance, delaying tariff rationalisation and smoother market access for Indian exporters seeking to diversify supply chains away from over-reliance on traditional East Asian manufacturing hubs.The human and educational dimensions between the two nations are also directly impacted. In recent years, New Delhi and Paris implemented ambitious mobility frameworks aimed at hosting over 30,000 Indian students in French higher education institutions by the end of the decade, backed by simplified post-study work visas. Campus shutdowns, localised curfews, disruptions in public transportation, and protests focused directly on the state of university and secondary education create logistical anxieties for Indian families and researchers residing in French urban centres. Furthermore, heightened volatility in Paris inevitably dents European travel and hospitality, impacting Indian business delegations, international conferences, and the seasonal influx of Indian tourism across Western Europe.Finally, the crisis in France holds instructive governance lessons for policymakers in New Delhi. The French upheaval lays bare the hazards of implementing technocratic fiscal and structural reforms without cultivating broad, consultative social consensus. Both nations possess vast, aspirational youth demographics entering competitive job markets marked by structural transitions and the pressures of technological disruption. When governments attempt to accelerate fiscal discipline, rationalise welfare subsidies, or reform public services without addressing fundamental anxieties regarding purchasing power and generational opportunity, the risk of explosive grassroots blowback surges. As Paris grapples with the embers of its latest public rebellion, the lesson resonating across world capitals, including New Delhi, is that fiscal math can never be entirely decoupled from the raw realities of the citizen's lived experience.(The views expressed are personal)This article is authored by Gunwant Singh, scholar, international relations and security studies, Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi.

title: Akshay Kumar, Kangana Ranaut and more stars wish Amit Shah on his 62nd birthday | Bollywood
description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah is celebrating his birthday. Several actors extended birthday greetings on X and wished him.  | Bollywood
content: Several actors extended birthday greetings to Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Thursday. Amit Shah turns 62 on October 22. On this occasion, many stars took to their X account to wish him and pray for his good health.Akshay Kumar's wish for Amit ShahActor Akshay Kumar wrote in Hindi, “Heartfelt birthday wishes to you, @AmitShah ji. You have always kept the nation first and foremost. May Mahadev's blessings always be upon you… may your health always remain good and your resolve always remain true. Jai Mahakal."Actor and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut took to her X account to share a picture with the Home Minister and wrote in the caption, “Heartfelt birthday wishes to the illustrious Union Home and Cooperation Minister of India, the honorable Shri Amit Shah Ji. I pray to Lord Shri Ram that you remain forever healthy, joyful, and blessed with a long life, continuing to contribute to the nation's progress in the same way. Jai Shri Ram!” Meanwhile, actor Vijay Deverakonda wrote, “Wishing Hon’ble Home Minister Shri @AmitShah Ji a very happy birthday. Wishing you good health, strength and success sir.”Actor Riteish Deshmukh wrote, “Wishing our Honourable Home Minister- Shri @AmitShah ji a very happy birthday. May god bless you with great health and long life.” Meanwhile, Tamil Nadu CM Vijay also penned a note for Amit Shah on X. It read, “Warm birthday wishes to the Hon’ble Union Minister of Home Affairs and Cooperation, Thiru. Amit Shah Avl! My best wishes for your good health and long life in service to the nation! Warm birthday wishes to the Hon’ble Union Minister of Home Affairs and Cooperation, Thiru. Amit Shah Avl. Wishing you a long life and good health in service to the nation.” PM Modi's notePrime Minister Narendra Modi also greeted Union Home Minister Amit Shah on his birthday and said his administrative understanding has ensured India's internal security systems become more effective. "Warm birthday greetings to Home Minister Amit Shah. His administrative understanding has ensured India's internal security systems become more effective," PM Modi said in a post on X. The prime minister said Shah's particularly noteworthy successes are in eliminating the menace of Maoism and in furthering the government's dream of a society free from drugs. "I pray that he is blessed with a long and healthy life in service of the people," he said.
