title: Delhi Metro starts 20 extra weekday trips as Grap Stage-I kicks in | Latest News Delhi
description: DMRC will step up dust-control measures at construction sites and nearby roads as Delhi-NCR tackles worsening air quality.  | Latest News Delhi
content: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) will run 20 additional train trips on weekdays from Thursday, October 22, amid Stage I of the Graded Response Action Plan (Grap) in the city to tackle deteriorating air quality.The DMRC said it is also intensifying anti-pollution drives at its construction sites and surrounding areas as Delhi-NCR.In a post on X on Wednesday evening, DMRC's official handle, @OfficialDMRC, said the additional services would encourage more commuters to use public transport instead of private vehicles. The corporation will also step up dust-control measures at construction sites and on roads under its jurisdiction across the national capital. The announcement comes after the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) invoked Grap Stage I across Delhi-NCR on Wednesday, following a sharp deterioration in air quality that pushed Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) into the 'poor' category. Also Read: Grap 1 imposed in Delhi-NCR as AQI enters 'poor' category day after DussehraWhat anti-pollution measures will DMRC take?According to DMRC, the intensified drives will focus on reducing dust at construction sites, removing accumulated dust from surrounding roads and clearing garbage from footpaths and road medians.Metro engineers will inspect construction sites and nearby roads to ensure that construction materials are properly covered and wheel-washing facilities for vehicles leaving the sites are functioning. These measures are intended to limit dust from construction activity and prevent it from spreading to surrounding areas.The corporation said the additional drives would supplement the pollution-control measures already in place.Approximately 31 kilometres of city roads are currently under DMRC's temporary jurisdiction to facilitate metro construction work. Most of these roads have already been repaired by the corporation to prevent them from contributing further to pollution, DMRC said.More than 250 anti-smog guns and mist guns have also been installed at construction sites, metro stations and office buildings to reduce dust levels. DMRC's Environment Department conducts daily inspections to ensure compliance with environmental norms.Also Read: DMRC first Indian metro organisation certified under latest ISO asset management standardWhy has Grap Stage I been invoked?The CAQM invoked the first stage of the Grap across Delhi-NCR on Wednesday after Delhi's air quality deteriorated sharply following Dussehra celebrations.GRAP is a set of emergency measures implemented in phases to tackle worsening air pollution across Delhi-NCR. Stage I applies when air quality enters the 'poor' category and requires authorities to strengthen pollution-control measures.According to the CAQM order, Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) rose from 179, in the 'moderate' category, on October 20 to 244 at 2pm on October 21, entering the 'poor' category. The commission cited forecasts from the India Meteorological Department and the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, which indicated that air quality was likely to remain poor over the coming days.Also Read: Bad air season begins: Post-Dussehra spike pushes Delhi AQI to ‘poor’HT reported on Thursday that Delhi's AQI had reached 245 at 4pm on Wednesday, marking the highest reading of the season and the worst since July 13.Under Grap Stage I, dust-control measures are mandatory at construction and demolition sites, while projects covering more than 500 square metres require an approved dust-management plan. Open waste burning is prohibited, and coal and firewood ovens or grills are barred in eateries and commercial kitchens. Diesel generators are restricted to essential and emergency services, while authorities are required to act against visibly polluting vehicles, industries and thermal power plants within 300 km of Delhi.The additional metro services and intensified construction-site inspections announced by DMRC come as authorities step up measures to prevent air quality from deteriorating further.

title: ఈశాన్య రుతుపవనాలు : 12 జిల్లాల్లో చుక్క వానలేదు.. 95 శాతం వర్షపాతం లోటు | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: తెలంగాణలో ఈశాన్య రుతుపవనాలతోనూ వరుణదేవుడు కనికరించలేదు. వర్షపాతం లోటు రాష్ట్రంలో స్పష్టంగా కనిపిస్తోంది. అక్టోబర్‌లో 12 జిల్లాల్లో చక్క వాన కూడా పడలేదు.
content: తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్రంలో ఈశాన్య రుతుపవనాల(North East Monsoon) సీజన్ అత్యంత పొడిగా ప్రారంభమైంది. ఈశాన్య రుతుపవనాల కాలంలో ఎప్పుడూ కురిసే సగటు వర్షపాతంతో పోలిస్తే ఈసారి తీవ్రమైన వర్షాభావ పరిస్థితులు నెలకొన్నాయి. ముఖ్యంగా రాష్ట్ర రాజధాని హైదరాబాద్‌తో పాటు పలు తెలంగాణలోని పలు జిల్లాల్లో సాధారణం కంటే అత్యల్ప వర్షపాతం నమోదవ్వడం పట్ల తీవ్ర ఆందోళన వ్యక్తమవుతోంది.సాధారణంగా తెలంగాణలో అక్టోబర్ నెల అత్యధికంగా వర్షాలు కురిసే నెలల్లో ఒకటి. అయితే ఈ ఏడాది అక్టోబర్ తొలి 21 రోజుల్లో సాధారణం కంటే విపరీతంగా వర్షపాతం పడిపోయింది. రాష్ట్ర సగటు వర్షపాతం చూసుకుంటే.. అక్టోబర్ 1 నుండి 21 వరకు రాష్ట్రంలో సాధారణంగా 75.6 మిమీ వర్షపాతం నమోదు కావాల్సి ఉండగా, కేవలం 3.5 మిమీ మాత్రమే నమోదైంది. అంటే రాష్ట్రవ్యాప్తంగా ఏకంగా 95 శాతం వర్షపాత లోటు నెలకొంది.గ్రేటర్ హైదరాబాద్ పరిధిలో పరిస్థితి మరింత దారుణంగా ఉంది. నగరంలో సాధారణంగా అక్టోబర్ నెలలో 114 మిమీ వర్షపాతం నమోదు కావాల్సి ఉండగా, ఈ నెల 21వ తేదీ వరకు కేవలం 2.8 మిమీ వర్షం మాత్రమే కురిసింది. దీంతో నగరంలో 97 శాతం వర్షపాత లోటు నమోదైంది. గత సంవత్సరాలతో పోలిస్తే ఈ వ్యత్యాసం స్పష్టంగా కనిపిస్తోంది. అక్టోబర్ 2020లో హైదరాబాద్ నగరంలో ఏకంగా 400.7 మిమీ వర్షపాతం నమోదు కాగా, 2016 అక్టోబర్‌లో 37.1 మిమీ వర్షపాతం నమోదైంది. కానీ ఈసారి పరిస్థితి పూర్తి విరుద్ధంగా మారింది.రాష్ట్రంలోని దాదాపు 12 జిల్లాల్లో అక్టోబర్ మొదటి 21 రోజుల్లో చుక్క వర్షం కూడా పడలేదు. హనుమకొండ, జయశంకర్ భూపాలపల్లి, జగిత్యాల, కరీంనగర్, మేడ్చల్-మల్కాజిగిరి, మంచిర్యాల, మెదక్, నిజామాబాద్, పెద్దపల్లి, రాజన్న సిరిసిల్ల, సంగారెడ్డి, సిద్దిపేటలో వానలు లేవు.అక్టోబర్ నెలలో రాష్ట్రంలోనే అత్యధికంగా వనపర్తి జిల్లాలో 17.7 మిమీ వర్షపాతం నమోదైంది. అయినప్పటికీ ఇది సాధారణ వర్షపాతం (82.1 మిమీ) కంటే 78 శాతం తక్కువ కావడం గమనార్హం. సాధారణంగా నమోదు కావాల్సిన 94.6 మిమీ వర్షపాతానికి గాను ఖమ్మంలో కేవలం 13.8 మిమీ వర్షపాతం మాత్రమే పడింది. యాదాద్రి భువనగిరిలో సాధారణంగా పడాల్సిన 84.6 మిమీకి గాను కేవలం 13 మిమీ వర్షపాతం మాత్రమే నమోదైంది.తెలంగాణతో పాటు హైదరాబాద్ నగరంలో ఈశాన్య రుతుపవనాల సమయంలో వర్షపాతం ఈ స్థాయిలో తగ్గిపోవడానికి ఎల్ నినో ప్రభావమే ప్రధాన కారణమని వాతావరణ నిపుణులు భావిస్తున్నారు. ఎల్ నినో అనేది పసిఫిక్ మహాసముద్రంలో ఏర్పడే ఒక సహజ వాతావరణ దృగ్విషయం. నీరు అసాధారణంగా వేడెక్కే ఒక వాతావరణ ప్రక్రియ. సముద్రపు ఉష్ణోగ్రతలు సాధారణం కంటే కొన్ని డిగ్రీల సెల్సియస్ పెరుగుతాయి. దీనివల్ల వాతావరణ ప్రసరణ విధానంలో మార్పులు వచ్చి, ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా వర్షపాత సరళి పూర్తిగా మారిపోతుంది.ప్రస్తుతం తెలంగాణలో కనిపిస్తున్న పొడి వాతావరణానికి, వర్షాలు తగ్గడానికి ఈ ఎల్ నినో ప్రభావమే కారణం. ఈ పరిస్థితి వ్యవసాయ రంగంతో పాటు తాగునీటి సరఫరాపై కూడా ప్రతికూల ప్రభావం చూపే అవకాశం ఉందని ఆందోళనలు వ్యక్తమవుతున్నాయి.

title: Uttarakhand CM launches AI voice portal to preserve Garhwali, Kumaoni and Jaunsari languages | India News
description: Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami launches Bhasha AI voice portal to preserve Garhwali, Kumaoni and Jaunsari and bring the languages to digital platforms. | India News
content: Chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami on Thursday launched a voice collection portal to bring Garhwali, Kumaoni and Jaunsari, three regional languages of the state, to AI platforms and help preserve them for future generations.The campaign was launched at the chief minister’s camp office under the ‘Bhasha AI’ initiative of the AI Strategic Engineering (AiSE) Foundation, where Dhami recorded a voice clip in Kumaoni. The initiative aims to build a repository of words, pronunciations, voices and speaking styles in the three languages so that AI-based technologies can eventually understand and communicate in them.CM Dhami said modern technology would be “crucial for preserving Uttarakhand’s folk languages, folk arts, culture and traditions”. “Languages and dialects are our identity,” he said, emphasising that Uttarakhand’s linguistic heritage should be taken to digital and global platforms through technology.The state government wanted people living in even the “remotest villages and regions to be able to access information about government schemes in their native languages and communicate their concerns to the government using the same languages,” Dhami said.“For this to become possible, AI systems would need to accurately understand local languages, including their vocabulary, pronunciation and different ways of speaking,” he added.Pointing out how the same word could be pronounced differently in different parts of Uttarakhand, Dhami said that the collection of such variations through the portal would help AI systems better understand the linguistic diversity of Garhwali, Kumaoni and Jaunsari.Sachidanand Semwal, founder of the non-profit AiSE Foundation, will lead the technical aspects of data collection, modelling, AI training and language-model validation for the portal, while Padma Shri folk singer Pritam Bhartwan will be the language expert coordinator. Shakti Prasad Bhatt is listed as the execution head.Bhartwan said the state’s local languages carried a rich heritage of folk life, traditional songs, Jagar and cultural practices. He said the Jagar Academy would assist the initiative by helping ensure accurate pronunciation and preserving the languages’ authentic character.“Bhasha AI initiative involves collecting words and audio samples from Garhwali, Kumaoni and Jaunsari. The long-term objective is to enable AI-based technology to understand and communicate in these regional languages,” Semwal said.

title: Acknowledge your mistake and apologise: Mika to U'Khand minister on Daler Mehndi row | Bollywood
description: Acknowledge your mistake and apologise: Mika to U'Khand minister on Daler Mehndi row  | Bollywood
content: New Delhi, Artists deserve dignity and respect, singer Mika Singh said on Thursday, reiterating that Uttarakhand cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal must apologise to his brother Daler Mehndi for publicly reprimanding him at an event.On Sunday evening, Mehndi was performing at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in Uttarakhand's New Tehri town when Uniyal stormed up to the stage and asked him loudly if he was drunk.The 59-year-old singer, known for hits such as "Tunak Tunak Tun", "Bolo Ta Ra" and "Ho Jayegi Balle Balle", was heard saying "sorry" in video clips that have since gone viral. Mika, who has been vocal in his support for his brother since the incident, has demanded an apology from Uniyal and urged Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami to look into the matter.In a fresh post, the singer said the minister should be grateful to Mehndi for agreeing to perform at the event after another artist, Sunanda Sharma, fell ill."Respected @SubodhUniyal1 ji, Minister Sahib, the real truth is that you should be grateful to Daler Mehndi ji for saving your event and fulfilling his responsibility."According to my information, Sunanda Sharma had initially been booked for this program, but she fell ill with fever. After that, just one day before the event, Daler Mehndi ji was called in, and despite not being well, he performed at the program," Mika said.He said it was painful to see Mehndi being accused of being drunk while performing on stage."If there has been any mistake on your part, you should acknowledge your mistake and apologize to Daler Mehndi ji. Minister ji, there are many important tasks to serve the public."I wish you would fulfill those responsibilities with the same seriousness that you use to question an artist. Veteran artists like Daler Mehndi ji deserve respect, not humiliation," he added.In a subsequent post, Mika said the whole world has come forward to support Mehndi but nobody has defended Uniyal."Celebrities and fans from across the globe are standing by him, @SubodhUniyal1 ji but nobody has come forward to support you. Why? Because people believe you were wrong in the way you treated him."Hon'ble @pushkardhami CM of Uttarakhand, please look into this matter. We love Uttarakhand and its people, but artists deserve dignity and respect," he said.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

title: Delivery boy dies by suicide after assault over torn currency note in east Delhi | India News
description: The two accused were arrested and were identified as Rakesh alias Bunti (30) and Rampal Singh (65), police added. | India News
content: A 24-year-old delivery executive, who allegedly consumed a poisonous substance a day after recording a video recounting his assault by two men over a torn currency note in east Delhi, died on October 20, with police subsequently adding a charge of abetment of suicide to the case, officials said on Thursday.The victim was allegedly assaulted by two residents of East Vinod Nagar on the night of October 4 after he refused to accept a torn currency note, according to police.The two accused were arrested and were identified as Rakesh alias Bunti (30) and Rampal Singh (65), police added.A PCR call was received at 11.03 pm on October 4, with the victim reporting that he had been attacked by the accused over the issue, police said.Also Read: Man dies by suicide in Badaun, father accuses 4 of harassmentHis medico-legal case (MLC) was prepared shortly after midnight on October 5, and an FIR was registered at Kalyanpuri police station the same day, they said.He later recorded a video detailing his account of the incident.Police subsequently received information that he had consumed a poisonous substance and was admitted to Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital on October 5.Also Read: Social media influencer with 1.4 mn followers found dead in Chennai; suicide suspectedHe died on October 20, following which Section 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), pertaining to abetment of suicide, was added to the FIR, police said.If you or someone you know needs support, please reach out to your nearest mental health specialist.Helplines: Aasra: 022 2754 6669; Sneha India Foundation: +914424640050 and Sanjivini: 011-24311918, Roshni Foundation (Secunderabad) Contact Nos: 040-66202001, 040-66202000, ONE LIFE: Contact No: 78930 78930, SEVA: Contact No: 09441778290

title: ‘This is shocking’: Bombay HC says Mumbai pollution surpassing Delhi, pulls up authorities | India News
description: Justice Kulkarni observed that Mumbai was failing to capitalise on its geographical advantages, including its sea breeze and open spaces. | India News
content: The Bombay High Court on Wednesday reportedly expressed alarm over the Maharashtra's Mumbai surpassing Delhi in pollution levels, air quality shocking while asking authorities how they were not losing sleep over the “emergency situation”.During the hearing, Justice Kulkarni reportedly observed that Mumbai was failing to capitalise on its geographical advantages, including its sea breeze and open spaces.The bench also flagged reports of Mumbai surpassing Delhi in pollution indexes and noted that visibility in the city had fallen below 500 metres on Tuesday, the Bar and Bench reported. Also Read: How pollution in Delhi surged on Dussehra night “This is shocking. The city has a sea breeze coming, which has a lot of open spaces, the whole openness of the sea, still we are facing this... You should see to it that Mumbai skies are clear," the Bench added, as quoted by the publication.Mumbai’s air quality index (AQI) has remained between 150 and 200 over the past week, according to aqi.in.Justice Kulkarni also questioned how enforcement officials could sleep peacefully while lakhs of citizens were facing what he described as an emergency situation.The bench expressed displeasure over the failure to secure prior permission for music systems used in processions, along with undertakings to comply with prescribed decibel limits. It also pointed to the continued bursting of firecrackers on busy public streets."No action on the issue of prior permission to use music systems in the processions being obtained, with an undertaking to comply with the decibel limits. Also, burning of firecrackers on busy public streets is not being controlled. There appears to be routine violations of the orders passed by this Court," it observed.Also Read: ₹35,000 penalty">Mumbai air pollution: BMC cracks down on construction sites, issues stop-work notice and ₹35,000 penaltyThe court on Wednesday reprimanded civic authorities, the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) and the police for failing to implement its directions on air and noise pollution, particularly during festivals and religious processions.A division bench was hearing a suo motu Public Interest Litigation (PIL) concerning pollution. The judges expressed concern over violations of court orders regulating sound systems and the bursting of firecrackers on public streets, as well as the authorities’ failure to take timely measures to inform citizens about the restrictions.HC raps BMC over firecrackersIn its written order, the bench criticised the slow pace of implementation of its earlier directives, stating that even basic preliminary requirements remained unfulfilled.The court also pulled up the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) and the MPCB for failing to issue public notices about its October 15 order prohibiting the bursting of firecrackers in public places, including streets, lanes and footpaths.The bench noted that neither authority had taken steps to publicise the ban through newspapers, electronic and social media, or other platforms, despite being directed to do so.Delhi pollution spikes ahead of DiwaliHour-by-hour readings showed pollution levels in Delhi rising sharply on Tuesday evening as Dussehra effigies were burned, while similar weather conditions on the two preceding nights had not triggered a comparable spike.A further rise in pollution is possible in the coming weeks as Diwali approaches, with firecrackers potentially being permitted more widely this year in light of the Supreme Court’s observations earlier this month.A bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant called for a “pragmatic and practical” approach to regulating firecrackers, cautioning that people could view overly restrictive measures as coercive. The court linked the Delhi-NCR case to a nationwide matter before a bench headed by Justice MM Sundresh, which had cleared “next-generation” laris, or joint crackers, across the country on September 30.(With inputs from Karuna Nidhi and Binayak Dasgupta)

title: DDA, INTACH to organise heritage, nature walks at six Delhi sites | India News
description: The six locations identified for the walks are Sanjay Van, Mehrauli Archaeological Park, Sultan Garhi, Tughlaqabad Fort, Deer Park-Hauz Khas and the Northern Ridge | India News
content: The Delhi Development Authority (DDA) has partnered with the Indian National Trust for Art and Cultural Heritage (INTACH) to organise guided heritage and nature walks at six locations across the national Capital over the next six months, with the initiative set to begin at Mehrauli Archaeological Park on October 24, officials said on Thursday.The initiative, being undertaken on the directions of Delhi lieutenant governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu, aims to connect residents with the city’s rich historical, architectural and natural heritage, the DDA said in a statement.The DDA has signed a six-month memorandum of understanding (MoU) with INTACH’s Delhi chapter to conduct two walks every month.The first walk will be held at Mehrauli Archaeological Park at 4pm on Saturday. It will introduce participants to the park’s historical structures, architectural features and lesser-known stories from Delhi’s past, the authority said.Also Read: Sanatkada Festival curtain raiser: Lucknow-Calcutta ‘raabta’ explored through Residency film and heritage walkThe six locations identified for the walks are Sanjay Van, Mehrauli Archaeological Park, Sultan Garhi, Tughlaqabad Fort, Deer Park-Hauz Khas and the Northern Ridge. Two walks will be organised at each location during the six-month period, taking the total number of walks to 12, the statement read.Each walk will accommodate up to 40 participants. Online registration is available through the DDA portal, with a participation fee of ₹500 plus GST per person per walk. Interested participants can register at bit.ly/HeritageWalkMAP.Under the agreement, INTACH’s Delhi chapter will curate the routes, themes and interpretative content and arrange heritage experts and guides in coordination with the DDA. The authority will facilitate access, permissions and other administrative arrangements for the walks.Earlier this month, Sandhu led a heritage walk at Sanjay Van, which saw participation from residents. He also launched the e-book Exploring the Delhi Ridge – Reviving the Heritage of Lungs of Delhi and directed the DDA to focus on ecological conservation, heritage protection and public engagement through such initiatives.The programme is also aligned with the Master Plan for Delhi 2047 (MPD-2047), which emphasises conserving the city’s heritage alongside planned and sustainable urban development. The plan encourages heritage trails, cultural circuits and public activities to promote tourism, support local businesses and improve public engagement with Delhi’s history.

title: Daler Mehndi should have informed us if he was unwell, says Uttarakhand minister; clarifies he had no intention to hurt singer | Hindustan Times
description: After facing criticism, Uttarakhand minister Subodh Uniyal said he felt pressured to question Daler Mehndi’s performance.
content: Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal has faced criticism from several celebrities for reprimanding Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi on stage during his performance at a cultural event. Now, speaking to PTI, Uniyal has clarified that he did not intend to hurt the singer and said Mehndi should have informed the organisers if he was unwell.Subodh Uniyal says Daler Mehndi should have informed if he was unwellThe minister claimed that Daler Mehndi was lip-syncing and appeared unable to speak or walk properly, leading him to suspect that the singer was under the influence of a substance. He added that, as the local representative associated with the organising committee, he felt “pressured” to question the performance.Uniyal said he learnt that Mehndi was unwell only after interrupting his performance. He said, “Such a big artiste, he should have informed us about this. This fact was revealed only when he was interrupted. If he was unwell, he should not have come to perform. We were asked to make full payment of ₹35 lakh in advance to the artiste; hotels were also booked in advance. I have nothing personal against Mehndi nor any intention to hurt him, but such a big artiste, knowing his condition, should have refused to perform.” The minister reiterated that he was “under pressure” as the elected representative of the constituency. He maintained that artists should conduct themselves appropriately to preserve their dignity and said he had not used any foul language while addressing Daler Mehndi.Uniyal said local artists are given preference at the Kunjapuri Fair, while performers from Bollywood are invited for only two days. He cited singer Sunanda Sharma as an example, saying she had refunded the full payment when she fell ill and could not perform.“When Sharma could not come, our team approached Daler Mehndi. If he was unwell, he should have informed us. The public are not doctors to know this. An artiste's family and well-wishers will always stand with him, but we should also have been informed in advance,” Uniyal said.About the Daler Mehndi rowThe controversy began when Uniyal walked onto the stage and expressed his displeasure while Daler Mehndi was performing at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in Narendra Nagar, in Uttarakhand's Tehri Garhwal district. The cultural event was organised by the state government, and a clip of the incident soon went viral on social media.Mehndi's brother, singer Mika Singh, defended him, stressing that he does not consume alcohol and criticising the way the minister had treated him. Bollywood actors Rajpal Yadav and Anupam Kher, along with comedian Kapil Sharma and singer Badshah, also expressed support for Mehndi. Mika has since sought an apology from the minister for allegedly insulting his brother.

title: Mahhi Vij says she refused to take alimony from Jay Bhanushali despite judge urging her to reconsider: ‘It’s his hard-earned money’ | Hindustan Times
description: Mahhi Vij said she declined alimony despite a judge urging her to reconsider, explaining that Jay Bhanushali had worked hard for his money.
content: Television actor Mahhi Vij broke down emotionally on Bigg Boss 20 after a fresh confrontation with Arishfa Khan. During the episode, Mahhi spoke about the challenges of single motherhood and revealed why she chose not to accept alimony or maintenance from her estranged husband, Jay Bhanushali. The actors announced their separation in January this year but continue to co-parent their daughter, Tara.The tension began after Gullu, Kanika and Mahhi compromised Arishfa’s lifeline. In retaliation, Arishfa threw water on their bed, triggering a heated argument. During the confrontation, Mahhi questioned Arishfa’s upbringing, leaving the influencer silent. Arishfa later broke down in front of Uditi Singh, questioning why Mahhi had brought her mother into the argument.Mahhi Vij talks about not taking alimony from Jay BhanushaliMahhi eventually realised that her remarks about Arishfa’s upbringing were inappropriate and apologised to her. However, during an argument in the latest episode, Arishfa brought up the incident again and called Mahhi “cheap” for her comments about her mother. Mahhi became emotional and broke down in tears.Speaking to Aasif Khan and Yung, Mahhi said, “Arishfa is such a liar. I want to speak to her as I talk to my daughter Tara, but she is very disrespectful. That day, I felt bad about what I told her. I am a single mother and only I know how I survive every day. Jay pushes me to step out; he says I am at home around Tara all the time, and he also offers to look after Tara. But my life revolves around her. She added, “I didn’t take a single penny in alimony or even ask for maintenance. I’m here on my merit, only so that my daughter’s life is secured. It’s not like Jay doesn’t offer to help, but I cannot ask for money from someone. It’s his hard-earned money. When I was standing in court, the judge asked me four times to reconsider not taking alimony or even maintenance. He insisted that I take it. I didn’t take it because Jay earned that money after working very hard. Not that he will refuse me for anything… his entire locker is open for me. But it’s his efforts; he stood for 16 hours at work and earned that.”About Jay Bhanushali and Mahhi Vij’s separationTelevision actors Jay Bhanushali and Mahhi Vij announced their separation on January 4, 2026, ending their 14-year marriage. The couple, who married in November 2011, confirmed their decision in a joint statement on social media. They said they had mutually decided to part ways, adding that there was no villain in their story and that they wanted to move forward with mutual respect and without bitterness. They also pledged to continue co-parenting their three children: their biological daughter, Tara, born in 2019, and their foster children, Khushi and Rajveer, whom they welcomed into their family in 2017.The announcement followed months of speculation about trouble in their marriage. Before confirming their separation, Mahhi had dismissed reports claiming she was seeking ₹5 crore in alimony from Jay, urging people not to believe unverified reports about their personal lives.

title: బ్లింకిట్ జోరు.. 'ఎటర్నల్' రాబడి 78% జంప్: లాభంలో మాత్రం షాక్ | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: ఎటర్నల్ సంస్థ క్యూ2 ఫలితాల్లో రెవెన్యూ 78 శాతం పెరిగి రూ.24,138 కోట్లకు చేరింది. బ్లింకిట్ వ్యాపారం భారీగా పుంజుకున్నప్పటికీ, విస్తరణ వ్యయాలు పెరగడంతో నికర లాభం అంచనాలను అందుకోలేకపోయింది. సంస్థ సరికొత్తగా 'dark.ai' అనే ఏఐ అసిస్టెంట్‌ను కూడా ప్రకటించింది.
content: ఎటర్నల్ (Zomato మాతృసంస్థ) త్రైమాసిక ఫలితాల ప్రకటనతో మరోసారి వార్తల్లో నిలిచింది. సెప్టెంబర్ త్రైమాసిక (Q2FY27) ఆర్ధిక ఫలితాలను వెల్లడించిన సంస్థ, తన అద్భుతమైన రాబడితో ఆకట్టుకున్నప్పటికీ, నికర లాభం విషయంలో విశ్లేషకుల అంచనాలను అందుకోలేకపోయింది. ఇదే సమయంలో వినియోగదారుల గోప్యతకు ప్రాధాన్యమిచ్చే 'dark.ai' అనే ఏఐ అసిస్టెంట్‌ను ప్రారంభించబోతున్నట్లు ప్రకటించి మార్కెట్ వర్గాల దృష్టిని ఆకర్షించింది. ఎండ్-టు-ఎండ్ ఎన్‌క్రిప్షన్‌తో, స్వంత ఇన్‌ఫ్రాస్ట్రక్చర్‌పై పనిచేసే ఈ ఏఐ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్ భవిష్యత్తులో కంపెనీకి ఎంతవరకు ఉపయోగపడుతుందో వేచి చూడాలని జెఫరీస్ ఇండియా నిపుణులు అభిప్రాయపడ్డారు.కీలక ఆదాయం ఒకే.. లాభంలోనే నిరాశఎటర్నల్ ఆర్థిక ఫలితాలను పరిశీలిస్తే, కార్యకలాపాల ద్వారా వచ్చిన ఆదాయం నిరుటితో పోలిస్తే ఏకంగా 78 శాతం పెరిగి రూ. 24,138 కోట్లకు చేరింది. అయితే నికర లాభం మాత్రం రూ.125 కోట్లుగా నమోదైంది. గత ఏడాదితో పోలిస్తే ఇది దాదాపు రెట్టింపు అయినప్పటికీ, విశ్లేషకులు భావించిన రూ.250 కోట్ల నుంచి రూ.300 కోట్ల అంచనాలను అందుకోవడంలో విఫలమైంది. బ్లింకిట్ వేగవంతమైన విస్తరణ వల్ల తరుగుదల (Depreciation) వ్యయం పెరగడం, అధిక పన్ను రేట్లు లాభాలపై ప్రభావం చూపాయి.దూసుకుపోతున్న బ్లింకిట్.. వ్యాపార విస్తరణ వేగవంతంకంపెనీ మొత్తం రాబడిలో దాదాపు 80 శాతం వాటా క్విక్ కామర్స్ విభాగమైన 'బ్లింకిట్' నుంచే వస్తుండటం గమనార్హం. బ్లింకిట్ ఆదాయం ఏటా 94 శాతం వృద్ధితో రూ.19,152 కోట్లకు చేరింది. గత ఏడాది నష్టాల్లో ఉన్న అడ్జస్టెడ్ ఎబిటా (Adjusted Ebitda) ఈసారి రూ.184 కోట్ల లాభంలోకి వచ్చింది. మార్జిన్లు వరుసగా ఆరో త్రైమాసికంలోనూ మెరుగుపడ్డాయి.చిన్న నగరాల్లోనూ బ్లింకిట్ సేవలకు విశేష ఆదరణ లభిస్తోందని, నిత్యం వెయ్యి ఆర్డర్లతో మెట్రో నగరాలకు సమానంగా పుంజుకుంటున్నాయని యాజమాన్యం ధీమా వ్యక్తం చేసింది. ఈ క్రమంలోనే మార్చి 2027 నాటికి డార్క్ స్టోర్ల లక్ష్యాన్ని గతంలో అనుకున్న 3,000 నుంచి 3,500కు పెంచారు. గత త్రైమాసికంలోనే కొత్తగా 308 స్టోర్లను ప్రారంభించడంతో ప్రస్తుతం మొత్తం స్టోర్ల సంఖ్య 2,751కి చేరింది. మార్చి 2028 నాటికి 5,000 స్టోర్లను అందుబాటులోకి తేవడమే కంపెనీ లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకుంది.జొమాటో, ఇతర విభాగాలు ఎలా ఉన్నాయంటే?ఫుడ్ డెలివరీ వ్యాపారమైన జొమాటో నికర ఆర్డర్ల విలువ (NOV) 21.5 శాతం పెరిగి రూ.11,445 కోట్లకు చేరింది. రాబోయే రెండు ఏళ్లలో ఈ విభాగంలో కనీసం 20 శాతం వృద్ధి సాధించాలని కంపెనీ భావిస్తోంది. మరోవైపు బీ2బీ విభాగం 'హైపర్‌ప్యూర్' రాబడి 13 శాతం పెరిగి రూ.1,154 కోట్లకు చేరింది. ఈవెంట్లు, టికెటింగ్ విభాగమైన 'డిస్ట్రిక్ట్' రాబడి 61 శాతం పెరిగి రూ.304 కోట్లకు చేరినప్పటికీ, ఇంకా నష్టాల్లోనే కొనసాగుతోంది.భవిష్యత్తుపై విశ్లేషకుల అంచనాలుఒకవైపు తీవ్రమైన పోటీ, మరోవైపు నిరంతర పెట్టుబడులు కంపెనీ మార్జిన్లపై ఒత్తిడి పెంచే అవకాశం ఉందనే ఆందోళనలు వ్యక్తమవుతున్నాయి. "బిజినెస్ మొమెంటమ్ బాగున్నప్పటికీ, తీవ్రమైన పోటీ మధ్య చేస్తున్న అగ్రెసివ్ విస్తరణ, కొత్త ప్రాజెక్టుల్లో వస్తున్న నష్టాలు ఇన్వెస్టర్లు గమనించాల్సిన అంశాలు" అని డోలత్ క్యాపిటల్ వ్యాఖ్యానించింది. ప్రస్తుతం ఎటర్నల్ షేర్లు అధిక వాల్యుయేషన్‌లో ట్రేడ్ అవుతున్నందున, రాబోయే రోజుల్లో చేసే కొత్త పెట్టుబడులు అనుకున్నంత ఫలితాలు ఇవ్వకపోతే వ్యతిరేక ప్రభావం పడే అవకాశం ఉందని మార్కెట్ వర్గాలు హెచ్చరిస్తున్నాయి.

title: 28 years after killing brother-in-law in Maharashtra's Thane, man on the run held in Bihar | India News
description: The main accused, identified as Sandeep Krishnan, 55, was apprehended in Bihar on October 18 by a special GRP team. | India News
content: The Government Railway Police (GRP) have arrested a man who had been on the run for 28 years after allegedly murdering his brother-in-law over a divorce dispute and staging the crime scene to look like a train accident, officials said on Thursday.The main accused, identified as Sandeep Krishnan, 55, was apprehended in Bihar on October 18 by a special GRP team after being tracked through modern technical surveillance and data analysis.According to the railway police officials, the incident dates back to January 14, 1998, when the station master informed the Dombivli railway police about a body lying on the tracks between Dombivli and Kopar stations.After inspecting the scene, investigators grew suspicious as the nature of the injuries and the positioning of the body indicated a deliberate murder rather than a railway accident. The victim was subsequently identified as 22-year-old Shailesh More.Also Read: Mumbai influencer moves court seeking custody of ‘blue drum’ murder convict Muskan Rastogi’s 10-month-old daughterInvestigation brought to light that More and the accused individuals, who were known to each other, had consumed alcohol together before a dispute broke out over past grievances.The primary motive stemmed from resentment over the fact that the victim had divorced the sister of one of the accused, an official said.During the altercation, the perpetrators strangled More to death and subsequently placed his body on the railway tracks to destroy evidence, he said.Following the crime, the three co-accused went into hiding. Although the police had previously filed a chargesheet in court against the absconding suspects, they remained untraceable for nearly three decades.Also Read: 26-year-old stabbed to death over Garba event scuffle; 3 held, 2 minors detainedThe breakthrough came recently when a special team was formed under the guidance of senior police officials to track down long-pending wanted criminals from old cold cases. Utilizing Call Detail Records (CDR) and mobile tower location data, investigators successfully traced Krishnan to Bihar, the official said.A special police team was dispatched to Bihar, where they arrested the fugitive.Krishnan was then presented before a local court in Bihar, which granted a transit warrant. He was brought back to Dombivli, and was produced in a court, which sent him to two days of police custody.Efforts are still underway to track down the remaining accused involved in the case, the official added.

title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 becomes 4th highest-grossing Tamil film of all time before end of week 1; 2nd highest-grossing Indian film of 2026 | Hindustan Times
description: Nelson Dilipkumar's Jailer 2 with Rajinikanth opened to positive feedback and has since performed well at the box office worldwide.
content: Nelson Dilipkumar and Rajinikanth seem to have done it again with the sequel to their 2023 hit Jailer. While Jailer 2 has yet to beat its predecessor, the sequel has become the fourth-highest-grossing Tamil film of all time. It has beaten the lifetime collections of films such as Mani Ratnam’s Ponniyin Selvan I and Lokesh Kanagaraj’s Coolie to take the spot in just seven days. It also became the second-highest-grossing Indian film of 2026, having overtaken Drishyam: The Conclusion.(Also Read: Jailer 2)Jailer 2 becomes 2nd-highest-grossing film of 2026According to the trade website Sacnilk, Jailer 2 has registered a net domestic collection of ₹317.20 crore in India and a gross collection of ₹371.45 crore. Adding to that, the ₹205 crore from overseas brings the worldwide gross of the sequel to ₹576.45 crore before the end of its first week in theatres. It has now surpassed the 20-day haul of Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam: The Conclusion, which has brought in ₹560 crore so far, making it the second-highest-grossing Indian film of 2026. This means that Jailer 2 has surpassed the lifetime collection of Ponniyin Selvan I, which stands at ₹488.36 crore gross. It also surpassed Rajinikanth’s previous film Coolie’s ₹518 crore gross, becoming the fourth highest-grossing Tamil film. Jailer 2 banked on the Navaratri and Dussehra season, along with no competition for Rajinikanth from his counterparts. And it paid off, with the film maintaining steady momentum even on weekdays, with only a few days to go until the next weekend. Sun Pictures, the film's producers, reported a collection of ₹549 crore in one week, calling it the highest-grossing first-week collection in Tamil cinema. Rajinikanth has maintained the top spot in Kollywood for years now, with his 2018 sequel to Robo, 2.0, directed by Shankar, bringing in ₹691 crore during its run. Though the film was declared average, given its reported budget of over ₹500 crore, it has remained unbeatable for all these years. Vijay’s film Leo, with Lokesh in 2023, grossed ₹605.90 crore worldwide and ranked second. Jailer came close to it, bringing in ₹604.74 crore. About Jailer 2Jailer 2 is directed by Nelson and produced by Kalanithi Maran through Sun Pictures. Rajinikanth, Ramya Krishnan, Mirnaa and Rithvik reprised their roles for the sequel. SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Vidya Balan are the new additions to the cast. Jailer 2 picks up where the first film left off, with Rajinikanth’s retired jailer, Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, looking to keep his family safe from an idol smuggling ring. He also tries to hide the truth about his son’s death from them, risking getting exposed at any time.
