But if you continue to drink, the surgeon cautioned about the risk of alcohol-related hepatitis, which involves inflammation that may cause tiredness, nausea, loss of appetite and yellow of the skin.The best course of action for liver recovery is to stop drinking, irrespective of stage, as this can prevent further damage.When can liver damage be irreversible?Liver damage can become irreversible when cirrhosis develops. As the doctor explained, persistent inflammation can lead to fibrosis, where scar tissue gradually replaces healthy liver tissue. In some cases, this progresses to cirrhosis, which can permanently impair liver function.Can detox drinks and cleansing diets help?“The idea that a fast detox can fix an alcohol‑damaged liver is wrong,” the surgeon said, dispelling the notion that detox drinks can reverse liver damage caused by alcohol. Instead, recovery depends on how soon you stop drinking and the stage of liver damage.In fact, some can backfire. Commercial detox products and herbal supplements have been flagged by the surgeon for their potential to harm the liver, as some ingredients can cause liver injury.What helps with liver recovery?The surgeon's advice is to stop alcohol consumption and follow a balanced diet rich in protein, fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and healthy fats to support liver recovery. However, people who drink heavily or are dependent alcohol should seek doctor's help as often withdrawl can be tough to break through. Managing weight, diabetes, blood pressure, and cholesterol is also important. So, steer clear of any loud claims of detox products.Note to readers: This article is for informational purposes only and not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always seek the advice of your doctor with any questions about a medical condition.

title: The Paradise OTT Cuts: ఓటీటీలో మొదలైన  జడల్ జమానా.. కానీ ది ప్యారడైజ్ స్ట్రీమింగ్ లో ట్విస్ట్.. ఏ సీన్లు కట్ చేశారంటే? | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: The Paradise OTT Cuts: నాని ఫ్యాన్స్, ఓటీటీ లవర్స్ కు ఫుల్ కిక్ ఇస్తూ ది ప్యారడైజ్ మూవీ ఇవాళ ఓటీటీలోకి వచ్చేసింది. అయితే థియేటర్లో ప్యారడైజ్ చూసిన ఆడియన్స్.. ఓటీటీలో స్ట్రీమింగ్ అవుతున్న సినిమాలో కొన్ని మార్పులు చూసి షాక్ అవుతున్నారు. మరి ఓటీటీ కోసం మేకర్స్ ఏం ఛేంజ్ చేశారో ఇక్కడ చూసేయండి.
content: The Paradise OTT Cuts: నేచురల్ స్టార్ నాని, దర్శకుడు శ్రీకాంత్ ఓదెల కాంబినేషన్‌లో వచ్చిన రా అండ్ రస్టిక్ యాక్షన్ డ్రామా 'ది ప్యారడైజ్' ఇవాళ (అక్టోబర్ 22) ప్రముఖ ఓటీటీ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్ నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్‌లో డిజిటల్ ప్రీమియర్ అయింది. థియేటర్లలో విడుదలైన కేవలం నాలుగు వారాల్లోనే ఈ చిత్రం ఓటీటీ వీక్షకుల ముందుకు వచ్చేసింది.ది ప్యారడైజ్ ఓటీటీది ప్యారడైజ్ మూవీ ఓటీటీలోకి అడుగుపెట్టింది. పాపులర్ ఓటీటీ ప్లాట్ ఫామ్ నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్‌లో తెలుగుతో పాటు తమిళ్, కన్నడ, మలయాళం, హిందీ భాషల్లో ఈ సినిమా స్ట్రీమింగ్ అవుతోంది. అయితే, థియేట్రికల్ వెర్షన్‌తో పోలిస్తే ఓటీటీ వెర్షన్‌లో మేకర్స్ కొన్ని కీలక మార్పులు చేయడం ఇప్పుడు ఫిలిం సర్కిల్స్‌లో ఆసక్తికరంగా మారింది.ఓటీటీ కోసం మార్పులుఓటీటీ ఆడియన్స్ ను మరింత ఎంటర్ టైన్ చేయడం కోసం ది ప్యారడైజ్ ఓటీటీ వర్షన్ ను రెడీ చేశారు. ఈ మూవీ థియేటర్లో రిలీజ్ అయినప్పుడు ‘ధూమవతి’ ఫైట్ ఎపిసోడ్ పై ట్రోల్స్ వచ్చాయి. ఇప్పుడు ఓటీటీలో స్ట్రీమింగ్ అవుతున్న ప్యారడైజ్ మూవీలో ఈ ఫైట్ ఎపిసోడ్ ను ఎడిట్ చేశారు.ధూమవతి ఎపిసోడ్ లో వచ్చే హీరో తల్లి డ్యాన్స్ పార్ట్ మొత్తాన్ని డిలీట్ చేశారు. దీంతో మూవీ రన్ టైమ్ తగ్గింది. కానీ దాన్ని కవర్ చేసేందుకు ఎండ్ క్రెడిట్స్ స్పీడ్ ను తగ్గించారు. థియేటర్లో ఈ ఎండ్ క్రెడిట్స్ స్పీడ్ గా వెళ్లిపోయాయనే కామెంట్లు వినిపించాయి. ఇక ఓటీటీలోని ది ప్యారడైజ్ మూవీలో కొన్ని చోట్ల గ్రాఫిక్స్ ను కూడా బెటర్ చేశారు.రా అండ్ రస్టిక్పక్కింటి అబ్బాయిలా కనిపించే నాని ఒక్కసారిగా దసరా మూవీతో మాస్ మోడ్ లోకి వెళ్లిపోయారు. అందులో నానిని చూసి ఆడియన్స్ ఆశ్చర్యపోయారు. దసరా కోసం నానిని పూర్తిగా మార్చేసిన అదే డైరెక్టర్ శ్రీకాంత్ ఓదెల ఇప్పుడు ది ప్యారడైజ్ కోసం మరింత రా అండ్ రస్టిక్ గా మేకోవర్ చేశారు. నాని ఇంత రా అండ్ రస్టిక్ గా నటించడం అతని కెరీర్ లోనే ఇది ఫస్ట్ టైమ్.ది ప్యారడైజ్ మూవీలో నానికి జోడీగా కాయదు లోహర్ హీరోయిన్ గా నటించింది. ఇక అగ్ర నటుడు మోహన్ బాబు విలన్ క్యారెక్టర్లో అదరగొట్టాడు. రాఘవ్ జుయల్ కూడా సత్తాచాటాలి. ఈ సినిమా బాక్సాఫీస్ దగ్గర రూ.170 కోట్లకు పైగా కలెక్షన్లను ఖాతాలో వేసుకుంది.

title: Step inside Malavika Mohanan's stunning Kerala-style home in Mumbai with Athangudi tiles, Tanjore painting and 3 balconies | Hindustan Times
description: Actor Malavika Mohanan’s Mumbai apartment blends bold Athangudi-inspired red flooring with South Indian touches, including a Tanjore painting.
content: A striking red floor, traditional South Indian decor, and the simple elegance of a modern celebrity apartment define actor Malavika Mohanan's home in Mumbai. In an October 9 Instagram post shared by Architectural Digest India (AD), the actor unveiled gorgeous corners of her beautiful and vibrant abode. The pictures are from a tour AD did of the actor's home in October 2025.Also Read | Step inside 117-year-old Kolkata home with colonial architecture, antique furniture and a vintage car collection featuring a Ford MustangInside Malavika Mohanan's homeAccording to AD India, the actor's home is a perfect reflection of its resident: artistic, intellectual, and deeply proud of their heritage. The first thing one notices upon entering the space is the striking red flooring, designed to resemble Athangudi tiles—a staple in most South Indian homes. The actor wanted to bring a slice of her heritage into her space in Mumbai; therefore, she built the decor around her South Indian heritage. Talking about the red flooring, the actor told AD India, “This is one of my favourite features of the home. I think it’s a very interesting colour to have on the floor, and it’s very interesting to have the signature piece of your living room be the tiles.”Where tradition meets modern aestheticsApart from the tiles, the actor also included elements such as an intricate Tanjore painting—sourced by Malavika and her mother from a craftsman in Tanjore itself—and Malabar influences, evident in a traditional temple tucked into the corner of the living room, reminiscent of temples in Kerala. According to the actor, an intricately carved brass lamp, known as a ‘Vilakku’, also hangs beside the temple and has been in the family for almost 15 years.The bedrooms become a personal gallery for the actor, where she has displayed cherished family moments and personal milestones. The walk-in wardrobe is a treasure trove of style and culture, boasting a bespoke vanity and a stunning brass lamp sourced from Morocco's hidden gems.A majestic wooden-and-glass bookshelf adorned with a globe, whimsical animal figurines, and many books becomes a symbol of the actor's love for art and literature. While the living room Athangudi-inspired tiles, in the bedrooms, Malavika flips the script by incorporating blue and white textutred flooring to give a boho touch to her space.The balconyAnother highlight of the house is the three aesthetic balconies—a luxury in Mumbai; the actor has decorated one of them with plants, a plush wicker couch with purple upholstery, a vibrant painting, wooden flooring, and a centre table. The actor shared that she loves spending time there and it has also become an integral part of her morning routine.

title: The Paradise OTT release: 24 minutes cut from Nani's film, Sonali Kulkarni’s trolled dance scene removed and VFX upgraded on Netflix | Hindustan Times
description: While the action and scale drew attention, viewers also questioned the lengthy second half, the violence and some of its creative decisions.
content: Nani’s The Paradise has arrived on the streaming service with a few changes, this time on Netflix. The Telugu action drama, directed by Srikanth Odela, is now available in a shorter version. The changes come after the film faced criticism following its theatrical release. While the action and scale drew attention, viewers also questioned the lengthy second half, the violence and some of its creative decisions. The Netflix version appears to have reworked parts of the film in response to that reception.What changes have been made on OTTThe film on Netflix is running for around 2 hours and 30 minutes instead of its original theatrical runtime of 2 hours and 54 minutes. One of the biggest changes in the streaming version is the removal of a dance segment featuring Sonali Kulkarni’s character, Dhumavathi. In the theatrical cut, the sequence appeared during a fight scene and quickly became a talking point online, with viewers turning it into a meme. The scene was among the film’s most criticised moments, with many questioning why the dance was included in the middle of an action sequence.Several reactions to the theatrical release pointed to a loss of momentum after the interval, with extended action scenes making the film feel longer than necessary. VFX gets an upgrade, end credits move slowerThe Netflix version reportedly features improved visual effects in some sequences, addressing criticism of certain shots in the theatrical release. The end credits have also been slowed down. Viewers had complained that they moved too quickly to read in theatres, and the revised version gives them more time to go through the names.Netflix India hinted at the revised release on X, formerly Twitter, with the post: “This Paradise is under construction & revolution 😎🐦‍⬛.”What Nani said earlierSpeaking to The Hollywood Reporter India, Nani addressed the mixed reactions to The Paradise and said he could understand where the criticism was coming from. The actor explained that the people closest to him have always been honest about his work, regardless of how well a film performs. "I'm not from a cinema background. The people I'm surrounded with are extremely honest to me. There's no filter at all," he said.Nani added that even his successful films have faced blunt feedback from friends and family: “My friends and family would say, 'We don't want to watch that film, we didn't like it at all...' So I was always very close to reality… I've always watched films in the theatre; I know that I am one among the audience. I don't think the audience is a separate entity. I always feel that if I like it, they would like it too... I'm one of them.” The Paradise’s box office run and castThe Paradise was one of the major Telugu releases of 2026, bringing Nani back together with director Srikanth Odela after their earlier success with Dasara. Produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri under the SLV Cinemas banner, the film also stars Kayadu Lohar, Mohan Babu, Sonali Kulkarni, Raghav Juyal and Priyadarshi.The film made a strong start, reportedly collecting ₹76 crore worldwide on its opening day. However, the initial momentum did not last, and its collections dropped over the following days. It eventually finished its theatrical run with an estimated worldwide gross of ₹173.35 crore. The Paradise started streaming on Netflix on October 22. It is available in Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Kannada and Malayalam, with 4K Dolby Vision support.

title: Keralam to form panel with trade union representatives to examine labour codes | Hindustan Times
description: Keralam to form panel with trade union representatives to examine labour codes
content: Thiruvananthapuram, The Keralam government has decided to constitute a special committee, including trade union representatives, to examine issues related to the implementation of labour codes and submit its report within 10 days.The new labour codes by the Union government came into force in November 2025, and the Keralam government maintained that it would implement them only after a detailed scrutiny.The decision was taken at a meeting chaired by Chief Minister V D Satheesan at the Secretariat in the presence of Labour Minister Bindu Krishna. Representatives of 22 trade unions attended the meeting."The committee will examine the issues in detail and submit practical suggestions for framing state rules in line with the labour codes. The Labour Department Secretary will be the convenor, while the Law Department Additional Secretary will be a member, a Chief Minister's Office release said on Thursday.The panel will also include seven representatives from various trade unions and officials of the Labour Department.The committee has been asked to submit its report within 10 days of its formation.Satheesan said a final decision on implementing the labour codes would be taken only after hearing the views of all stakeholders and examining the legal aspects."Within the limits of the law, the government will take steps to minimise the impact of the labour codes and protect workers' interests," he said, adding that the labour rules framed by Keralam should serve as a model for the country.The meeting also decided to bring to the attention of the Centre concerns over the threshold prescribed for defining workers under the labour codes and demand a reduction in the limit, the release said.The CM assured the trade unions that the state government was committed to protecting workers' rights and interests and would take all necessary measures in this regard, it said."Trade unions will be given an opportunity to suggest amendments to the draft prepared in 2021. The special committee's draft recommendations will be shared with all trade unions, while other unions will also be allowed to attend the committee's sittings and submit their views and suggestions," the release said.All trade unions that attended the meeting took a common position on the need to protect workers' interests, the release said.The final state rules under the labour codes will be prepared and published based on the committee's report and the suggestions submitted by trade unions, it added.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

title: APPSC : థానేదార్, లెక్చరర్ పోస్టులకు ఎంపికైన అభ్యర్థుల జాబితా విడుదల | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: APPSC : థానేదార్, లెక్చరర్ పోస్టులకు తాత్కాలికంగా ఎంపికైన అభ్యర్థుల జాబితాను ఏపీపీఎస్సీ విడుదల చేసింది. అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో వీటిని చూసుకోవచ్చు.
content: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ పబ్లిక్ సర్వీస్ కమిషన్(APPSC) ఏపీ ఫారెస్ట్ సబార్డినేట్ సర్వీస్‌లోని థానేదార్ పోస్టులకు సంబంధించి వాకింగ్ టెస్ట్, వైద్య పరీక్షలకు తాత్కాలికంగా అర్హత సాధించిన అభ్యర్థుల జాబితాను విడుదల చేసింది. అదేవిధంగా ప్రభుత్వ డిగ్రీ కళాశాలల్లోని లెక్చరర్ పోస్టులకు సంబంధించి మూడు సబ్జెక్టులకు సంబంధించిన తాత్కాలిక ఎంపిక ఫలితాలను కూడా ప్రకటించింది.కమిషన్ విడుదల చేసిన ప్రకటన ప్రకారం సెప్టెంబర్ 9, 2025 నాటి నోటిఫికేషన్ నంబర్ 13/2025 ద్వారా చేపట్టిన థానేదార్ నియామక ప్రక్రియలో, తదుపరి దశకు తాత్కాలికంగా ఎంపికైన అభ్యర్థుల జాబితాను అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్ https://psc.ap.gov.in లో అందుబాటులో ఉంచారు.ఫిబ్రవరి 9, 2026న (ఉదయం, మధ్యాహ్నం సెషన్లలో), ఫిబ్రవరి 10, 2026న (మధ్యాహ్నం సెషన్‌లో) ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లోని ఉమ్మడి 13 జిల్లాల్లో నిర్వహించిన రాత పరీక్షలో అభ్యర్థులు సాధించిన మెరిట్ ఆధారంగా వీరిని ఎంపిక చేశారు. వాకింగ్ టెస్ట్, వైద్య పరీక్షలకు సంబంధించిన తేదీలు, సమయాలు, వేదికల వివరాలను అర్హులైన అభ్యర్థులకు విడిగా తెలియజేస్తామని ఏపీపీఎస్సీ పేర్కొంది.మరో ప్రకటనలో డిసెంబర్ 30, 2023 నాటి నోటిఫికేషన్ నంబర్ 17/2023 ద్వారా చేపట్టిన ఏపీ కాలేజియేట్ ఎడ్యుకేషన్ సర్వీస్ (జనరల్ రిక్రూట్‌మెంట్) పరిధిలోని ప్రభుత్వ డిగ్రీ కళాశాలల లెక్చరర్ పోస్టులకు ఎంపికైన అభ్యర్థుల జాబితాను ఏపీపీఎస్సీ విడుదల చేసింది.కామర్స్, హిస్టరీ, పొలిటికల్ సైన్స్ అనే మూడు సబ్జెక్టులకు సంబంధించిన తాత్కాలిక ఎంపిక జాబితాలు కమిషన్ అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో అందుబాటులో ఉన్నాయి. మిగిలిన రెండు సబ్జెక్టులకు సంబంధించిన ఫలితాలను త్వరలోనే ప్రకటిస్తామని కమిషన్ తెలిపింది.అభ్యర్థులు తాజా జాబితాలను చూసేందుకు, నియామక ప్రక్రియలకు సంబంధించిన మరిన్ని వివరాల కోసం APPSC అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌ను సందర్శించాలని అధికారులు సూచించారు.ఈ లింక్ క్లిక్ చేసి జాబితాను చూడండి.

title: Delhi content creator Amir Shokeen under fire over racial abuse of Tripura youth, Union minister vows action: 'This evil man' | India News
description: The content creator allegedly calls the youth “Chinese" and compares his appearance to pop star Michael Jackson and “Chinese President”. | India News
content: Union parliamentary affairs minister Kiren Rijiju on Wednesday condemned the alleged racial abuse of a youth from Tripura by a Delhi-based content creator after videos surfaced on social media. Rijiju said the police would teach the “evil man” a "hard lesson".The content creator, Amir Shokeen, later shared videos on Instagram apologising for the incident. He claimed that it was a scripted performance and that the youth featured in it was a “known person”.ALSO READ | In South Delhi, racial abuse didn't come from strangers. It came from my neighboursThe Delhi Police's Intelligence Fusion and Strategic Operations (IFSO) unit will probe the incident, officials told news agency PTI. The Special Police Unit for North Eastern Region (SPUNER) has sent a formal request to the IFSO unit to investigate the video, they added.What was the video about?In the video, Shokeen is heard making offensive comments about the youth's appearance and regional identity after learning that he is from Tripura. HT could not independently establish when or where the incident occurred.The content creator allegedly calls the youth “Chinese" and compares his appearance to pop star Michael Jackson and Chinese President Xi Jinping, and makes fun of Tripura's name. The video also shows Shokeen making offensive gestures and touching the youth inappropriately while portraying the interaction as online comedy.Union minister, Tripura CM vow actionIn a post on X, Rijiju said there was a delay in filing an official complaint but vowed that the accused would face action."This evil man will be punished. There was a delay in lodging the official complaint, but Delhi Police and Tripura Police will teach him a hard lesson," he said."People who tolerate such wicked behaviour in society are also responsible for the spread of hatred," the minister added.Tripura chief minister Manik Saha asked the state's Director General of Police (DGP) to coordinate with the Delhi Police over the incident. "CM Manik Saha has directed DGP Tripura to coordinate with Delhi Police over derogatory remarks made by a content creator against a young man from the state. Law will take its course of action," the chief minister's office (CMO) said in a post on X.Leader of the opposition (LoP) in the Tripura assembly, CPI(M)’s Jitendra Chaudhury also urged the Delhi Police to take immediate action against the content creator. "Arrest him. Prosecute him to the fullest extent of the law. Make an example so loud and so clear that no one ever dares to insult Tripura and the Tiprasa ever again," Chaudhury said.The Tripura Students Forum Delhi (TSFD) has also filed a complaint with the Delhi Police, seeking an FIR and an immediate investigation into the incident.Content creator apologises, says video was ‘staged’Following heavy backlash, Shokeen uploaded two videos on Instagram to apologise for the incident. He said that it was a scripted performance. “The video was scripted. The person shown in the video is known to us. It was supposed to be a funny video. And you must have seen in it that the guy is also making fun of me. I am sorry for that. I had no intention of saying anything wrong about anyone. If anyone feels bad, I am sorry for that,” he said in the video. In a second video posted on Thursday, Shokeen said, “I am apologising with folded hands. Please forgive me for this. I have small children to support. I am ready to apologise in every way. I had no intention of doing anything wrong.”With inputs from agencies

title: US visa wait times for Indians rise; Mumbai, Delhi see longest visitor visa appointment delays | Hindustan Times
description: The latest US visa tracker lists student and exchange visa waits of one month in Hyderabad and four months in Mumbai.
content: The US Department of State has updated visa interview wait times for Indian applicants, providing the latest estimates for visitor, student, work-related and crew and transit visa categories across five consular posts in India.According to the department’s Global Visa Wait Times tracker, updated on October 21, applicants seeking B1/B2 visitor visas can expect the next available interview appointment in seven and a half to 12 months, depending on the consulate. The estimates also show differences in appointment availability for students, exchange visitors and applicants seeking petition-based visas.The official tracker covers Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai and New Delhi. It provides both the average wait for visitor visa interviews during the previous month and the estimated time until the next available appointment.Also Read: US launches nationwide operation targeting undocumented immigrants accused of SNAP fraudUS visa wait times across five Indian consulatesThe following are the latest figures published by the US State Department for applicants requiring an interview. Visitor visa appointments: What the latest data showsFor B1/B2 visitor visas, Mumbai has the longest estimated wait for the next available appointment, at 12 months. New Delhi follows at 11 months, while Hyderabad lists 10.5 months. The estimated wait is 8.5 months in Kolkata and 7.5 months in Chennai.The average wait times recorded during the previous month differ from current appointment estimates in some locations. In New Delhi, for instance, the average wait was seven months, while the next available appointment is estimated to be 11 months away. Mumbai's average was 12.5 months, compared with 12 months for the next available appointment.Also Read: US secures $5 million settlement after Instacart accused of favoring visa holders over American workersThe department says these figures measure different things: the average wait reflects the period from fee payment to interview for applicants who attended interviews during the previous month, while the next available appointment is a current estimate.Student and work visa timelinesFor F, M and J student and exchange visas, Hyderabad has the shortest estimated wait among the five posts, at one month. Kolkata lists 2.5 months, New Delhi three months, Chennai 3.5 months and Mumbai four months.For petition-based categories, which include H, L, O, P and Q visas, Hyderabad has the longest estimated wait at 6.5 months. New Delhi lists 3.5 months, Chennai 2.5 months, Mumbai two months and Kolkata one month.For crew and transit visas, Hyderabad lists less than half a month, followed by Mumbai at 1.5 months and New Delhi at three months. The tracker does not provide estimates for Chennai and Kolkata in this category.How applicants can check for earlier appointmentsThe State Department says embassies and consulates release additional appointment slots regularly. Applicants who have already scheduled an interview can check the appointment system for earlier openings and reschedule if a suitable slot becomes available.The department cautions that wait-time estimates do not guarantee an appointment within a specific period. The published figures also do not include appointments for applicants eligible for an interview waiver. Applicants should consult the official tracker and the relevant embassy or consulate website for the latest information.

title: Mumbai influencer moves court seeking custody of ‘blue drum’ murder convict Muskan Rastogi’s 10-month-old daughter | Hindustan Times
description: The ‘Blue Drum’ murder case found Muskan and her extramarital partner at the time, Sahil Shukla, guilty of killing her husband Saurabh Rajput.
content: A Mumbai-based influencer has filed an application in a Meerut district court seeking to take care of and provide for the 10-month-old daughter of Muskan Rastogi, a convict in Uttar Pradesh's infamous ‘Blue Drum’ murder case.The court found Muskan Rastogi and her then extramarital partner, Sahil Shukla, guilty of murdering her husband, Saurabh Rajput, and concealing his dismembered body in a blue drum. Both were convicted by a Meerut court on September 30 this year and have now been sentenced to death.Also Read I No one is above the law in 'new Uttar Pradesh': AdityanathMumbai-based influencer seeks child custodyFaizan Ansari, an influencer by profession, moved to court on Wednesday seeking permission to take up the education and upbringing of Rastogi's 10-month-old daughter with Shukla named Mannat, alias Radha who was born during the term of her mother's imprisonment, as per a PTI report.To support his plea, Ansari has left the assessment of his financial capacity to the authorities, expressing his willingness to abide by their determination of the expenses required for the infant’s education, healthcare and marriage. Rajput's mother Renu Devi reportedly refused to take up care of the child. District Government Counsel KK Chaubey stated that any decision involving the child would have to take into account her mother's wishes and applicable legal provisions.Chaubey remarked that a proposal to provide financial assistance to the child through the administration could be considered under the prescribed procedure, clarifying that merely filing an application in court did not confer any right to the child's custody or guardianship, according to PTI.The ‘Blue drum’ murder caseRastogi and Shukla were jointly convicted in the 2025 murder of the former's husband after his body was recovered from a large blue plastic storage container, leading to the case being dubbed as "the blue drum murder".Rajput, a merchant navy officer, was killed on March 3, 2025, and his body was recovered two weeks later, in a case that made national headlines. According to the police probe, Rajput had brought ‘kofta’ curry from his mother Renu Devi’s house on the night of the murder. Rastogi allegedly laced the food with a sedative, as previously reported by HT. After Rajput became unconscious, Shukla was allegedly called to the house.Police said Rajput was subsequently murdered and his body dismembered in the washroom. The convicts allegedly first attempted to place the body in a briefcase, but abandoned the plan after its hook broke. The body was then placed in a bed before being concealed in the blue drum.Also Read I Woman, partner sentenced to death in ‘blue drum’ murder caseCops questioned the cab driver in whose vehicle Rastogi and Shukla reportedly travelled after the crime. Investigators also collected statements and CCTV footage from the hotel where the two were said to have stayed. Call detail records, mobile phone location data, hotel registers and forensic reports were also examined.The case came to light after Rajput’s brother, Bablu, lodged a missing-person complaint on March 18, 2025, expressing suspicion about Rastogi and Shukla. According to investigating officer Ramakant Pachauri, then station house officer of Brahmpuri police station, police registered an FIR and began investigating Rajput’s disappearance.District judge Arvind Kumar Mishra pronounced the verdict last week after 126 hearings in a 13-month trial, court officials said. Both convicts were sentenced to death.

title: Yogi congratulates Swati Chaudhary on Asian Para Games archery silver | Hindustan Times
description: Swati Chaudhary’s silver medal in the women’s W1 archery event at the Asian Para Games 2026 has drawn congratulations from Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath.
content: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath congratulated Swati Chaudhary for winning the silver medal in the women’s W1 archery event at the Asian Para Games 2026, saying her achievement would inspire young people across the country to pursue their ambitions.In a post on social media platform X, Adityanath described Chaudhary’s performance as a historic achievement and said the state was proud of her. He also wished her a bright future.The congratulatory message came alongside the state government’s emphasis on expanding sports infrastructure, training facilities and career opportunities for athletes. According to the information shared by the state government, initiatives under the Yogi Adityanath-led administration aim to support players from training and competition to financial rewards and government employment.Under the One District, One Sport initiative, Khelo India Centres have been approved in all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh. These centres are intended to provide local sporting talent with coaching, sports kits and necessary equipment.The state also operates five sports colleges in Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Saifai, Fatehpur and Saharanpur. They provide training in 14 sports, alongside free accommodation, meals and education. The establishment of the Major Dhyan Chand Sports University in Meerut is another initiative aimed at strengthening sports education and advanced training.The state has also announced reward provisions for athletes achieving major results at international competitions. Individual Olympic gold medallists are eligible for ₹6 crore, silver medallists for ₹4 crore and bronze medallists for ₹2 crore. The Laxman and Rani Laxmi Bai awards recognise outstanding sporting performances.The government has also provided for appointments to gazetted posts for international medal winners, while work to expand village playgrounds and build international cricket stadiums in Gorakhpur and Varanasi is expected to add to the state’s sports infrastructure.The Sports Policy 2023 focuses on identifying talent, improving training and linking sporting achievement with employment opportunities. Chaudhary’s medal has brought attention to the achievements of athletes from Uttar Pradesh and the opportunities available to aspiring sportspersons.

title: OTT Friday Release: ఓటీటీలో ఫ్రైడే ధమాకా-రేపు ఒక్కరోజే చూడాల్సిన టాప్ 7 సినిమాలు- కీర్తి సురేష్ టు వరలక్ష్మి శరత్ కుమార్ | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Top 7 OTT Friday Releases: ఓటీటీలోకి అక్టోబర్ 23 శుక్రవారం సరికొత్త 7 సినిమాలు రిలీజ్ కానున్నాయి. నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్, ప్రైమ్ వీడియో, జీ5, హాట్‌స్టార్‌లలో క్రైమ్ థ్రిల్లర్ల నుంచి టైమ్-లూప్ కామెడీల వరకు అలరించేందుకు వస్తున్న టాప్ 7 ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ క్రేజీ సినిమాలు, వెబ్ సిరీస్‌ల పూర్తి వివరాలు ఇక్కడ చూడండి.
content: OTT Release Movies Friday: ఈ వారాంతంలో ఓటీటీ వినోద ప్రియులకు పండగే అని చెప్పాలి. విభిన్న కథాంశాలతో రూపొందిన సినిమాలు, వెబ్ సిరీస్‌లు ఒక్క అక్టోబర్ 23 శుక్రవారం నుంచి ప్రముఖ ఓటీటీల్లో స్ట్రీమింగ్‌కు సిద్ధమయ్యాయి.రేపు ఒక్కరోజే 7 ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ సినిమాలుహాలీవుడ్ స్థాయి యాక్షన్, సైకలాజికల్ థ్రిల్లర్లు, టైమ్ లూప్ కామెడీలు, స్ఫూర్తిదాయక బయోపిక్‌లు ప్రేక్షకులను అలరించేందుకు రేపు టాప్ 7 ఓటీటీ ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ సినిమాలు వరుస కడుతున్నాయి. కీర్తి సురేష్, వరలక్ష్మి శరత్‌కుమార్, మనోజ్ బాజ్‌పాయ్ నటించిన సినిమాలు ఈ వీకెండ్‌కే ప్రత్యేక ఆకర్షణగా నిలవనున్నాయి.కార్తీక్ సుబ్బరాజు డ్రామా 'డోరతి' - నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్కోలీవుడ్ వర్సటైల్ దర్శకుడు కార్తీక్ సుబ్బరాజు తెరకెక్కించిన తమిళ పీరియాడికల్ డ్రామా 'డోరతి' నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్ వేదికగా రేపు ఓటీటీ రిలీజ్ అవుతోంది. 1980ల నేపథ్యంతో సాగే ఈ కథలో విజిల్‌ వీరయ్య అనుచరులుగా పెరిగిన సుబ్బు, కార్తీ అనే ఇద్దరు చిన్ననాటి మిత్రుల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపించారు. సుబ్బు వదిన డోరతీ అనుమానాస్పద స్థితిలో మరణించడంతో కథ ఊహించని మలుపు తిరుగుతుంది. సుబ్బు తన జెండర్ ఐడెంటిటీని బయటపెట్టడంతో కుటుంబం ఆమెను వెలేస్తుంది. సుబ్బును అంతమొందించే బాధ్యతను వీరయ్య కార్తీకి అప్పగిస్తాడు. ప్రయాణంలో కార్తీకి కలిగే భావోద్వేగాలు, ఆంతరంగిక మథనం ఈ సినిమాకు ప్రధాన బలం. కీర్తి సురేష్, సనంత్, రిషికాంత్, రామచంద్రన్ దురైరాజ్ కీలక పాత్రలు పోషించారు.మనోజ్ బాజ్‌పాయ్ 'గజబ్ రాత్'- నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్నటనకు మారుపేరైన మనోజ్ బాజ్‌పాయ్ ప్రధాన పాత్రలో నటించిన ఇన్వెస్టిగేటివ్ క్రైమ్ థ్రిల్లర్ 'గజబ్ రాత్'. ఢిల్లీ పోలీసు విభాగంలో లంచగొండి అధికారి అజయ్ దీక్షిత్ పాత్రలో మనోజ్ కనిపించనున్నారు. వేగంగా వెళ్తున్న కారు నుంచి తీవ్రంగా గాయపడిన ఒక మహిళను రోడ్డుపై పడేయడంతో అజయ్ జీవితం మలుపు తిరుగుతుంది. కేసు విచారణ క్రమంలో పెద్ద పెద్ద రాజకీయ, వ్యాపార దిగ్గజాల కుట్రలు బయటపడతాయి. డబ్బు సంపాదన ప్రాధాన్యమా లేక వృత్తి ధర్మం ముఖ్యామా అనే వైరుధ్యంలో అజయ్ తీసుకున్న నిర్ణయం ఏంటో నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్‌లో చూడాల్సిందే.వరలక్ష్మి 'సట్టముమ్ నీదియుమ్ 2' - జీ5చట్టం, న్యాయం మధ్య నలిగే వ్యవస్థాగత అవినీతిని ప్రశ్నిస్తూ రూపొందిన తమిళ లీగల్ డ్రామా 'సట్టముమ్ నీదియుమ్' రెండో సీజన్ జీ5లో ఓటీటీ స్ట్రీమింగ్ కానుంది. న్యాయవాది సుందరమూర్తి సమాజంలో బలీయమైన శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొంటూ చేసే పోరాటం ఈ సీజన్‌లో మరింత ఉత్కంఠగా సాగనుంది. పవర్, నైతికత మధ్య సాగే ఈ పోరాటంలో వరలక్ష్మి శరత్‌కుమార్, శరవణన్, లావణ్య, ప్రేమ్ కుమార్ కీలక పాత్రల్లో మెరిశారు.టైమ్ లూప్ కామెడీ 'ధూమకేతు' - నెట్‌ఫ్లిక్స్మలయాళంలో సరికొత్త కాన్సెప్ట్‌లతో వచ్చే సినిమాలు ఎప్పుడూ ఆకట్టుకుంటాయి. సుధి మ్యాడిసన్ దర్శకత్వంలో వచ్చిన 'ధూమకేతు' ఒక వినూత్న టైమ్-లూప్ డార్క్ కామెడీ. 36 ఏళ్ల కుట్టన్ పెళ్లి రోజే ముసుగు దొంగలు దాడి చేసి అతని ప్రాణాలు తీసి నవవధువును కిడ్నాప్ చేస్తారు. అయితే, ప్రతీసారి చనిపోగానే కుట్టన్ మళ్లీ ఉదయం పెళ్లి ఘడియల్లోనే కళ్లు తెరుస్తాడు. ఒక అరుదైన తోకచుక్కతో ముడిపడి ఉన్న ఈ మిస్టరీని ఛేదించేందుకు అతను పడే పాట్లు నవ్వులు పూయిస్తాయి. సజిన్ గోపు, నిఖిలా విమల్, గణపతి ప్రధాన పాత్రల్లో నటించారు.ది లెజెండ్ ఆఫ్ హనుమాన్ సీజన్ 7 - జియోహాట్‌స్టార్ప్రసిద్ధ యానిమేషన్ ఓటీటీ సిరీస్ 'ది లెజెండ్ ఆఫ్ హనుమాన్' ఏడో సీజన్ జియోహాట్‌స్టార్‌లో రేపటి నుంచి అందుబాటులోకి రానుంది. లంక యుద్ధంలో రావణాసురుడు అత్యంత శక్తివంతమైన రూపాన్ని ధరించడంతో పోరాటం తీవ్రరూపం దాల్చుతుంది. ధర్మ పరిరక్షణ కోసం హనుమంతుడు కాల ప్రయాణం చేస్తూ శ్రీరాముడి గతం ద్వారా మృత్యు లోకం నుంచి శక్తివంతమైన దివ్యాస్త్రాన్ని సాధించే ఘట్టాలు ఇందులో అద్భుతంగా ఆవిష్కరించారు.స్ఫూర్తిదాయక క్రీడా చిత్రం 'సుమో దీదీ' - జీ5భారతదేశపు మొదటి, ఏకైక మహిళా సుమో రెజ్లర్ హేతల్ దవే వాస్తవ జీవిత ఆధారంగా తెరకెక్కిన చిత్రం 'సుమో దీదీ'. మహిళల శరీరాకృతిపై సమాజంలో ఉండే అపోహలను పటాపంచలు చేస్తూ జపాన్‌లో కఠోర శిక్షణ పొంది జాతీయ స్థాయిలో గుర్తింపు సాధించిన హేతల్ పోరాట పటిమను ఈ చిత్రం కళ్లకు కడుతుంది. జీ5 ఓటీటీలో ఈ స్ఫూర్తిదాయక చిత్రం అందుబాటులోకి రానుంది.క్రైమ్ డ్రామా 'చార్ యార్' - ప్రైమ్ వీడియో2000ల ప్రారంభంలోని ముంబై మహానగరం నేపథ్యంలో సాగే నలుగురు స్నేహితుల కథే 'చార్ యార్'. జై, టోనీ, సాహిల్, సమీర్ అనే నలుగురు మధ్యతరగతి యువకులు తమ కలలను నిజం చేసుకునే క్రమంలో ఒక అత్యవసర నిర్ణయం వల్ల నేర ప్రపంచంలోకి అడుగుపెడతారు. గ్యాంగ్‌స్టర్లు, పోలీసుల మధ్య చిక్కుకున్న వారి స్నేహం ఎలాంటి మలుపులు తిరిగింది అనేది అమెజాన్ ప్రైమ్ వీడియోలో చూడవచ్చు.తెలుగులో 5 స్ట్రీమింగ్ఇలా రేపు ఒక్కరోజే టాప్ 7 ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ సినిమాలు ఓటీటీ రిలీజ్ కానున్నాయి. ఇందులో డోరతి, గజబ్ రాత్, ది లెజెండ్ ఆఫ్ హనుమాన్ సీజన్ 7, సట్టముమ్ నీదియుమ్ 2, ధూమకేతు వంటి ఐదు సినిమాలు తెలుగులో ఓటీటీ స్ట్రీమింగ్ అవనున్నాయి.

title: Trump administration appeals court order to restore green card lottery, seeks stay | Hindustan Times
description: The Trump administration has appealed a federal judge’s order requiring the State Department to reopen registration for the 2027 Diversity Visa lottery.
content: The Trump administration has filed an appeal against a federal judge's directive mandating that the State Department reinstate the 2027 Diversity Visa lottery and has concurrently requested that the judge suspend the directive pending the appellate review, as per Newsweek.U.S. District Judge Jinsook Ohta of the Southern District of California issued a preliminary injunction in response to litigation initiated by immigration law firm Red Eagle Law, L.C., instructing the department to restore the Diversity Visa Program commencing with its lottery registration phase.The initiative, frequently referred to as the green card lottery, allocates approximately 55,000 diversity visas annually to people from other nations that have experienced historically limited immigration rates to the United States.On October 19, the government submitted its notice of appeal, contesting Judge Ohta's preliminary injunction and associated orders. Additionally, the government filed a separate motion requesting that Judge Ohta suspend her injunction pending the resolution of the appeal.Also Read: Trump revokes over 300,000 visas: Here's what Indian nationals travelling to the US must knowDV-2027 entry process witnesses changesThe department disclosed in November 2025 its intention to implement modifications to the DV-2027 entry procedure and said that the registration commencement date would be communicated at the earliest feasible opportunity. However, the registration window remained unopened following the commencement of fiscal year 2027 on October 1, as documented in the court's decision. The judge determined that this circumstance constituted an effective termination of the program, as prospective applicants are unable to participate in the diversity visa lottery without prior enrollment in the registration system.“The State Department also offered no reason as to why the temporary postponement announced in November 2025 turned into an indefinite suspension extending into the start of fiscal year 2027,” Ohta wrote.Also Read: H-1B woes: Over 12,000 Indian tech workers return from US amid visa uncertainty and layoffs - Key details hereThe rationale behind the judge's injunction decisionOhta determined that Red Eagle Law satisfied the prerequisites for obtaining a preliminary injunction. She concluded that the law firm demonstrated a substantial likelihood of prevailing in its litigation, as the State Department failed to provide sufficient justification for converting an initial postponement of the 2027 lottery into an indefinite cessation of operations.The judge also mentioned that Red Eagle Law would experience a loss of clientele and financial revenue should the program continue to remain in a state of suspension, and that such losses would be irretrievable through litigation proceedings. The judge further noted that the reinstatement of the program would not impose an undue hardship upon the government and would advance the public interest by ensuring the State Department's adherence to applicable federal legislation.

title: Three months too short to submit stampede probe report, will strive to meet deadline: SIT head | Kolkata
description: Three months too short to submit stampede probe report, will strive to meet deadline: SIT head  | Kolkata News
content: Kolkata, Justice Anindita Roy Saraswati , who heads a special investigation team investigating the Durga Puja stampede in Kolkata, said on Thursday that three months was too short to submit the report, but the team would strive to meet the deadline.The October 17 stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata led to 19 deaths and left 25 people injured. The six-member special investigation team has been constituted in consultation with the Calcutta High Court to probe the cause of the incident and recommend measures to prevent such incidents in future."SIT members will meet soon to chalk out a roadmap for the investigation. We will visit the site to ascertain the cause of the incident," the retired judge told a vernacular news channel.About the three-month deadline set by the state government to submit its report, she said, "It is a short duration, but we will try our best to meet the deadline."According to the government, the SIT will examine the sequence of events leading to the stampede, including the circumstances that triggered the initial crowd surge, the number of people present at the venue and whether the gathering exceeded its assessed safe capacity.It will scrutinise CCTV footage, mobile phone clips, forensic findings, call records, police station and control room logs, medical records and other evidence related to the incident.The SIT will also examine the preparedness and response of the organisers, police, private security personnel, volunteers, ambulance services, hospitals, fire services and civic authorities.Besides the retired judge, the SIT comprises the principal secretary of the Disaster Management and Civil Defence Department, the director general and inspector general of police of the Special Task Force, a representative of the West Bengal Police chief not below the rank of additional director general, a representative of the Home and Hill Affairs Department not below the rank of joint secretary, and a representative of the National Disaster Response Force in Kolkata.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

title: Gold smuggling syndicate busted at Mumbai airport, gold worth  ₹3.47 crore seized; five nabbed | Mumbai news
description: Among the five arrested by the agency were two passengers, a third-party entity's employee and two recipients, DRI officials said.  | Mumbai news
content: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has busted an alleged gold smuggling syndicate by arresting five of its members and seizing 2.31 kilograms of smuggled gold, estimated at ₹3.47 crore, at Mumbai airport.Acting on a tip-off, the DRI's Mumbai unit conducted operations on Monday and Tuesday to foil the syndicate's smuggling bid through the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (CSMIA), officials said. Among the five arrested by the agency were two passengers, a third-party entity's employee and two recipients, DRI officials said."During the operation, DRI seized 2.317 kg of 24-carat foreign-origin gold bars, valued at around ₹3.47 crore, and apprehended the five persons involved in the smuggling network, " an officer said. Preliminary investigation has revealed the involvement of the accused in the clandestine movement and handling of the smuggled gold, the officer said.The arrests and the seizure of gold were effected under the provisions of the Customs Act. Further investigation is underway to trace the syndicate's wider network and identify other individuals involved in the smuggling syndicate, officials said."DRI remains committed to dismantling organised smuggling networks and curbing the illicit trade in foreign-origin gold through intelligence-led enforcement, " an officer said.Cocaine worth ₹1 crore seized, carrier arrestedIn a separate operation, the DRI 's Mumbai unit seized smuggled 190 grams of cocaine, worth ₹1 crore in the illicit market, allegedly from a Zambian national who arrived at the CSMIA from Sierra Leone, via Ethiopia, on Tuesday with the contraband.The accused had allegedly ingested the cocaine - filled capsules in a bid to smuggle the drug into India, DRI officials said.Acting on specific intelligence, DRI officers intercepted the female Zambian national who arrived at the Mumbai international airport from Freetown, Sierra Leone, via Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The DRI had information that the accused foreign passenger was a carrier of a narcotics trafficking network and was concealing a drug inside her body through ingestion, officials said.During a subsequent medical examination, the passenger expelled 11 capsules containing white powder. Tests confirmed the alleged presence of cocaine in the recovered substance. The contraband was seized, and the passenger was arrested under the provisions of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act.“The case highlights the persistent threat posed by international drug-trafficking networks exploiting air travel and human carriers to smuggle narcotic substances,” a DRI official said. Further investigation is underway to unravel the wider network and identify other persons involved in the smuggling bid, the official said.

title: తెలంగాణలో పడిపోతున్న భూగర్భ జలాలు.. ఇక్కడ ఏడాదిలోనే 6.85 మీటర్ల మేర పతనం | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: రాష్ట్రంలో భూగర్భ జలాలు అడుగంటిపోతున్నాయి. ఇక హైదరాబాద్‌లో లెక్కలు చూస్తే మాత్రం షాకింగ్‌గా ఉంది. ఇది ఇలాగే కంటిన్యూ అయితే చాలా ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కోవలసి రావొచ్చు.
content: తెలంగాణలో భూగర్భ జలాలు ఊహించని రీతిలో అడుగంటిపోతున్నాయి. గ్రేటర్ హైదరాబాద్ పరిధిలో గత ఏడాది అక్టోబర్ నాటితో పోలిస్తే, ఈ ఏడాది సెప్టెంబర్ నాటికి నగర పరిధిలోని ప్రధాన కార్పొరేషన్లలో నీటి మట్టాలు అత్యంత ప్రమాదకర స్థాయికి పడిపోయాయి. గతేడాది సెప్టెంబర్‌లో భూగర్భ జలాల సగటు లోతు 4.73 మీటర్లు ఉండగా ఈ ఏడాది సెప్టెంబర్ నాటికి అది ఏకంగా 11.58 మీటర్లకు పడిపోయింది. అంటే ఒక్క ఏడాది వ్యవధిలోనే సగటున 6.85 మీటర్ల మేర భూగర్భ జలాలు క్రమంగా క్షీణించాయి.ఎల్ నినో ప్రభావం, వర్షపాతంలో మార్పులు, నీటి వాడకం విపరీతంగా పెరగడమే ఈ పరిస్థితికి ప్రధాన కారణమని భూగర్భ జల వనరుల శాఖ సమర్పించిన నివేదిక స్పష్టం చేస్తోంది. హైదరాబాద్, రంగారెడ్డి, మేడ్చల్ మల్కాజిగిరి, సంగారెడ్డి జిల్లాల పరిధిలోని 46 మండలాల్లో భూగర్భ జల శాఖ నిర్వహించిన సర్వే ఆధారంగా అత్యంత తక్కువ, ఉత్తమ నీటి మట్టాలు ఉన్న ప్రాంతాల వివరాలు చూడండి.అత్యంత తీవ్రంగా నీటి మట్టాలు పడిపోయిన ప్రాంతాలు.. కూకట్‌పల్లి (మేడ్చల్): 20.67 మీటర్ల లోతు (అత్యంత దారుణంగా నీరు పడిపోయిన ప్రాంతం). హయాత్‌నగర్ (రంగారెడ్డి): 19.46 మీటర్ల లోతు, శంకర్ పల్లి (రంగారెడ్డి): 19.25 మీటర్ల లోతు, మేడిపల్లి (మేడ్చల్): 18.23 మీటర్ల లోతు, మల్కాజిగిరి (మేడ్చల్): 17.11 మీటర్లు పడిపోయాయి.భూగర్భ జలాలు మెరుగ్గా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలు చూసుకుంటే.. షేక్‌పేట్: 1.87 మీటర్లు, హిమాయత్‌నగర్: 2.90 మీటర్లు, అమీన్‌పూర్: 3.00 మీటర్లతో కాస్త మెరుగ్గా ఉన్నాయి.కొన్ని కీలక ప్రాంతాల్లో పీజోమీటర్ల ద్వారా నమోదు చేసిన గణాంకాల ప్రకారం భూగర్భ జలాలు అడుగుకి పడిపోయిన తీవ్రత వెల్లడవుతోంది. కూకట్‌పల్లి పరిధిలో ఎంఆర్‌ఓ ఆఫీస్ వద్ద 47.23 మీటర్లు, కేపీహెచ్‌బీలో 28.78 మీటర్లు, కూకట్‌పల్లిలో 23.38 మీటర్ల లోతుకు పడిపోయింది.హయాత్‌నగర్: ఆటోనగర్‌లో 37.71 మీటర్లు, హయాత్‌నగర్ సెంటర్‌లో 15.92 మీటర్లు, కుతుబుల్లాపూర్-2 లో 37 మీటర్లు, జీడిమెట్లలో 20.19 మీటర్లు, గాజులరామారంలో 23.24 మీటర్లు, చెంగిచర్ల సబ్‌స్టేషన్ వద్ద 25.70 మీటర్లు, మేడిపల్లి టౌన్‌లో 19.87 మీటర్లు భూగర్భ జలాలు పడిపోయాయి. అమీర్‌పేట్ ఎస్‌ఆర్ నగర్‌లో 19.77 మీటర్లు, ఎర్రగడ్డ చెస్ట్ హాస్పిటల్ వద్ద 13.81 మీటర్లుగా నమోదయ్యాయి.భూగర్భ జలాలు పడిపోవడం వల్ల ప్రజలు మరింత లోతైన బోర్‌వెల్లు తవ్వాల్సి వస్తుందని, ఇది భూగర్భ జలాలను మరింత వేగంగా ఖాళీ చేస్తుందని నిపుణులు చెబుతున్నారు. ఎండిపోయిన చెరువులు, సరస్సులను పునరుద్ధరించడం ద్వారా మాత్రమే నీటిమట్టాలను మళ్లీ పెంచవచ్చని పేర్కొన్నారు. మురుగునీటి శుద్ధి కేంద్రాల నుండి వచ్చే శుద్ధి చేసిన నీటిని చెరువుల్లోకి మళ్లించాలని సూచించారు. అలాగే మొక్కలకు ఉదయం, సాయంత్రం వేళల్లో నీళ్లు పోయడం, వాషింగ్ మెషీన్‌ను పూర్తి లోడ్‌తో రెండు మూడు రోజులకోసారి వాడటం వల్ల నీటి వృథాను అరికట్టవచ్చు.

title: 53-yr-old man unloading cargo in Mumbai dies as passing bus hits parked tempo door | Mumbai news
description: Police said the bus, operated by wet-lease contractor Mateshwari with BEST, was travelling from Majas depot towards Andheri on route 441/31.  | Mumbai news
content: A 53-year-old man was killed in Mumbai’s Majas area on Wednesday after a passing bus struck a parked tempo’s door, sending it swinging back into him as he unloaded cargo, police said on ThursdayPolice said the incident took place at 10:15am on October 21 near PMG Colony.The deceased has been identified as Farid Ahmad Shaikh. Police said the bus, operated by wet-lease contractor Mateshwari with BEST, was travelling from Majas depot towards Andheri on route 441/31.The bus driver told the police that the utility vehicle was parked on the left side of the road. Shaikh was unloading chickens and opened the vehicle’s rear door moments before the bus passed through.“The door struck the bus’s left rear corner before rebounding and hitting Shaikh, causing him to fall and sustain injuries. The bus driver initially continued ahead but stopped after passengers told him a person had been injured in the incident,” a BEST official said.Other workers also followed the bus and confronted the driver, who called the police helpline to report the incident. The two vehicles were taken to the MIDC police station. Police allowed the driver and conductor to leave, with instructions to keep the bus at Majas depot pending further action.Police received information later in the night that Shaikh had succumbed to his injuries and an accidental death report (ADR) had been registered. The driver has been booked for causing death due to negligence, dangerous driving and rash driving.

title: Bigg Boss Telugu 10: బిగ్ బాస్ తెలుగు 10లో మళ్లీ మిడ్ వీక్ ఎలిమినేషన్.. ఈ సారి ఆ కంటెస్టెంట్ ఔట్.. హౌస్ లో గ్రూప్ గేమ్! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Bigg Boss Telugu 10: బిగ్ బాస్ తెలుగు ఆడియన్స్ కోసం మరో ట్విస్ట్ రెడీ అయిందని తెలిసింది. ఈ 10వ సీజన్ ఫస్ట్ వీక్ లోనే మిడ్ వీక్ ఎలిమినేషన్ తో మేకర్స్ షాకిచ్చారు. ఇప్పుడు ఏడో వారంలోనూ మరోసారి మిడ్ వీక్ ఎలిమినేషన్ కచ్చితంగా జరుగుతుందని టాక్. మరి ఈ సారి ఎవరు బయటకు వెళ్తారు? అనేది చూద్దాం.
content: Bigg Boss Telugu 10: బిగ్ బాస్ 10 తెలుగు సీజన్ ఇప్పుడు ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ గానే సాగుతోంది. శాలిని సీక్రెట్ రూమ్ నుంచి రావడం, గోట్ (G.O.A.T) అవతారం అంటూ బిగ్ బాస్ హడావుడి చేయడం ఆడియన్స్ ను ఆకట్టుకుంటోంది. అయితే ఈ వారం మిడ్ వీక్ ఎలిమినేషన్ ఉంటుందనే టాక్ ఇప్పుడు హాట్ టాపిక్ గా మారింది.బిగ్ బాస్ ఎలిమినేషన్ఆటలో సవాలు కాదు ఆటే సవాలు అంటూ బిగ్ బాస్ తెలుగు 10వ సీజన్ స్టార్ట్ అయింది. అందుకు తగ్గట్లే ఫస్ట్ వీక్ లోనే మిడ్ వీక్ ఎలిమినేషన్ తో ఇద్దరు కంటెస్టెంట్లు బయటకు వెళ్లారు. మళ్లీ వాళ్లలో ఒకరు రీ ఎంట్రీ కూడా ఇచ్చారు. ఇప్పుడు బిగ్ బాస్ లో ఏడో వారంలోనూ మిడ్ వీక్ ఎలిమినేషన్ పక్కాగా ఉందని సమాచారం.ఏడో వారంఇప్పటికే బిగ్ బాస్ తెలుగు 10వ సీజన్ సగం అయిపోవడానికి వస్తోంది. ప్రస్తుతం సీజన్ లో ఏడో వారం సాగుతోంది. హౌస్ లోనేమో కంటెస్టెంట్లు ఫుల్ గా ఉన్నారు. వీళ్లలో నుంచి హౌస్ మేట్స్ ను తగ్గించాల్సిందే. అందుకే మేకర్స్ ఈ వారం మిడ్ వీక్ ఎలిమినేషన్ తో ఒకరిని, డబుల్ ఎలిమినేషన్ తో మరొకరిని ఇంటికి పంపిస్తారని తెలిసింది.డేంజర్లో వీళ్లిద్దరుప్రస్తుతం అనఫిషియల్ ఓటింగ్ ట్రెండ్ చూస్తే నీతు నటరాజ్, దక్షి డేంజర్ జోన్లో ఉన్నారు. వీళ్లకు ఓట్లు ఎక్కువగా పడటం లేదు. ఈ నేపథ్యంలో ఈ వారం హౌస్ లో నుంచి వీళ్లిద్దరూ ఎలిమినేట్ అయ్యే అవకాశం ఉందని టాక్. మిడ్ వీక్ లో ఒకరిని, వీకెండ్ ఎపిసోడ్లో మరొకరిని ఎలిమినేట్ చేస్తారని అంటున్నారు.రోహిత్ వర్సెస్ త్రిగుణ్బిగ్ బాస్ హౌస్ లోనే కాదు ఓటింగ్ లోనూ రోహిత్ వర్సెస్ త్రిగుణ్ వార్ సాగుతోంది. ఓటింగ్ లో టాప్ స్పాట్ కూడా వీళ్లిద్దరూ పోటీపడుతున్నారు. ప్రస్తుతానికి త్రిగుణ్ ను వెనక్కి నెట్టి రోహిత్ టాప్ ప్లేసుకు చేరుకున్నాడని తెలిసింది. ఆ తర్వాత అమన్, ఆర్కే, శ్వేతా నాయుడు, ఝాన్సీ, సుధీర్ వరుసగా ఉన్నారని సమాచారం.గ్రూప్ గేమ్మరోవైపు బిగ్ బాస్ 10 తెలుగు హౌస్ లో గ్రూప్ గేమ్ అనేది ఇప్పుడ డిస్కషన్ పాయింట్ గా మారింది. అమన్, రోహిత్, శాలిని కలిసి గ్రూప్ గేమ్ ఆడుతున్నారనే ట్రోల్స్ వస్తున్నాయి. బరువులు మోసే టాస్క్ లో అమన్ కు ఫేవర్ చేయడం కోసం అతనితో డిస్కషన్ చేసి మరీ ఇతర కంటెస్టెంట్లకు రోహిత్, శాలిని బరువులు వేశారు.

title: Tiger Shroff shooting case: Shooters surveyed Salman, Aamir Khan, Ranbir Kapoor’s houses too, say police | Mumbai news
description: The two alleged shooters, both 18 and from Haryana’s Sonipat district, reportedly spent a month in Mumbai before the October 18 firing in Juhu.  | Mumbai news
content: Even as three more arrests were made in the Tiger Shroff shooting on Wednesday, taking the total to ten, police have learnt that the shooters had carried out reconnaissance at the homes of two more A-list actors, in addition to the Bandra (west) residence of Salman Khan.Police said the shooters, recruited by the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, had surveilled the Khar residence of actor Aamir Khan and the home of actor Ranbir Kapoor in Mumbai. Interrogation of the two shooters, Phool Singh and Rehan Ansari, and their accomplice, Hritik Kumar aka Roshan Ramu Mahto, has revealed that Shroff was not the gang’s original target but was chosen for the hit as he lacked security cover. They had abandoned the idea of another target as their security was too tight to breach.Also read: 3 more held in Tiger Shroff shooting case, total arrests rise to 10 as police probe alleged Bishnoi gang linksShooters spent a month in Mumbai before Juhu attackThe two 18-year-old shooters – Phool Singh and Rehan Ansari, both residents of Sonipat district in Haryana – had stayed in Mumbai for a month before the October 18 shooting in Juhu. They had checked into various lodges in Dadar and spent around ₹2 lakh, including the cost of the Bajaj Pulsar motorcycle used in the shooting, police said. During this time, the accused also surveilled the residences of Salman Khan, Aamir Khan and Ranbir Kapoor. The shooters also told the police that on October 11, a week before the firing, they visited the Juhu football ground where Shroff regularly played. They were unarmed at the time.They received the pistols used in the attack a day earlier, on October 17, and practiced in a forested area before one of the pistols jammed. They took the weapons to the lodge where they were staying and while attempting to fix the pistol, it accidentally went off. Police are yet to verify these details.Police are hoping more details will emerge as they interrogate the ten accused arrested in the case until Wednesday. The accused include the two shooters and their accomplice. They were intercepted and arrested in Kota from a train headed for New Delhi after the firing and brought to Mumbai on Wednesday. Police are yet to recover the firearms used in Sunday’s firing and the mobile handsets of the accused. They have been remanded to police custody until October 31.Also read: Tiger Shroff firing sparks security concerns: Celebrity sightings cancelled, consider bulletproof carsDelhi Police arrested four alleged weapon suppliers and facilitatorsThe Delhi police arrested four others, including two women, on Tuesday, for supplying weapons to the shooters and harbouring them. They were identified as Kunal Sanjay, 21, Sumit Soraliya, 19, Radha Verma, 23 and Babita Rao, 23. They were arrested in Delhi and Sonipat in Haryana.Three more arrests were made on Wednesday – Sameer, Jatin and Ankit – in Sonipat. Police said Sameer is an alleged co-conspirator, who was in touch with Anil Pandit, a key Bishnoi operative who orchestrated the October 18 shooting.Also read: How Tiger Shroff attack weapon was delivered: Pistol collected from Amritsar via ‘dead letter box’, two women took it to MumbaiJatin had travelled with Kunal to Amritsar, where they picked up the pistols allegedly used in the shooting. The weapons were brought to Mumbai by Radha and Babita, who handed them over to the hitmen. Jatin had also accompanied the shooters to Mumbai, made arrangements for their stay and paid them. Police said Ankit too was involved in the logistics for the shooters in Mumbai.All three are in transit and expected to reach Mumbai early on Thursday.(Inputs from Neeraj Mohan in Rohtak)

title: Champions League: Harry Kane's influence, tactical shifts define Arsenal-Bayern Munich 2-2 draw | Football News
description: It was an end-to-end game at Allianz Arena, where both teams played out of their skin to earn three points, but had to settle for one  | Football News
content: The Champions League night makes teams do something extra, and Arsenal and Bayern Munich had to move away from their usual strengths to keep each other at bay. Arsenal took the game to Bayern with patient possession, while Vincent Kompany's side showed they could threaten without dominating the ball. In the end, neither approach secured all three points in a 2-2 draw at the Allianz Arena.It was an end-to-end game at Allianz Arena, where both teams had to play out of their skin to earn three points, but had to settle for one each.The fight on display by both teams was predictable, but not their approach. Unlike in the Premier League, where Arsenal often pounce on an error from the opponents, here they tried going long after patient build-up play. When Bukayo Saka got injured , it was a moment when Arsenal might have panicked in the past. But with the squad depth they have developed recently---they had Eberechi Eze on the bench---that wasn't the case. Mikel Arteta was calm while replacing Saka with Eze, he even looked to be smiling as he sent the number 10 on the field.The Gunners didn't change their approach apart from putting Noni Madueke on the right flank in Saka's place and Eze on the left. Bayern missed the leadership qualities of Joshua Kimmich who missed the match due to personal reasons. Martin Odegaard caught Bayern's defensive line off-guard with a chip from midfield to Eze, who was sharp enough to receive and fire past Manuel Neuer with a right-footed strike to open the scoring. It came almost against the run of play. Before that, Arsenal were playing short, quick passes to move forward, but Odegaard's through ball in the air caught Bayern's defence unawares.It was time for Bayern to respond, but they were missing their creative force, Michael Olise, who was suspended for this match. Bayern have managed without Jamal Musiala, but Olise has been their driving engine for the forwards. Vincent Kompany found a way for the big night, and Harry Kane played a big role. The Englishman was ready to hit hard yards, dropping into midfield as he switched to more of a number 10 role, something we don't see from modern strikers like Kylian Mbappe and Erling Haaland.The Bayern number 9 not only scores goals but also runs back deep to help his midfielders, as seen in crucial World Cup encounters. Kompany made a bold call to play Alphonso Davies at left wing, not as a full back, to use his speed to disrupt Arsenal's defence. Davies did the same with the equaliser, but credit goes to Kane for the pass from near the centre of the pitch to find Davies. The first half ended 1-1.The Gunners looked more patient and comfortable on the ball in the early minutes of the second half. Bayern didn't lose their calm despite not playing their usual game, which was to hold more possession. They relied on counter-attacks to stun Arsenal's defensive line that was missing William Saliba. Kane continued to play deep and tried to win the ball in midfield, allowing Ismael Saibari and Konrad Laimer to make off-the-ball movements to find space in attack. In the 60th minute, Kane arrived in front of the box to receive a pass from Laimer and took a shot, which was blocked. Jurrien Timber's hand made contact gifting Bayern a crucial penalty.Kane sent David Raya the wrong way to score his 16th goal against Arsenal and make it 2-1 for his side. The Englishman has been in terrific form, continuing where he left off last season, and the way he has been helping his team create chances despite being a number 9 is what sets him apart.Kane's performance in the last 11 matches for club and country: Kane's influence was everywhere in the game, as he even took the goal kicks to ensure smooth distribution of passes despite having an experienced Neuer in goal.Meanwhile, Arsenal have found a way to score late goals this season, changing outcomes. They did it against Nottingham Forest with an 80th-minute goal in the 1-0 win. The Leeds clash also saw Arsenal score two after the 60th minute, while trailing by a goal, to seal the match 2-1 in their favour. They did it in the Champions League too against Napoli, with Odegaard scoring the lone goal in the 75th minute. At the Allianz Arena, they stayed calm when things were going against them. A patient build-up saw Declan Rice turn clutch for them in a big UCL night with an 82nd-minute strike. It was Rice who passed to Madueke, who let it towards Viktor Gyokeres with Rice arriving in the box. He received the ball from the striker to put it past Neuer to help Arsenal earn a 2-2 draw.At the end, it looked like a fair result given how both teams played and adapted to various phases. Bayern are used to holding possession, but here they let Arsenal dictate with 57% at the final whistle. Arsenal, who rely on defensive solidity, were ready to take risks against Kompany's attacking side and focused more on creating chances than just holding the ball and waiting for their chance.

title: Macron hits back at Trump, others over remarks linking France riots to migration: 'Stupid comments' | World News
description: Trump had urged Macron to “close your borders and take control before it is too late!”  | World News
content: French President Emmanuel Macron on Wednesday accused foreign leaders, including those in the United States, of exploiting unrest in France for political gain.The French president slammed “unacceptable” and “stupid” remarks about the riots and rubbished claims blaming Muslim migrants for the violence.The protests, triggered by soaring living costs, have led to widespread rioting and looting. Republicans in the US have reportedly alleged that Muslims are releasing pent-up anger at the historically Catholic France. “Today, radical Islam is the single greatest threat to the American democracy and freedom. We’re seeing in real time in France what happens when moderates capitulate to radical Islam,” Kansas Senator Roger Marshall told the crowd at Monday's rally attended by Trump, according to an AP report. Trump had urged Macron to “close your borders and take control before it is too late!”Also Read: Buildings set on fire, shops looted, over 1,000 arrested as protests against rising living costs in France turn violentMacron rejects claims of migrant role in riotsResponding to the remarks, Macron said there had been “foreign manipulation of information in the aftermath” of the looting in Paris and other French cities last weekend, the Associated Press (AP) reported. Macron was speaking in Qatar at the end of a tour of key energy suppliers in Gulf Arab states.“And that has led to comments that are as unacceptable as they are stupid, from many people, including foreign leaders,” he said.When a reporter asked whether he was referring to Trump, Macron replied, “Among others.”The French president also flagged the circulation of AI-generated images purportedly depicting events in France that had never taken place.“We've seen AI-generated images depicting scenes that never actually happened in France. We've had people claiming that we were invaded by hordes of migrants and Islamists, which is completely false,” Macron said.What Trump saidUS President Donald Trump on Sunday blamed "immigration of people" for the widespread unrest in France as violent protests broke out in Paris, Nice, Marseille and other cities over rising inflation.Trump, in a post on Truth Social, said, "France is burning! The immigration of people from an entirely different world, people with hatred in their hearts, has shattered that once great country."What is happening in France?France witnessed widespread unrest during demonstrations against inflation and the rising cost of living, with clashes between police and protesters, looting and damage reported across several cities.Streets were left devastated on Sunday morning following Saturday's demonstrations, news agency AFP reported. The protests were reportedly called by the Yellow Vest movement, which has campaigned against rising prices and the cost of living.“We're sick of slaving away for poverty wages while our rents keep going up,” teacher Regine Monfroid told AFP, highlighting the financial pressures faced by demonstrators. The protests, however, also centred on other grievances.Also Read: 'France is burning': US President Donald Trump blames 'immigration' for unrest in French cities(With inputs from agencies)

title: Why Under-Construction Home Buyers Should  Understand Partial Disbursement Before Signing | Hindustan Times
description: Understand partial disbursement for under-construction home loans,  including stages, pre-EMI, full EMI and how disbursement affects your monthly outflow.
content: The volume and value of home loan disbursals in top Indian cities have increased by 10% and 15%, respectively, in FY25, according to an Urban Money report. For buyers of under construction properties, these loans are typically disbursed in stages as construction progresses rather than all at once. Most buyers don't think much about that structure until there is a mismatch between their first EMI statement and what they budgeted for.The reason is simple: a loan for a property that's still being built arrives in pieces, tied to how much of the building actually exists at any given point. This structure determines your home loan disbursement and the monthly payment before you're anywhere near moving in, and it's the part of the process that catches even careful buyers off guard.What Is Partial Disbursement in a Home Loan?A partial disbursement home loan simply means your lender releases the sanctioned amount in parts, tying each release to how far construction has actually progressed. It's the default arrangement for any home loan for under construction property, since paying out the full amount upfront would leave the bank funding work that hasn't happened yet.The opposite is full disbursement, used for ready-to-move or resale homes, where the entire loan amount goes out in a single transfer after paperwork. With partial disbursement, each tranche needs its own round of verification, so the pace of your loan payouts is tied directly to your builder's construction timeline.How Is a Home Loan Disbursed for an Under-Construction Property?The stages of home loan disbursement for an under-construction property usually follow the pace of construction itself; each tranche tied to a specific milestone the builder has completed.1. Foundation stage: released once the plot is confirmed and the foundation work has started, typically 15-25% of the sanctioned loan2. Plinth or column level: paid out once the foundation and plinth are complete and columns are cast, another 20-25% of the loan3. Lintel or roof level: released once the roof slab is cast and wall construction is underway, usually the largest chunk, 25-30%4. Brickwork and plastering: paid after brickwork and plastering are done and doors and windows are fitted, around 15-20%5. Finishing stage: the remaining amount, released once flooring, electrical work, plumbing, and painting are complete and the home is nearing possessionEach stage requires the builder to raise a demand letter along with proof of the work completed, which the lender's engineer verifies on-site before releasing the next tranche. The home loan disbursement process typically spans the entire construction period, anywhere from 12 to 36 months or more, depending on the project.Pre-EMI vs EMI: What Changes During Construction?Pre-EMI and full EMI are the two repayment modes tied to how your loan gets disbursed, and knowing the difference matters more than most buyers realise before signing.BasisPre-EMIFull EMIWhat you payInterest only on the amountdisbursed so farPrincipal plus interest, on the full sanctioned amountWhen it appliesDuring construction, before full disbursementAfter full disbursement or possessionEffect on tenureDoesn’t reduce loan tenure or principalStarts reducing principal from month oneMonthlyoutflowLower, increases as more isdisbursedHigher, but fixed from the startNote: Pre-EMI keeps your monthly outflow lower while you're likely also paying rent, but full EMI clears your loan faster and starts building equity sooner, so the better choice depends on how tight your cash flow is during construction. A Quick Example of How Partial Disbursement WorksLet’s take an example of Rohit. He's buying an under-construction flat and took a ₹40 lakh home loan at 9% interest, 20-year tenure, and his bank agrees to release the money in four equal tranches of ₹10 lakh, one at each big construction milestone.Here's what his pre-EMI looked like at every stage:● Foundation stage, ₹10 lakh released: pre-EMI comes to about ₹7,500 a month, interest on just that first tranche● Plinth stage, ₹20 lakh released: his monthly outgo jumps to roughly ₹15,000 ● Structure stage, ₹30 lakh released: pre-EMI climbs again, to around ₹22,500● Finishing stage, full ₹40 lakh released: pre-EMI ends, full EMI begins, and Rohit's now paying close to ₹36,000 a month on the entire loan amountAdd it all up across the roughly 18 months his flat took to build, and Rohit paid close to ₹2.7 lakh in pre-EMI interest, allowing him to manage his cash flow during construction while keeping his principal repayment for later.Is Partial Disbursement a Good Idea Before You Sign?Partial disbursement is a good idea if you'd rather pay interest only on the amount used for construction, instead of full EMIs on money still sitting unused. It also lets your lender verify progress at each stage, keeping your loan tied to real construction milestones rather than a fixed calendar date.Getting the most out of it comes down to a bit of planning. Ask the builder for a construction timeline you can rely on, then check it against your lender's disbursement schedule so the two line up. When they match, the pre-EMI phase stays predictable, and you move into full EMI right around the time you're ready to move in.ConclusionHome loan disbursement for an under-construction property works in stages, and once you know how those stages and pre-EMI affect your monthly outflow, the whole process is a lot easier to plan around.Rohit's example shows what that can look like in real numbers, and running your own numbers through a home loan calculator gives you a clear picture of what to expect.Note to readers: This article is part of HT's paid consumer connect initiative and is independently created by the brand.
