title: Rare egg of extinct giant moa bird to return to New Zealand after 60 years in US collection | Trending
description: After nearly six decades in a US collection, a rare moa egg is returning to New Zealand.   | Trending
content: A rare egg belonging to an extinct giant bird is set to return to New Zealand after spending nearly 60 years in a private collection in the United States. The egg, which dates back to a species that once roamed the country, was purchased by biotechnology company Colossal Biosciences at an auction earlier this year. It will be handed over to Māori researchers and cultural leaders in December.Why is the rare moa egg returning to New Zealand?According to a Colossal Biosciences announcement published through PR Newswire, the egg was discovered in New Zealand on January 14, 1966. It later entered a private American collection before resurfacing at an auction in Colorado in June 2026, when the company bought it specifically to bring it home.Measuring approximately 22 cm long and 17 cm wide, the egg has been reconstructed from numerous fragments, with some pieces still awaiting restoration.(Also Read: Minnesota farmer discovers massive metallic ‘space object’ in cornfield, federal agencies notified)The find is particularly significant because fewer than 40 substantially complete moa eggs are known in public collections worldwide. Only eight retain at least 90% of their original shells, according to the company.What was the moa, the giant bird that went extinct?Moas were flightless birds native to New Zealand. According to People, nine species once lived in the country, ranging from birds roughly the size of turkeys to the South Island giant moa, which could stand nearly 12 feet tall with its neck extended and weigh more than 500 pounds.The birds disappeared around 600 years ago, within two centuries of Polynesian settlement in New Zealand.Filmmaker Sir Peter Jackson, who is involved in the company's moa research partnership, said the extinct birds remained an important part of New Zealand's cultural memory. He helped draw attention to the egg after learning it was being sold outside the country, prompting discussions with Colossal about securing its return.How will researchers study the rare egg?The egg will be entrusted to representatives of Ngāi Tahu, the Māori people whose ancestors lived alongside moa on New Zealand's South Island.Researchers hope its examination could help establish which moa species laid it and where it originated. However, any future scientific testing will be guided by Ngāi Tahu researchers and Māori cultural practices.(Also Read: Video: Elephant carrying silver howdah panics at Karnataka Dasara celebration, damages vehicles before being tranquilised)Ngāi Tahu archaeologist Kyle Davis said the egg could reveal information about the bird, the landscape it came from and potentially the people connected to it.Colossal is also collaborating with New Zealand partners on research exploring whether moa could one day be brought back through de-extinction technology.

title: CA inter result : సీఏ ఇంటర్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాలు విడుదల | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: ది ఇన్‌స్టిట్యూట్ ఆఫ్ చార్టర్డ్ అకౌంటెంట్స్ ఆఫ్ ఇండియా సీఏ ఇంటర్మీడియట్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 పరీక్షల ఫలితాలను గురువారం (అక్టోబర్ 22న) అధికారికంగా విడుదల చేసింది.
content: చార్టర్డ్ అకౌంటెన్సీ (సీఏ) కోర్సు చదువుతున్న అభ్యర్థులు ఎంతగానో ఎదురుచూస్తున్న సీఏ ఇంటర్మీడియట్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాలు వచ్చేశాయి. ది ఇన్‌స్టిట్యూట్ ఆఫ్ చార్టర్డ్ అకౌంటెంట్స్ ఆఫ్ ఇండియా (ICAI) గురువారం (అక్టోబర్ 22న) అధికారిక పోర్టల్‌లో ఈ ఫలితాలను విడుదల చేసింది. హైదరాబాద్, విజయవాడ, విశాఖపట్నం సహా తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల్లోని ప్రధాన కేంద్రాల నుంచి వేలాది మంది విద్యార్థులు ఈ పరీక్షలకు హాజరయ్యారు.సెప్టెంబర్ 4 నుంచి సెప్టెంబర్ 15 వరకు జరిగిన సీఏ ఇంటర్మీడియట్ పరీక్షల స్కోర్‌కార్డులు, మెరిట్ జాబితా, ఉత్తీర్ణత శాతాన్ని ఐసీఏఐ పోర్టల్‌లో అందుబాటులో ఉంచారు. విద్యార్థులు తమ రోల్ నంబర్, రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ నంబర్ నమోదు చేసి ఫలితాలను ఉచితంగా డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేసుకోవచ్చు.సీఏ ఇంటర్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాలు- ఆల్ ఇండియా టాపర్లు వీరే!ఈసారి వెలువడిన సీఏ ఇంటర్మీడియట్ ఫలితాల్లో నీల్ రాజేష్ షా, చందక్ సాక్షి అత్యుత్తమ ప్రతిభ కనబరిచి ఆల్ ఇండియా మొదటి ర్యాంక్ (ఏఐఆర్ 1) సాధించారు. వీరు సాధించిన విజయంపై పలువురు ఐసీఏఐ ప్రతినిధులు, విద్యావేత్తలు ప్రశంసలు కురిపించారు.సీఏ ఇంటర్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాలు- పాస్ పర్సెంటేజ్..ఫలితాల విడుదలతో పాటు ఇంటర్మీడియట్ ఉత్తీర్ణత శాతాన్ని ఐసీఏఐ అధికారికంగా వెల్లడించింది:గ్రూప్-I: 23.14 శాతంగ్రూప్-II: 18.92 శాతంరెండు గ్రూపులు : 13.21 శాతంఅత్యంత కఠినమైన మూల్యాంకనం ఉండే సీఏ కోర్సులో బోత్ గ్రూప్స్‌లో 13 శాతానికి పైగా అభ్యర్థులు ఉత్తీర్ణత సాధించడం విశేషం.సీఏ ఇంటర్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాలు చెక్ చేసుకునేందుకు కావాల్సిన డైరక్ట్ లింక్ కోసం ఇక్కడ క్లిక్ చేయండి.సీఏ ఇంటర్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాలు- స్కోర్‌కార్డ్ డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేసుకోండిలా..అభ్యర్థులు caresults.icai.org, icai.nic.in లేదా icaiexam.icai.org వెబ్‌సైట్ల ద్వారా తమ మార్కుల వివరాలను తెలుసుకోవచ్చు.ముందుగా ఐసీఏఐ అధికారిక ఫలితాల పోర్టల్ caresults.icai.org ని సందర్శించాలి.హోమ్‌పేజీలో ఉన్న 'CA Intermediate September 2026 Examination Result' లింక్‌పై క్లిక్ చేయాలి.మీ రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ నంబర్, రోల్ నంబర్ నమోదు చేయాలి.స్క్రీన్‌పై కనిపించే క్యాప్చా కోడ్‌ను ఎంటర్ చేసి ‘సబ్మీట్’పై క్లిక్ చేయాలి.మీ స్కోర్‌కార్డ్ స్క్రీన్‌పై కనిపిస్తుంది. భవిష్యత్తు అవసరాల కోసం దానిని ప్రింట్ లేదా పీడీఎఫ్ రూపంలో సేవ్ చేసుకోవాలి.ఈమెయిల్, ఎస్ఎమ్ఎస్ ద్వారా సీఏ ఇంటర్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాలు..వెబ్‌సైట్ ట్రాఫిక్ వల్ల ఆలస్యం కాకుండా నేరుగా ఫోన్‌కు ఫలితాలు పొందే సదుపాయాన్ని కూడా ఐసీఏఐ కల్పించింది. ఎస్ఎంఎస్ ద్వారా ఫలితాలు పొందాలనుకునే అభ్యర్థులు CAIPCNEW అని టైప్ చేసి, స్పేస్ ఇచ్చి తమ 6 అంకెల సీఏ ఇంటర్ రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ నంబర్‌ను నమోదు చేసి 58888 నంబర్‌కు సందేశం పంపాల్సి ఉంటుంది.మార్కుల వెరిఫికేషన్ ప్రక్రియ..సీఏ ఇంటర్ సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 ఫలితాల్లో తమకు వచ్చిన మార్కులతో అసంతృప్తిగా ఉన్న లేదా జవాబు పత్రాల మూల్యాంకనంపై సందేహాలు ఉన్న అభ్యర్థులు రీవెరిఫికేషన్ కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు. ప్రతి పేపర్‌కు రూ.100 రుసుము చెల్లించి ఆన్‌లైన్ లేదా ఆఫ్‌లైన్ పద్ధతిలో దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవడానికి ఐసీఏఐ అవకాశం కల్పిస్తోంది.ఆఫ్‌లైన్ ద్వారా దరఖాస్తు పంపాలనుకునే వారు 'ది డిప్యూటీ సెక్రటరీ (ఎగ్జామ్స్), ది ఇన్‌స్టిట్యూట్ ఆఫ్ చార్టర్డ్ అకౌంటెంట్స్ ఆఫ్ ఇండియా, ఐసీఏఐ భవన్, ఇంద్రప్రస్థ మార్గ్, దిల్లీ - 110002' చిరునామాకు స్పీడ్ పోస్ట్ లేదా రిజిస్టర్డ్ పోస్ట్ ద్వారా పంపవచ్చు. వెరిఫికేషన్ సమయంలో మార్కుల కూడికలో తప్పులు, మూల్యాంకనం కాకుండా మిగిలిపోయిన సమాధానాలు, జవాబు పత్రాల క్రమం వంటి అంశాలను అధికారులు సమగ్రంగా తనిఖీ చేస్తారు.

title: I tried 3 dermatologically tested skincare products for sensitive skin: Here is what I like with some trade-offs | Fashion Trends
description: I recently tried 3 dermatologically tested skincare products on my sensitive skin and here is what I like and dislike about them.   | Fashion Trends
content: Sensitive skin can make building a skincare routine tricky. A product that works beautifully for one person may cause redness, irritation or breakouts for another. That is why I tend to look for products that are dermatologically tested, non-comedogenic and suited to my skin’s specific needs. However, these claims do not guarantee that a product will suit everyone.I looked at three skincare essentials from Glenmark: Episoft AC Moisturiser with Microencapsulated Sunscreen, La Shield Sunscreen Lotion Max SPF 80+ PA++++, and Episoft OC Cleansing Gel. Each serves a different purpose, from cleansing and moisturising to sun protection. Here is what stands out about their formulations, what I like about their features, and what I would keep in mind if I had sensitive, oily or acne-prone skin. I tried each of them for almost a month to see what worked and what could have been improved. A moisturiser that also offers sun protection sounds practical, especially when I want to keep my morning skincare routine simple. Episoft AC combines moisturising benefits with broad-spectrum SPF 30 protection. The packaging describes it as a lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturiser with microencapsulated sunscreen, making it an option worth considering for sensitive and acne-prone skin.What I like: The combination of hydration and sun protection is the biggest advantage for me. Ingredients such as glycerin and D-panthenol help attract and retain moisture, while capric triglyceride helps soften the skin. These ingredients make the formula particularly interesting for skin that feels dry, tight or uncomfortable after cleansing.I also appreciate the non-comedogenic positioning, especially if I am dealing with occasional breakouts and want to avoid unnecessarily heavy products. The microencapsulated sunscreen technology is another notable feature. The product combines moisturising benefits with UV protection, which can help simplify the number of steps in a morning routine.For someone who prefers a straightforward skincare regimen, this could be a useful everyday option. I would apply it evenly to the face and neck before heading outdoors, making sure I use enough product for adequate coverage.What could have been improved: My main reservation is the SPF 30 rating. Although it offers broad-spectrum protection, I would prefer a higher-SPF sunscreen for prolonged outdoor exposure, particularly during hot, sunny days. I would also avoid assuming that a moisturiser with SPF automatically replaces every other sun-protection measure.Another consideration is texture. Even products described as lightweight can feel different depending on whether the skin is oily, dry or combination. I would want to check how it sits on my skin before layering makeup over it.My verdict: Episoft AC is worth considering if I want a moisturiser with added sun protection and prefer a simplified morning routine. However, I would still use adequate sunscreen protection, reapply as needed and pay attention to how my skin responds. Sunscreen is one skincare step I would not want to skip, particularly when spending time outdoors. La Shield Sunscreen Lotion Max advertises SPF 80+ and PA++++ protection, making it an option for people looking for high-level labelled UVB and UVA protection.What I like: The high SPF rating immediately catches my attention. SPF primarily indicates protection against UVB rays, while the PA rating communicates UVA protection. Together, these labels help me understand the type of sun protection the product is designed to provide.The packaging also highlights an ultralight feel, moisture-boosting properties, quick absorption and no white cast. These are useful features to look for in a daily sunscreen, particularly if I want to wear it under makeup or dislike products that leave a visible residue.I also like that the formula is presented as dermatologically tested. For someone with sensitive skin, this is a helpful consideration when narrowing down options, although it does not guarantee that irritation will never occur.What could have been improved: A high SPF number does not automatically make a sunscreen the right choice for my skin. I would need to assess its texture, finish and ingredient list before deciding whether it works for me. Some sensitive skin types react to particular UV filters or other formulation ingredients, so I would introduce it cautiously.Most importantly, I would not treat a high SPF rating as permission to skip reapplication. I would apply it generously before sun exposure and reapply at appropriate intervals, especially after sweating, swimming or wiping my face.My verdict: La Shield Sunscreen Lotion Max is worth exploring if high labelled sun protection is a priority. However, ingredient compatibility, comfortable wear and consistent application matter just as much as the SPF number. Cleansing is the foundation of my skincare routine, but I do not want a face wash that leaves my skin feeling stripped or tight. Episoft OC Cleansing Gel is designed for oily and acne-prone skin, with a non-comedogenic formulation intended to remove excess oil without unnecessarily compromising the skin's moisture barrier.What I like: The product's focus on oil control makes it relevant for people who experience a shiny T-zone, clogged pores or occasional breakouts. Its formulation includes ingredients such as niacinamide, zinc PCA, allantoin and glycerin.Niacinamide is known for supporting the skin barrier and helping improve the appearance of uneven skin tone. Zinc PCA is used in skincare formulations aimed at managing excess sebum, while allantoin helps condition the skin. Glycerin attracts moisture, which is useful when I want a cleanser that does not leave my face feeling excessively dry.I also appreciate the emphasis on a non-drying cleansing experience. For sensitive skin, maintaining the skin barrier is important, and an overly harsh cleanser can make dryness and irritation more noticeable.What could have been improved: My biggest concern is that a cleanser formulated for oily skin may not be ideal for every sensitive skin type. If my skin is dry, dehydrated or experiencing a compromised barrier, I would be cautious about cleansing too frequently or using a product that leaves it feeling tight.Even ingredients generally considered beneficial can cause individual reactions. I would introduce the gel gradually and observe whether my skin develops redness, itching or unusual dryness. I would also avoid combining too many potentially irritating products at once while assessing its suitability.My verdict: Episoft OC Cleansing Gel is an option I would consider for oily or combination skin that needs daily cleansing. If my skin were very dry or reactive, I would compare it with a gentler cleansing lotion before making a decision.Final ThoughtsThese three products address different skincare needs. Episoft AC combines moisturising benefits with SPF 30, La Shield Sunscreen Lotion Max focuses on high labelled sun protection, and Episoft OC Cleansing Gel targets excess oil and cleansing.For sensitive skin, I would prioritise comfort, a simple routine and careful introduction of new products over claims alone. Dermatological testing and non-comedogenic labelling are useful starting points, but neither guarantees that a formula will suit every individual. I would patch-test new products, follow the directions on their packaging and consult a dermatologist if irritation persists.Ultimately, the best skincare routine is one that meets my skin's needs without leaving it feeling uncomfortable or overwhelmed. title: Are you ready for parenthood? Fertility expert reveals insights about timing and fertility stagnation in relationships | Health
description: How can couples navigate different feelings about parenthood? Focuses on open communication and understanding each partner's readiness and concerns.  | Health
content: Timing differences around parenthood can create emotional pressure in a relationship, making honest, respectful communication especially important. For some couples, the decision to have a baby comes naturally. For others, partners may be at different stages: one may feel ready to start a family while the other wants more time. Career plans, finances, personal goals, health concerns, or simply feeling emotionally unprepared can influence this decision. When fertility also becomes a consideration, the conversation can feel even more urgent.Why do couples feel differently?• Career and financial stability: They may want to feel more secure before taking on parenting responsibilities.• Lifestyle changes: Giving up personal freedom, changing routines, and taking on new responsibilities can feel overwhelming.• Health or fertility concerns: Previous health issues or worries about fertility may influence how a person approaches the decision.• Relationship concerns: One partner may feel that certain aspects of the relationship need more attention before having a child.Understanding the reason behind the hesitation is often more useful than repeatedly asking, “When will you be ready?”Start with a conversation, not a deadlineIdeally, have the discussion when both partners are calm and have enough time to talk. Instead of trying to convince the other person, each partner should explain what they want and why, or “What are you worried about?”Consider fertility without creating fearAge and fertility can be relevant, particularly when a couple is planning to delay pregnancy. However, fertility varies considerably from person to person. "Couples with reproductive health concerns can speak to a gynecologist or fertility specialist to understand their options based on their personal circumstances," Dr Anuranjita Pallavi, Senior Consultant, Reproductive Medicine & IVF, Motherhood Hospital, Kharghar, Mumbai, tells Health Shots. A fertility consultation should provide information, not pressure one partner into having a baby before they feel ready.Find a way forward togetherThis could include financial planning, completing health check-ups, addressing relationship concerns, or making career arrangements. If conversations repeatedly end in conflict, couples counseling can provide a neutral space to understand each other’s expectations and concerns. One partner’s urgency shouldn't automatically override the other’s concerns, but neither should hesitation be dismissed. When fertility is part of the conversation, getting accurate medical information can help replace assumptions and anxiety with clarity.(Disclaimer: This article is for informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always seek the advice of your doctor with any questions about a medical condition.)

title: గురు గోచారంతో ఈ రాశుల జీవితాల్లో కీలక మార్పులు.. 2027 జనవరి వరకు ఎలా ఉండబోతోందంటే! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: హిందూ జ్యోతిష్య శాస్త్రంలో దేవగురు బృహస్పతిని జ్ఞానం, విద్య, సంతానం, వివాహం, ధనం, అదృష్టానికి కారకుడిగా భావిస్తారు. ఈ కథనం ప్రకారం, గురు భగవానుడు కర్కాటక రాశి నుంచి సూర్యుడి ఆధిపత్యంలోని సింహ రాశిలోకి ప్రవేశించి, 2027 జనవరి 24 వరకు అక్కడే సంచరించనున్నారు.
content: హిందూ జ్యోతిష్య శాస్త్రంలో జ్ఞానం, సంతానం, వివాహం, ధనం, అదృష్టం మరియు విద్యకు కారకుడిగా దేవగురు బృహస్పతిని భావిస్తారు. ఆకాశంలో తన మిత్ర రాశి సంచారంలో భాగంగా, త్వరలో గురు భగవానుడు కర్కాటక రాశి నుంచి సూర్యుడి ఆధిపత్యం ఉన్న సింహ రాశిలోకి అడుగుపెట్టనున్నారు. ఈ రాశి మార్పు తర్వాత, వచ్చే 2027 జనవరి 24 వరకు గురుడు ఇదే స్థానంలో సంచరించనున్నారు. ఈ గోచారంతో చంద్రుడు, కేతువుల ప్రభావం నుంచి గురుడు విముక్తుడవుతున్నారు. విద్యార్థులకు, ఉద్యోగస్తులకు ఈ కాలం అత్యంత కీలకమని నిపుణులు చెబుతున్నారు.జాతకంలో గురుని ప్రభావం.. సానుకూలత, ప్రతికూలతలుజ్యోతిష్య నిపుణుల విశ్లేషణ ప్రకారం, ఒకరి జన్మ లగ్న కుండలిలో గురుడు శుభ స్థానంలో ఉంటే అద్భుతమైన ఫలితాలు వస్తాయి. ఒకవేళ గురుడు నీచ స్థానంలో ఉన్నా లేదా పాప గ్రహాలైన కుజుడు, రాహువు, కేతువు, శనిల కలయికలో ఉన్నా కొన్నిసార్లు ప్రతికూల పరిస్థితులు ఎదురుకావచ్చు.ఆరో, మొదటి లేదా పన్నెండో స్థానాల్లో గురుని సంచారం ఉన్నప్పుడు వ్యక్తిగత జీవితంలో జాగ్రత్తగా వ్యవహరించడం ముఖ్యం. పెద్దలను, గురువులను గౌరవిస్తూ, కృతజ్ఞతా భావంతో ఉంటే గురుబలం పెరుగుతుందని పండితులు సూచిస్తున్నారు.12 రాశులపై గురు గోచార ప్రభావంమేష రాశి: ఈ రాశి వారు వివాహ విషయాల్లో కాస్త ఆచితూచి అడుగు వేయాలి. అలాగే ఆరోగ్యపరమైన చిన్నచిన్న సమస్యలు ఎదురయ్యే అవకాశం ఉంది కాబట్టి తగు జాగ్రత్తలు అవసరం.వృషభ రాశి: వృషభ రాశి జాతకులకు సంతాన ప్రాప్తికి సంబంధించిన శుభవార్తలు వినే అవకాశం ఉంది. కుటుంబంలో సంతోషకరమైన వాతావరణం నెలకొంటుంది.మిథున రాశి: మిథున రాశి వారికి ఆర్థికంగా మంచి లాభాలు కలుగుతాయి. విద్యా రంగంలో విద్యార్థులు అద్భుతమైన ప్రతిభ కనబరుస్తారు.కర్కాటక రాశి: కుటుంబంలో ఇప్పటివరకు వేధిస్తున్న సమస్యలు క్రమంగా తొలగిపోయి, అందరి మధ్య సఖ్యత పెరుగుతుంది.సింహ రాశి: స్వరాశిలోకి గురుని ప్రవేశం వల్ల ఈ రాశి వారికి సమాజంలో కీర్తి ప్రతిష్టలు పెరుగుతాయి. విజ్ఞాన రంగంలో రాణించడంతో పాటు విద్యార్థులకు అద్భుతమైన ఫలితాలు దక్కుతాయి.కన్యా రాశి: ఈ సమయంలో దూర ప్రాంతాలకు ప్రయాణాలు చేసే అవకాశం ఉంది. ఆరోగ్యం చాలావరకు కుదుటపడి మానసిక ప్రశాంతత లభిస్తుంది.తులా రాశి: ప్రయాణాల ద్వారా విశేషమైన లాభాలను ఆర్జిస్తారు. కుటుంబ విషయాలు సర్దుమమణుగుతాయి. రచయితలు, కళాకారులకు ఈ కాలం సువర్ణావకాశం.వృశ్చిక రాశి: గత కొంతకాలంగా వేధిస్తున్న సమస్యల నుంచి ఉపశమనం లభిస్తుంది. సంతానం ద్వారా శుభవార్తలు వింటారు, ఆరోగ్యం మెరుగ్గా ఉంటుంది.ధనుస్సు రాశి: మీ మాటతీరుతో చుట్టూ ఉన్నవారిని ఆకట్టుకుంటారు. మీ ఆలోచన విధానం పట్ల ఇతరులు ప్రభావితమవుతారు.మకర రాశి: జీవితంలో పరిస్థితులు గతంతో పోలిస్తే మెరుగ్గా మారుతాయి. కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో సంతోషంగా గడుపుతారు, ఇంటా బయటా సానుకూలత ఉంటుంది.కుంభ రాశి: కేతువు, గురుల సంయోగ ప్రభావంతో అకస్మాత్తుగా ధనలాభం కలుగుతుంది. మిత్రుల సహకారం లభిస్తుంది. అయితే వ్యక్తిగత జీవితంలో కొన్ని ఒడిదుడుకులు ఎదురుకావచ్చు కాబట్టి సమన్వయంతో వ్యవహరించాలి.మీన రాశి: సమయం అనుకూలంగా ఉన్నప్పటికీ, ఆరోగ్యంపై ప్రత్యేక శ్రద్ధ పెట్టడం చాలా ముఖ్యం. కార్యాలయంలో మీ కష్టానికి తగిన ప్రతిఫలం, గుర్తింపు లభిస్తాయి.

title: Over 8,000 youths attend Sanatani Shankhnaad festival in Greater Noida | Hindustan Times
description: More than 8,000 young people attended Sanatani Shankhnaad 2026 at Sharda University in Greater Noida.
content: More than 8,000 young people from across Uttar Pradesh participated in ‘Sanatani Shankhnaad 2026’, a youth festival organised by the state’s information department at Sharda University in Greater Noida on Wednesday, with discussions and cultural performances focusing on India’s diverse traditions and shared cultural identity.Held under the theme ‘Diverse India: Connecting with Uttar Pradesh’s Cultural Roots’, the event aimed to connect the younger generation with India’s cultural heritage and encourage them to play an active role in its preservation. Participants highlighted the idea that linguistic and differences in forms of worship did not diminish a shared sense of belonging.The festival featured discussions on the philosophical and scientific basis of Sanatan traditions, religious freedom under the Indian Constitution, spiritual knowledge and the role of young people in nation-building.Speakers included religious leader Balkानand Giri Ji Maharaj, Supreme Court advocate Vishnu Jain, Sadhvi Dr Shivani Bharti and Kajal Hindustani. They discussed cultural identity, the relevance of Sanatan traditions and the role of youth in preserving heritage. Speakers also shared their views on what they described as changes in Uttar Pradesh since 2017 in cultural revival, religious tourism and heritage conservation.The event combined intellectual discussions with performances representing different Indian cultural traditions. The programme included folk dances, Kathak, Bharatanatyam, devotional music, theatrical performances and a special dance dedicated to Goddess Durga.A musical and visual presentation on cultural changes in Uttar Pradesh under Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath also featured at the festival. The programme concluded with a musical night by the Keshavam band, combining contemporary music with devotional songs and bhajans.Organisers positioned the festival as a platform for young people to engage with cultural traditions through discussion, artistic expression and music. Its central message was captured in the phrase ‘Bhasha anek, bhav ek’, meaning many languages, one sentiment, reflecting the idea of cultural unity amid diversity.

title: INDIA bloc plans next round of protests against CEC Gyanesh Kumar in early November | India News
description: The Opposition leaders have started discussing ideas for another round of protests after the series of marches in central Delhi in the second week of October. | India News
content: The INDIA bloc’s next round of protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar may begin in early November, following the upcoming rally at the Ramlila Ground on November 1. The Opposition leaders have started discussing ideas for another round of protests after the series of marches in central Delhi in the second week of October.“Various options are being considered at this stage. With the political success of our marches in the heart of Delhi, some leaders want a repetition of that massive mobilisation. Another idea is to hold a mock Parliament that will enact the impeachment of Gyanesh Kumar. Other steps have also been suggested,” CPI(M) general secretary MA Baby told HT.A senior Congress leader added that there are no concrete plans but “things are being chalked out by the top leadership.” He reminded that both the Leader of the Opposition, Rahul Gandhi, and the Congress general secretary, KC Venugopal, had announced that the protests will continue until Gyanesh Kumar resigns.What has happened till now?The Opposition parties led massive marches in central Delhi in the second week of October, mobilizing thousands of party workers, students and civil society activists in the biggest demonstrations in the recent times against Kumar, that led a fresh showdown with the BJP.The Opposition met President Droupadi Murmu on October 9 to demand “resignation of Kumar and repeal of the 2023 law that provides life-long immunity to the CEC and the ECs.” They sought “immediate suspension of the SIR and immediate restoration of all 13.3 crore voters illegally deleted from electoral rolls.”President Droupadi Murmu sought proof of vote-chori from the Opposition.On October 12, Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi led the biggest march in recent times—to file a petition to the Supreme Court. Gandhi. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and other leaders alleged in the petition that there was “unilateral and arbitrary exercise of the collective powers of the Election Commission of India by the Chief Election Commissioner during the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.” They demanded review of key decisions to seek protection of the Constitutional guarantee of universal adult suffrage.They also raised “the consequent concerns regarding the integrity of the electoral process” and “the infringement of the constitutional right of eligible citizens to be registered as voters and to exercise their right to vote.” To be sure, the Opposition petitioners have clearly stated that they do not seek to reopen the question of the validity of the SIR as such.What lies aheadEven as preparations have already begun by the Congress and other parties for the Ramlila Ground rally, senior leaders are discussing how to regain the momentum of the protests, which came to a halt due to Navaratri and Durga Puja.When asked about the mock parliament, Baby said, “We will invite eminent jurists and former Supreme Court judges and conduct a mock trial to impeach Gyanesh Kumar. There would be someone who will also defend Kumar, but the whole show would be to underline how Kumar is guilty on many counts.”Another senior leader of the Opposition, who did not wish to be named, said, “the final decision on how to proceed will be taken collectively. No party will unilaterally decide everything.” The INDIA bloc will also form a coordination committee, drawing members from various constituent parties to oversee all protest plans.The INDIA bloc’s upcoming rally in New Delhi against mass disenfranchisement and Kumar will include student bodies and civil society organisations, people familiar with the matter said, adding that the initiative is in line with Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi’s position that “all protests are one.

title: AR Rahman's Ramayana wedding song Jodi Jodi wins praise, fans apologise to him after Ravana Tandav criticism: 'God-level stuff’ | Bollywood
description: After early criticism of AR Rahman’s score for Ramayana’s Ravana Tandav, the album launch prompted praise and apologies.  | Bollywood
content: Music composer AR Rahman faced criticism for his score for the Ramayana song Ravana Tandav, with many expressing disappointment and calling it a mediocre track. However, the audience's reaction took a 180-degree turn after the film's music album was launched at a grand event in Chennai. The wedding song Jodi Jodi has received particular praise, with many even predicting an Oscar for Rahman.Internet impressed with Ramayana's wedding song, Jodi JodiJodi Jodi was performed by Chinmayi Sripada at the album launch event in Chennai. Composed by AR Rahman with lyrics by Kumar Vishwas, the song has been praised for its devotional feel, with many calling it a masterpiece and the best song from Ramayana. The song, along with the Vanvas theme and Mangal Rang, has not yet been released on YouTube. However, clips from Chinmayi's live performance at the event have mesmerised listeners online. Praising the song and Rahman's music, one person commented, "Why the song sounds like THOSE end of 90s and Early 20s PEAK emotional songs ! It's PEAK PEAK PEAK... Gave me vibes of the era of 90s - 2015." Another wrote, "This has that old Indian song feeling....which got lost somewhere. Just plain beautiful vocals being the star." A third comment read, "This is god level stuff." Another listener wrote, "Peak Mithila wedding vibes. Anyone from Bihar will know what ARR cooked here." Before the album launch, the Ramayana makers released Ravana Tandav on Dussehra. The song featured Yash as Ravana performing the Tandav to the Shiv Stotram. However, Rahman's score received a mixed response online, with some viewers criticising the music and asking producer Namit Malhotra to replace the composer in the sequel. Following the album launch and live performances of songs such as Mangal Rang and Jodi Jodi, several listeners appeared to reconsider their earlier criticism and apologised to Rahman.One person commented, "To the people who were criticising ARR and doubting him for the film, including myself. We all should apologise to ARR for doubting his skills." Another wrote, "Louder apologies for doubting Rahman." A third comment read, "Hands down Rahman. I'm really sorry. i will again say: you ruined my afternoon yesterday, and now you've ruined my entire rest of the month for now. I felt goosebumps while listening to music. that's so peak." Another listener commented, "Oscar-level stuff man."About RamayanaHelmed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is reportedly being made on a budget of ₹4,000 crore and is among the most ambitious projects in Indian cinema. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Yash as Ravana. The cast also includes Kajal Aggarwal, Lara Dutta, Sheeba Chaddha, Arun Govil, Rakul Preet Singh and Vivek Oberoi in key roles.The film is planned as a two-part saga, with the first part scheduled to release in theatres on November 5, 2026.

title: Para Asian Games 2026| Visualisation behind my success, para-athlete Nishad Kumar opens up after historic double gold | Hindustan Times
description: Nishad Kumar became only the third Indian to win two golds at one edition of the Asian Para Games, clinching the men’s high jump T47 and long jump T47 titles.
content: Nishad Kumar has leapt into history! The 27-year-old became only the third Indian to win two golds at a single Asian Para Games edition in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. After winning the men’s long jump in T47 classification — for athletes with upper limb impairments — with a 7.11m effort on Monday, he cleared a Games-record 2.04m in high jump T47 on Tuesday, joining Ankur Dhama and Sheetal Devi in the elite club. And what’s the secret behind his success? Visualisation, says Nishad, who was seen urging spectators to cheer louder before competing. “When I train, I imagine that 1 lakh people are in attendance cheering for me to hype my adrenaline. Visualisation has helped me not get distracted and has made me mentally tough. That toughness is the biggest cause behind my success.”But even as Nishad celebrates his historic double gold, sporting glory doesn’t always bring the recognition it deserves. With fans on social media questioning the limited television coverage of the Asian Para Games compared to the recently concluded Asian Games, Nishad says he has learnt to look beyond the attention: “When you are standing on that podium, looking at the Tiranga waving high, nothing matters anymore! You do not care who is talking about you and who is not. All you think about is that you have achieved what you wanted to.”But he admits that the lack of recognition for para-athletes once affected him deeply. “It used to hurt me, bother me, that why do we still have to fight for attention and recognition even though we are winning a huge number of medals for India; be it at the Paralympics, Asian Para Games or more. It does nothing but affect your mental health, and that affects my game. So now I focus on myself. What is not in my control should be taken care of by the administration and concerned authorities. I have stopped thinking about it.”

title: Laya Son Of Kanakadurgamma: అమ్మవారిగా సీనియర్ హీరోయిన్ లయ- నిధి అన్వేషణ కథతో సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ- పోస్టర్ రిలీజ్ | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Son Of Kanakadurgamma Laya Poster Release: దేవీ నవరాత్రుల పవిత్ర సందర్భంగా 'సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ' చిత్రం నుంచి సీనియర్ హీరోయిన్ లయ అమ్మవారి రూపంలో ఉన్న పవర్‌ఫుల్ పోస్టర్‌ను స్టార్ ప్రొడ్యూసర్లు వైజయంతీ మూవీస్ అశ్వనీదత్, స్వప్న దత్ విడుదల చేశారు. నిధి అన్వేషణ నేపథ్యంలో ఈ సినిమా సాగనుంది.
content: Son Of Kanakadurgamma Laya Poster Release: తెలుగు డివోషనల్ కథలతో చాలా అరుదుగా సినిమాలు వస్తుంటాయి. భక్తి పారవశ్యంతో వచ్చే సినిమాల కోసం ఆడియెన్స్ ఎదురుచూస్తుంటారు. ఇలాంటి సమయంలో టాలీవుడ్‌లో ఓ విభిన్నమైన కాన్సెప్ట్ చిత్రం పట్టాలెక్కింది.సీనియర్ హీరోయిన్ లయ పోస్టర్సీనియర్ హీరోయిన్ లయ, అనురూప్ కటారి, ఆకాంక్ష త్యాగరాజన్ ప్రధాన పాత్రల్లో నటిస్తున్న చిత్రం 'సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ'. దసరా పండుగ శుభ సమయాన్ని పురస్కరించుకుని సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ సినిమా నుంచి అత్యంత శక్తివంతమైన పోస్టర్‌ను చిత్రబృందం సోషల్ మీడియా వేదికగా విడుదల చేసింది.చాలా కాలం తర్వాత పవర్‌ఫుల్ పాత్రతోటాలీవుడ్ ప్రముఖ నిర్మాతలు వైజయంతీ మూవీస్ అధినేత సి. అశ్వనీదత్, స్వప్న దత్ ఈ ప్రత్యేక పోస్టర్‌ను ఆవిష్కరించి, చిత్ర యూనిట్‌కు శుభాకాంక్షలు తెలియజేశారు. కుటుంబ కథా చిత్రాలతో తెలుగు ప్రేక్షకుల గుండెల్లో చెరగని ముద్ర వేసుకున్న నటి లయ, చాలా కాలం తర్వాత ఒక పవర్‌ఫుల్ పాత్రతో వెండితెరపై అలరించబోతున్నారు.నిధి అన్వేషణ కథతోవిజయవాడ కనకదుర్గమ్మ ఆశీస్సులతో, ఇంద్రకీలాద్రి నేపథ్యాన్ని ముడిపెడుతూ సాగే థ్రిల్లింగ్ నిధి అన్వేషణ (Treasure Hunt) డ్రామాగా ఈ సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ సినిమాను రూపొందిస్తున్నారు. ఇటీవల విడుదల చేసిన పోస్టర్‌లో నటి లయ అమ్మవారి దివ్యమైన, ఉగ్ర రూపంలో దర్శనమిచ్చారు.రౌద్ర రూపంలో నటి లయ.. రొమాలు నిక్కబొడుచుకునేలా సన్నివేశాలు!కాకర్ల గోవర్దనరావు అందించిన ఈ విలక్షణమైన కథకు దుర్గ ఫణిదర్ లంక దర్శకత్వం వహిస్తున్నారు. రాగా మూవీస్, తిలోత్తమ ప్రొడక్షన్స్ బ్యానర్లపై వాణి శంకర్, తిలోత్తమ సంయుక్తంగా సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ చిత్రాన్ని ఎక్కడా కాంప్రమైజ్ కాకుండా నిర్మిస్తున్నారు.అమ్మవారిగా లయ"ఈ సినిమాలో నిధి అన్వేషణ కాన్సెప్ట్ ప్రేక్షకులకు సరికొత్త అనుభూతిని ఇస్తుంది. నటి లయ అమ్మవారిగా కనిపించే ప్రతి సన్నివేశం థియేటర్లలో ప్రేక్షకులకు రొమాలు నిక్కబొడుచుకునేలా ఉత్కంఠ రేపుతుంది" అని చిత్ర యూనిట్ సభ్యులు ఆశాభావం వ్యక్తం చేశారు.అద్భుతమైన సాంకేతిక విలువలు.. కట్టిపడేసే యాక్షన్ సీక్వెన్సెస్!సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ చిత్రానికి కథతో పాటు సాంకేతిక నిపుణుల పనితనం ప్రధాన బలంగా నిలవనుంది. శశిధర్ లంక స్వరాలు సమకూరుస్తుండగా, ప్రముఖ సంగీత దర్శకుడు సామ్ కే ప్రసన్ నేపధ్య సంగీతం (BGM) అందిస్తున్నారు. ప్రసాద్ కేవీ ఛాయాగ్రహణ బాధ్యతలు చూస్తుండగా, రాజేష్ లంక పవర్ ఫుల్ యాక్షన్ సన్నివేశాలను కొరియోగ్రఫీ చేస్తున్నారు.శరవేగంగా షూటింగ్సన్ ఆఫ్ కనకదుర్గమ్మ చిత్రానికి రాఘవేందర్ రెడ్డి కూర్పు బాధ్యతలు తీసుకోగా, చైతన్య మీనవల్లి, ప్రసాద్ కేవీ సంభాషణలు రాశారు. ప్రస్తుతం షూటింగ్ శరవేగంగా జరుపుకుంటున్న ఈ సినిమాకి సంబంధించిన మరిన్ని కీలక విషయాలను త్వరలోనే ప్రకటిస్తామని నిర్మాతలు తెలిపారు.

title: ఆటోమొబైల్​ కంపెనీలకు ఈసారి పండుగ లేదు! నవరాత్రిలో పడిపోయిన సేల్స్.. | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: భారత ఆటోమొబైల్ పరిశ్రమకు అత్యంత ఆశాజనకమైన నవరాత్రుల పండుగ సీజన్‌లో ఈసారి ఆశించిన స్థాయిలో వాహనాల విక్రయాలు జరగలేదు! గత ఏడాదితో పోలిస్తే మొత్తం వాహన రిజిస్ట్రేషన్లు 6.52 శాతం తగ్గాయని ఫాడా వెల్లడించింది.
content: దేశవ్యాప్తంగా పండుగ శోభ వెల్లివిరిసినప్పటికీ, భారత ఆటోమొబైల్ రంగానికి మాత్రం ఈ ఏడాది నవరాత్రి పెద్దగా కలసిరాలేదు! ఏడాది మొత్తంలో అత్యధిక సంఖ్యలో వాహనాలు అమ్ముడయ్యే ఈ పవిత్ర దసరా/నవరాత్రుల పది రోజుల కాలంలో కార్లు, బైకుల కొనుగోళ్లు క్షీణించాయి. వాహన డీలర్ల సమాఖ్య 'ఫాడా' విడుదల చేసిన తాత్కాలిక గణాంకాల ప్రకారం.. గత ఏడాది నవరాత్రులతో పోలిస్తే ఈసారి వాహన రిజిస్ట్రేషన్లు 6.52 శాతం తగ్గాయి.ఏ కేటగిరీలో ఎలా ఉంది?అక్టోబర్ 11 నుంచి అక్టోబర్ 20 మధ్య జరిగిన నవరాత్రుల పండుగ సమయంలో దేశవ్యాప్తంగా మొత్తం 11.23 లక్షల వాహనాలు మాత్రమే విక్రయమయ్యాయి. గతేడాది పండుగ సీజన్‌లో (సెప్టెంబర్ 22 నుంచి అక్టోబర్ 2 మధ్య) ఈ సంఖ్య 12.01 లక్షల యూనిట్లుగా ఉండేది. ట్రాక్టర్లు, వాణిజ్య వాహనాల మినహా మిగిలిన అన్ని విభాగాల్లోనూ విక్రయాలు మందగించాయి.ప్రత్యేకించి ప్యాసింజర్ వాహనాల (కార్లు, ఎస్‌యూవీలు) విభాగంలో విక్రయాలు భారీగా పడిపోయాయి. గత ఏడాదితో పోలిస్తే కార్ల రిజిస్ట్రేషన్లు ఏకంగా 21.9 శాతం క్షీణించి 1.83 లక్షల యూనిట్లకు పరిమితమయ్యాయి. ద్విచక్ర వాహనాల అమ్మకాలు 2.8 శాతం తగ్గి 8.34 లక్షల యూనిట్లుగా నమోదయ్యాయి. మూడు చక్రాల వాహనాల విక్రయాలు 7.5 శాతం క్షీణించి 45,735 యూనిట్లకు పడిపోయాయి.అయితే వాణిజ్య వాహనాల విక్రయాలు 1.1 శాతం పెరిగి 35,618 యూనిట్లకు, ట్రాక్టర్ల విక్రయాలు 0.9 శాతం పెరిగి 22,690 యూనిట్లకు చేరుకున్నాయి.దూసుకుపోతున్న ఎలక్ట్రిక్ వాహనాలు!సాంప్రదాయ పెట్రోల్, డీజిల్ వాహనాల అమ్మకాలు తగ్గినప్పటికీ, ఎలక్ట్రిక్ వాహన రంగం (ఈవీ) మాత్రం పండుగ వేళ మెరుగైన వృద్ధిని సాధించింది. ద్విచక్ర వాహన విభాగంలో ఈవీల జోరు స్పష్టంగా కనిపించింది. ఈసారి నవరాత్రుల్లో ఈవీల విక్రయాలు 26.78 శాతం వృద్ధి నమోదు చేశాయి. గత ఏడాది మొత్తం పండుగ అమ్మకాలలో ఈవీల వాటా 7.7 శాతంగా ఉండగా, ఈసారి అది 10.5 శాతానికి చేరడం గమనార్హం.విక్రయాలు తగ్గడానికి కారణాలేంటి?ఈసారి వాహన విక్రయాలు తగ్గడానికి ప్రధానంగా గతేడాది ఉన్న 'హై బేస్ ఎఫెక్ట్' కారణమని విశ్లేషకులు చెబుతున్నారు. గత 2025 నవరాత్రుల మొదటి రోజే జీఎస్టీ 2.0 పన్ను తగ్గింపు అమలులోకి వచ్చింది. దీనితో వినియోగదారులు ఒక్కసారిగా షోరూమ్‌లకు పోటెత్తి వాహనాలు కొనుగోలు చేశారు. దానికితోడు గతేడాది నవరాత్రులు 11 రోజుల పాటు సాగగా, ఈసారి పండుగ రోజులు 10 రోజులకే పరిమితమయ్యాయి."గతేడాదితో పోలిస్తే 6.52 శాతం స్వల్ప క్షీణత కనిపించడం కేవలం సాంకేతికపరమైన అంశమే. గతేడాది జీఎస్టీ పన్ను కోత వల్ల వినియోగదారుల నుంచి అనూహ్యమైన డిమాండ్ వచ్చింది," అని ఫాడా అధ్యక్షుడు సాయి గిరిధర్ స్పష్టం చేశారు.ఆటోమొబైల్ దిగ్గజాల ధీమా..విక్రయాల తగ్గుదలపై దేశీయ కార్ల తయారీ దిగ్గజాలు మాత్రం పెద్దగా ఆందోళన చెందడం లేదు. దేశంలోనే అతిపెద్ద కార్ల తయారీ సంస్థ మారుతీ సుజుకీ ఈసారి డెలివరీలు గతేడాదితో సమానంగానే ఉన్నాయని తెలిపింది."నవరాత్రుల కాలంలో ఈసారి మా డెలివరీలు గతేడాదితో పోలిస్తే దాదాపు 98 శాతంగా ఉన్నాయి. ప్లాంట్ల ఉత్పత్తి సామర్థ్య పరిమితుల వల్లే ఎక్కువ వాహనాలను అందించలేకపోయాం. ఓణం నుంచి దసరా వరకు మా విక్రయాలు 30 శాతం పెరిగాయి. దీపావళి నాటికి రెండంకెల వృద్ధిని సాధిస్తాం," అని మారుతీ సుజుకీ సీనియర్ ఎగ్జిక్యూటివ్ ఆఫీసర్ పార్థో బెనర్జీ ధీమా వ్యక్తం చేశారు.టాటా మోటార్స్ కూడా షోరూమ్‌లకు కస్టమర్ల రాక, బుకింగ్‌లు ఆశాజనకంగా ఉన్నాయని వెల్లడించింది."నవరాత్రుల సమయంలో 50,000 కంటే ఎక్కువ వాహనాలను కస్టమర్లకు అందించాం. ఒక్క విజయదశమి రోజునే 10,000 కంటే ఎక్కువ కార్లను డెలివరీ చేశాం," అని టాటా మోటార్స్ ప్యాసింజర్ వెహికల్స్ చీఫ్ కమర్షియల్ ఆఫీసర్ అమిత్ కామత్ తెలిపారు.దక్షిణ కొరియా ఆటో దిగ్గజం హ్యుందాయ్ మోటార్ ఇండియా కూడా నగర, గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల్లో తమ కార్లకు మంచి డిమాండ్ ఉందని పేర్కొంది. పితృ పక్షం నుంచి నవరాత్రుల మధ్య కాలంలో రిజిస్ట్రేషన్లు 30 శాతం పెరిగి 41,000 యూనిట్లకు చేరాయని కంపెనీ ఎండీ, సీఈఓ తరుణ్ గార్గ్ వివరించారు. ధంతేరాస్, దీపావళి వరకు ఈ ఊపు కొనసాగుతుందని ఆయన ఆశాభావం వ్యక్తం చేశారు.

title: Controversial K-beauty anti-ageing injection made from cadaver skin sparks infection concerns | Trending
description: Experts remain sceptical about the benefits of cadaver-derived skin boosters, raising concerns over potential bacterial and viral contamination.  | Trending
content: The global cosmetic industry is seeing a shift toward regenerative therapies, but one of the most unexpected anti-ageing developments is a South Korean "skin booster" derived from donated human cadaver tissue.One such injectable product is called Elravie Re20, distributed in South Korea by Humedix. The company website states that the product is made from “freeze-dried human tissue” and warns that it “must be stored at room temperature (1 to 30°C) until opening of the package.”Where is the tissue collected from?The hot new treatment of “cadaver-derived skin injections” uses tissues derived from the skin of dead US citizens, reported Business Insider. The outlet reported that each year thousands of Americans donate their body tissue upon their deaths. The donated skin, which is worth tens of millions of dollars, goes from being stored in American tissue banks to biotech companies in South Korea."With tissue donation, there's a lot of money at stake,” Ana Iltis, a professor at Wake Forest and also the former president of the American Society for Bioethics and Humanities, told Business Insider.Further, in a statement, Humedix said that the skin tissue is obtained from deceased donors through US tissue banks.Trend raises safety concernsThe product, however, has raised safety concerns among medical professionals. “The product is claimed to be acellular, meaning all cells have been removed and suggesting it’s sterile. But are bacteria found in cells only?” Dr Peter Pang Chi-wang, a plastic surgery specialist, told the South China Morning Post (SCMP). “The safety of the product has not been proven yet.”Dr Chi-wang also disputed the claimed benefits of the product, saying that they remain uncertain. He said there are no records showing that the product could tighten skin or reduce pores.Another dermatologist, Dr Kingsley Chan Hau-ngai, raised the question of possible infection that the product may cause. “Cadavers are not that clean, how can they ensure the pathogens are removed?” he said. “Also, how are the products stored? If they have been stored for a long time, there could also be bacteria, fungi or virus growing.” He added that the product sounded more like a gimmick.Crackdown in Hong Kong:These heightened medical concerns quickly triggered real-world enforcement in Hong Kong, where health officials raided clinics to seize illegal vials of the Korean cadaver-skin booster. Authorities confirmed the treatment has no regulatory approval, warning that administering unregistered human-derived products carries severe risks.

title: 'Sundar Pichai said no, no, no': Donald Trump says Google CEO refused to rename Atlantic Ocean | Hindustan Times
description: US President Donald Trump has said he discussed the possibility of renaming the Atlantic Ocean on Google Maps with Google CEO Sundar Pichai
content: US President Donald Trump has said he discussed the possibility of renaming the Atlantic Ocean on Google Maps with Google CEO Sundar Pichai, but the company was reluctant to take up the idea. Trump made the remarks during a rally in South Carolina on October 21, where he also joked about renaming the Pacific Ocean the “American Ocean” and speculated about how European leaders would react.Trump said he had considered renaming the Atlantic Ocean but decided against pursuing the idea after speaking to Pichai. He also referred to Google’s earlier decision to display the Gulf of Mexico as the Gulf of America on Google Maps for users in the United States.Trump’s conversation with Sundar PichaiDuring his speech, Trump said he had spoken to Pichai, whom he described as a “brilliant guy”, about the proposal. He also mentioned Google co-founder Sergey Brin while praising the company’s leadership.“So we seriously looked at the Atlantic Ocean, and I called Google Maps, who were really great with the lake,” Trump told supporters at Clemson.“And I spoke to a brilliant guy, Sundar. He heads all of Google. He’s a brilliant guy. Sergey and Sundar, totally brilliant guys,” he said, apparently referring to Google co-founder Sergey Brin. “And, you know, they’re still rattled from the Gulf.”Trump then recounted his conversation with Pichai about the Atlantic Ocean.“And I said, Sundar, I’m thinking of the Atlantic Ocean. Can you handle it?” Trump said.Pichai replied: “No, no, no. This time I’m not doing it. Oceans are different, sir. You know, they cover a lot of… They cover really a lot of countries. Please don’t ask us to do that.” On renaming Pacific OceanThe US President subsequently suggested he would drop the proposal to rename the Atlantic Ocean. “So I’ll probably pass. Should I pass? I think let’s keep it the Atlantic Ocean, right?” Trump said.However, Trump floated the possibility of renaming the Pacific Ocean, asking the audience how Europe might respond to such a move.“We’re going to call it the American Ocean. How do you think Europe would fit?” he said.Trump claimed that he only liked the Atlantic and the Pacific oceans, and had no plans to assign his name or the name of his country to any other ocean.Trump also referred to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen while speculating about the reaction to the proposed name change.(Also read: Trump warns EU of ‘much higher levels’ of tariffs over delayed trade deal, sets deadline)“I'll probably give up on this idea. What do you think, give up? Let's leave the Atlantic Ocean. But the Pacific Ocean—we'll call it the American Ocean. How do you think Europe will react to this? Do you think they'll like it? Europe will be thrilled, right? [European Commission President] Ursula [von der Leyen] will call and say "thank you very much," Trump ironically remarked.Trump’s comments come after his administration renamed the Gulf of Mexico the Gulf of America through an executive order shortly after he took office in January 2025. Google Maps subsequently began displaying the new name to users in the US, while users elsewhere continued to see the Gulf of Mexico or both names, depending on their location.(Also read: Google Maps to rename Gulf of Mexico to 'Gulf of America' for US users)

title: Banarasi, Chanderi, Bandhani or Ajrakh: 4 Indian fabrics I’ve recently started exploring | Fashion Trends
description: I’m exploring Indian wear and four timeless fabrics: Banarasi, Chanderi, Bandhani and Ajrakh. Here’s how I’d style each to suit my personal style.  | Fashion Trends
content: For the longest time, I thought of Indian wear in terms of occasions. There were kurtas for family gatherings, dressier outfits for festivals and sarees that came out when there was a wedding to attend. But lately, I have found myself looking at Indian fabrics differently. I am increasingly drawn to the richness of traditional textiles, the stories behind their patterns and the way a well-chosen piece can make an outfit feel special without trying too hard.The more I explore Indian wear, the more I realise that not every beautiful fabric needs to be reserved for a grand occasion. Some make a statement the moment you walk into a room. Others have a quieter charm that grows on you, especially when you learn how to style them.Banarasi, Chanderi, Bandhani and Ajrakh are four textiles I keep coming back to, each for a different reason. While Banarasi feels elegant and occasion-ready, Ajrakh has a sophisticated, understated appeal. Chanderi looks stunning when styled well, although I can see why its delicate, sometimes sheer texture might take a little getting used to for beginners. Bandhani, meanwhile, has that evergreen quality that makes it feel relevant across generations.So, if you are also trying to figure out which Indian fabric suits your personal style, here is how I would approach the choice.1. Banarasi: For when you want understated elegance with a little grandeur There is something about Banarasi fabric that makes Indian wear look instantly elevated. Traditionally associated with Varanasi, Banarasi textiles are known for their intricate weaving, rich textures and elaborate motifs, often featuring floral patterns and zari work.For me, Banarasi represents the kind of elegance that does not need much explanation. Even a relatively simple silhouette can look dressed up when the fabric has beautiful detailing. It is the sort of textile I would gravitate towards when I want an outfit to feel polished, feminine and timeless.A Banarasi saree is an obvious choice for weddings and festive celebrations, but I also like the idea of incorporating the fabric in smaller doses. A Banarasi dupatta paired with a solid kurta and straight trousers can make a relatively simple outfit feel occasion-worthy. A woven Banarasi skirt with a plain blouse is another way to enjoy the richness without committing to an elaborate ensemble.Who should choose Banarasi?If your style leans towards classic Indian elegance, rich colours, intricate details and outfits that photograph beautifully, Banarasi is worth exploring. It is particularly suited to weddings, festive gatherings and occasions when you want your clothing to do most of the talking.My styling tip would be to let the weave take centre stage. If the fabric is heavily patterned or features prominent zari work, keep the jewellery relatively restrained. The aim is to complement the textile rather than compete with it.One practical consideration: traditional silk Banarasi pieces can be expensive and may need careful storage and maintenance. If you are buying your first piece, consider how frequently you will wear it and whether a dupatta or a lighter garment might be a more versatile starting point.2. Ajrakh: For a classy, artistic and quietly confident wardrobe If Banarasi is about grandeur, Ajrakh is about detail. This traditional block-printing craft is associated with Kutch in Gujarat and parts of Sindh, and is recognised for its geometric patterns, repeated motifs and rich combinations of indigo, red, black and earthy tones.What I find particularly appealing about Ajrakh is that it does not have to look festive to feel special. Its beauty lies in the intricacy of the print. The patterns can be striking without appearing overly ornate, which makes the fabric an interesting option for someone who wants Indian wear to feel sophisticated rather than heavily dressed up.I would consider Ajrakh one of the more versatile choices for building a wardrobe around Indian textiles. An Ajrakh kurta with straight cotton trousers can work for a casual lunch, a day of errands or a relaxed workday, depending on the garment and dress code. A printed shirt or tunic paired with well-fitted jeans is another way to make the craft feel contemporary.For a more traditional look, an Ajrakh dupatta can add depth to a simple solid-coloured kurta set. I would lean towards silver jewellery, understated earrings and neutral footwear to keep the overall outfit balanced.Who should choose Ajrakh?If you enjoy prints, earthy colours, artistic details and clothing that feels distinctive without being flashy, Ajrakh could be your match. It is also a good option if you are trying to move beyond plain kurtas but are not quite ready for heavily embellished Indian wear.The important thing is to pay attention to the actual fabric and printing technique. Ajrakh is a craft, not a guarantee that every garment will be made using the same process or materials. Check the fabric composition, printing method and care instructions before buying, particularly if you are looking for an authentic hand-block-printed piece.Of the four textiles I am exploring, Ajrakh has a particularly strong appeal for everyday styling. It offers a way to wear Indian craft without feeling as though you need a wedding invitation to justify the outfit.3. Chanderi: For a light, graceful and polished look Chanderi has a very different personality. Originating in the Madhya Pradesh town of Chanderi, the textile is known for its lightweight feel, delicate appearance and subtle sheen. Depending on the weave, it can combine silk, cotton and other fibres, creating fabrics that feel airy yet look refined.I find Chanderi beautiful, but I can also understand why it might feel a little challenging for someone who is just beginning to explore Indian wear. Its delicate appearance, potential sheerness and the way it falls on the body can make choosing the right garment and underlayers more important.That said, once you get the styling right, Chanderi can look stunning. It has a quiet sophistication that works especially well when you want to look dressed up without wearing something visibly heavy.A Chanderi kurta paired with cigarette trousers or straight pants is an easy starting point. For a more festive look, a Chanderi suit with a contrasting dupatta can create a beautiful balance between simplicity and detail. A Chanderi saree is also worth considering if you enjoy a lighter alternative to heavier occasion-wear fabrics.Who should choose Chanderi?Chanderi is worth exploring if you prefer delicate textures, lighter-looking outfits and a graceful silhouette. It is particularly appealing for daytime celebrations, intimate family functions, festive lunches and occasions when heavily embellished clothing feels excessive.My advice for beginners would be to start with a lined kurta or a well-constructed suit rather than immediately investing in a saree. Check the fabric's opacity, how it drapes and whether the garment needs a slip or lining. These small details can make a substantial difference to how comfortable and confident you feel wearing it.Also, do not assume that every Chanderi garment is delicate in exactly the same way. The fibre composition, weave and finish affect its care requirements, so follow the garment's specific instructions.For me, Chanderi is the textile that rewards a little patience. It might not be the first thing you reach for when you are unsure what to wear, but a thoughtfully chosen piece can become one of the most elegant items in your Indian wardrobe.4. Bandhani: For a timeless Indian look that works across generations Bandhani is one of those crafts that feels familiar without ever becoming irrelevant. Traditionally associated with Gujarat and Rajasthan, it is a form of tie-dye in which sections of fabric are tied before dyeing to create distinctive dotted patterns and designs.Its appeal lies in its versatility. Depending on the colours, pattern, fabric and silhouette, Bandhani can look festive, traditional, playful or contemporary. It is equally capable of bringing colour to a simple kurta set and becoming the focal point of a celebratory saree.What I particularly like about Bandhani is that it does not feel restricted to one age group. A young woman can wear a Bandhani dupatta with a simple kurta and jeans, while someone who prefers a more traditional wardrobe might choose a saree or a coordinated suit. The craft adapts to the person wearing it rather than demanding a particular aesthetic.For everyday styling, I would start with a Bandhani dupatta in a colour that complements pieces already in your wardrobe. It can instantly brighten a plain kurta without requiring an entirely new outfit. For festive occasions, a Bandhani saree or a coordinated set can deliver a more traditional look, especially when paired with classic earrings and comfortable footwear.Who should choose Bandhani?If you love colour, traditional Indian motifs and pieces you can style in several different ways, Bandhani is a strong choice. It is particularly useful for people who want to introduce more Indian textiles into their wardrobes gradually rather than buy an entirely new set of occasion wear.My practical tip is to think beyond the brightest or most elaborate versions of the craft. A Bandhani piece in a muted palette can feel just as striking as one in vivid colours, especially when the rest of the outfit is kept simple.As with any textile, check whether the garment is hand-tied, machine-produced or made using another method. Colourfastness and care requirements can vary, so avoid assuming that every Bandhani garment should be washed or stored in the same way.Banarasi vs Chanderi vs Bandhani vs Ajrakh: Which one should you choose?The easiest way to decide is to start with how you want your clothes to make you feel and where you intend to wear them.FabricThe overall aestheticBest suited forA good starting pieceBanarasiElegant, rich and timelessWeddings, festivals and dressier occasionsDupatta or woven skirtAjrakhClassy, artistic and understatedEveryday wear, casual outings and relaxed workdaysPrinted kurta or tunicChanderiLight, delicate and polishedDaytime celebrations and festive gatheringsLined kurta or suitBandhaniColourful, versatile and traditionalEveryday styling, festivals and family functionsDupatta or kurtaThese are starting points, not strict rules. A lighter Banarasi garment can work beyond weddings, a Chanderi piece can be styled casually, and Ajrakh or Bandhani can look festive depending on the garment and accessories.How I am approaching Indian wear differentlyAs I explore more Indian fabrics, I am realising that building a wardrobe around them does not mean abandoning contemporary clothing or dressing traditionally from head to toe. It is more about finding pieces that feel natural to my personal style.I am drawn to the elegance of Banarasi, particularly when the weave does the work instead of layers of embellishment. Ajrakh appeals to me for its classy, almost effortless character. Chanderi is something I would like to explore more carefully because the right fit and construction seem essential to enjoying it. And Bandhani feels like the kind of textile that can stay relevant in a wardrobe for years, regardless of changing trends.I would rather begin with one well-chosen piece than buy several garments simply because a particular textile is trending. A beautiful dupatta, for instance, can introduce a new craft into an existing wardrobe without requiring a complete style overhaul.I am also learning that the most flattering outfit is not necessarily the one with the most elaborate fabric or the highest price tag. It is the one that works with your comfort level, the occasion and the way you genuinely like to dress. That might mean wearing an Ajrakh kurta with jeans, pairing a Bandhani dupatta with a simple suit or choosing Banarasi when you want to feel particularly dressed up.There is no single Indian fabric that suits everyone best. The trick is to understand what each one brings to your wardrobe and choose accordingly.The verdict: Which Indian fabric suits your style best?If you love timeless elegance and a little grandeur, start with Banarasi. If you prefer understated sophistication and prints that can work beyond festive occasions, Ajrakh deserves your attention. If delicate textures and graceful silhouettes appeal to you, give Chanderi a chance, beginning with a well-constructed garment. And if you want a versatile, colourful textile that works across generations, Bandhani is difficult to overlook.Personally, I am leaning towards the elegance of Banarasi and the understated charm of Ajrakh, while keeping Chanderi and Bandhani on my list as I explore Indian wear further.Perhaps that is the best way to approach traditional textiles: not as trends to collect, but as crafts to discover, wear and make your own. title: Meet the 33-year-old Indian who cracked a  ₹33 crore deal on Shark Tank USA | Hindustan Times
description: The NID Ahmedabad alumnus spent three years refining the design, changing manufacturers seven times and making 16 trips to China before producing a single unit.
content: A spoon that looks like a flat, 0.1-inch bookmark can be folded into a teaspoon, tablespoon or precise measuring spoon. Who would’ve thought that this innovative design could win hearts and money, too! The origami-inspired invention, named Polygons, took Kolkata-born designer Rahul Agarwal to Shark Tank USA in June, where he secured a $3.5M (approx ₹33.03 crore) deal. When the episode aired last week, a clip of his pitch went viral, crossing 1.5 million views.Made from food-grade thermoplastic and hydrophobic silicone, with small magnets sealed inside, the spoon has brought attention to the National Institute of Design (NID) Ahmedabad alumnus and his invention. “In 2014, a senior at NID told me not to bother redesigning objects that had already reached perfection. He gave the example of a spoon,” recounts Agarwal, adding, “My immediate thought: challenge accepted. And I don’t even cook. Ego, it turns out, is the second mother of invention.”While the initial paper-and-plastic origami prototype took just three days to make, developing a durable, washable and manufacturable version took three years. “It involved over 1,000 iterations, changing manufacturers seven times, and making 16 trips to China before a single unit could be produced,” adds Agarwal.The 33-year-old says preparing for the pitch took considerable work. “I studied the great TV demos — Scrub Daddy, Slap Chop, and the like,” says Agarwal, adding, “When the call came to shoot the episode, I was on vacation with my family. I spent half the holiday in a hotel room writing and rewriting the script.”

title: Gold Loan Interest Rates: How Government Policies and Economic Changes Affect Borrowers | Hindustan Times
description: Changes in RBI rates can influence gold loan costs, while gold prices affect how much jewellery may secure.
content: Diwali is a few weeks away. A small shop owner needs fresh stock on the shelves, but most of the cash is stuck in the business. So what's the quickest way out? For many families, it's the jewellery kept at home. A loan against it can come through fast. What people often miss is that the gold loan interest rate on such a loan isn't fixed. It keeps moving with the economy.Anyone running a home budget or a small business will find it useful to know why. The gold loan rate of interest a lender quotes depends on a few things: what the central bank decides, how high inflation is, and how much money is moving around in the system. Once borrowers understand this, planning a loan gets a lot easier.How RBI Policy Shapes Gold Loan CostsMost of it starts with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The RBI lends money to banks at a rate called the repo rate. When that rate changes, loans across the market slowly follow, and loans against gold are no different. A repo rate cut usually opens the door to a lower gold loan interest rate. That means a lighter monthly repayment.The amount that can be borrowed matters too. The latest RBI guidelines for gold loan have applied since April 1, 2026. They set up a tiered Loan-to-Value (LTV) system. Put simply, on loans up to ₹2.5 lakh, a borrower can now get up to 85% of the gold's value. Earlier the limit was 75%. For a farmer or a small trader, that's more money from the same set of ornaments.Market Movements and Borrowing PowerThen there's the price of gold itself. The gold rate today has a direct say in how much money a borrower can raise. When world markets get nervous, or prices of everyday goods keep climbing, big investors buy gold to stay safe. Demand goes up, and so does the price.A higher gold rate today means the same pair of bangles can bring in a bigger loan. There's a catch, though. Lenders don't use just one day's price. They take whichever is lower, the 30-day average or the previous day's closing price. So a sudden one-day jump won't raise the loan amount straight away. Good gold prices also make lenders feel safer about the loan, and that can sometimes help the gold loan rate of interest. It depends on the lender.Choosing the Right Financial PartnerTiming is one part of it. The lender is the other. It's safer to go with an RBI-regulated lender that sticks closely to the new rules. Muthoot Finance is one such name. It has the largest gold loan portfolio among NBFCs in India and branches across the country, so help is usually close by. Processing is quick, and pledged gold is kept in secure vaults. There's also an online gold loan facility, which lets existing customers handle things like repayment without a branch visit.Informal moneylenders don't have to follow many rules. Regulated lenders do. Gold has to be valued at the 22-carat price published by IBJA or a SEBI-regulated exchange. Once a loan is fully repaid, the jewellery must be handed back within seven working days. If the lender is late, it pays the borrower ₹5,000 for every day of delay. And under income tax rules, cash payouts stop at ₹20,000. Anything more goes to a bank account.Planning the Loan WellIt's possible to check eligibility online before going to a branch at all. A gold loan calculator asks for the weight and purity of the jewellery, then uses the current gold price to show a rough loan amount. With that number in hand, deciding the loan size and repayment period is much simpler.Here's how some common economic changes can affect a gold loan borrower:What ChangesWhat It Means for the BorrowerRBI cuts the repo rateLoans may become cheaper over timeRBI raises the repo rateBorrowing costs may go upGold prices riseThe same jewellery can fetch a bigger loanGold prices fallThe loan limit shrinks, and the lender may ask for part payment or more goldInflation stays highGold prices often rise, but RBI may keep rates high to control pricesUseful Tips Before BorrowingGetting a gold loan isn't hard. Still, a few small checks can save trouble later:Read the Key Fact Statement (KFS): Every lender has to give this document. It shows the gold loan interest rate and repayment terms on one page.Match tenure with income: In a bullet repayment loan, the principal and interest are paid together at the end. These loans are now capped at 12 months. If income comes in slowly, monthly EMIs may be easier to manage.Check the numbers first: Spending a minute on a gold loan calculator before applying helps avoid borrowing more than needed.Keep documents ready: Loans up to ₹2.5 lakh don't usually need a detailed income check. KYC papers like Aadhaar and PAN are still needed, though. Since anything above ₹20,000 goes to a bank account, it helps to have an active one.ConclusionA gold loan is still one of the easiest ways to get money fast. Borrowers who keep an eye on RBI decisions and gold prices can plan better. And with higher LTV limits on small loans, the same jewellery now brings in more.Before going ahead, it's worth working out how much is really needed and checking where gold prices stand. Then it comes down to picking an experienced, RBI-regulated lender. Muthoot Finance, with its reach across India and quick disbursal, is a name many families already trust.Note to readers: This article is part of HT's paid consumer connect initiative and is independently created by the brand.
