title: Hyderabad Metro : హైదరాబాద్ మెట్రో ప్రయాణికులకు బిగ్ న్యూస్.. 60 కొత్త కోచ్‌ల‌తో 10 రైళ్లు | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Hyderabad Metro : హైదరాబాద్ మెట్రోకు మరిన్ని కోచ్‌లు రానున్నాయి. 60 కొత్త కోచ్‌లను ప్రవేశపెట్టాలని నిర్ణయించారు. దీనిద్వారా కొత్తగా 10 రైళ్లు నడవనున్నాయి.
content: హైదరాబాద్ మెట్రో రైలు ప్రయాణికులకు త్వరలోనే మరిన్ని మెరుగైన సేవలు అందుబాటులోకి రానున్నాయి. నగరంలో రోజురోజుకూ పెరుగుతున్న ప్రయాణికుల రద్దీని తట్టుకునేందుకు, భవిష్యత్ అవసరాలను తీర్చేందుకు గాను మెట్రో నెట్‌వర్క్‌కు కొత్తగా 60 కోచ్‌లను జోడించేందుకు హైదరాబాద్ మెట్రో సిద్ధమైంది.సుమారు రూ. 923.62 కోట్ల అంచనా వ్యయంతో చేపట్టనున్న ఈ భారీ ప్రాజెక్ట్ కోసం డిజైన్, తయారీ, సరఫరా, నిర్వహణకు సంబంధించి అంతర్జాతీయ స్థాయిలో బిడ్డర్ల నుంచి టెండర్లను ఆహ్వానించారు. హైదరాబాద్ మెట్రో రైల్ లిమిటెడ్(HMRL) తరఫున ఢిల్లీ మెట్రో రైల్ కార్పొరేషన్ లిమిటెడ్ కొనుగోలు ప్రక్రియను పర్యవేక్షిస్తోంది. ఈ ప్రాజెక్ట్‌కు తెలంగాణ ప్రభుత్వం నిధులు సమకూరుస్తుండగా, హెచ్‌ఎంఆర్‌ఎల్ ప్రాజెక్ట్ యజమానిగా ఉంటుంది.జనవరి 13, 2027 వరకు బిడ్లు దాఖలు చేసేందుకు అవకాశం ఉంది. 15 సంవత్సరాల పాటు కోచ్‌లు, డిపో పరికరాలు, సంబంధిత యంత్రాల సమగ్ర నిర్వహణ కోసం బిడ్లను ఆహ్వానిస్తూ.. టెండర్ నోటిఫికేషన్ జారీ చేశారు. డిజైన్, తయారీ, టెస్టింగ్, కమిషనింగ్ పూర్తి చేయడానికి 125 వారాల సమయం కేటాయించారు.కాంట్రాక్ట్ పొందిన సంస్థ కొత్త కోచ్‌ల డిజైన్, తయారీ, సరఫరా, టెస్టింగ్, కమీషనింగ్‌తో పాటు మెట్రో సిబ్బందికి అవసరమైన శిక్షణను ఇవ్వాల్సి ఉంటుంది. కొత్త కోచ్‌లకు మద్దతుగా డిపోలోని యంత్రాలు, టెస్టింగ్ పరికరాలు, ప్రత్యేక పరికరాల మెయింటెనెన్స్‌ను కూడా 15 ఏళ్ల పాటు నిర్వహించాల్సి ఉంటుంది.ప్రస్తుతం రద్దీ సమయాల్లో మెట్రో రైళ్లలో విపరీతమైన తోపులాట ఎదుర్కొంటున్న ప్రయాణికులకు ఈ కొత్త కోచ్‌ల రాక పెద్ద ఊరటనివ్వనుంది. కొత్త కోచ్‌లు అందుబాటులోకి వస్తే రైళ్ల ఫ్రీక్వెన్సీ పెరగడమే కాకుండా ప్రయాణికుల సామర్థ్యం కూడా గణనీయంగా పెరుగుతుంది. అయితే ఈ కొత్త కోచ్‌లను ఏ రూట్లలో నడుపుతారు, ఏ తేదీ నుండి అందుబాటులోకి తెస్తారు అనేది ప్రాజెక్ట్ పురోగతి ఆధారంగా అధికారులు ప్రకటించనున్నారు. ఈ 60 కొత్త కోచ్‌లు వస్తే అదనంగా మరో 10 కొత్త రైళ్లను నడపవచ్చు. ఒక్కోటి 6 కోచ్‌లతో ఉంటుందిఒకవైపు కొత్త కోచ్‌ల కొనుగోలు ప్రక్రియ సాగుతుండగా, మరోవైపు నగరంలో మెట్రో నెట్‌వర్క్ విస్తరణకు హెచ్‌ఎంఆర్‌ఎల్ వేగంగా అడుగులు వేస్తోంది. పాతబస్తీ కారిడార్ దారుల్షిఫా - చంద్రాయణగుట్ట మధ్య 7.5 కి.మీ కారిడార్ రోడ్డు వెడల్పు పనులను అదనపు మేనేజింగ్ డైరెక్టర్ బి. అజిత్ రెడ్డి ఇటీవల సమీక్షించారు. 888 ఆస్తుల్లో ఇప్పటికే 833 ఆస్తుల భూసేకరణ పూర్తయింది.

title: Delhi sees rise in temprature, no rainfall in last 24 hours; AQI remains ‘poor’ | Latest News Delhi
description: The minimum temperature rose at all five weather stations compared with the previous day, with increases ranging from 0.3 to 1.7 degrees Celsius.  | Latest News Delhi
content: Delhi’s minimum temperature rose across all five weather stations on Thursday, with Safdarjung recording a 1.7-degree Celsius jump in 24 hours to settle at 19.7 degrees Celsius, while Lodhi Road recorded the highest departure from normal at two degrees above average, according to India Meteorological Department data.The capital's air quality remained in the poor category in the morning, with the Air Quality Index being recorded at 226.Temperature risesThe minimum temperature at Safdarjung, Delhi’s base weather station, stood at 19.7 degrees Celsius, 1.3 degrees above normal, while Palam recorded a minimum of 18.7 degrees Celsius, 0.2 degrees below normal. The minimum temperature at Palam rose by 0.9 degrees Celsius compared with the previous day.Lodhi Road recorded a minimum temperature of 19 degrees Celsius, two degrees above normal, following a 1.3-degree-Celsius rise in 24 hours. The Ridge recorded a minimum of 19.4 degrees Celsius, 0.1 degrees below normal, while Ayanagar logged 19.3 degrees Celsius, 0.5 degrees above normal.The minimum temperature rose across all five weather stations compared with the previous day, with the increase ranging from 0.3 degrees Celsius at the Ridge to 1.7 degrees Celsius at Safdarjung.Meanwhile, the maximum temperature recorded at Safdarjung on Wednesday was 32.1 degrees Celsius, 0.5 degrees below normal. Palam recorded a maximum of 29.5 degrees Celsius, 3.3 degrees below normal, while Lodhi Road and Ayanagar logged 31.8 degrees Celsius each.No rainfall was recorded at any of the five stations in the 24 hours ending at 8.30am on Thursday, according to the IMD.Delhi's AQIAccording to data from 56 of 59 monitoring stations, Chandni Chowk, Vivek Vihar, and Jahangirpuri recorded air quality in the very poor zone, with readings of 307, 306, and 309, respectively.Nineteen stations recorded air quality in the moderate zone while the remaining were in the poor category at 7.05 am on Thursday.Delhi woke up to its foulest air in more than three months on Wednesday, as smoke from Dussehra celebrations, trapped by still, damp night air, pushed the AQ into the poor category and prompted the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) to invoke Stage I of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) across Delhi-NCR.The AQI climbed from 179 on Tuesday to 245 at 4pm on Wednesday, the highest reading of the season and the worst since July 13, when it stood at 246. The 66-point jump was the third-largest the day after Dussehra in the past decade, and Wednesday’s reading was the worst for the day after the festival since 2021, when the index stood at 284.Farm fires set to add to the burdenThe Decision Support System for Air Quality Management in Delhi forecasts stubble burning's share of the city's pollution to rise from 3.9% on Wednesday to 7.4% on Thursday and 15.9% on Friday, and the India Meteorological Department and the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology expect the air to stay poor over the coming days.

title: Mouli Comments: న్యూస్ ఛానెల్ వాళ్లు కాల్ చేసి బ్లాక్ మెయిల్ చేశారు.. చేసేదేం లేక వెళ్లా: యంగ్ హీరో మౌళి సంచలన కామెంట్లు | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: Mouli Comments: టాలీవుడ్ లో ఆచితూచి అడుగులు వేస్తూ దూసుకెళ్తున్నాడు యంగ్ హీరో మౌళి. లిటిల్ హార్ట్స్ తో ఆడియన్స్ హార్ట్స్ దోసేసిన అతను ఇప్పుడు దొంగ నా కొడుకు మూవీ చేస్తున్నాడు. ఈ మూవీ టీజర్ లాంఛ్ ఈవెంట్లో మౌళి కామెంట్లు కలకం రేపుతున్నాయి.
content: Mouli Comments: డిజిటల్ ప్రపంచం నుంచి వెండితెరకు ఎంట్రీ ఇచ్చి సక్సెస్ సాధించడం అంత సులువు కాదు. యూట్యూబర్ మౌళి తనుజ్ ప్రశాంత్ తన మొదటి సినిమా 'లిటిల్ హార్ట్స్' చిత్రంతో బాక్సాఫీస్ వద్ద స్లీపర్ హిట్ అందుకొని అందరి దృష్టిని ఆకర్షించాడు. ఈ రొమాంటిక్ కామెడీ ఎంటర్‌టైనర్‌తో నటుడిగా మంచి గుర్తింపు తెచ్చుకున్నాడు మౌళి.మౌళి కామెంట్లుతాజాగా జరిగిన 'దొంగ నా కొడుకు' సినిమా టీజర్ లాంచ్ ఈవెంట్‌లో మౌళి తన మనసులోని ఆవేదనను బయటపెట్టాడు. ఈ ఒక్క ఏడాదిలోనే తను ఇండస్ట్రీలో ఎంతో ద్వేషాన్ని, అసూయను ఎదుర్కొన్నానని చెప్పాడు. తనపై ఎందుకు అంత నెగెటివిటీ చూపించారో పూర్తి వివరాలు ఇప్పుడు బయటపెట్టలేనని, కానీ ఒక సంఘటన మాత్రం తనను తీవ్రంగా కలిచివేసిందని ఆవేదన వ్యక్తం చేశాడు.ఆసక్సెస్ వెనుకాలే ఒక భయంకరమైన, చేదు అనుభవాన్ని మౌళి ఎదుర్కొన్నాడు. తాజాగా ఆయన చేసిన వ్యాఖ్యలు ఇప్పుడు సోషల్ మీడియాలో విపరీతంగా వైరల్ అవుతున్నాయి.బ్లాక్‌మెయిల్ చేశారు'లిటిల్ హార్ట్స్' సినిమా విడుదలై మంచి విజయం సాధించిన తర్వాత ఒక ప్రముఖ న్యూస్ ఛానల్ నుండి మౌళికి పిలుపు వచ్చింది. వారి ఛానల్ నిర్వహించే ఒక ఈవెంట్ కు గెస్ట్ గా రావాలని మౌళిని ఇన్వైట్ చేశారు. అయితే ఆ సమయంలో మౌళికి ఒంట్లో అస్సలు బాగోలేదు. దీంతో తను రాలేనని చాలా మర్యాదగా వాళ్లకు చెప్పాడు.కానీ ఆ ఛానల్ ప్రతినిధులు మాత్రం దానికి ఒప్పుకోకుండా, ఒకవేళ రాకపోతే భవిష్యత్తులో వచ్చే సినిమాలపై దెబ్బకొడతామంటూ బహిరంగంగానే బ్లాక్‌మెయిల్ చేశారని మౌళి సంచలన నిజం బయటపెట్టాడు.భయపడే ఆ ప్రోగ్రామ్‌కి వెళ్లానుతమలాంటి పెద్ద ఛానల్స్ బెదిరిస్తే చిన్న నటులు భయపడిపోతారని, ఏమీ చేయలేరని వారు భావించారని, అది నిజమేనని మౌళి ఒప్పుకున్నాడు. ఆ సమయంలో తాను తీవ్రమైన భయాందోళనకు గురయ్యానని, చేసేదేమీ లేక అనారోగ్యంతో ఉన్నా కూడా ఆ కార్యక్రమానికి హాజరయ్యానని తెలిపాడు.సినిమా రంగంలో తనకంటూ ఒక లక్ష్యం ఉందని, ఇక్కడ మనుగడ సాగించాలంటే ఇలాంటి అవమానాలను, బెదిరింపులను తట్టుకొని ముందుకు వెళ్లక తప్పదని మౌళి ఎమోషనల్ అయ్యాడు. ఒక యువ ప్రతిభావంతుడికి ఇలాంటి అనుభవం ఎదురవడంపై నెటిజన్లు సదరు ఛానల్ పై తీవ్ర ఆగ్రహం వ్యక్తం చేస్తున్నారు.దొంగ నా కొడుకు గురించిమౌళి హీరోగా నటించిన దొంగ నా కొడుకు మూవీపై క్రమంగా బజ్ క్రియేట్ అవుతోంది. ఈ సినిమా నవంబర్ 13, 2026న థియేటర్లలోకి రానుంది. దీనికి శ్రును కంబాల డైరెక్టర్. అతనికి ఇదే ఫస్ట్ మూవీ. మైత్రీ మూవీ మేకర్స్ ఈ మూవీని నిర్మిస్తోంది.

title: Tadoba tiger reserve introduces sensor-based system to manage wildlife waterholes | Mumbai news
description: Tadoba tiger reserve introduces sensor-based system to manage wildlife waterholes  | Mumbai news
content: Chandrapur, The Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in Maharashtra's Chandrapur district has introduced a sensor-based system on a pilot basis to regulate water levels at wildlife waterholes, reduce wastage and ensure reliable water availability for animals, officials said.Describing it as a first-of-its-kind initiative in wildlife waterhole management, TATR Field Director Dr Prabhu Nath Shukla said the device automatically starts and stops pumps based on water levels.The system activates the pump when the water level falls below a predefined limit and switches it off once the water reaches the upper level, preventing overflow and unnecessary pumping, he said in a release issued on Wednesday.The initiative comes at a time when drought conditions and uncertainty over future water availability have made efficient water management increasingly important.TATR has around 130 natural water sources and 350 artificial waterholes, many of which are supported by solar-powered pumping systems. Despite last summer's intense heat, no water tankers were required to refill these waterholes, the release said.However, solar-powered pumps often continue to operate even after waterholes are full, leading to overflow. While some excess water serves as wallowing spots for wild animals, manually switching off the pumps can be risky for staff and is not an efficient solution.Shukla said the sensor-based system would help reduce water loss, limit unnecessary groundwater extraction and minimise the need for continuous human monitoring.The device comprises a level sensor, controller and relay connected to the pump. It functions automatically, ensuring water availability while reducing manual intervention, he added."TATR is presenting the system as a first-of-its-kind sensor-based approach to wildlife waterhole management. Its wider use could strengthen water conservation, help the management in providing water availability to the wildlife even during drought conditions, and also aid groundwater conservation," said Shukla.To improve the spatial distribution of water sources across the reserve, TATR has divided its core area into grids and plans to provide waterholes in each grid. The exercise, aimed at ensuring equitable access to water for wildlife across the reserve, is expected to be completed this year, the release said.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

title: Two teen siblings safely rescued as fire breaks out in their house in East Delhi | Latest News Delhi
description: Both rescued children, aged around 15 and 16, were rushed to Guru Teg Bahadur (GTB) Hospital, where their condition is stated to be normal.  | Latest News Delhi
content: Two minor siblings were safely rescued after a fire broke out in a house in Balbir Nagar Extension near Shahdara in east Delhi in the early hours of Thursday, trapping them inside a room on the ground floor, fire department officials said.Both rescued children, aged around 15 and 16, were rushed to Guru Teg Bahadur (GTB) Hospital, where their condition is stated to be normal. However, it was not immediately known whether the teenagers were injured in the fire.A Delhi Fire Services (DFS) official said the fire control room received a call at 1.50am, regarding a fire in a house in Balbir Nagar Extension, Gali Number-16, Nala Road. Initially, five water tenders were rushed from Shahdara fire station. Around 2am, one more water tender was dispatched.“The firefighters stopped the blaze and returned to the fire station at 3.15am. Fire station officer Anoop reported that the fire was in an electric scooter and a motorcycle. Due to smoke, two children were trapped inside a room on the ground floor. They were rescued and rushed to the GTB Hospital in a CATS ambulance,” the DFS official said.The building comprises the ground and first floors and occupies a 40-square-yard area. Although a short circuit is suspected to be the possible cause of the fire, the local police have initiated a probe to ascertain the exact reason, another official said.

title: Venezuelan crude, Russian oil, trade deal: What US Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s India visit signalled | India News
description: The trip offered a clear view of the Trump administration’s priorities in India, with energy, and Venezuelan crude in particular, at the top. | India News
content: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Wednesday concluded a two-day India visit that departed from diplomatic convention, bypassing New Delhi for Mumbai and the Reliance Industries’ vast refinery complex in Jamnagar. The trip, which came as Washington and New Delhi edge closer to a long-awaited trade deal, offered a clear view of the Trump administration’s priorities in India, with energy, and Venezuelan crude in particular, at the top.HT looks at the big takeaways from Rubio’s visit:Tribute and talks in MumbaiRubio, who arrived in Mumbai on Tuesday, began his visit by laying a wreath at a memorial for the victims of the 26/11 terror attacks, in which six Americans were also killed. He then met External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar for a meeting that largely focused on trade, energy, defence, technology and people-to-people relations. On Wednesday, the US Secretary of State focused on meetings with India’s largest business houses, meeting Tata chief N Chandrasekaran and Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani before heading to Jamnagar for a tour with Reliance chairman Mukesh Ambani. Reliance said the visit centred on the firm’s massive refinery in the city, upcoming new energy giga-factories and data centres.Also read | Trump's Russia oil tariff waiver, the midterm election calculus behind it and the stakes for India-US trade dealMumbai over DelhiRubio’s decision to visit Mumbai and skip Delhi, the usual stop for visiting dignitaries, drew much attention. But the focus on Mumbai, and particularly his closely watched meeting with Reliance Industries, said a lot about his priorities.Washington has made clear that it wants India to purchase more energy from Venezuela in the aftermath of an American military operation that toppled President Nicolas Maduro in January this year. Over the last year, the Trump administration has played an increasingly large role in running Venezuela’s highly lucrative oil sector. The government even brokered an agreement giving it a major ownership stake in NABEP, an energy firm that has been handed control of oil fields holding 65 billion barrels of proven reserves.Given Venezuela’s staggering overdependence on oil export revenues and Washington’s need to shore up the US-backed government currently in power, the Trump administration has been looking for major export markets for Venezuelan energy. That is where Reliance, which runs the world’s largest refinery complex in Jamnagar, fits into Rubio and the administration’s calculations.Also read | Russia sanctions pause to assess impact on India, global energy prices, says Trump officialIndia has ramped up crude oil imports from Venezuela in recent months, with much of the energy heading to Reliance’s refinery in Jamnagar. According to analytics firm Kpler, Reliance accounted for an estimated 76% of India’s crude oil imports from Venezuela in September this year. Rubio said he would discuss Venezuela with Reliance and even spoke of India’s position as a “refining superpower”.Confronting anti-India sentimentRubio also made notable remarks on key challenges in the US-India relationship. He became one of the few senior Trump administration officials to directly address concerns over rising anti-Indian hatred, attributing it to “ignorance” and “hatred” among small groups in American society. Besides, he stressed the importance of senior leaders refraining from encouraging such sentiment.The US Secretary of State’s remarks on India’s Russian oil purchases were also significant. He said that maintaining a strong relationship with India was one factor behind President Trump’s recent decision to waive tariffs on India and other countries for buying Russian energy.Also read | ‘Very, very close’: Marco Rubio on India-US trade deal after meeting with EAM JaishankarLast week, Trump announced that he would waive tariffs that could have targeted India and four nations for purchasing Russian oil and gas, just a month after the House of Representatives passed an act giving him the power to levy up to 100% tariffs on the top five purchasers of Russian energy.Rubio also acknowledged that it would be difficult for India to move away from Russian crude in a short time. This suggests that at least some of India’s messaging about its energy relationship with Russia is getting through to senior decision makers.On the trade deal, Rubio asserted the two sides are “very, very close” with just a few remaining details left to be ironed out.

title: Schaeffler India CEO Harsha Kadam taken into custody over fatal accident near Pune, SOP lapses under scrutiny | Hindustan Times
description: The accident occurred while workers were replacing old carbon dioxide (CO₂) cylinders in a fire suppression system at the company’s facility.
content: Alleged lapses in following standard operating procedures (SOPs), failure to ensure mandatory safety measures, and delays in rescue efforts have come to the fore after Schaeffler India CEO Harsha Kadam was taken into custody on Tuesday in connection with a June factory accident that killed two workers and injured three others.The accident occurred on June 9, 2026, while workers were replacing old carbon dioxide (CO₂) cylinders in a fire suppression system at the company’s facility.Also Read I Pune reports first suspected dengue death of the year; girl, 9, diesLacked adequate ventilation, emergency exitThe deceased were identified as Vaibhav Thorat and Gaurishankar Sharma. According to the Pimpri-Chinchwad police, work was undertaken in a pit/basement without the requisite permission from the Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health. The area allegedly lacked adequate ventilation or an emergency exit.The furnace plant too wasn’t shut down, and adequate checks were not carried out to ensure that the work complied with prescribed SOPs.Shweta Khedkar, deputy commissioner of police (zone 4), said, “The accused was detained. Later, he was facing a blood pressure-related issue. Hence, he was hospitalised and medical treatment is underway.” According to Khedkar, a report was submitted in court and further procedure is underway. According to the Pimpri-Chinchwad police, work was being carried out in the heat-treatment pit at Shafalar company without obtaining permission from the office of the deputy director, Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health. A total of 14 carbon dioxide (CO₂) cylinders were to be replaced, eight of which had already been replaced. However, all the cylinders were kept at the site simultaneously, in violation of SOPs that require cylinders to be replaced one at a time rather than keeping them all in one place. All these lapses were mentioned in a report made by the Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health.The police also cited a lack of coordination that allegedly delayed rescue operations following the accident.Also Read I No chai, coffee or cooked food at Pune railway station grocery kiosksInitially an accidental death report (ADR) was filed at Talegaon MIDC police station. After detailed investigation of the ADR, an FIR was filed at Talegaon MIDC police station on July 4 under sections 106(1), 125(B), 125(B), and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

title: Andhra Pradesh: 1 killed in stick fight as part of annual Banni festival | India News
description: The annual festival is part of post-Dussehra festivities to pay obeisance to Sri Mala Malleswara Swamy | India News
content: One person was killed, and over 100 were injured in “Karrala Samaram”, a stick fight as part of the annual Banni festival in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district on Thursday, police said.The annual festival is held in Devaragattu as part of post-Dussehra festivities to pay obeisance to Sri Mala Malleswara Swamy.Police said despite the injuries, devotees continued to participate in a centuries-old ritual, in which groups from different villages compete to gain possession of the idols of the presiding deity. A police officer said Pothuraju, 28, a resident of Alur, died after being struck with sticks as devotees attempted to take control of the idols.The injured were shifted to the government hospital in Alur for treatment. Medical camps were set up at the venue to provide emergency care to those wounded in the fight.Thousands of devotees from Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and Maharashtra participated in Banni.The festivities began with the ceremonial wedding of Sri Mala Malleswara Swamy, conducted by Vedic priest Ravi Sharma after midnight on Wednesday. Following the ritual, the festival idols were carried in a palanquin from a hilltop to the Simhasana Katta at the foothills.After special prayers and a Maha Mangala Harathi, the Banni victory procession, known as the deity’s Banni Jaitrayatra, commenced. Devotees entered the fray with sticks and torches as they sought to take possession of the festival idols.The hill reverberated with traditional slogans, as thousands of devotees, many covered in turmeric powder, gathered under the glow of torches. Sticks were swung in the air during the confrontation, resulting in several devotees suffering head injuries and other serious wounds. The fight continued for more than half an hour.The ritual is traditionally associated with a symbolic battle among devotees. The celebrations continued from midnight until dawn on the Devaragattu hill, approximately 800 feet high.

title: J&K medicos call off strike after CM Omar Abdullah promises 100% stipend hike | Hindustan Times
description: Interns first launched a strike on August 30, arguing that their stipends were the lowest in the country.
content: After sustained protests and strikes by medical interns of Jammu and Kashmir for the enhancement of their stipends, the Omar Abdullah-led government on Wednesday heeded their demand and issued orders to raise the amount from ₹12,300 to ₹25,000 per month, an increase of over 100%. Following the orders, the medical interns called off their strike and welcomed the decision.The office of chief minister said that the government has formally notified the decision. “In a significant decision, the government of Jammu and Kashmir has formally notified the enhancement of the monthly stipend for MBBS/BDS interns, including foreign medical graduates (FMGs), from ₹12,300 to ₹25,000, effective October 1, 2026,” Abdullah’s office said.“Recognising the vital contribution of young medical professionals to J&K’s healthcare system, the decision provides much-needed financial support while acknowledging their dedication and commitment to patient care,” it said.Also Read I Landmark at 11,500 ft, regular high court hearings begin in LehSaugat Biswas, commissioner secretary to the government, health and medical education department, in an order, said that the interns will get the new stipend with effect from October 1. The decision follows repeated protests and strikes by medical interns across government hospitals in the UT since August this year. The ruling National Conference (NC) said that the decision was aimed to help the young doctors of the Union territory.Strikes for stipend revisionInterns first launched a strike on August 30, arguing that their stipends were the lowest in the country. They suspended the protest on September 8 after health and medical education minister Sakina Itoo assured them of a revision within a month.However, with no progress eight months after the government initially recommended the hike to the finance department during the February assembly session, the interns resumed a pen-down strike on Tuesday.Following the end of the strike on Wednesday, Mohammad Momin Khan, president of the J&K chapter of the All India Medical Students’ Association, welcomed the stipend hike for MBBS and BDS interns.“We thank everyone including officials and politicians from the ruling as well as the opposition. They supported these doctors a lot. Now, our focus shifts to PG residents like MD, MS and MDS. If states like Uttar Pradesh and Delhi are paying PG doctors over ₹1lakh, why not government must address this disparity too” he said. Dr Mohammad Akib Javid, joint secretary of the J&K chapter of All India Medical Students’ Association, thanked the CM and Itoo for approving the revision. “Today is a significant and proud moment for all MBBS and BDS interns of Jammu and Kashmir,” Javid said in a statement.National Convenor of J&K Students Association, Nasir Khuehami, also welcomed the decision. “The enhancement of the monthly stipend for MBBS/BDS interns, including FMGs, is a welcome and long-overdue decision. Many thanks to the CM for addressing this longstanding demand. The increase will provide much-needed financial relief and recognise the hard work of medical interns,” he said.Also Read I Secretary tourism reviews functioning of directorate, key projects in JammuHealth minister Sakina Itoo said that the government stands by its promises. “We stand by the promises we make, and we deliver on our commitments. This significant enhancement in the stipend of medical interns reflects our belief that the government is of the people, by the people and for the people. Grateful to the CM for this important decision that recognises the dedication of our young medical professionals and strengthens healthcare in J&K,” she said.

title: Two dead, 17 injured after bus rolls down gorge in Jammu and Kashmir's Udhampur | Hindustan Times
description: Officials said the bus (JK02AL-3477) was heading from Panchound to Ramnagar when the driver lost control at Gulli Gala.
content: A five-year-old girl and a woman were killed, and 17 others injured, after a passenger bus veered off the road and rolled down a 50 feet deep gorge at Gulli Gala in the Latti area of Udhampur’s Ramnagar tehsil on Wednesday morning.Officials said the bus (JK02AL-3477) was heading from Panchound to Ramnagar when the driver lost control at Gulli Gala.Also Read I Secretary tourism reviews functioning of directorate, key projects in JammuBad road, ongoing repairs, overspeedingThe deceased were identified as Takshika (5), daughter of Rakesh Kumar, a resident of Chatrari, and 24-year-old Sunita Devi, wife of Kuldeep Kumar of Panchound. The injured were rushed to the Sub-District Hospital (SDH) in Ramnagar for treatment.“The road is bad and repairs are being done, but the bus driver, Munshi Ram, was overspeeding the vehicle. He apparently failed to negotiate a sharp bend, and as a result, the bus plunged into the deep gorge,” said a police officer.He informed that the bus driver, who suffered minor injuries, has been arrested and a case under Section 105 (3) of BNS has been registered. Police said that the injured were being treated at Government Medical College, Udhampur, and are reported to be stable. Earlier during the day, Union minister and local Member of Parliament Dr Jitendra Singh contacted Udhampur deputy commissioner Ananth Dwivedi to review the situation and assured all necessary administrative and medical assistance to the victims. Lieutenant governor Manoj Sinha and chief minister Omar Abdullah voiced grief over the incident, and assured all necessary assistance to the victims and their families.LG office and Omar Abdullah remarkIn a post on X, the office of LG wrote, “Distressed to learn about the loss of lives due to a tragic bus accident in Ramnagar, Udhampur. My condolences to the bereaved families. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured.”“I have directed the district administration to provide all necessary assistance to the affected families and ensure the best possible treatment to those who have been injured in the accident,” the post reads.Abdullah also extended condolences to the bereaved families and directed the authorities to ensure the best possible medical care and assistance to the injured. The CM’s Office is in constant touch with the authorities concerned and is closely monitoring the situation, officials said.Also Read I Bus plunges into gorge in Jammu and Kashmir's Udhampur, 10 injuredSenior BJP leader and MLA Sunil Bhardwaj visited the Ramnagar hospital to enquire about the condition of the injured passengers. He voiced concern over the condition of the road where the accident occurred and emphasised the need for its upgradation to ensure safer travel for commuters. He also highlighted the importance of strengthening healthcare facilities in the constituency to ensure timely medical assistance and better treatment for people, particularly during emergencies.

title: Char Dham yatra enters final phase as footfall crosses 6 million mark | India News
description: Badrinath Dham remained the most visited shrine this season, recording 2,069,866 pilgrims, while Kedarnath Dham followed with 1,775,059 pilgrims. | India News
content: The Char Dham Yatra has entered its final phase, with over six million pilgrims having visited the Himalayan shrines so far this season, officials said. The total footfall stood at 6,031,017 till Tuesday evening.Last year over 5 million pilgrims had visited Char Dham Shrines, while in 2023 , over 5.6 million pilgrims had visited the four shrines. The yatra, which began on April 19, will conclude for the winter after the portals of Badrinath Dham are closed on November 16.Also Read I KSRTC makes extensive arrangements for Sabarimala pilgrimageOfficials said that Badrinath Dham remained the most visited shrine this season, recording 2,069,866 pilgrims, while Kedarnath Dham followed with 1,775,059 pilgrims, officials said.Uttarkashi district magistrate Prashant Arya said the administration is focusing on preparations for the winter Char Dham Yatra. Once the deities move to their winter abodes at Mukhba for Goddess Ganga and Kharsali for Goddess Yamuna, pilgrims will be able to continue their pilgrimage there. He added that various executive agencies had been directed to ensure the convenience of pilgrims and smooth arrangements throughout the season. The winter Char Dham Yatra for Kedarnath will begin after the closure of its portals and the arrival of the deity at the winter abode in Ukhimath. Rajkumar Tiwari, president of Shree Kedar Sabha Teerth Purohit Samaj, Kedarnath, said the winter pilgrimage last year attracted a large number of tourists to Ukhimath. “Once the deity reaches the winter abode, pilgrims will be able to have continuous darshan during the winter season too along with other nearby dhams, including Trijugi Narayan temple,” Tiwari said.

title: 2027 poll preparation: Akhilesh Yadav to meet Azam Khan in Rampur jail today | Hindustan Times
description: Party sources see the meeting as a clear signal that Khan remains a key figure and has not been sidelined, countering opposition claims
content: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav is scheduled to visit senior leader and former Uttar Pradesh minister Azam Khan at Rampur District Jail on Thursday, October 22, and later meet his family. The visit bears significance in a region with a sizeable Muslim population and comes as the party intensifies preparations for the 2027 Assembly elections.Party sources see the meeting as a clear signal that Khan remains a key figure and has not been sidelined, countering opposition claims. It follows All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen chief Asaduddin Owaisi’s recent visit to Rampur, underscoring competitive outreach in western Uttar Pradesh.Discussions between Yadav and Khan are expected to cover electoral strategy, particularly in the Moradabad division where Azam Khan has long held influence, along with potential candidates and alliance possibilities.Also read: ED questions Azam Khan in Rampur jail over Jauhar Trust fund trailSpeaking to the media in Lucknow on Wednesday, Akhilesh Yadav said, “The atrocities and injustice against Azam Khan and his family are not hidden from anyone. This government has done great injustice to him and his family. The Samajwadi Party will continue to fight for his justice, as it has been doing.”Azam Khan has been lodged in Rampur District Jail since November 17, 2025, after a special MP/MLA court convicted him and his son Abdullah Azam Khan in a 2019 dual PAN card forgery case involving cheating, forgery and criminal conspiracy.Both initially received seven-year sentences; however, a sessions court later enhanced Azam Khan’s term to 10 years. Over 110 cases have been registered against him over the years, with convictions in around eight.Also read: Two PAN card case: Azam Khan’s sentence enhanced to 10 yearsIn May 2026, he was also sentenced to two years in a 2019 case over “tankhaiyya” remarks against officials. A fresh FIR based on an Enforcement Directorate complaint over alleged financial irregularities at Mohammad Ali Jauhar University, which he founded, was registered in mid-October.Despite prolonged incarceration, Azam Khan’s influence has persisted. During the 2022 Assembly elections, the SP-Rashtriya Lok Dal alliance performed strongly in western UP, with the SP winning 17 of 27 seats in the Moradabad division, including multiple seats in Rampur, Sambhal, Moradabad and adjoining districts. Akhilesh had given weight to Azam Khan’s input on ticket distribution at the time.Sources indicate that Thursday’s meeting could address candidate selection, ongoing party surveys, and issues the SP may highlight, such as the Jauhar University matter and the Sambhal violence linked to a temple-mosque dispute. Alliance talks, particularly with the Congress and seat-sharing challenges in western UP, may also be discussed.Also read: Keeping up with UP| Azam Khan: The new face of Muslim victimhoodThe visit is expected to reinforce the SP’s organisational presence and message of continuity in a competitive political landscape with less than a few months remaining for the 2027 UP assembly polls.

title: In 2025, three African wild dog brothers travelled 4,126 km across Zambia in eight months, a record dispersal distance for an African mammal | World News
description: A 2025 study found three wild dog brothers left their Zambian pack and traveled 4,126 km in eight months, the longest trek recorded for an African mammal.  | World News
content: The Serengeti wildebeest migration is one of Africa’s best-known animal journeys, yet the longest African round-trip migration on record, by blue wildebeest, is 650 kilometers (about 404 miles), according to the UN Convention on Migratory Species. A very different trip has now gone far beyond that. A study published in the journal Ecology found that three wild dog brothers in Zambia traveled 4,126 kilometers (or about 2,560 miles) in eight months. It was the longest recorded dispersal by an African mammal.Why do wild dogs leave home?Dispersal is a one-way trip to find mates and new territory. Migration is a round trip between seasons, so the two are different behaviors and the numbers are not a like-for-like comparison. Even so, the distance the brothers traveled is far greater than that of any documented African migration. Wild dogs are pack animals and typically only the alpha male and alpha female breed. This can cause young dogs to look for mates elsewhere. Despite the name, they are not closely related to domestic dogs.From Kafue National Park to the Luangwa ValleyThe brothers were from the Mayukuyuku pack in Kafue National Park in western Zambia. Seven related young dogs, three males and four females, left the pack within two weeks of each other, lead author Scott Creel of Montana State University wrote in The Conversation. Each group set off on its own path. The collared brothers kept going by themselves and reached the Luangwa Valley in eastern Zambia. They appear to have been there ever since and seem to have met females, since they no longer roam around. How scientists tracked each stageCreel works with Matt Becker and the Zambian Carnivore Programme. For more than 16 years, the team has been studying over 500 African wild dogs from over 50 packs per year and fitting GPS collars. The collars record each dog’s position by satellite every few hours. That shows where packs live, when young dogs leave home, where they go, and where they die. The researchers say this type of intensive fieldwork helps them learn where animals are likely to die, and why.The dangers along the wayThe journey was dangerous. One of the biggest dangers is wire snares set for bushmeat. Young dogs are also inexperienced and pass through areas with lions, other packs, and rivers full of crocodiles. The team found that more than half the dogs they tracked did not survive. In 2021, one female, EWD-1355, traveled more than 2,300 kilometers in one year. In June of 2022, she died in a wire snare.Why the record gives hopeAfrican wild dogs are among the world’s most endangered large carnivores. Small isolated populations are prone to extinction, and several small populations in the Serengeti, the Lower Zambezi, and Zambia’s Liuwa Plain have already been lost. The tracking shows that dispersing dogs have traveled between every major wild dog population in Zambia. Zambian dogs have also crossed into Mozambique and Malawi, and to within a few kilometers of Zimbabwe, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Angola.However, reaching another population is not the same as joining it. Wild dogs usually fight, sometimes fatally, with unfamiliar dogs, so joining a new group often fails. About 40 percent of Zambia has some form of legal protection for wildlife, and corridors such as the Luangwa Valley remain highly effective, the researchers note. Creel expects more young dogs to disperse as protected populations rebound, but he says that will be good news only if their routes are safer.

title: 38-year-old man placed on car roof, assaulted and run over in UP's Kanpur | Hindustan Times
description: Police are examining CCTV from more than two dozen cameras and tracing the suspects after the victim’s family alleged that an earlier dispute led to the attack.
content: A 37-year-old man died after he was allegedly assaulted, placed on the roof of a car and driven for around 1.5 km before falling on to the road and being run over. His family has linked the incident to an earlier dispute. More than two dozen CCTV cameras reportedly captured the incident.The victim, Biru Singh Bhadauria, was a salesman with a food products company and lived in Arra, under the Hanumant Vihar police area. He was returning home from a Dussehra fair on Tuesday night when he was allegedly stopped by Mewalal, who was driving a car, and four other men, including Rajveer. His family said he had a dispute with Mewalal and Rajveer a few days earlier.Also read: 26-year-old stabbed to death over scuffle at Garba event in Thane's Dombivli; 3 held, 2 minors detainedMen allegedly assault victim and drive away with him on car roofAccording to the allegations, the men assaulted Bhadauria and hit him with the car when he tried to escape. They then placed him on the roof of the car, trapped his hands in the windows and drove away with the windows shut.Bhadauria fell near Ashwani Trading Company in Rajendra Nagar. The occupants of the car allegedly drove over him. He suffered several serious injuries, including badly crushed fingers. Devendra Singh Chauhan, a passer-by, recognised Bhadauria and informed his family. His relatives took him to a private hospital, which referred him to Hallet Hospital. Doctors there declared him dead.Also read: Indian-origin man seeks funeral funds after wife kills 5-year-old daughter in New York: 'I lost my whole world'Family alleges police failed to act promptly on initial complaintWhen the body reached his home on Wednesday, the family protested against the police response. They alleged that the police had not acted promptly on their initial complaint. The family has since filed a second complaint alleging murder, deputy commissioner of police (South) Deependra Nath Chowdhary said. “We are examining the available CCTV footage and action will be taken based on the findings,” he said. Police have reportedly traced the car, which is owned by Mewalal, and the suspects’ mobile phone locations to Jahanabad in Fatehpur district. The family has demanded the arrest of those responsible.Bhadauria is survived by his wife, Reena. She said she had submitted a complaint to the police and that a case should be registered.

title: Everyday Explained: Why some people feel dizzy and nauseous while reading or looking at their phones during a car ride | Health
description: The science of motion sickness and why reading a book during a car ride can make some people feel unwell.  | Health
content: If you often feel nauseous while reading or scrolling through your phone during a car ride, you are not alone. In this edition of HT Lifestyle’s series, ‘Everyday Explained,’ we spoke to Dr Chaithanya Ravikumar, a physician at Koshys Hospital, to understand the science behind motion sickness and why it affects some people more than others.​Also read | Everyday explained: Those little ribbons inside your tops and dresses help prevent them from stretching. Here's howWhy do some people get motion sickness while reading in a car?Dr Ravikumar highlighted that motion sickness while reading in a moving car occurs primarily because of a mismatch between the sensory signals received by the brain. The eyes are focused on a relatively stationary object, such as a book or mobile phone, while the inner ear, which helps maintain balance and detect movement, senses that the body is in motion. This conflict between visual and vestibular information can trigger symptoms such as nausea, dizziness, sweating, headache and, in some cases, vomiting. “The inner ear contains specialised structures that detect changes in movement, direction and acceleration. When a person is travelling in a car, these structures continuously communicate movement-related information to the brain,” explained Dr Ravikumar. However, when the person reads, the eyes remain fixed on the page, creating the impression that the visual environment is stationary. The brain receives conflicting information about whether the body is moving, and this sensory mismatch can activate the neural pathways responsible for motion sickness.Dr Ravikumar highlighted that not everyone experiences this phenomenon to the same extent. Individual susceptibility varies depending on factors such as age, genetic predisposition, migraine history and sensitivity to sensory conflicts. Children, particularly those between two and twelve years of age, are more susceptible to motion sickness, although it can occur at any age. People with migraines may also be more prone to motion-related nausea and dizziness.The severity of symptoms can increase when a vehicle frequently accelerates, brakes or changes direction, as these movements create additional stimulation of the balance system. Reading in the back seat, where the road ahead is less visible, may further aggravate the problem. Poor ventilation, strong odours, anxiety, fatigue and dehydration can also worsen symptoms in susceptible individuals.How to prevent motion sickness?“The simplest preventive measure is to avoid reading or looking at a phone while the vehicle is moving. Instead, looking outside at the horizon or at distant, relatively stable objects can help the brain reconcile visual information with the movement detected by the inner ear,” advised Dr Ravikumar.Sitting in the front passenger seat, keeping the head relatively still, ensuring adequate ventilation and taking breaks during long journeys may also help. For individuals who experience significant symptoms, medication may be considered after consulting a doctor, as some motion sickness medicines can cause drowsiness and may not be suitable for everyone. Motion sickness while reading is generally harmless and does not necessarily indicate an underlying medical condition. “However, if dizziness or nausea occurs frequently even when the person is not travelling, persists after the journey, or is accompanied by severe headache, hearing changes, difficulty walking or other neurological symptoms, medical evaluation is advisable to rule out other causes,” highlighted Dr Ravikumar.Note to readers: This article is for informational purposes only and not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always seek the advice of your doctor with any questions about a medical condition.

title: Minnesota farmer discovers massive metallic ‘space object’ in cornfield, federal agencies notified | Hindustan Times
description: A large, metallic object, suspected to be from space, has been found in a cornfield in Minnesota, USA.
content: A large, metallic object, suspected to be from space, has been found in a cornfield in Minnesota, USA. The Stevens County Minnesota Sheriff’s Office announced in a press release that the object measures 11-feet in diameter and was found on October 14.“On October 14, 2026, at approximately 3:30pm, the Stevens County Sheriff’s Office received a phone call of foreign debris that was found in a cornfield in Scott Township,” the Sheriff’s Office said.Authorities arrived at the scene to discover a “large, metallic object, approximately 11-feet in diameter.” They described it as “presumably a space object”. How was the space object discovered?According to local news station KGW8, a farmer found the object sitting in his cornfield. Based on the size of the corn growing underneath, the farmer estimated that the object had been sitting in the field for about six weeks before it was found.What is space debris?According to the European Space Agency, space debris are defined as “all non-functional, man-made objects, including fragments and elements thereof, in Earth orbit or re-entering into Earth atmosphere. Man-made space debris dominate over the natural meteoroid environment, except around millimetre sizes.”Space debris enter the earth’s atmosphere daily. However, most burn up before reaching the ground.(Also read: What are the ‘mysterious’ balls found on Australian beach? Space agency has an answer)What happened to the ‘space object’ in Minnesota?After confirming the presence of the object, the sheriff’s office notified the Minnesota Duty Officer, prompting federal agencies to respond. Authorities are now working with state and federal agencies to identify the object’s owner and arrange for its removal from the field.Officials said that the object has serial numbers, which could help identify its owner.Officials also confirmed that the discovery poses no danger to the public.(Also read: Space debris found in Maharashtra likely from 'China rocket')

title: How Punjab cop in anti-drone unit helped smugglers clear 24 drug deliveries | India News
description: Karandeep told his interrogators that he had been a heroin addict, a vulnerability that the trafficking networks exploited to turn him. | India News
content: Karandeep Singh, the Punjab police constable arrested on October 15 by the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) for colluding with drug traffickers, has allegedly told interrogators that he has collected over two dozen consignments of drugs sent from across the Pakistan border since June this year.An NCB officer, who asked not to be named, said Karandeep, who was posted with the force’s anti-drone unit mandated to intercept drugs and weapons smuggled across the Indo-Pak fence, used his operational knowledge of anti-drone deployments in Tarn Tarn district to guide smugglers to safe drop zones.On two occasions, he did pass on tips to the police that led to drug seizures. Karandeep also applied for, and received, an arms licence for a personal weapon, claiming a threat to his life for helping police bust drug-related cases. An NCB officer said this was designed to to preserve his standing within the police force while he facilitated the trafficking operation.Karandeep was intercepted by the Border Security Force (BSF) in Tarn Taran on October 15 while he was smuggling 15 kg of high-grade heroin. The NCB took over the case.The officer said Karandeep had been taking deliveries of drug consignments sent across the border in June. Since August, he also started helping his handlers with safe drop-zone locations. “Based on his communications with Pakistan handlers and the drop zones he sent them for safe delivery, investigators could confirm at least 24 deliveries,” the officer said. The China-made drones used by traffickers can carry payloads of anywhere between 5-15 kg of heroin.Karandeep told his interrogators that he had been a heroin addict, a vulnerability that the trafficking networks exploited to turn him.“Earlier this year, people contacted him via encrypted calls from Pakistan and lured him into smuggling heroin, for which he received his share of drugs and money. He claimed he did not know how the Pak smugglers knew he was a user and lured him. Pakistani smugglers target such vulnerable people, including villagers. He is still being questioned,” a second officer said.On Tuesday, the local Punjab media reported the arrest of Karandeep’s associate, Lakwinder Singh, a former sarpanch of Rajoke village, a border village, in Tarn Taran. Lakwinder Singh is also in NCB custody.A BSF officer, who asked not to be named, said the force had had Lakwinder on its radar for a long time. Local BSF units had searched his house several times but found no evidence.“He had come under the radar because forensic analysis of a few recovered drones showed their flight paths near or above Lakwinder Singh’s house many times. This meant the drugs, which are always tied to the drone using a hook, were dropped at or near his house. But he always feigned ignorance and BSF teams did not recover anything during searches,” the officer said.Rajoke has been a hotspot of cross-border smuggling in the district.At least 11 drones have been shot down here since 2023, but the instances have declined since 2025. Only one drone was busted from Rajoke this year, in April. Local BSF officers believed at the time that this route was no longer in use.“With the Punjab cop’s and the sarpanch’s arrest, it is clear that the cases had not decreased. They had only become smarter,” he added.Drug enforcement agencies registered 305 drone-related seizure cases across India in 2025, recovering 468 kg of narcotics. Punjab alone accounted for 298 of those cases and 461 kg of seized drugs, primarily heroin.On September 26, the Punjab police also arrested an inspector posted in the counter-intelligence unit on charges of smuggling 3.35 kg of heroin, 6 pistols and 6 cell phones.

title: Harleen Sethi on Jennifer Winget's wedding, being inspired from Parineeti Chopra: It's inspiring to see inspiring women around you | Hindustan Times
description: Harleen Sethi opens up on forming friendships with Jennifer Winget and Parineeti Chopra during Shaque, Jennifer's wedding and Parineeti handling trolls
content: Harleen Sethi was recently seen playing a grey shade character Shreya in the web series Shaque: Trust No One, and she admits it was “challenging” to understand the complex relationships her character explored. However, it brought her a different perspective. “One of the things that acting has brought into my life is a lot more empathy. Shreya definitely was a morally ambiguous character but I took it up as a responsibility to give a voice to a character like this and make people like this in the society feel seen,” she says.Shreya is shown indulging in infidelity and betraying her friend, played by actor Parineeti Chopra. The actor insists that it is important to demarcate the person and the character, not just as an audience but also as an actor. “It's very important to keep your own morals aside to be able to humanise these characters. Right and wrong in society is very subjective, and when we see these kinds of characters on screen, there is an understanding that is created,” she says.Through the shoot of the show, Harleen Sethi got a lifelong friendship with actor Jennifer Winget. And at her wedding recently, she got to be part of the celebrations. “I was very happy for her and it was very emotional. We shot this show almost a year-and-a-half ago and that's when she shared with me about her love story with Will (William Ishmael). At that time they were dating and over this time period, I saw her go from being a girlfriend to a fiancee, and then being a bride in front of my eyes,” she gushes.Sethi also got inspired from Parineeti Chopra with the way she handled trolling regarding her weight gain post having her child. “Parineeti is very comfortable in her own skin and she is a very confident woman. I don't think she is somebody who gets too affected by what people are saying or if they are trolling her. It was a joy to see her promote the show with the confidence that she did. Everyone was asking her about these kinds of questions and the way she was answering it was amazing. She articulated everything so well, which made me realise that she has so much clarity about how she sees her life. She is in no rush to lose weight just to basically please people. She is very clear about the work-life balance. She is very happy in the phase of life that she is in,” she says, adding, “It's always very inspiring to see inspiring women around you, when women speak and carry themselves with so much confidence. It only motivates you and it makes you want to do better.”

title: Tantara first look: Know all about Gong Yoo and Song Hye Kyo's upcoming Netflix period K-drama on Korea’s music industry | Web Series
description: The upcoming Netflix period k-drama is set in South Korea’s entertainment industry during the 1960s, 1970s and 1980s.  | Web Series
content: South Korean actors Song Hye Kyo and Gong Yoo are teaming up for the first time in Tantara, a Netflix period k-drama set in South Korea’s entertainment industry during the 1960s, 1970s and 1980s. The series will follow a group of people trying to make a name for themselves in the music business, where talent and ambition often come with personal sacrifices. Netflix on Thursday announced December 11 as the premiere date.Tantara poster gives a glimpse of the music-filled dramaNetflix has released a date announcement poster that offers a first look at the characters and the world they inhabit. Built around the image of a record player, the poster brings together the people, performances and ambitions that drive the story.Min Ja (Song Hye Kyo) and Dong Gu (Gong Yoo) are shown on their journey from nightclub workers to talent managers, while Min Hui (Kim Seol Hyun) appears as a performer finding her feet in the industry. The poster also features Seok Gil Yeo (Cha Seung Won) with his saxophone, hinting at the role music will play in the series. The first look points to a story that goes beyond the glamour of show business to explore the struggles of people trying to make their dreams a reality. What is Tantara about?Tantara takes viewers to a time when making it in the Korean entertainment industry was far from easy. Against a backdrop of poverty, intense competition and violence, the series follows people who are willing to take risks to build better lives for themselves.Hye Kyo plays Min Ja, who grows up struggling to make ends meet. Having spent much of her life taking whatever work she can find, she decides to try her luck in the music business. Her childhood friend Dong Gu, played by Gong Yoo, joins her in the pursuit. The two face setbacks together, starting out as waiters before taking their first steps as talent managers.Their big break comes when they meet Min Hui, a singer with a striking voice who becomes their first artist. But working together is not always easy. She is ambitious, sharp and rebellious, and her relationship with Min Ja is far from straightforward. As both women fight for what they want, their bond becomes an important part of the story.The drama also features Seok Gil Yeo, a gifted composer known for turning newcomers into popular performers. Lee Hanee plays Yang Ja, Min Hui’s mother, who has not given up on her own dream of becoming a singer. Veteran actor Na Moon Hee appears as Mal Soon, a character whose life reflects the changes and hardships that come with the passage of time. Song Hye Kyo and Gong Yoo share the screen for the first timeOne of the biggest talking points about Tantara is the pairing of Song Hye Kyo and Gong Yoo. Despite being two of South Korea’s most recognisable stars, the actors have not previously worked together on screen. The series also marks Noh Hee Gyoung’s return to television after more than four years. For Gong Yoo, it is a reunion with director Lee Yoon Jung, who previously directed him in the popular series The 1st Shop of Coffee Prince in 2007.When and where to watchThe production is reportedly backed by a budget of around 80 billion Korean won ($58 million USD) as per Chosun Biz Korea. Tantara is also expected to have 22 episodes. The show is among Netflix’s upcoming Korean dramas to watch. The series will premiere on December 11, on Netflix.

title: India, Canada explore energy partnership as both sides push to seal trade deal | India News
description: Negotiators will meet in New Delhi early next month for the sixth round of CEPA talks, with both countries aiming to finalise the agreement. | India News
content: India and Canada may explore deeper energy cooperation while expeditiously concluding negotiations for a comprehensive free trade deal, people aware of the matter said, adding that the countries plan to establish a two-way energy supply chain in which India would import Canadian oil and gas and send refined petroleum products the other way.A team of Canadian negotiators will visit New Delhi early next month to participate in the sixth round of free trade talks, they said, requesting anonymity. Both sides are making efforts to conclude negotiations for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) before an expected visit of Prime Minister Narendra Modi to Canada in mid-December, they added.The prime ministers of the two countries have decided to cooperate in key areas such as trade, energy, technology, security and people-to-people ties, they said. The High Commission of India in Ottawa last week announced Modi’s visit to Canada on December 11-12.Establishing a robust energy supply chain is one of the potential areas of cooperation, the people mentioned above said.Canadian oil sands are the world’s fourth largest oil deposits and it is also the fourth largest producer of crude oil in the world after the US, Russia and Saudi Arabia. It is also fifth largest producer of natural gas.Also read: India-Canada ties are on an upward trajectoryOil, gas and refined petroleum products among focus areasIndia and Canada are compatible for a robust energy supply chain. While Canada is one of the top oil and gas producers, India is the world’s third biggest crude oil consumer after the US and China. It is also the second largest consumer of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG or cooking gas) and fourth largest consumer of liquefied natural gas (LNG).“India and Canada are in talks to establish reliable supply chains in key sectors such as crude oil, LPG, LNG, potash, nuclear fuel (uranium) and refined petroleum products. India is a major refining hub and it can ensure supply of fuels and petroleum products to Canada,” one of the people cited above said.Canada, which is one of the top energy producers in the world, requires refined products in huge quantities because of geographical issues (leading to logistical hurdles) and technical reasons (such as refinery configuration). Most refineries in Canada are not configured to process heavy and bituminous crude extracted from oil sands in Alberta. But some of the Indian refineries can process any type of crude, the people said.Also read: PM Modi to visit Canada on December 11-12 as countries seek to boost tiesHigh-level visits help rebuild and deepen bilateral tiesIndia and Canada are working to deepen ties after PMs Narendra Modi and Mark Carney met at the G7 Summit in Canada in June last year and the G20 Summit in South Africa five months later. This was followed by Carney’s India visit in February-March this year. In May, commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal led a trade mission to Canada with representatives of over 100 Indian companies. It was followed by India visits by Canadian foreign minister Anita Anand and trade minister Maninder Sidhu in mid-October. Sidhu was accompanied by a 300-strong Canadian business delegate, the largest Canadian trade delegation to India in 30 years.The people said that the negotiations for the India-Canada CEPA is progressing fast, and most of the key issues related to the free trade agreement have been resolved. Both sides are working to finalise the trade deal before December, aiming to raise two-way trade to Canadian $70 billion (US$50.4 billion) by 2030. Bilateral goods and services trade between India and Canada in 2025 was Canadian $30.4 billion (US$21.9 billion), with merchandise trade contributing Canadian $13.6 billion (US$9.8 billion).Also read: India-Canada trade sees double-digit growth amid PM Modi's December visitCanada currently exports goods such as vegetables, mineral fuels and oils, and wood pulp to India worth Canadian $3.9 billion (US $2.85 billion). It imports Indian merchandise worth Canadian $9.7 billion (US$7.08 billion), including precious stones, metals, machinery and pharmaceuticals.India and Canada launched the CEPA negotiations in New Delhi on March 2 after Goyal and Sidhu signed the terms of reference in the presence of PMs Modi and Carney. The negotiations have moved swiftly since then, and the first round of virtual talks was held in March 2026, followed by the second round in New Delhi during May 4-8, and the third round in Ottawa during July 6-10. The fourth and the fifth rounds took place in New Delhi (September 14-18) and Ottawa (October 5-9) respectively.

title: Retirement planning : రిటైర్మెంట్ తర్వాత ఈక్విటీకి ఎంత డబ్బులు కేటాయించాలి? | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: పదవీ విరమణ తర్వాత షేర్ మార్కెట్ లేదా ఈక్విటీ ఫండ్లలో ఎంత శాతం పెట్టుబడి ఉంచాలనేది ప్రతి పెన్షనర్‌కు ఒక పెద్ద సందేహం, ఆందోళనకర విషయం! ఈ నేపథ్యంలోనే ఈక్విటీ కేటాయింపులు ఎంత ఉండాలో ఫ్రీఫిన్‌కాల్ వ్యవస్థాపకుడు, ఐఐటీ మద్రాస్ ప్రొఫెసర్ డాక్టర్ ఎం పట్టాభిరామన్ వివరించిన కీలక సూత్రాలు మీకోసం..
content: ఉద్యోగ విరమణ చేయగానే పెట్టుబడుల నిర్వహణ విధానం పూర్తిగా మారిపోతుంది. ఉద్యోగంలో ఉన్నంతకాలం సంపదను పెంచుకోవడం ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం కాగా, రిటైర్మెంట్ తర్వాత మాత్రం సమకూరిన కార్పస్‌ను కాపాడుకోవడం, పెరుగుతున్న ద్రవ్యోల్బణాన్ని తట్టుకోవడం అత్యంత కీలకంగా మారుతుంది.60 ఏళ్ల వయస్సులో రిటైర్ అయ్యే వ్యక్తి మరో 20 నుంచి 30 ఏళ్ల పాటు జీవించే అవకాశం ఉంటుంది. మరి ఇలాంటి సుదీర్ఘ కాలంలో మార్కెట్ ఒడుదొడుకులను తట్టుకుంటూ, రోజువారీ ఖర్చులను నెట్టుకురావడానికి ఈక్విటీ మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్లు లేదా స్టాక్స్‌లో ఎంత శాతాన్ని కొనసాగించాలి? పర్సనల్ ఫైనాన్స్ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్ 'ఫ్రీఫిన్‌కాల్' (Freefincal) వ్యవస్థాపకుడు, ఐఐటీ మద్రాస్ ప్రొఫెసర్ డాక్టర్ ఎం పట్టాభిరామన్ దీనిపై స్పష్టమైన మార్గదర్శకాలను అందించారు.ఈక్విటీ కేటాయింపులు 30 శాతానికే పరిమితం!ఉద్యోగంలో ఉన్నప్పుడు చాలామంది తమ పోర్ట్‌ఫోలియోలో 50 నుంచి 70 శాతం వరకు ఈక్విటీల్లో ఉంచుతారు. కానీ క్రమం తప్పకుండా పింఛను లేదా నెలానెలా ఉపసంహరణలు ప్రారంభమైన తర్వాత ఈ వ్యూహాన్ని మార్చుకోవాల్సి ఉంటుంది."సాధారణంగా రిటైర్ అయిన వ్యక్తి తన మొత్తం పొదుపులో ఈక్విటీ వాటాను 30 శాతానికి మించకుండా చూసుకోవడమే ఉత్తమం," అని ప్రొఫెసర్ పట్టాభిరామన్ పేర్కొన్నారు.పెట్టుబడిదారుడి వద్ద ఉన్న కార్పస్ పరిమాణం ఆధారంగా ఈ శాతంలో స్వల్ప మార్పులు ఉండవచ్చు. ఉదాహరణకు, ఏడాదికి రూ.6 లక్షల ఖర్చులు ఉన్న ఇద్దరు వ్యక్తులను పరిశీలిద్దాం. ఒకరి వద్ద రూ.1.8 కోట్లు (ఏడాది ఖర్చులకు 30 రెట్లు) కార్పస్ ఉండగా, మరొకరి వద్ద రూ.4.5 కోట్లు (ఏడాది ఖర్చులకు 75 రెట్లు) ఉంది. ఇక్కడ రెండో వ్యక్తి వద్ద పెద్ద మొత్తంలో పొదుపు ఉంది కాబట్టి, మార్కెట్ నష్టాలను తట్టుకునే సామర్థ్యం ఆయనకు ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. ఇలాంటివారు మాత్రమే ఈక్విటీల్లో కాస్త ఎక్కువ రిస్క్ తీసుకోగలరు.ద్రవ్యోల్బణం, 'సీక్వెన్స్ ఆఫ్ రిటర్న్స్' ముప్పు!రిటైర్మెంట్ ఫండ్​పై ద్రవ్యోల్బణాన్ని మించి భారీ లాభాలు వస్తాయని ఆశించడం సరికాదు. పన్నులు పోను వాస్తవిక రాబడి సున్నా శాతంగా గానీ, లేదా మైనస్ 1 నుంచి 2 శాతంగా గానీ అంచనా వేసుకుని ప్రణాళిక రచించుకోవాలి! ఉదాహరణకు సగటు ద్రవ్యోల్బణం 6 శాతంగా ఉంటే, పెట్టుబడి రాబడి కూడా 6 శాతమే వస్తే ఆ నిధులు పెరుగుతున్న జీవన వ్యయాలను మాత్రమే భరించగలవు.దీనికి తోడు 'సీక్వెన్స్ ఆఫ్ రిటర్న్స్ రిస్క్' అనే ప్రమాదాన్ని గ్రహించాలి. రిటైర్ అయిన తొలి ఐదేళ్లలోనే మార్కెట్లు తీవ్రంగా పతనమైతే, ఖర్చుల కోసం విత్‌డ్రా చేసుకునే క్రమంలో నష్టాల్లో ఉన్న ఫండ్లను తక్కువ ధరలకే అమ్మాల్సి వస్తుంది. ఆ తర్వాత మార్కెట్లు ఎంత కోలుకున్నా, ప్రారంభంలో నష్టపోయిన పెట్టుబడి విలువను మళ్లీ రాబట్టడం సాధ్యం కాదు. అందుకే రాబడుల కంటే పోర్ట్‌ఫోలియో రక్షణకే ప్రాధాన్యం ఇవ్వాలి. 15 ఏళ్ల స్థిర రాబడి బఫర్.. 'బకెట్ స్ట్రాటజీ'పదవీ విరమణ నిధికి రక్షణ కల్పించేందుకు మరో కీలక సూత్రం.. తొలి 15 ఏళ్ల ఖర్చులకు సరిపడా నిధులను స్థిర రాబడినిచ్చే పథకాల్లో కేటాయించడం. దీనివల్ల ‘బకెట్ స్ట్రాటజీ’ అమలు చేయడం సులభమవుతుంది.ఈ పద్ధతిలో రోజువారీ ఖర్చులకు అవసరమైన డబ్బును భద్రమైన డెట్ ఫండ్లు, ఫిక్స్​డ్​ డిపాజిట్లలో ఉంచి, దీర్ఘకాలిక వృద్ధి కోసం కేటాయించిన 20-30 శాతం ఈక్విటీ భాగంలో కొన్ని ఏళ్ల పాటు ఎటువంటి మార్పులు చేయకుండా వదిలేయవచ్చు. మార్కెట్లు పతనమైన సమయంలో స్టాక్స్ లేదా మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్లను విక్రయించాల్సిన అవసరం రాదు. వీటితో పాటు స్థిరమైన పెన్షన్ ఇచ్చే యాన్యుటీ పథకాలను కూడా జోడించుకుంటే రిటైర్మెంట్ జీవితం మరింత భరోసాగా ఉంటుంది.(గమనిక- ఇది సమాచారం కోసం రూపొందించిన కథనం మాత్రమే. హిందుస్థాన్ టైమ్స్ తెలుగుకు ఎలాంటి సంబంధం లేదు. ఏదైనా రిటైర్మెంట్​ ప్లానింగ్ చేసుకునేందుకు సర్టిఫైడ్ ఫైనాన్షియల్ ప్లానర్​ని సంప్రదించడం శ్రేయస్కరం.)
