title: Possible tornado rips through Heber-Overgaard, Arizona; crews assessing'considerable damage' | Hindustan Times
description: Damage is being assessed in a northeastern Arizona community after a possible tornado ripped through Wednesday night, October 21.
content: Damage is being assessed in a northeastern Arizona community after a possible tornado ripped through Wednesday night, October 21. The possible storm knocked down power poles and caused serious damage, AZ Family reported.Power has been out in the area. However, it is unclear how many Navopache Electric Cooperative customers were affected. The company stated that it does not have an estimated time for when power will be restored.Also Read | Fort Stockton tornado touchdown: Scary videos show damage in Texas cityRep. Walt Blackman said that the storm caused “considerable damage” in the Heber-Overgaard area. At least one person was reportedly hurt. Witnesses speak outBetty Nixon, who has lived in Heber for eight years, said that the storm hit around 7 p.m.“I was in the kitchen, and I just heard the sounds outside were not normal. The wind, the house started getting pelted with debris,” she said. “I got on the floor with the dogs and just was worried that the windows were gonna shatter. It sounded like a tornado.”Nixon said that a large part of her neighbor’s tree was down in her yard. Another neighbor’s windows broke during the storm, she claimed.According to Nixon, the sudden and intense storm lasted only about 30 to 45 seconds.Also Read | Tornado touchdown in Clayton, NC? Latest radar as warnings issued for Johnston and Wake counties“I had no warning whatsoever,” she said. “It was just this horrible sound of wind and flying debris crashing against the house. And that was my first warning.”Meanwhile, the Navajo County Sheriff’s Office said it is responding to a major incident in the Overgaard area. It also asked people to avoid two areas – State Route 260 between Mogollon and the Overgaard Airpark, and areas north of State Route 377 extending toward Tonto.Blackman said that he wants Gov. Katie Hobbs to declare a state of emergency for the area.“Our immediate priorities must be protecting lives, restoring electrical service, ensuring public safety, and providing assistance to families whose homes and property have been damaged,” he said.

title: 22% of Indian college students have started businesses, 43% aspire to: Survey | India News
description: GUESSS India is part of the biennial Global University Entrepreneurial Spirit Students’ Survey (GUESSS), launched by the University of St Gallen, Switzerland. | India News
content: More than one in five Indian college students has already started a business, while 43% aspire to become entrepreneurs, broadly in line with global averages, according to a report released on Wednesday by the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Mandi.However, the report has flagged gaps in converting ambition into viable ventures, stating that “half of Indian students know no entrepreneur beyond their parents”, while also flagging limited exposure to entrepreneurs, low early sales and weaker follow-through among women, and calling on universities to prioritise actual business creation over entrepreneurship plans and competitions.The GUESSS India 2025 report, titled ‘How do we make student entrepreneurs?’, is based on responses from 25,783 students across more than 1,200 higher education institutions in 34 states and Union Territories (UTs). It found that 22% of Indian students had already started a business, compared with 23% globally, while 43% in both the Indian and global samples aspired to entrepreneurship.GUESSS India is part of the biennial Global University Entrepreneurial Spirit Students’ Survey (GUESSS), launched by the University of St Gallen, Switzerland, in 2003 to study students’ entrepreneurial ambitions, activities and influencing factors. The global survey drew more than 300,000 students from 57 countries in 2023.GUESSS India provides insights into the entrepreneurial intentions, activities and perceptions of Indian students, benchmarking them against global peers. The 2025 India survey was conducted between September and December.The findingsReleased by IIT Mandi in partnership with Bengaluru-based REVA University, the survey found that 35.5% of Indian student businesses had recorded regular sales, compared with 33% globally. Nearly 31% of Indian student businesses with regular sales were founded in 2025, against 18% globally.“India's students are as ambitious as any in the world, and those who start are building real businesses that already hire people,” said Dr Puran Singh, associate professor at IIT Mandi's School of Management and country delegate for GUESSS India, who led the report.The findings also point to a shift in career preferences. The proportion of students wanting to run their own businesses immediately after graduation rose from 14% in 2023 to 16.2% in 2025. Over the same period, the share aspiring to government jobs fell from 12.7% to 10.1%, while the share seeking jobs at large companies declined from 31.3% to 27.4%.However, the report found a gap between students' business plans and the ventures they actually operate. While information technology, artificial intelligence and digital businesses were among the most common entrepreneurial plans, only about one in 10 existing student-run businesses was digital.Exposure to entrepreneurship was another key factor. Students with entrepreneurs among their relatives, friends, classmates or teachers were three times more likely to start a venture. Yet half of Indian students surveyed said they did not know any entrepreneur beyond their parents, compared with about one-third globally.The survey also found that among students still developing their ventures, only 10% had made their first sale, compared with 23% globally. Repeat entrepreneurship, however, was more common in India: 41% of founders of student businesses with regular sales had closed an earlier venture and started another, against 33% globally. Meanwhile, 42% of Indian student entrepreneurs ran two or more businesses, compared with 25% worldwide.Women expressed entrepreneurial ambitions almost as frequently as men but were less likely to act on them. Among students who wanted to start a business, 45% of women had begun one, compared with 53% of men.Suggestions for universitiesThe report called on universities to track how many students translate entrepreneurial ambitions into actual businesses, rather than measuring interest alone. It said 51 out of every 100 students who wanted to start a business had done so. It also recommended that universities bring alumni entrepreneurs, faculty founders and student business owners into classrooms and hostels, and prioritise first sales, registrations and prototypes over business-plan competitions.“A university's task is no longer only to educate students for jobs. It is to educate them for enterprise, so that they create the jobs,” said Dr P Shyama Raju, chancellor of REVA University, the national partner for the survey.“Student entrepreneurship is central to how the School of Management thinks about management education: we want our students to build ventures and organisations, not only to manage them,” said Prof Anjan Swain, chair of IIT Mandi's School of Management.

title: US secures $5 million settlement after Instacart accused of favoring visa holders over American workers | Hindustan Times
description: Instacart agreed to pay up to $5 million to settle allegations that it disadvantaged American workers during recruitment.
content: Instacart has agreed to pay $5 million to settle allegations that it discriminated against American workers by favoring temporary visa holders during recruitment for jobs linked to green-card sponsorship, the US Department of Justice (DOJ) and the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) announced on October 20, 2026.The settlement with Maplebear Inc., which operates the online grocery delivery platform Instacart, follows investigations into its recruitment practices under the US Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) program. Federal agencies alleged that the company created additional barriers for American workers applying for positions advertised as part of the green-card sponsorship process.The agreement includes up to $4 million to compensate affected applicants and people who were deterred from applying because of the alleged practices. Instacart will also pay $1 million in civil penalties to the US government.ALSO READ: US launches nationwide operation targeting undocumented immigrants accused of SNAP fraudWhat US investigators found in Instacart's hiring processAccording to the DOJ, Instacart required applicants for certain positions advertised under PERM recruitment to submit applications by physical mail. This differed from the company's standard recruitment process, which allowed candidates to apply electronically.The department said the additional requirement created obstacles for US workers and meant many applicants were not considered in a timely manner. The EEOC's investigation uncovered similar evidence.Assistant Attorney General Harmeet K. Dhillon said the settlement marked the 15th agreement reached by the Civil Rights Division under her leadership to protect American workers.EEOC Chair Andrea Lucas said the agency would act against employers that unlawfully restrict employment opportunities for US workers by preferring temporary visa holders.The agencies alleged that the recruitment practices violated the Immigration and Nationality Act and Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which prohibit certain forms of discrimination based on citizenship status and national origin, respectively.How the $5 million settlement will workUnder the agreement, a claims administrator will contact potentially affected applicants and determine eligibility for back pay and compensatory damages. The compensation fund can total up to $4 million.ALSO READ: Infosys, Cognizant and TCS H-1B visa registrations plunge amid Trump’s US immigration crackdownApplicants who believe they were affected can email Instacart@eeoc.gov so the agencies can share their information with the claims administrator.Instacart must also advertise relevant positions on its public careers website and accept electronic applications during PERM recruitment. The company is required to revise its employment policies, train personnel on anti-discrimination obligations and comply with monitoring and reporting requirements.What the case means for the green-card processThe PERM program allows employers to sponsor eligible foreign workers for employment-based permanent residency after conducting recruitment to determine whether qualified US workers are available for the position.Employers cannot unlawfully disadvantage American workers based on citizenship status or national origin during this process. PERM is an important step for many employment-based green-card applications, including those in the EB-2 and EB-3 categories.The DOJ said the settlement forms part of its Protecting U.S. Workers Initiative, relaunched in 2025 to investigate employers accused of illegally favoring temporary visa holders.The case highlights the scrutiny employers face over recruitment practices used in employment-based immigration sponsorship and the requirement to provide US workers with fair opportunities to apply.

title: James Talarico, the former middle school teacher challenging Ken Paxton in Texas Senate race | Hindustan Times
description: Democrat candidate James Talarico, running for a US Senate seat from Texas is set to face Republican candidate Ken Paxton in the November 2026 midterms.
content: James Dell Talarico is currently in the spotlight as he runs for a US Senate seat from Texas, challenging Republican candidate and state attorney general Ken Paxton. The race has garnered widespread attention as Texas hasn’t seen an elected Democrat senator since 1988 after Lloyd Bentsen. Talarico will face Paxton on November 3, during the midterm elections.Talarico claims to “fight against corruption” and “win power back for working people” as per his election campaign. He has also integrated his Christian beliefs into politics to shape conversations around social justice and equality.Talarico was a former language arts teacher at Rhodes Middle School, San Antonio in Texas. He began his political career in 2018 after he was elected to the Texas House of Representatives. A Presbyterian seminarian, Talarico defeated Jasmine Crockett and Ahmad Hassan in the Democratic primary and became a nominee for the Texas Senate seat.James Talarico: Early life, education and family Talarico was born in May 1989 in Round Rock, Texas. His mother Tamara Talarico raised him after leaving his biological father, who had drinking problems, that led to violence. She later married Mark Talarico who adopted James.James Talarico describes his mom as a “fighter” and credits her as the main inspiration for his life and political career. He is in a long-term relationship with Brianna Menard who he met in the Texas State legislature.Talarico attended Wells Branch Elementary School and graduated from McNeil High School. He earned a bachelor’s degree in government from the University of Texas and a master’s degree in education policy from Harvard University in 2016. He also earned a Master of Divinity degree from Austin Presbyterian Theological Seminary while serving in the Texas House of Representatives.Also Read | When was James Talarico last seen in public? Trump claims ‘bad rumors coming out’ about DemocratMajor issues and policiesUsing his own experience with Type 1 diabetes followed by high costs of insulin, he prioritizes providing an affordable healthcare option to all Americans. Through his campaign website, Talarico also proposes to lower prescription drug prices and strengthen the Affordable Care Act. He has also called for addressing medical debt, protecting reproductive healthcare access and strengthening rural hospitals. Talarico has also worked to lower prescription drug costs in Texas by supporting an insulin cost cap and allowing the state to import cheaper medicines from Canada. Talarico also proposes raising taxes on wealthy individuals and large corporations while providing greater financial support to working families. He proposed expanding the Child Tax Credit and raising the wages for American workers up to $15 per hour. He is also keen on addressing rising housing and grocery costs and repealing the “Trump tariffs”.As a former middle school teacher himself, he made public education an integral part of his political agenda. Talarico supports increased funding for public schools, better teacher pay, early childhood education and improved mental health support for students. In January 2023, he announced a bill proposing a $15,000 pay raise for every teacher in Texas, after mentioning his own financial struggles as a former teacher. He also opposes private school voucher programs that use public funds to pay for private education. Talarico's views on immigration, jobs and tradeTalarico has proposed to pass immigration reforms that focus on border security. He also proposed the deportation of criminals, gang members and human traffickers. Further, he supports giving citizenship to immigrants who have been in the US for a long time now. He also called for developing more advanced technology to detect drugs and other threats more efficiently.Talarico has also advocated for setting up vocational training programs that allow young workers to enter the workforce. His campaign highlights his record in the Texas Legislature of supporting workforce development as well. He publicly opposes tariffs, believing that they act as hidden taxes and increase costs. His broader trade agenda also emphasizes maintaining international partnerships and strengthening supply chains.Talarico's stance on the Iran conflict and AIDuring the campaign, Talarico has criticized the Iran conflict, arguing that it has led to an increase of fuel prices. Citing how the Iraq war “robbed America of young lives”, he argues that military conflicts can also cost resources while damaging the country’s standing internationally. He has also called for diplomatic efforts to secure peace in the Middle East region and for US foreign policy to prioritize protecting civilians.Talarico advocated for regulating technology companies in order to safeguard social media to protect minors. He also proposed protecting workers from AI surveillance, requiring human review of automated workplace decisions and ensuring AI companies follow copyright laws. As per his website, he protected victims of explicit deepfakes during his time in the Texas Legislature. He also supported the establishment of the Texas Cyber Command that helps to protect infrastructure systems. Notably, Talarico supports the usage of AI in classrooms in order to maximize learning among students as well.Also Read | Texas election results: Who won the Senate, governor and attorney general primaries? Ken Paxton vs John Cornyn winnerTalarico's controversiesTalarico has faced criticism over his remarks on gender and religion. In a 2021 Texas House committee hearing, he said biological sex was not limited to two categories and referred to six biological sexes. He also drew criticism for saying that “God is non-binary.” He later clarified that what he meant was God could not be defined by human categories.In February 2026, a TikTok influencer named Morgan Thompson claimed that in a private conversation, Talarico referred to former US Representative Colin Allred as a “mediocre Black man”. Thompson also claimed that he contrasted Allred with Jasmine Crockett, describing her as a “formidable, intelligent Black woman”. Talarico, however, denied the allegations, calling them “mischaracterization of a private conversation”.Net worth and moreAccording to the Federal Election Commission (FEC), his Senate campaign raised approximately $68.56 million and had about $21.55 million in cash on hand as of June 30, 2026. A June 2026 Forbes report covered billionaire donors supporting his Senate campaign, estimating at least $2.5 million contributions. However, his personal net worth is not a matter of public records.As the 2026 US Senate race in Texas approaches, Talarico is campaigning on issues including healthcare, public education, immigration and economic policy. His record as a state legislator and former teacher remains central to his campaign as he prepares to face Republican Ken Paxton in the November election.-ByTanisha Sharma

title: Man beheads wife in Bengal's Bankura, places severed head at temple, kills father too; arrested | India News
description: The incident took place at Nat Lalbaba Manachar, an area on the bank of the Damodar River that borders the jurisdictions of Sonamukhi police station in Bankura | India News
content: A man was arrested for allegedly beheading his wife and killing his father with a sharp weapon in West Bengal's Bankura district, police said on Tuesday.The incident took place on Monday night at Nat Lalbaba Manachar, an area on the bank of the Damodar River that borders the jurisdictions of Sonamukhi police station in Bankura district and Kanksa police station in Paschim Bardhaman district.The accused, identified as Mangal Choudhury, allegedly beheaded his wife, Rumpa Choudhury (39), before killing his father, Rajendra Choudhury, aged around 60, with a sharp weapon, according to police.Also Read | Bengal man arrested for retired school teacher's murder in DelhiThe severed head of the woman was allegedly placed at a temple, triggering panic in the area.The body of Rajendra Choudhury was recovered from the courtyard of the house. Mangal also allegedly attempted to attack his brother, who managed to escape.Police from Sonamukhi and Kanksa police stations reached the spot after receiving information about the incident. Both bodies were recovered, and arrangements were being made to send them for post-mortem examination, sources at Sonamukhi police station said.The motive behind the double murder remains unclear, with investigators yet to establish whether the crime was linked to occult (tantric) rituals or whether any other person had instigated the accused.Local residents said that Mangal and his wife regularly offered prayers at a temple and that a tantric practitioner used to visit their house.However, police have not confirmed any link between the murders and tantric practices, and the circumstances leading to the crime remain under investigation.The accused was arrested on Monday. However, he could not be produced before a court as he had an injured finger and was admitted to Bankura Sammilani Medical College and Hospital for treatment, the police said.

title: సికింద్రాబాద్, విశాఖ, తిరుపతి మధ్య ప్రత్యేక రైళ్లు.. షెడ్యూల్, హాల్టింగ్ స్టేషన్ల వివరాలు ఇవే! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: పండుగ సీజన్ కారణంగా ప్రయాణికుల రద్దీని దృష్టిలో పెట్టుకుని రైల్వే శాఖ ప్రత్యేక రైళ్లను ప్రకటించింది. ఈ ట్రైన్స్ విశాఖ, తిరుపతి, సికింద్రాబాద్ మధ్య ఉన్నాయి.
content: పండుగ సీజన్‌లో ప్రయాణికుల రద్దీని దృష్టిలో ఉంచుకుని దక్షిణ మధ్య రైల్వే కీలక నిర్ణయం తీసుకుంది. ప్రయాణికుల సౌకర్యార్థం వివిధ ప్రాంతాల మధ్య ప్రత్యేక రైళ్లను నడుపుతున్నట్లు ప్రకటించింది. ఈ మేరకు దక్షిణ మధ్య రైల్వే చీఫ్ పబ్లిక్ రిలేషన్స్ ఆఫీసర్ ప్రకటన విడుదల చేశారు. సికింద్రాబాద్ - తిరుపతి, విశాఖపట్నం - సికింద్రాబాద్ మధ్య నడిచే ఈ ప్రత్యేక రైళ్ల షెడ్యూల్, వేళలు, ఆగే స్టేషన్ల పూర్తి వివరాలు చూడండి.సికింద్రాబాద్–తిరుపతి07424(సికింద్రాబాద్ నుండి తిరుపతి) స్పెషల్ ట్రైన్ అక్టోబర్ 22, 2026 సికింద్రాబాద్‌లో రాత్రి 8 గంటలకు బయలుదేరుతుంది. మరుసటి రోజు శుక్రవారం ఉదయం 11 గంటలకు తిరుపతి చేరుకుంటుంది. ఈ ప్రత్యేక రైలు మార్గమధ్యంలో చర్లపల్లి, నల్గొండ, మిర్యాలగూడ, గుంటూరు, తెనాలి, చీరాల, ఒంగోలు, నెల్లూరు, రేణిగుంట స్టేషన్లలో ఆగుతుంది. ఈ రైలులో 2ఏసీ, 3ఏసీ, స్లీపర్, జనరల్ సెకండ్ క్లాస్ కోచ్‌ అందుబాటులో ఉంటాయి.విశాఖపట్నం – సికింద్రాబాద్విశాఖపట్నం, సికింద్రాబాద్ నగరాల మధ్య ప్రయాణించే వారి కోసం రెండు వైపులా ప్రత్యేక రైళ్లను అందుబాటులోకి తెచ్చారు. విశాఖపట్నం – సికింద్రాబాద్ స్పెషల్ (Train No. 08517) అక్టోబర్ 22, అక్టోబర్ 25, 2026 తేదీల్లో నడుస్తాయి. విశాఖపట్నంలో మధ్యాహ్నం మధ్యాహ్నం 3:50 గంటలకు బయలుదేరి, మరుసటి రోజు ఉదయం 8 గంటలకు సికింద్రాబాద్ చేరుకుంటుంది.సికింద్రాబాద్ – విశాఖపట్నం స్పెషల్ (Train No. 08518) అక్టోబర్ 23, అక్టోబర్ 26 తేదీల్లో ఉంటాయి. సికింద్రాబాద్‌లో రాత్రి రాత్రి 8 గంటలకు బయలుదేరి, మరుసటి రోజు మధ్యాహ్నం 12:05 గంటలకు విశాఖపట్నం చేరుకుంటుంది. ఆగే స్టేషన్లు వివరాలు చూస్తే.. దువ్వాడ, అనకాపల్లి, సామర్లకోట, రాజమండ్రి, భీమవరం టౌన్, గుడివాడ, విజయవాడ, గుంటూరు, మిర్యాలగూడ, నల్గొండ, చర్లపల్లి స్టేషన్లలో నిలుస్తాయి. ఈ రైళ్లలో కూడా 2ఏసీ, 3ఏసీ, స్లీపర్, జనరల్ సెకండ్ క్లాస్ కోచ్‌లను ఏర్పాటు చేశారు.పండుగ వేళ స్వగ్రామాలకు, ఆధ్యాత్మిక క్షేత్రాలకు వెళ్లే ప్రయాణికులు ఈ ప్రత్యేక రైలు సేవలను వినియోగించుకోవాలని దక్షిణ మధ్య రైల్వే కోరింది. ప్రయాణికులు రైల్వే ఐఆర్‌సీటీసీ వెబ్‌సైట్ లేదా స్టేషన్ కౌంటర్ల ద్వారా ముందస్తు రిజర్వేషన్ చేసుకోవచ్చు.

title: Film workers' body urges PM Modi to intervene in Daler Mehndi row: ‘Advise public reps to exercise greater sensitivity when dealing with artists’ | Hindustan Times
description: FWICE has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to intervene after Uttarakhand minister Subodh Uniyal publicly reprimanded Daler Mehndi during a cultural event.
content: From Anupam Kher and Kapil Sharma to Badshah, several Bollywood and Punjabi celebrities have come out in support of Daler Mehndi after he was publicly reprimanded by Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal at a cultural event. Now, the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, seeking his intervention and expressing concern over the treatment of the singer at the event.FWICE comes in support of Daler MehndiIn its letter, the film and television workers' body said concerns about the singer's physical condition and performance should have been handled sensitively. "While we appreciate the importance of maintaining the proper conduct of public events, such concerns ought to be addressed with sensitivity and discretion rather than through public reprimand," read the letter, a copy of which was also sent to Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami.The organisation said it was aware that the singer had been dealing with health issues and was recovering from a recent surgery. It also maintained that he does not consume alcohol, stressing, "In these circumstances, it is particularly important to exercise restraint before drawing conclusions about an artist's condition. Any concerns regarding a performer's well-being should be addressed with compassion and professionalism." The letter also highlighted Daler's contribution to Indian music. It read, "Shri Daler Mehndi is a celebrated name in Indian music whose songs and performances have earned him widespread recognition across generations. An incident involving the public humiliation of such a senior artist is deeply distressing to the entire entertainment fraternity. We therefore respectfully request your kind attention to this incident and urge you to advise the concerned authorities and public representatives to exercise greater sensitivity when dealing with artists and performers."All about the controversyThe controversy began when Uttarakhand minister Subodh Uniyal took to the stage and expressed displeasure while Daler Mehndi was performing at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in Narendra Nagar on Sunday night. The cultural event was organised by the Uttarakhand government. A video of the incident went viral on Monday, showing the minister reprimanding Daler and criticising him for allegedly lip-syncing instead of singing live. Uniyal also alleged that the singer was intoxicated and was unable to speak or stand properly.Speaking to ANI, Uniyal later explained that he had reprimanded Daler because he felt the singer was not doing justice to his art. He claimed that Daler appeared disoriented on stage, struggled to stand and was lip-syncing rather than singing live. The minister added that the singer had been paid ₹35 lakh for the performance, which prompted him to express his displeasure.Daler's brother, singer Mika Singh, has since demanded an apology from Uniyal for publicly reprimanding the veteran singer.(with inputs from PTI)

title: Researchers used environmental DNA to detect the critically endangered Chinese bahaba in Hong Kong waters for the first time in more than a decade | World News
description: Researchers detected DNA of the endangered Chinese bahaba in western Hong Kong waters, the first discovery in over a decade, without catching a single fish.  | World News
content: Sometimes the biggest news can come from the smallest clues. According to a Lingnan University press release dated July 23, 2026, researchers found traces of the Chinese bahaba in western Hong Kong waters. The release calls it the first scientific discovery of this fish in the city in over a decade. The fish itself was not caught. The evidence came from DNA left behind in seawater.About the Chinese bahabaThe Chinese bahaba is a large fish found off the Chinese coast. It can grow up to two meters in length and is often called the “Panda of the Sea”. In the 20th century, it was abundant around Tai O in Hong Kong, where local people called it the "Tai O fish." The species is classified as critically endangered by the International Union for Conservation of Nature and as a first-class protected wild animal in China. The Lingnan release said the fish's swim bladder has value as medicine. That demand led to intense overfishing and a dramatic population decline in the wild.How scientists track fish they can't seeFish release DNA in tiny bits of mucus and waste as they swim. Scientists call this environmental DNA, or eDNA. Lingnan University’s Division of Science jointly developed an eDNA test for the Chinese bahaba using mitochondrial genome sequences. The test can identify the species without confusing it with other fish, and the release said lab tests and computer analysis confirmed this. The work was led by Prof. Jack Ip Chi-ho of Lingnan University and Prof. Junjie Wang of South China Normal University. The study was supported by the Marine Ecology Enhancement Fund of the Airport Authority Hong Kong and two other research projects. What the survey foundBetween January and September 2025, the team surveyed 23 sites in western Hong Kong waters. They took three one-liter samples of seawater at each site, and because the team returned to the sites several times, the sampling added up to a total of 414 samples. Sterile distilled water was also used as a control to rule out contamination. DNA of the Chinese bahaba was detected at four sites in September 2025: Tai O, Sha Chau and Lung Kwu Chau Marine Park, Southwest Lantau Marine Park and Sunny Bay. Tai O had the highest frequency and concentration. That timing coincides with an August 2025 release of about 1,300 hatchery-reared juvenile bahaba into the Pearl River Estuary. The researchers suggest some of these young fish may have entered western Hong Kong waters.Why this approach mattersIp explained that the fish is so rare that it is very unlikely to be encountered in regular surveys. Such surveys usually involve trawling or capture, and require skilled staff and a lot of money. They can also harm seabed habitats and put non-target species at risk. Water sampling is a less invasive method because researchers can verify a species’ presence without having to catch or disturb it. The team says the tool could help groups evaluate the effectiveness of juvenile release programs. It could also help biodiversity monitoring in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.What this does and does not tell usThe method can help with long-term monitoring of the bahaba in the Pearl River Estuary and adjacent waters, the team says. A trace of DNA tells you a fish has been there, but not how many. Because the detections coincide with the hatchery release, the findings do not show that a wild population has survived; the DNA may well have come from released juveniles. Prof. Ip said the bahaba has not been recorded in Hong Kong waters for over a decade. With this tool, conservation groups can track the movement of released fish without having to catch them.

title: Veeramani’s aide bought gold to shield boss in sexual abuse case: Police | India News
description: Shaktivel, the manager, was arrested on October 18 for allegedly transferring cash to “influential people” | India News
content: Industrialist R Veeramani’s manager procured 23 bars of gold to protect his boss, who was arrested in August in Chennai for allegedly sexually assaulting girls over years, investigators said.Shaktivel, the manager, was arrested on October 18 for allegedly transferring cash to “influential people.” Police have not named anyone who received money or gold from him.A police officer said a probe is underway to ascertain whether Shaktivel transferred the funds to protect Veeramani from police action.Veeramani, 84, was arrested after a local court rejected a police closure report in the case in February. The report was filed four months after Veeramani’s purportedly explicit video with a minor was submitted to the police in October 2025.Police told the court that the case could be reopened if new evidence emerged. But the court instructed police to continue the probe.Attempts were allegedly made to hush up the case. A person aware of the matter said on condition of anonymity that Shaktivel transferred funds and purchased 23 gold bars weighing 23 kg on Veeramani’s instructions between February and July. The gold bars were purchased from a well-known jeweller with showrooms across Tamil Nadu.The Special Investigation Team investigating Veeramani’s alleged sexual crimes is also looking for Prakash, one of his financial advisors. Police said Prakash received most of the funds through Veeramani’s group companies.A second person said it was being investigated whether the gold Shaktivel purchased and the funds Prakash received were used to pay some “high-profile” people to protect Veeramani from arrest.An investigation is underway regarding the monetary transactions made through Shaktivel, the eighth person to be arrested in the case, to help Veeramani evade police arrest, the person said.The sale of Veeramani’s two properties worth ₹36.52 crore and ₹43.72 crore near Chennai is under the scanner as it coincided with the police closure report in February.Police are investigating the link between the sale and the case and whether the proceeds were used as bribes.Police have registered seven cases of sexual assault under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act against Veeramani and recorded 11 statements of minors.Veeramani’s drivers Lazer, Parthiban and Babu, who allegedly brought his victims to his home, were arrested on October 5 and remanded to judicial custody.Police said searches were conducted at the residences of Veeramani in Chennai, his farmhouse and an office, and some incriminating documents were recovered.

title: Delhi’s air quality remains ‘poor’ for second consecutive day; no relief expected in coming days | India News
description: Stubble burning’s share of the city’s pollution areto rise from 3.9% on Wednesday to 7.4% on Thursday and 15.9% on Friday | India News
content: Delhi’s air quality remained in the ‘poor’ category for the second consecutive day on Thursday morning with the air quality index being recorded around 253 (9am). According to data available from 56 of 59 monitoring stations, Chandni Chowk, Vivek Vihar and Jahangirpuri recorded air quality in the very poor zone with readings of 307, 306, 309 respectively.Nineteen stations recorded air quality in the moderate zone while the remaining were in the poor category.Also Read | How pollution in Delhi surged on Dussehra nightDelhi recorded the season’s first ‘poor’ air on Wednesday as smoke from Dussehra celebrations, trapped by still, damp night air, pushed the AQI into the poor category and prompted the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) to invoke Stage I of the Graded Response Action Plan (Grap) across Delhi-NCR. Also Read | Grap 1 imposed in Delhi-NCR as AQI enters 'poor' category day after DussehraThe AQI climbed from 179 on Tuesday to 245 at 4pm on Wednesday, the highest reading of the season and the worst since July 13, when it stood at 246. The 66-point jump was the third-largest the day after Dussehra in the past decade, and Wednesday’s reading the worst for the day after the festival since 2021, when the index stood at 284.Farm fires risingThe Decision Support System for Air Quality Management in Delhi forecasts stubble burning’s share of the city’s pollution to rise from 3.9% on Wednesday to 7.4% on Thursday and 15.9% on Friday, while the India Meteorological Department (IMD) and the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology expect the air to stay ‘poor’ over the coming days.

title: In spotlight after HC ruling: The secrecy around orders from government to take down social media posts | HT Explainers
description: The rules do not require users to be informed of takedown orders, but the HC held that notifying affected users is essential to natural justice. | HT Explainers
content: When the government wants a social media post, page or account inaccessible in India, the order goes to the platform, not to the person who posted it. The user usually finds out only when the content disappears or the platform sends an automated message, and often never sees the order itself.On October 5, 2026, the Punjab and Haryana High Court said this cannot continue under one of the two main takedown routes. A copy of the order must go to the user at the same time it goes to the platform.The government has two main legal ways to get content removed, and they come with very different levels of transparency. The first is blocking under Section 69A of the Information Technology (IT) Act. It lets the Centre direct an intermediary to block public access to information in the interest of the sovereignty and integrity of India, defence, security of the State, friendly relations with foreign states or public order, or to prevent incitement to a cognisable offence related to these. Orders issued under it are confidential in nature. The procedure is laid down in the IT (Procedure and Safeguards for Blocking for Access of Information by Public) Rules, 2009.The second route is a notice under Section 79(3)(b) of the Act, read with Rule 3(1)(d) of the IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021. Section 79 protects platforms from liability for what their users post, but that protection is lost if the platform is notified by the government that content is being used for an unlawful act and does not remove it quickly. Rule 3(1)(d) turns this into a deadline. It was originally 36 hours, but amendments notified in February 2026 cut it to three hours. Many of these notices are routed through the Sahyog portal run by the Home Ministry’s cyber crime coordination centre.The 2009 blocking rules do give some role to the affected party. Rule 8 says the government’s Designated Officer should identify the person or platform hosting the content and issue a notice asking them to appear before the examining committee. Rule 9 allows an emergency interim direction without that hearing, with the matter to go to the committee within 48 hours. But Rule 16 requires all blocking requests and actions to be kept strictly confidential, so the order is rarely seen even by those most affected by it.Rule 3(1)(d) of the 2021 Rules has no such hearing provision at all. Nothing in it requires the government to tell the user whose content is affected, or to make the order public.Also read: Australia to sue Facebook, TikTok over violations of under-16 social media banThe Punjab and Haryana High Court rulingIn Haryana 24 News Network Private Limited v Union of India and Others, decided on October 5, 2026, Justice Tribhuvan Dahiya set aside the blocking of a news company’s Facebook page, which the Superintendent of Police, Yamuna Nagar, had ordered. The page had been blocked in India since August 21, 2026.The Superintendent of Police sent an intimation to Meta on August 21 asking it to disable the page. The company said it was never told. Its directors learned of the block only from a notice on the page itself, in which Meta said access had been restricted in India after a notice from the Government of India or law enforcement under Section 79(3)(b), and told the user to “reach out to The Government of India/Law Enforcement” for details. The company said neither the police nor Meta ever gave it a copy of the intimation.The court found the intimation invalid on two grounds. First, the rules say that where the police issue such an intimation, the officer must be of the rank of Deputy Inspector General of Police or above and specially authorised by the government. A Superintendent of Police is below that rank. The state argued the power had been delegated to him, but the court said it could not point to any rule allowing that, and called the officer’s action an arbitrary exercise of power.Second, the court noted that nothing showed the mandatory monthly review of such intimations had been carried out, even though more than a month had passed. It held that the intimation was without jurisdiction, so Meta was not required to act on it.The state argued that the company should first have gone to Meta’s grievance officer under Rule 3(2) of the IT Rules. The court refused to send it there. It said that a hearing before the grievance officer is meaningless if the user does not know what the intimation says or what material it relied on. The rule does not expressly require the government to tell the user, but the court held this is an essential part of natural justice and has to be read into the rule.The court ordered Meta to restore the page. It added that if the authorities find anything illegal on the page in future, they must give the company a copy of any new intimation immediately after sending it to the platform.The October 2025 amendment on who can send a noticeThe ruling builds on a change the government itself made a year earlier. In October 2025, MeitY amended the IT Rules to bring in senior-level authorisation for takedown notices under Rule 3(1)(d). Such notices can now be issued only by an officer not below the rank of Joint Secretary or equivalent, or a Director-level officer where no Joint Secretary has been appointed, in the Central or a State Government.Police can issue them only through a specially authorised officer of Deputy Inspector General rank or above. Lower-ranking officers can no longer send direct blocking orders. The notice must also be a reasoned one in writing, stating the legal provision invoked, the nature of the unlawful act and the specific URL to be removed, and all such notices are to be reviewed every month by an officer of at least Secretary rank. The High Court’s judgment quotes this amended text in full.The change came after a long dispute over who could send such notices. In July 2025, X Corp’s counsel told the Karnataka High Court it would be dangerous if “every Tom, Dick and Harry officer” could send takedown notices, a remark the government objected to. In September 2025, the High Court dismissed X’s petition and upheld the government’s power to issue the notices, and X said it would appeal. The amendment followed about a month later.What the amendment did not do was require the government to tell the affected user. That is the gap the Punjab and Haryana High Court has now filled, at least within its jurisdiction.Also read: ‘How can 12-13 year-olds have social media accounts?’: Supreme Court orders Centre to remedy law for minorsSection 69A and the secrecy of ordersRule 16 of the blocking rules treats directions under section 69A as confidential. The Telegram block this June is one of the rare cases where such orders came to light.MeitY, acting on the recommendation of the National Testing Agency, issued orders under Section 69A, blocking Telegram across India to disrupt organised fraud ahead of the NEET-UG re-examination on June 21. The order also directed Telegram to disable its message-editing feature until June 30, to prevent the fabrication of paper-leak evidence.The orders became known largely because Telegram challenged them in the Delhi High Court, which dismissed its petition on June 19, finding the government had followed the procedure and the step was proportionate given the emergency. Digital rights groups argued that such orders should be published so they can be tested in court, citing the Supreme Court’s 2020 judgment in Anuradha Bhasin v Union of India.

title: ‘Won’t call Jantar Mantar stir’: CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka released after 7-day custody based on condition | India News
description: The SEM directed Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka to furnish personal bonds and sureties of  ₹50,000 each and appear for a hearing on October 23. | India News
content: A special executive magistrate on Wednesday ordered the release of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-conveners Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from judicial custody after they agreed not to call any protests at Jantar Mantar until the site is re-notified as a designated protest site.The written undertakings, furnished before assistant commissioner of police (ACP) Ritu Raj, acting as the SEM of New Delhi district, said, “We reiterate our undertaking and commitment towards peace, law and order, public tranquility and further we specifically state that we will not make any calls for protest at Jantar Mantar till such a time that it is de-notified in accordance with law.”In it, they also promised “not to commit any breach of peace” and expressed “full faith” in the judiciary and the SEM court. The undertakings further reiterated that any protest undertaken by them would be done “within the four corners of the constitution”. The order was also made public on Wednesday.Also read: No Jantar Mantar protest call until it remains de-notified: CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka to courtThe court thereby, accepted the undertakings and ordered their release on furnishing personal bonds and surety bonds of ₹50,000 each.“The immediate measures contemplated under Section 135(3) BNSS for the prevention of a breach of the peace or disturbance of public tranquillity can, in the present circumstances, be adequately secured by the execution of a bond for keeping the peace, supported by the written undertakings now given today in the Court,” the magistrate said, holding that further incarceration was no longer warranted.The magistrate directed the two leaders to strictly comply with their undertakings and bonds and appear at every hearing. They have also been asked to appear with their sureties on October 23, when the police must submit a verification report on the sureties furnished by them.Also read: 'Barricades have a purpose': Delhi HC pulls up Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, cites arson outside IndiaProsecution opposed releaseThe release came two days after the SEM extended their five-day judicial custody by another two days, observing that the leaders showed “no respect for law”.During Wednesday’s proceedings, the investigating officer (IO) had sought a fresh three-day extension of their judicial custody, arguing that “the threat to law and order persisted”.The prosecution, represented by legal consultants Bhairav Dass and Prashant Prakash, opposed their release, contending that the leaders’ public statements and media remarks contradicted their submissions before the court.“Considering their previous conduct and recent developments, the respondents do not deserve any leniency of law,” the prosecution submitted. It also flagged remarks allegedly made by their associates, while the two were being taken to Tihar Jail at an earlier date, claiming these undermined the dignity of the SEM court.Advocate Abhik Chimni, representing Das and Ranka, offered an unconditional verbal apology and assured the court that such conduct would not reoccur.Also read: ‘Suddenly we hear about regime change’: Delhi HC during CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka's plea hearingBackground to the caseThe case arose from preventive proceedings initiated by Parliament Street police under Sections 126 and 170 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) over apprehensions of a breach of peace.Ranka and Das were arrested on October 12 after they scaled an iron gate and entered the Jantar Mantar protest site. They were arrested a day later for “trespassing”. On October 14, SEM sent the duo to five days of judicial custody after the Delhi Police argued that “there was a presumption that the accused might carry out a crime” if released.On Monday, the SEM court extended their judicial custody for another two days. Delhi Police had opposed their release, citing the sensitivity of the festival season and alleging that the leaders had previously violated peace bonds.Also read: 'Truth has triumphed': CJP's Saurav Das as court frees him, Ashutosh RankaPolice officials in their submissions had warned that the two could regroup and plan another protest if released. The defence had argued that there was no concrete evidence to suggest they posed an ongoing threat to public safety or would breach the peace.On October 11, Ranka and Das had been released on the condition that they “can not breach peace” for one year, a day after signed a day after being detained ahead of a planned protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR).

title: FBI offers $20,000 reward in search for Atlanta Homeland Security building arson suspect, releases images | Hindustan Times
description: The FBI is seeking the public’s help to identify a man suspected of attempting to set fire to a federal building in downtown Atlanta.
content: The FBI is seeking the public’s help to identify a man suspected of attempting to set fire to a federal building in downtown Atlanta. A reward of up to $20,000 is being offered.The agency released photos of the man and said that the attempted arson occurred Tuesday evening, October 20, at the Department of Homeland Security building at 180 Ted Turner Drive, which houses an Immigration and Customs Enforcement field office. The FBI notice says that the incident took place at about 8:14 p.m.Also Read | Sam Altman breaks silence, shares rare family photo after Molotov cocktail thrown at his home at 3:45 am “The FBI is seeking information about an unidentified male suspected of involvement in an attempted arson at the DHS/ICE building at 180 Ted Turner Drive in downtown Atlanta on October 20, 2026, at approximately 8:14 p.m. The suspect fled southbound on Ted Turner Drive,” the FBI wrote on X. What earlier reports saidThe FBI earlier said that its agency is investigating reports that a possible incendiary device was thrown at the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement building in downtown Atlanta on Tuesday night, October 20. There was an active scene near the ICE field office on Ted Turner Drive."There is no known threat to public safety at this time," the FBI shared in a statement, per 11Alive.Also Read | What is a Molotov cocktail, used in attack on pro-Israel activists in US?11Alive journalist Cody Alcorn shared details about the alleged incident.“Source tells me Atlanta ICE Field Office on Ted Turner Dr. SW was hit with what was described to me as Molotov cocktails tonight. @Atlanta_Police is on scene. Working to get additional details,” he wrote on X.He later added in an update, “Crime scene established along the exterior gates of the field office on Ted Turner.”Alcorn also shared an update from FBI Atlanta, which reads, “FBI personnel and evidence response technicians are on site collecting evidence. There is no known threat to public safety at this time. The investigation is ongoing, and no further details are currently available”.

పనిమనిషి వసంతను పిలుస్తుంది రేఖ. కాఫీ పెట్టమంటే కుదరదని చెబుతుంది.రేఖకు ఎదురుతిరిగిన పనిమనిషిపొయ్యి ఖాళీ లేదు. వంట చేస్తున్నాను. ఈరోజు పెద్దయ్యగారు పెద్దమ్మగారి పెళ్లి రోజు అంటగా. వాళ్లకోసం చేస్తున్నాను అని పనిమనిషి చెప్పి వెళ్లిపోతుంది. నీ మాట అంటే లెక్కలేకుండా పోతుందేంటీ రేఖ అని భ్రమరాంబ అంటుంది. మరోవైపు గుడిలో సుభాష్, అపర్ణ పూజ చేస్తారు. నా మనవడు మనవరాలు నిజంగా వివాహబంధంతో ఒక్కటికావాలని కోరుకుటుంది అపర్ణ.అదంతా సులువు కాదని ఓ స్వామిజీ ఎంట్రీ ఇస్తాడు. గురువుగారు చాలా కాలం తర్వాత మీ దర్శనం దక్కింది. కానీ ఎందుకు అలా అన్నారో అర్థం కావడం లేదని అపర్ణ అంటుంది. మీ వంశానికి వారసుడు అయిన రాజు జీవితాన్ని మృత్యువు నీడలా వెంటాడబోతుంది. తన ప్రాణాలకు పెనుప్రమాదం ముంచి ఉంది. పుష్కరకాలం క్రితం రాజు ప్రాణ గండం నుంచి బయటపడ్డాడు. ఇప్పుడు మళ్లీ ప్రాణగండం ఉందని స్వామిజీ అంటాడు.దీనికి పరిష్కారం చెప్పమని అపర్ణ అంటుంది. రాజు, ఇందుల సాన్నిహిత్యం పెళ్లి బంధంతో ముడిపడాలి. ఇద్దరికి బ్రహ్మముడి పడాలి. ఇందు మాంగళ్య బలం రాజుకు తోడుకావాలి. ఇది వెంటనే జరగాలి. ఇప్పుడు చేసే చిన్నపొరపాటు రేపు జరగబోయే పెద్ద విపత్తుకు దారి తీయొచ్చు అని చెప్పి వెళ్లిపోతాడు స్వామిజీ. మరోవైపు రాజు, ఇందు కారులో వెళ్తుంటారు.రాజు, ఇందుకు తప్పిన గండంరాజు లేట్ చేశాడని కోప్పడుతుంది ఇందు. రూల్స్ గురించి మాట్లాడుతుంది. రాజు రొమాంటిక్ సాంగ్స్ పెడతాడు. ఇందు చిరాకుపడుతుంది. ఐదు నిమిషాల్లో ఆఫీస్‌లో ఉండాలంటుంది ఇందు. దాంతో రాజు స్పీడుగా వెళ్తాడు. రాంగ్ రూట్‌లో ఒకడు రావడంతో రాజు సడెన్ బ్రేక్ వేస్తాడు. ఇంతలో అపర్ణ ఫోన్ చేసి ఎక్కడున్నావని అడుగుతుంది.యమలోకానికి దగ్గరిగా వెళ్లి వచ్చేశాను అని ఇందు చెబుతుంది. ఏంటే సరిగా చెప్పు అని అపర్ణ అంటే.. ఇప్పుడే యాక్సిడెంట్ చేస్తూ మిస్ అయి కారు పక్కకు తీసుకుని ఉన్నామని ఇందు అంటుంది. వెంటనే రమ్మని అపర్ణ ఆర్డర్ వేస్తుంది. రాజుకు పని అప్పగించి రమ్మని సుభాష్ అంటాడు. రాజుకు అదే విషయం చెబుతుంది ఇందు. మరోవైపు బంగారం బాక్స్‌ను పట్టుకొస్తూ కింద పడేస్తాడు వెంకీ.అందులో గోల్డ్ చూసి ఇది 24 క్యారెట్ గోల్డ్ కాదని కొలిక్‌తో అంటాడు వెంకీ. ఇది ఐశ్వర్య కంపెనీకి క్వాలిటీ లేని గోల్డ్ పంపిస్తే ఎలా రా అని వెంకీ అంటాడు. ముందు మన కంపెనీ గురించి ఆలోచించు. అదంతా వద్దని ఫ్రెండ్ అంటాడు. వాళ్ల కుటుంబం గురించి నాకు తెలుసు. వాళ్లు ఇలాంటి గోల్డ్ అడగరు. మన కంపెనీలో ఏదో ఫ్రాడ్ జరుగుతుందిరా అని వెంకీ అంటాడు.కంపెనీ ఫ్రాడ్ కనిపెట్టిన వెంకీనువ్వు మరీ ఎక్కువ ఆలోచిస్తున్నావ్. అంత పెద్ద కంపెనీకి ఇంత తక్కువ క్వాలిటీ పంపిస్తే తెలియదా. క్వాలిటీ చెక్ ఉంటుందని ఫ్రెండ్ అంటాడు. నా ముందు తప్పు జరిగితే నేను ఊరుకోలేనురా అని వెంకీ అంటాడు. ఎన్నిసార్లు మేనేజర్‌తో తిట్లు తింటావురా. లైట్ తీసుకో అని ఫ్రెండ్ అంటాడు. అందరూ లైట్ తీసుకుంటున్నారంటే కచ్చితంగా ఇక్కడ ఫ్రాడ్ జరుగుతుంది. లైట్ తీసుకోలేను అని వెంకీ మనసులో అనుకుంటాడు.మరోవైపు ఇందుకు రాజును నిజంగా పెళ్లి చేసుకో అని చెబుతుంది. ఎందుకు అని ఇందు అడుగుతుంది. విషయం చెప్పకుండా వాడికి ఇష్టం లేకున్నా పెళ్లి చేసుకోమ్మని అపర్ణ చెబుతుంది. పేమెంట్ ఇచ్చినట్లు చేసుకోవాలా. అదంతా కుదరదు. బావ నన్ను పెళ్లి చేసుకోను అంటే నేను తట్టుకోలేను అని ఇందు అంటుంది.ఇప్పుడు వాడిని పెళ్లి చేసుకోకుంటా తర్వాత చేసుకుందామన్న వాడు ఉండడే. వాడికి ప్రాణగండం ఉందే. నువ్వు వాన్ని పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటేనే వాడు బతుకుతాడు అని గుడిలో స్వామిజీ చెప్పినగురించి అపర్ణ చెబుతుంది. ఇందు నమ్మదు. మృత్యువు ఏ రూపంలో అయిన రావచ్చు. వాడు నీ మెడలో కట్టే తాళిబొట్టే శ్రీరామ రక్ష అని 20 ఏళ్ల క్రితం జరిగిన యాక్సిడెంట్ గురించి చెబుతుంది అపర్ణ.వారం రోజుల టైమ్నువ్వే వెళ్లి వాడితో మాట్లాడి పెళ్లికి ఒప్పించే. మనకు ఇంకా వారం రోజులు మాత్రమే టైమ్ ఉందే అని అపర్ణ అంటుంది. సరేనని ఇందు అంటుంది. మరోవైపు రేఖ కంగారుగా అటు ఇటు నడుస్తుంటుంది. ఇలాంటి బతుకు బతికేకన్నా చావడం మేలు అని శేషు అంటాడు. ఇదే ఆలోచన వాళ్లకు వచ్చేలా చేస్తానని రేఖ అంటుంది. ఈ ఇంట్లో పెద్ద తలకాయ పోతే వీళ్లందరికి భయం పుడుతుందిగా. ఇంట్లో పెద్ద అనిపించుకుంటున్న ఆ తలకాయను లేపేస్తా అని రేఖ అంటుంది.కొంపదీసి చంపేస్తావా ఏంటీ అని శేషు షాక్ అవుతాడు. ఎలా ఏంటీ అని భ్రమరాంబ అడుగుతుంది. ఇవాళ వాళ్ల పెళ్లి రోజు కదా. కానీ ఇదే వాళ్ల ఆఖరి రోజు. ముసలోడికి మెడిసిన్ వేస్తారుగా. రాజు ఇవాళే కొత్త మెడిసిన్ తెచ్చాడు. అందులో మనం డోస్ పెంచేస్తాం. అది సుభాష్‌కి అపర్ణ ఇస్తుంది. కాసేపటికి రియాక్షన్ కొట్టి రక్తం కక్కుని అక్కడిక్కడే చస్తాడు అని రేఖ ప్లాన్ చెబుతుంది.రాజునే మెడిసిన్ తెచ్చాడు కాబట్టి వాన్ని నిందిస్తాం. రాజు కావాలనే మెడిసిన్ తెచ్చాడని ఇందును నమ్మిస్తాం. అప్పుడు రాజును ఇంట్లోంచి ఇందు గెంటేస్తుంది అని రేఖ అంటుంది. ఇక నువ్వే ఇంటికి దిక్కు అవుతావని భ్రమరాంబ అంటుంది. ఒకవేల మన ప్లాన్ వికటిస్తే అందరూ కలిసి మనమీద పడతారని, ఇదేదో తేడా కొట్టేలా ఉందని శేషు అంటాడు.చావుగంట మోగిస్తాఈరోజు ఈ ఇంట్లో చావుగంట మోగించకపోతే నా పేరు రేఖనే కాదని శపథం చేసి వెళ్లిపోతుంది రేఖ. మరోవైపు సీఈఓ కుర్చీలో రాజు కూర్చుంటాడు. ప్రశాంత్ వస్తాడు. మేడమ్ గురించి అడిగితే ఇందుకేనా డల్‌గా ఉన్నావని అడుగుతాడు రాజు. మేడమ్ నాకు దేవతలాంటిది. నేను భక్తుడిని సర్ అని ప్రశాంత్ అంటాడు. టేబుల్‌పై కాళ్లు పెట్టుకుంటాడు రాజు.డిజైన్స్ గురించి రాజు అడిగితే.. 3 రోజుల్లో కంప్లీట్ చేస్తానని ప్రశాంత్ అంటాడు. అంటే నీకు శాలరీలో 70 శాతం కట్ చేసి ఇస్తామని రాజు అంటాడు. అంతపని చేయకండని ప్రశాంత్ వేడుకుంటాడు. ఇంతలో వెంకీ వస్తాడు. తన కంపెనీలో ఫ్రాడ్ జరుగుతుందని, అందులో ఐశ్వర్య కంపెనీకి కూడా భాగం ఉందని డౌట్‌గా ఉందని వెంకీ చెబుతాడు.వెంకీని జైలుకు పంపే సలహాగోల్డ్‌లో క్వాలిటీ లేదని చెబుతాడు వెంకీ. అదే విషయం ఇందుకు చెబుతాడు రాజు. బిజినెస్ చేసే స్టైల్ మార్చుకోమ్మని ఐశ్వర్యకు రాజు వార్నింగ్ ఇస్తాడు. రాజు, ఇందు నీపై ఎంక్వైరీ చేసేలోపు వెంకీని జైలుకు పంపిస్తే సైలెంట్ అవుతారని ఐశ్వర్యకు రేఖ సలహా ఇస్తుంది. అక్కడితో నేటి బ్రహ్మముడి సీరియల్ ఎపిసోడ్ ముగుస్తుంది.

title: In 2018, DNA from wild canines on a Texas island revealed genes from red wolves, a species declared extinct in the wild nearly four decades earlier | World News
description: A 2018 study found red wolf genes in wild canines on a Texas island, decades after the species was declared extinct in the wild. No pure wolves were found.  | World News
content: Imagine an animal that vanished from the wild and then left a clue in a place no one expected. That’s what happened on Galveston Island, Texas. A 2018 study titled ‘Rediscovery of Red Wolf Ghost Alleles in a Canid Population Along the American Gulf Coast,’ published in the journal Genes, found red wolf genes in the DNA of wild canines there. Red wolves had been declared extinct in the wild by 1980. Even the scientists were surprised by the finding, because conventional science had dismissed red wolf sightings along the Gulf Coast as misidentified coyotes.A species on the edgeRed wolves (Canis rufus) once ranged throughout the southeastern United States. They are bigger than coyotes but smaller than gray wolves. By the 1970s, they were becoming extinct, and many were cross-breeding with coyotes. The last known red wolves were captured for a captive breeding program in an effort to save the species.The Princeton University study news report said 240 canines were captured for the program. Seventeen were determined to be pure wolves, and of these, fourteen were able to breed. North Carolina began reintroducing red wolves in 1987. But the report says that as of 2018, the wild population had fewer than 40 red wolves, putting the species once again on the brink of extinction in the wild. A scalpel in the mailThe study began with wildlife biologist Ron Wooten, who had been tracking a pack of canines on Galveston Island. He emailed Bridgett vonHoldt’s lab at Princeton, requesting genetic testing on two road-killed animals. vonHoldt says she gets that kind of request often. But his enthusiasm and dedication showed through, as did some very interesting photographs of the dogs. Then the second sample got lost along the way, so Wooten sent the scalpel he had used to take it. Researcher Elizabeth Heppenheimer said no one had ever sent the lab a scalpel before, which made extracting that DNA memorable.What the DNA showedHeppenheimer said the find was remarkable because red wolves had been declared extinct in the area more than 35 years ago. The team compared the Galveston DNA with samples taken from 29 coyotes in Alabama, Louisiana, Oklahoma, and Texas. They also used 10 gray wolves from Yellowstone, 10 eastern wolves from Algonquin Provincial Park in Ontario, and 11 captive red wolves.The Galveston animals were genetically closer to captive red wolves than to typical southeastern coyotes. They had genes found in captive red wolves, but not found in coyotes and gray wolves. They also had a genetic variation found in no known North American canine. Heppenheimer said it may represent red wolf genes lost during captive breeding. The study title uses the term "ghost alleles", and alleles are simply different versions of a gene.What it means, and what it does notThat doesn’t mean there’s a secret pack of pure red wolves hidden somewhere. The researchers only had photographs and small samples from road-killed animals to work with and did not measure any body dimensions. The animals were “ambiguous-looking,” Heppenheimer acknowledged, probably because of interbreeding. Wolves and coyotes tend to interbreed only when population densities are very low.Texas may be a good place for future reintroduction efforts, Heppenheimer said, but first more research is needed. If reintroduced wolves interbreed with local coyotes, the hybrids could help restore lost red wolf genes. There might not be a “canonical coyote” in the American Southeast, said senior author vonHoldt. Some coyotes, she said, might retain genetic traces of an extinct species. Heppenheimer, a lead author along with Kristin Brzeski, credited the people on the ground for the discovery.

title: Saints are having a big-screen moment: After Hanuman Ansh films on Goswami Tulsidas, Sant Ravidas, Sant Haridas, Sai Baba, Sant Tukaram and more | Hindustan Times
description: After Hanuman Ansh, Bollywood is finding inspiration in India’s saints, with films on Goswami Tulsidas, Sant Ravidas, Sant Haridas and Sai Baba on the way
content: The phenomenal success of Hanuman Ansh, based on the life of spiritual guru Neem Karoli Baba, has put stories of Indian saints in the cinematic spotlight. Directed by Dr Vishal Chaturvedi, the film, reportedly made on a budget of under ₹2 crore, has crossed ₹450 crore worldwide since its August 7 release. And Bollywood is taking notice. At least six films are now in various stages of development.From two films on 16th-century poet-saint Goswami Tulsidas to projects on Sant Haridas, Sant Ravidas and Sai Baba, filmmakers are turning to India’s spiritual figures for inspiration. A film on 17th-century Marathi saint Tukaram is also eyeing a theatrical re-release, while projects on Guru Nanak and Sant Kabir are reportedly in the pipeline. A second instalment of the Hanuman Ansh trilogy is also planned. RambolaChaturvedi, who has already announced Rambola, a biopic on Tulsidas, believes the success of Hanuman Ansh has opened doors for a genre that producers were previously hesitant to back.“Genuinely, ek mahaul bana hai! For many years, industry people did not believe that this genre could work. I am sure with more successful films like this they will. Spiritual films and projects on Indian saints and personalities will work,” he says, adding, “Some will surely take it as a formula, but those who make it with full honesty will get success. The good thing is that producers will now believe that such projects can work.”He adds, “Hanuman Chalisa was the core of my debut film so it’s a natural leap to make a film on the writer of Hanmanu Chalisa which is Goswami Tulsidas. It’s my ode to the writer.” Interestingly, filmmaker Dr Chandraprakash Dwivedi also announced a film titled Rambola on Dussehra, based on the same poet-saint.Raidas Ek VicharThe trend extends beyond Tulsidas. Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha director Abhishek Singh, who is working on Raidas Ek Vichar, based on Sant Ravidas, says, “Our cinema takes a leap towards a genre after every decade, and now I see a trend where films on saints will work if made honestly. These are legends of our country about whom not many know about extensively. So, with films on them, the audience will like it, cinema will get a new variation and people will get aware about our sant-mahatma. I have been working on it since 2024, and we will go on floor in May 2027. It will have a big chunk on Mirabai too.” He adds, “I take it as a very positive trend and will be commercially beneficial for makers and good content for the audience but there should not be an overkill like so many have started making mythological films AI. Like, I planned Ramayana five years back when no other project was coming but it took me five years and it’s co-incidence it’s released near another (Nitesh Tewari’s) Ramayana.”HaridasFor The Taj Story (2025), director Tushar Amrish Goel, Hanuman Ansh has given him the confidence to move ahead with his film on Swami Haridas, the saint associated with Vrindavan’s Banke Bihari temple (he discovered the idol of Banke Bihari at Nidhi Van): “Now, I have faith this story should be told, and we will begin the shoot in early 2027 in Vrindavan.” The filmmaker who hails from Meerut says, “I have been seriously working on projects rooted to our culture and history. The Taj Story was an attempt in this direction. I feel people should attempt a film when it's backed with a story line that can attract audience else make a documentary if just want to show historical facts.”He adds, “I had an idea but after Hanuman Ansh, I got that faith that we can got confidence that such projects can work and get a back-up from producers. Thanks to Vishal Chaurvedi, makers now thinking on such projects.”Tera Sai Meanwhile, Palaash Muchhal’s Tera Sai, starring Sanjay Mishra as Sai Baba, is complete and slated for an early 2027 release. The film also stars Sayaji Shinde, Manoj Joshi, Omkar Das Manikpuri, Avika Gor and Rohan Mehra. Being made in Hindi, Marathi, Telugu and Tamil, the film is slated for February 2027 release. The filmmaker had also visited Shirdi with Mishra and team members to take Baba’s blessing.Sant Tukaram Director Aditya Om is planning a February re-release of his 2025 film Sant Tukaram, starring Subodh Bhave, after legal issues affected its theatrical run. “The film opened with good reviews but got stuck in some issues. Now, it's the right time to bring the film back in theatre as I feel people should know about our greats,” he adds.Trade viewHowever, trade analyst Komal Nahta cautions against treating faith as a box-office formula: “Audiences don't go to films just for a genre. Formule se film nahi chalti, it has to appeal. All types of films work, but just because a film on Baba worked, it does not mean all films in the same genre will work. They view films for the good content they get! It's once in a while that films work purely on faith, provided all stars are in sync."

title: Maharashtra medical interns threaten strike from November 1 over stipend hike | Mumbai news
description: Odisha offers medical interns up to  ₹44,000 a month, while West Bengal pays  ₹43,000, according to the figures cited by the Association of State Medical Interns.  | Mumbai news
content: Over 8,000 medical interns across Maharashtra have threatened to go on strike from November 1 if the state government does not increase their stipend from ₹18,000 to ₹30,000. The Association of State Medical Interns (ASMI) has also announced that its members will wear black ribbons at their hospitals on Thursday as a mark of silent protest.“The stir could impact services in 42 government hospitals and 28 major private hospitals attached with medical colleges across the state,” said ASMI president Dr Rushikesh Sangle. “The emergency services, the outpatient department, and various procedures and allied services in private and public hospitals could be affected.”Also read: J&K medicos call off strike after Omar promises 100% stipend hikeDelegation to meet medical education minister over pending hikeAn ASMI delegation is slated to meet Maharashtra’s medical education minister Hasan Mushrif later this week to discuss the demands, Sangle added. During a meeting earlier this month, Mushrif had reportedly confirmed to the delegation that his department had approved the hike and forwarded the file to the planning and finance department to align with revisions made in other states. However, the hike has not been enforced yet.Maharashtra has over 8,000 medical students who are completing a mandatory one-year internship as part of their MBBS course. The internship is done after the final examinations and is required to obtain the degree and permanent medical registration to practice.Currently, Odisha offers the highest stipend in the country at ₹41,000- ₹44,000, followed by West Bengal ( ₹43,000), Assam ( ₹36,000), and Delhi ( ₹30,000- ₹34,000). States that pay stipends lower than Maharashtra include Uttarakhand ( ₹17,000), Chhattisgarh ( ₹15,900), Madhya Pradesh ( ₹14,000), Uttar Pradesh and Mizoram (both ₹12,000).Also read: Ladakh’s first medical college to become operational in 2027 as centre approves staff recruitment IMA backs interns, flags rising cost of livingMaharashtra’s medical students have also received support from bodies such as the Indian Medical Association (IMA), which has written to authorities including the Maharashtra chief minister, medical education minister, and the principal secretary (medical education and drugs department).“The existing stipend of ₹18,000 no longer reflects the prevailing cost of living and the professional responsibilities entrusted to interns,” the IMA wrote in its letter. “Rising expenses related to accommodation, food, transportation, study materials, examination fees and daily necessities have placed considerable strain on medical graduates during this crucial period of training.”The IMA added that a fair stipend could help improve doctors’ morale, keep pace with inflation and rising living costs, promote professional satisfaction, and support the professional development of future doctors.Earlier, the medical interns had also written to Mushrif, the principal secretary of the medical education department, and the chief minister’s office (CMO) about their demand. “We received the demand a few days ago, and we are examining it,” said medical education secretary Dheeraj Kumar.HT also reached out to Mushrif for comment, but didn’t receive a response till the time of going to press.

title: పాపాంకుశ ఏకాదశి మహత్యం: వేటగాడి జీవితాన్ని మార్చిన శ్రీహరి వ్రతం.. ఇలా చేస్తే 10 తరాలకు మోక్షం! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: హిందూ ధర్మంలో పాపాంకుశ ఏకాదశికి ప్రత్యేక స్థానం ఉంది. ఆశ్వయుజ మాసం శుక్ల పక్షంలో వచ్చే ఈ పవిత్రమైన రోజున పద్మనాభుడైన శ్రీమహావిష్ణువును భక్తిశ్రద్ధలతో ఆరాధించడం, ఉపవాసం పాటించడం, దానధర్మాలు చేయడం విశేషమైనవిగా పురాణాలు పేర్కొంటున్నాయి.
content: హిందూ సనాతన ధర్మంలో ఏకాదశి వ్రతాలకు అత్యంత విశిష్టమైన స్థానం ఉంది. మనుషులు చేసిన సమస్త పాపాలను హరించి, మోక్షాన్ని ప్రసాదించే పవిత్ర దినాలలో ఆశ్వయుజ మాసం శుక్ల పక్షంలో వచ్చే ఏకాదశికి ప్రత్యేక గుర్తింపు ఉంది.దీనినే 'పాపాంకుశ ఏకాదశి' అని పిలుస్తారు. ఈ వ్రత మహత్యం గురించి సాక్షాత్తు శ్రీకృష్ణ పరమాత్ముడు ధర్మరాజుకు వివరించినట్లు పద్మపురాణంలో పేర్కొనబడింది. జీవితంలో ఎన్నో పాపాలు చేసిన వారైనా సరే, ఈ ఒక్క రోజు భక్తిశ్రద్ధలతో శ్రీహరిని ఆరాధిస్తే సకల పాపాల నుంచి విముక్తి పొందవచ్చని పురాణాలు చెబుతున్నాయి.పాపాంకుశ ఏకాదశి విశిష్టతశ్రీకృష్ణుడు తెలిపిన వివరాల ప్రకారం, ఆశ్వయుజ శుక్ల పక్ష ఏకాదశి రోజున పద్మనాభ రూపంలో ఉన్న శ్రీ మహావిష్ణువును పూజించాలి. మునులు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లపాటు కఠినమైన తపస్సు చేస్తే లభించే పుణ్యఫలం కేవలం గరుడధ్వజుడైన శ్రీహరిని మనసారా ప్రార్థించడం ద్వారా లభిస్తుంది.భూమిపై ఉన్న సమస్త తీర్థాలను దర్శించిన ఫలం కేవలం విష్ణునామ కీర్తనతోనే సాధ్యమవుతుందని ప్రతీతి. భగవంతుని శరణు లేకపోతె ఎప్పటికీ యమయాతనలు తప్పవు. ఏకాదశి రోజున ఉపవాస దీక్ష ఆచరిస్తే యమలోక బాధలు వుండవు. అయితే, విష్ణు భక్తులుగా ఉంటూ శివ నింద చేయడం లేదా శైవ భక్తులు విష్ణు నింద చేయడం మహాపాపమని, అలాంటివారు ఘోర నరకాన్ని చవిచూడాల్సి వస్తుందని పురాణాలు హెచ్చరిస్తున్నాయి.వేటగాడి కథఈ వ్రత మహత్యాన్ని వివరించేందుకు వింధ్య పర్వత ప్రాంతానికి చెందిన ఓ పాపాత్ముడైన వేటగాడు కథను ఉదాహరణగా చెబుతారు. జీవితాంతం పాప కార్యాలకే పాల్పడిన ఆ వ్యక్తి, తన తుది దశలో యమదూతలను చూసి భయకంపితుడయ్యాడు. వెంటనే మహర్షి అంగిరసుని ఆశ్రయించి తన పాప ప్రక్షాళనకు మార్గం చూపమని వేడుకున్నాడు.అప్పుడు ఆ మహర్షి అతనికి ఆశ్వయుజ శుక్ల పక్ష పాపాంకుశ ఏకాదశి వ్రతం గురించి వివరించారు. ఆ వేటగాడు శ్రద్ధగా ఈ వ్రతాన్ని ఆచరించి తన సమస్త పాపాల నుంచి విముక్తుడయ్యాడు. చివరికి విష్ణు లోకాన్ని చేరుకున్నాడు. పద్మపురాణం ప్రకారం ఈ రోజు ఉపవాస దీక్షతో పాటు రాత్రి జాగారం చేయడం వల్ల మోక్షాన్ని సులభంగా పొందవచ్చు. అంతేకాకుండా, తల్లి తరఫు పది తరాలు, తండ్రి తరఫు పది తరాల పూర్వీకులను కూడా ఉద్ధరించినవారవుతారు.దాన ధర్మాల ద్వారా అపార పుణ్యంఈ పవిత్రమైన రోజున కేవలం పూజలతో సరిపెట్టకుండా శక్తి కొలది దానధర్మాలు చేయడం వల్ల అనూహ్య ఫలితాలు ఉంటాయి. బంగారం, నువ్వులు, భూమి, ఆవు, అన్నం, నీరు, చెప్పులు, గొడుగు వంటి వస్తువులను దానం చేయడం ఉత్తమం. ఇలా చేయడం వల్ల ఆ వ్యక్తి ఎప్పటికీ యమధర్మరాజు ముఖాన్ని చూడాల్సిన అవసరం రాదని విశ్వాసం.హోమం, స్నానం, జప తపాలు, ధ్యానం వంటి పుణ్యకర్మలు ఆచరించే వారికి భయంకరమైన యమయాతనల నుంచి రక్షణ లభిస్తుంది. సమాజంలో ఎంతో దీర్ఘకాలం ఆయువుతో, సిరిసంపదలతో, ఆరోగ్యంతో జీవించేవారు గత జన్మల్లో పుణ్యం చేసుకున్నవారేనని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు స్పష్టం చేశారు. మనుషులు తమ పాపాల వల్ల దుర్గతిని, ధర్మం వల్ల స్వర్గాన్ని పొందుతారని ఈ వ్రత కథ ద్వారా స్పష్టమవుతోంది.

title: 26-year-old stabbed to death over scuffle at Garba event in Thane's Dombivli; 3 held, 2 minors detained | Hindustan Times
description: Police arrested three men and detained two minors in connection with the killing, booking the accused under multiple provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
content: A minor scuffle at a Garba event in Dombivli on October 18 between a 15-year-old and a group of youths led to the murder of the teenager’s elder brother, who intervened to settle the matter amicably, on Monday. The deceased was identified as Sahil Gaikwad, 26, a resident of Dombivli West.The Vishnunagar police arrested three men, including the prime accused Harshad Giri, 20, also a Dombivli West resident, and detained two minors. The other arrested accused are Harshad Giri, Dishant Gaikwad, and Kamlesh, according to the police.Also read: Delhi class 12 student stabbed to death outside school over uniform shoes; 5 heldDispute began with altercation at Garba eventThe events leading to the murder unfolded on the evening of October 18, when the victim’s 15-year-old brother was attending a Garba event, where an argument and subsequent scuffle broke out between him and Giri, the main accused.When Gaikwad learnt about the incident, he approached Giri and his friends the same evening, questioned them about their alleged misbehaviour towards his brother, and urged them to settle the matter amicably. Both sides agreed to resolve the dispute and shook hands.Also read: Chandigarh: 17-year-old boy stabbed to death after dispute at Sector 41 Ramlila, minor heldHowever, on Monday night, when Gaikwad was standing outside a school in Telkoswadi, Dombivli West, Giri and five others allegedly confronted him. Giri then stabbed him multiple times in the chest before fleeing. Gaikwad was rushed to Shastri Nagar Hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.Vijay Marathe, assistant commissioner of police, Dombivli, said the accused are students in classes 11 and 12 at nearby colleges. “We have arrested three accused and detained two minors in the case,” said Marathe.The accused have been booked under sections 103(2), 135, 189(2), 190, 191(2) and 191(3) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS)..

title: Baba Siddique murder: Maharashtra court questions cops approach, seeks details on steps taken to get Anmol Bishnoi’s custody | Mumbai news
description: The special MCOCA court has given investigators until October 28 to submit details of the legal steps taken to bring the jailed accused  | Mumbai news
content: Over two years after former Maharashtra minister and senior NCP leader Baba Siddique was shot dead in Bandra, a special MCOCA court on Wednesday asked Mumbai police to explain why they had not secured the presence of alleged mastermind Anmol Bishnoi in court, even though he is currently lodged in Tihar Jail.Special Judge Satyanarayan Navander asked the prosecution whether it had approached the central government to withdraw the order restricting Bishnoi’s physical removal from prison. The central government order, issued on December 5, 2025 under Section 303 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), bars Bishnoi’s removal from Tihar Jail for one year or until the completion of the trial in the specified case, whichever is earlier.Also read: Baba Siddique case: Did Mumbai police exhaust all options to secure Anmol Bishnoi’s presence?Widow challenges police stand on custodial interrogationThe judge’s question arose during a hearing on an application by Shehzeen Siddique, the slain NCP leader’s widow, who sought action over the alleged failure to comply with the court’s earlier orders. In a written submission, Siddique challenged the investigating officer’s claim that the central government restriction prevented custodial interrogation, arguing that the police could produce him via video-conferencing and also obtain permission to question him inside the jail.The submission cited the Supreme Court’s 2025 ruling in CBI vs Mohd. Yasin Malik case, which dealt with a similar restriction on the accused’s movement from Tihar.Special Public Prosecutor Mahesh Mule requested more time from the court, citing the absence of the case’s investigating officer, ACP Subhash Dhudhgaonkar.Also read: Baba Siddique murder case: Accused moves HC for preserving his call records to prove his charge of illegal detentionCourt had earlier termed investigating officer’s explanation unsatisfactoryOn August 5, the court had issued a show-cause notice to Dhudhgaonkar after he had argued that video-conferencing could not substitute physical custody, without which the investigation would be hampered. The court called his explanation “wholly unsatisfactory”.Advocate Pradeep Gharat, appearing for the intervener alongside advocate Trivankumar Karnani, countered Mule’s request for more time by alleging that the prosecution was deliberately delaying proceedings. He pointed out that over three months had passed since the court’s July 10 order, which directed police to take all legally available steps to secure Bishnoi’s presence, including alternatives such as video-conferencing.Also read: Baba Siddique murder case: Accused alleges 5-day illegal detention by police before arrestPolice directed to submit report by October 28After hearing both the sides, the court set October 28 as the deadline for the police to place on record the steps taken to secure Bishnoi’s presence.Bishnoi is among the key accused in the investigation into Siddique’s murder, which, police allege, involves a wider conspiracy linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. Siddique was shot dead outside his son Zeeshan’s office in Bandra East on October 12, 2024. Police arrested 27 accused in the case.Investigators say Anmol Bishnoi’s physical custody is crucial to probe the conspiracy, identify other participants, and trace alleged financiers, weapons and digital communications. The next hearing in the case is slated for October 28.

title: JMI constitutes committee to draft constitution of Jamia Millia Islamia Students' Union | Education
description: The committee reached out to the protesting students the very next morning on October 19th and visited the protest site to initiate a dialogue.  | Education News
content: Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) has constituted a high-level seven-member committee and reiterated its commitment to resolving the ongoing student protest through dialogue, mutual trust and meaningful and constructive engagement. Following the constitution of a high-level seven-member committee comprising senior Deans and Professors on October 18, 2026, to engage with the protesting students and examine their demands, the committee initiated a series of discussions and took further steps towards addressing the issue of students’ representation on campus, as per the release.Varanasi air show: Schools in two blocks of Chandauli to go online on Oct 22, 24The committee reached out to the protesting students the very next morning on October 19th and visited the protest site to initiate a dialogue. The initial interaction was productive and laid the groundwork for further engagement.Subsequently, the committee requested a list of bona fide students and invited a representative group of students for a discussion at the office of the Dean of Social Sciences.Gujarat Govt tightens school entry rules; outsiders can't enter without permissionAccording to the release, in response to the invitation, student representatives attended the 2-hour meeting on October 20 at the office of the Dean of the Faculty of Social Sciences, in which their grievances were heard and discussed. A further meeting was held at 6:30 p.m. on October 20 at the Dean of Students’ Welfare (DSW) office to formalise the minutes of the discussion, incorporating the broad suggestions put forward by the students. However, despite several rounds of discussion and efforts to finalise the document, the students did not agree to sign the minutes. Notwithstanding this, the above committee and the JMI administration have continued to work towards finding a resolution to the issue.Gwalior’s Chirag Chopra overcomes family debt and academic setbacks to become bank officer through self-studyUnder the chairmanship of the Vice-Chancellor, Prof Mazhar Asif, and in the presence of the Registrar, JMI, Prof. Md.
