title: అటుకులతో రుచికరమైన కట్లెట్.. సంజీవ్ కపూర్ సీక్రెట్ రెసిపీ ఇదే | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: రోజూ తినే అటుకులతో ఎంతో రుచికరమైన స్నాక్ తయారు చేసుకోవచ్చని చెబుతున్నారు ప్రముఖ షెఫ్ సంజీవ్ కపూర్. కేవలం 30 నిమిషాల వ్యవధిలో క్రిస్పీ పోహా కట్లెట్ తయారు చేసే విధానాన్ని ఆయన పంచుకున్నారు. ఆ వివరాలు మీకోసం.
content: అటుకులు అనగానే మనకు ముందుగా గుర్తుకొచ్చేది సాధారణ పోహా ఉప్మా. అయితే, రోజువారీ టిఫిన్‌కు భిన్నంగా, సాయంత్రం వేళల్లో వేడివేడిగా ఏదైనా క్రిస్పీ స్నాక్ తినాలనిపిస్తే అటుకులతో కట్లెట్ ట్రై చేయవచ్చని ప్రముఖ సెలబ్రిటీ షెఫ్ సంజీవ్ కపూర్ సూచిస్తున్నారు.ఇంట్లో అందుబాటులో ఉండే సాధారణ దినుసులతోనే కేవలం అర గంట తయారీ సమయం, మరో 20 నిమిషాల వంట సమయంతో ఈ రుచికరమైన కట్లెట్లను సులువుగా చేసుకోవచ్చని ఆయన వివరించారు.పోహా కట్లెట్ తయారీకి కావలసిన పదార్థాలుదొడ్డు అటుకులు - 1½ కప్పులునూనె - 2 టేబుల్ స్పూన్లు (కట్లెట్స్ షాలో ఫ్రైకి సరిపడా)ఆవాలు - ½ టీస్పూన్జీలకర్ర - 1 టీస్పూన్ఇంగువ - ¼ టీస్పూన్కరివేపాకు - 8 నుంచి 10 ఆకులుపచ్చిమిర్చి తరుగు - 2ఉల్లిపాయ తరుగు - 1 (పెద్దది)పసుపు - ¼ టీస్పూన్ఉప్పు - రుచికి సరిపడాఉడికించి, తురిమిన బంగాళాదుంపలు - 2 (మధ్యస్థ పరిమాణం)వేయించిన పల్లీల పొడి - ¼ కప్పుకొత్తిమీర తరుగు - 2-3 టేబుల్ స్పూన్లుచక్కెర - ½ టీస్పూన్నిమ్మకాయ - సగం చెక్కగ్రీన్ చట్నీ - సర్వింగ్ కోసంపోహా కట్లెట్ తయారీ విధానంముందుగా అటుకులను జల్లెడలో (స్ట్రైనర్) వేసి నీటితో శుభ్రంగా కడిగి, 8 నుంచి 10 నిమిషాల పాటు పక్కన ఉంచాలి.నాన్ స్టిక్ పాన్‌లో 2 టేబుల్ స్పూన్ల నూనె వేసి వేడెక్కాక ఆవాలు వేయాలి. అవి చిటపటలాడాక జీలకర్ర, ఇంగువ వేసి బాగా కలపాలి.ఆ తర్వాత కరివేపాకు, పచ్చిమిర్చి తరుగు వేసి కొద్దిసెకన్ల పాటు వేయించాలి. అనంతరం ఉల్లిపాయ ముక్కలు వేసి పారదర్శకంగా మారే వరకు వేగనివ్వాలి. అందులోనే పసుపు, రుచికి సరిపడా ఉప్పు వేసి కలపాలి.ఈ మిశ్రమంలో ఉడికించిన బంగాళాదుంప గుజ్జు, వేయించిన పల్లీల ముక్కలు, కొత్తిమీర, చక్కెర వేసి బాగా కలపాలి. మిశ్రమం బాగా వేడెక్కే వరకు రెండు నుంచి మూడు నిమిషాల పాటు ఉడికించాలి.ఇప్పుడు ఈ మిశ్రమాన్ని ఒక బౌల్‌లోకి తీసుకుని, ముందుగా కడిగి పెట్టుకున్న అటుకులను అందులో వేసి బాగా కలపాలి. చివరిగా నిమ్మరసం పిండి, బాగా కలిపి చల్లారనివ్వాలి.మిశ్రమం చల్లారిన తర్వాత సమాన భాగాలుగా చేసుకుని, చేతితో ఉండలుగా చుట్టి, కట్లెట్ ఆకారంలో ఒత్తుకోవాలి.నాన్ స్టిక్ పాన్‌లో షాలో ఫ్రైకి సరిపడా నూనె వేసి వేడిచేయాలి. కట్లెట్లను అందులో వేసి రెండు వైపులా దొరగా, క్రిస్పీగా మారే వరకు వేయించాలి. వేగిన కట్లెట్లను టిష్యూ పేపర్‌పై తీసి అదనపు నూనెను తొలగించాలి.వీటిని సర్వింగ్ ప్లేట్‌లోకి తీసుకుని వేడివేడిగా గ్రీన్ చట్నీతో వడ్డిస్తే ఎంతో రుచికరమైన అటుకుల కట్లెట్ సిద్ధమవుతుంది.షెఫ్ సంజీవ్ కపూర్ గురించి..1964 ఏప్రిల్ 10న జన్మించిన సంజీవ్ కపూర్ భారతదేశపు ప్రసిద్ధ సెలబ్రిటీ షెఫ్, టీవీ ప్రెజెంటర్, రచయిత, వ్యాపారవేత్త. 1990లలో ప్రసారమైన ప్రముఖ వంటల కార్యక్రమం 'ఖానా ఖజానా'తో ఆయన ప్రతీ ఇంట్లో సుపరిచితులుగా మారారు. ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పలు రెస్టారెంట్లను ప్రారంభించిన ఆయన, భారత పాకశాస్త్ర రంగానికి చేసిన సేవలకుగానూ 2017లో భారత రాష్ట్రపతి చేతుల మీదుగా ప్రతిష్టాత్మక పద్మశ్రీ పురస్కారాన్ని అందుకున్నారు.

title: By 2023, five years after Isle Royale’s wolf restoration began in 2018, researchers found the effort had established a self-sustaining wolf population | World News
description: A five-year study found that 19 wolves brought to Isle Royale built a self-sustaining population of at least 27, though genetic diversity is still a concern.  | World News
content: How do you bring a species back to an island when only two animals remain? That was the challenge on Isle Royale, a wilderness national park in Lake Superior, where the last two wolves were not breeding. A five-year assessment published in Conservation Science and Practice said a restoration project that began in 2018 achieved its goal of establishing a self-sustaining wolf population. The study period ran from September 24, 2018, to September 1, 2023. It also used computer modeling to examine the odds of the wolves still being alive on the island 20 years from now.A park that lost its wolvesAccording to a 2017 BioScience article by Mech and colleagues, wolves and moose have been studied on the 540-square-kilometer island since 1958. Wolves arrived across the ice about 1949, and their numbers once rose to about 50. They averaged about 25 a year over the years. Then the population fell to two nonbreeding wolves. The park has long been known for its wolves and moose, and the research draws strong interest from visitors. The authors saw it as a unique opportunity for science-based park management. At the time, the Park Service had proposed bringing in 20 to 30 wolves over three years to reestablish the population. How 19 wolves were brought inResearchers documented that the National Park Service moved 19 wolves to the island between September 2018 and September 2019. The animals were from Minnesota, Michigan, and Ontario, Canada. To preserve social bonds, managers tried to move wolves that had been in the same packs together. The research also compares this to an Idaho wolf project where older pack members were released in pairs or trios. The goal was not just to reintroduce wolves to the island. The goal was to build a population that could last 20 years. To track progress, the team looked at wolf counts, reproduction, and recruitment, which means young wolves joining the population.What happened over five yearsThe figures moved in the right direction. The first winter they monitored, researchers counted ten wolves. By April 2023, the minimum count was 27. A minimum count is the lowest number of wolves researchers can verify. The wolf count rose in the five years after the move. The count was above the 50-year average of 22 wolves in three of the five years. The wolves also bred each year, including the year they arrived. Researchers tallied at least 10 litters and 29 pups. These totals do not simply add up, because wolves also died or left the island along the way. About three out of four wolves survived each year, and four of the 11 mainland wolves had died within a year. The wolves formed packs and established territories much like those of earlier generations of wolves. The assessment also points to a family group from Michipicoten Island as a major source of new pups. Citing these trends, the authors concluded that the project met its objective of establishing a self-sustaining wolf population.What the numbers say about the futureThe study also cast an eye forward. Its population simulations indicated an 80% plus chance wolves would remain on the island for 20 years. That held even at high levels of inbreeding. The simulations incorporated inbreeding depression, meaning that inbreeding can reduce survival or reproduction, so the odds already accounted for that risk. Based on trends in reproduction, recruitment, counts, and viability, the researchers said they expected the project to meet its goal of a wolf population lasting more than 20 years. But simulations are not guarantees. Genetic diversity remains a concern for a small group on an isolated island. The early results are encouraging, but the long-term picture will take more time to confirm.

title: Trump administration revokes over 300,000 visas as immigration checks tighten | Hindustan Times
description: The Trump administration has revoked more than 300,000 visas, citing criminal conduct, public-safety risks, immigration violations and fraud.
content: The State Department has confirmed that the Trump administration has invalidated over 300,000 United States visas following President Donald Trump's return to office, thereby intensifying the government's comprehensive immigration enforcement measures.According to Tommy Pigott, a State Department spokesperson, the administration announced on Tuesday that it “has revoked more visas at a faster pace than any administration in history.”The official stated that the administration maintains “zero tolerance” toward international visitors holding visas who engage in unlawful conduct, perpetrate fraudulent activities, or pose threats to national security.According to previous departmental records, over 175,000 visa cancellations had been processed by August 10. The department had earlier disclosed that more than 100,000 visa cancellations were executed in January."We are taking, and will continue to take, action to keep our borders, and our nation, secure," Pigott stated.Also Read: H-1B visa crackdown: Cloudera breaks silence as US bars tech giant from sponsoring Green Cards: ‘We don't discriminate’Trump's illegal immigration crackdownThe Trump administration's immigration enforcement strategy encompasses measures targeting both undocumented and lawful immigration pathways, featuring extensive apprehension operations and removal proceedings combined with stricter regulations governing legal entry channels.Legal immigration admissions have declined by approximately fifty percent following policies implemented during the current year, concurrent with substantial reductions in refugee intake and a stated preference for South African white nationals in resettlement programs. The administration has prioritized combating birth tourism and visa fraud through enhanced enforcement mechanisms.Why are US visas being revoked?A spokesperson from the State Department informed Al Jazeera that the predominant portion of visa revocations resulted from criminal conduct, public-safety risks, immigration law breaches, fraudulent activities or false statements, or additional evidence demonstrating the individual no longer qualified for visa status.Among the revoked visas, 25 percent were tied to assault and related offenses, while 22 percent involved driving under the influence, according to the official. Theft represented 7 percent of cases, with substance abuse or distribution accounting for an additional 7 percent. Over 4,000 revocations targeted people whom the department identified as having participated in or supported “birth tourism” activities.The State Department has not disclosed a detailed analysis of the 300,000 visa revocations categorized by nationality or visa type, making it difficult to determine which foreign national populations have experienced the greatest impact.In addition to revoking visas, the Trump administration has implemented stricter social media review procedures for immigrants and visa applicants.Heres' what happens when visa gets revokedThe revocation of a visa typically prohibits the holder from using that document for travel to the US. Individuals living outside the United States may find themselves unable to travel with a revoked visa, whereas those already present within the country may maintain their current immigration status provided that no additional measures are implemented.Guidance for Indian nationalsIndian citizens planning to travel to the United States for academic pursuits, professional opportunities, commercial ventures, or leisure activities should be aware of the following considerations.• Adhere to visa requirements: Academic visa holders must meet all conditions stipulated by their immigration classification, while working professionals must verify that their employment and conduct align with their approved visa category.• Furnish correct documents: Discrepancies or false statements in visa petitions and accompanying materials may result in immigration complications.• Recognize visa limitations: A visa serves as authorization for a foreign national to apply for entry into the United States; however, it does not ensure entry approval. Visa cancellation and removal proceedings are distinct legal matters.• Review official correspondence: Individuals who receive formal notification or suspect their visa status has been revoked should contact the US embassy, consulate, or appropriate immigration agencies to obtain personalized guidance regarding their circumstances.

title: Delhi government to spend  ₹20 crore on three foot overbridges, a skywalk across the city | Latest News Delhi
description: Each of these pedestrian bridges has provisions for passenger lifts, escalators, and LED lighting fixtures as part of the pedestrian infrastructure.  | Latest News Delhi
content: The Public Works Department (PWD) will spend nearly ₹20 crore on the construction of three foot overbridges (FOBs) and a skywalk in Delhi, including an ₹8-crore pedestrian crossing at the junction of Road No. 68 and Road No. 69 near the district commissioner’s office in Shahdara, officials said.The department will also redevelop the Foot Over Bridge (FOB) near Jhandewalan Mandir at Rani Jhansi Road,To be sure, experts suggest opting for at-grade or ground-level crossings for people, as FOBs have served little purpose in urban planning, with people choosing to use the road instead of FOBs even where these are constructed.The projectsThe Shahdara project, located in the Trans-Yamuna area, will be developed at the junction of two roads near the DC office in Nand Nagri. The project includes civil and electrical works, with ₹7.40 crore allocated for civil construction and ₹66.48 lakh for electrical components. The three FOBs covered under the second tender will come up at Shahbad Dairy on Badli-Bawana Road, near the A-2 Block Jeevan Park bus stand close to the Major Deepak Tyagi traffic signal, and near Mata Chanan Devi Hospital at the C-1 red light on Pankha Road in Janakpuri.Officials said the skywalk project is expected to be completed in eight months, while a three-month deadline has been set for the remaining FOBs. According to PWD officials, ₹8.07 crore has been earmarked for the Shahdara project, while ₹11.56 crore will be spent on three foot overbridges at Shahbad Dairy on Badli-Bawana Road, near the Jeevan Park bus stand and near Mata Chanan Devi Hospital in Janakpuri, whereas one crore would be spent on the Jhandewalan facility. The combined estimated cost of the four projects is around ₹20.64 crore.Each of these pedestrian bridges has provisions for passenger lifts, escalators, and LED lighting fixtures as part of the pedestrian infrastructure, aimed at making the crossings more accessible and improving pedestrian safety. The works will also include the revamp of adjoining areas, the restoration of disturbed surfaces, and other allied construction activities.Earlier this year, the Delhi government’s Foot Over Bridge (FOB) Committee approved the construction of eight new pedestrian bridges at key traffic intersections across the city’s arterial roads managed by the PWD. Among the newly cleared locations are Madhuban Chowk in northwest Delhi, Shabad Dairy on Bawana Road, Ber Sarai Market near Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) and a site near Okhla Sabzi Mandi.

title: US launches nationwide operation targeting undocumented immigrants accused of SNAP fraud | Hindustan Times
description: ICE says it has arrested multiple immigrants accused of fraudulently obtaining SNAP benefits, as part of the Trump administration’s anti-fraud initiative.
content: The US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has launched a nationwide operation targeting undocumented immigrants accused of fraudulently obtaining taxpayer-funded food assistance benefits, as the Trump administration expands its efforts to investigate alleged fraud involving federal programs.ICE announced the operation in a post on X on October 21, saying multiple immigrants had been arrested over allegations of fraud involving the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), which provides food assistance to eligible low-income individuals and families.The agency said the operation was part of the Trump administration’s Task Force to Eliminate Fraud, a broader initiative aimed at addressing alleged misuse of government-funded programs.“SNAP is designed to help struggling American families put food on the table, NOT fund illegal aliens scamming taxpayer-funded programs,” ICE said in its post. The agency added that it would continue pursuing those accused of fraud, with arrests and deportations among the potential consequences for individuals subject to immigration enforcement.Also read: Green Card renewal in US: How Indians can seek a review after an application denialICE targets alleged food assistance fraudThe announcement follows a broader federal crackdown on suspected fraud involving SNAP and other government assistance programs.According to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), the nationwide operation has resulted in multiple arrests. The department identified several Haitian nationals and a Cuban national among those apprehended, according to a report by Fox News.DHS said the operation would continue as authorities investigate allegations that individuals fraudulently obtained benefits.However, allegations of fraud do not establish guilt, and the circumstances of individual cases depend on the evidence and legal proceedings involved.Also read: US legal immigration falls by half under Trump as visa restrictions hit 91 countriesWhat is SNAP and who qualifiesSNAP, commonly known as food stamps, helps eligible households with limited incomes purchase groceries through benefits issued on electronic benefit transfer cards.The US Department of Agriculture (USDA) administers the program, while states handle applications and benefits distribution.Undocumented immigrants are not eligible for SNAP benefits under federal rules. Certain categories of lawfully present noncitizens may qualify if they meet the applicable immigration-status and other eligibility requirements, according to the USDA.The program is intended to support eligible households facing food insecurity, with federal and state authorities responsible for preventing and investigating misuse.Trump administration expands fraud crackdownThe ICE operation is part of a wider effort by the Trump administration to investigate suspected fraud across federal assistance programs.On October 21, the Justice Department announced a nationwide enforcement effort involving SNAP and other US Department of Agriculture programs. The department said actions against more than 40 defendants involved alleged or established schemes that were associated with nearly $45 million in intended losses to the federal government, including nearly $42 million involving SNAP.The cases included allegations of stolen benefit-card information, fraudulent transactions and schemes involving the exchange of benefits for cash or other prohibited items.The Justice Department said the enforcement effort involved federal prosecutors, the USDA and other law enforcement agencies.ICE has said it will continue targeting individuals accused of fraudulently accessing food assistance benefits as the administration pursues its broader anti-fraud initiative.

title: Texas GOP candidate Brandon Herrera sparks backlash over joke about sending kittens to Chinese restaurants | Hindustan Times
description: A resurfaced clip shows Texas congressional candidate Brandon Herrera suggesting shelters work with Chinese restaurants to avoid euthanizing unadopted kittens.
content: Republican congressional candidate Brandon Herrera has drawn renewed attention after a video resurfaced showing him joking about sending unadopted kittens to Chinese restaurants during a podcast appearance, invoking a racist stereotype about Chinese people and the consumption of cats and dogs.The remarks were made during an appearance on The Josie Show last year and circulated again on social media on October 21, 2026. Herrera is running for the US House of Representatives in Texas’ 23rd Congressional District against Democratic candidate Katy Padilla Stout. During the conversation, the host, known as The Redheaded Libertarian, recounted rescuing a kitten after learning that its three siblings were on an animal shelter’s euthanasia list. She said she returned to help the other kittens and arranged for a rescue organization to find them homes.Also read: JD Vance says 'there's a chance' he may not run for 2028 presidential race to succeed TrumpHerrera responded by saying he disliked seeing animals euthanized unnecessarily, before suggesting that shelters could work with Chinese restaurants.What Brandon Herrera said about unadopted kittens“I hate to see animals put down for no reason,” Herrera said during the conversation.He then added: “Like, the very bare minimum, they could at least collaborate with the local Chinese restaurant and some sort of like— Don’t let it go to waste, you know?”The exchange, which was part of a discussion about rescuing vulnerable animals, subsequently resurfaced on X.Also read: Obama condemns probe into Ilhan Omar, says Trump administration is using federal power to intimidate herThe clip showed Herrera making the suggestion while responding to the host's account of efforts to save the kittens. The remarks turned a conversation about animal welfare into a joke implying that the animals could be sent to a Chinese restaurant for consumption.Who is Brandon Herrera?Herrera, a firearms content creator known online as “The AK Guy”, is running for Congress in Texas’ 23rd Congressional District. He is challenging Democratic candidate Katy Padilla Stout for the seat.The episode adds to scrutiny of candidates' past public statements during election campaigns, particularly when their remarks involve ethnic stereotypes.

content: Podarillu Serial Today Episode: పొదరిల్లు సీరియల్ ఈరోజు ఎపిసోడ్‌లో నేను 3 లెక్కపేటేదాకా అలాగే ఉండాలని మహాలక్ష్మి అంటే.. 30 లెక్కపెట్టేదాకా కూడా ఉంటానని కేశవ అంటాడు. అవసరం లేదు 3 చాలు అని లెక్కపెడుతుంది మహా. 1, 2 చెప్పి 3 మాత్రం చెప్పదు. పల్లీలు తీసుకొచ్చి తింటుంది. చక్రి, మాధవను కూడా కూర్చోమని తింటారు.ఐస్ క్రీమ్ దొంగతనంఏవండి 3 అనరా అని కేశవ అడిగితే.. నాకు మూడు ఉన్నప్పుడు అంటాను. వారం తర్వాత అంటానని మహా అంటుంది. దాంతో దెబ్బకు కేశవ టీ పాయ్ మీద నుంచి దిగుతాడు. అలా కేశవతో మహా ఆడుకుంటుంది. మీరు ఓడిపోయారోచ్.. కాబట్టి ఇద్దరు ఐస్ క్రీమ్ షేర్ చేసుకుని తినిపించాలి అందరికి అని మహాలక్ష్మి అంటుంది. బయటకు వెళ్లి ఐస్‌క్రీమ్ కొంటారు.చక్రికి మహా ఏదో చెబుతుంది. అదే విషయం కేశవ, పెద్దిలకు చెబుతాడు చక్రి. అంతా ఐస్‌క్రీమ్ తీసుకుని దొంగతనంగా పరిగెత్తుతారు. అంటే అంతా కలిసి ఐస్ క్రీమ్ దొంగతనం చేస్తారు. ఎందుకు పరిగెత్తారు. నేను ముందే ఐదు వందలు ఇచ్చానని మహా అంటుంది. దాంతో అంతా షాక్ అవుతారు. మీరు పరిగెత్తడం వల్ల రావాల్సిన చిల్లర కూడా పోయింది. మీరు మధ్యలో దూరితో ఇంతే. నష్టమే అని మహా అంటుంది.అక్కడ ఇద్దరు అమ్మాయిలి పానీపూరి తింటుంటారు. ఇప్పుడు మహాను ఏడిపిద్దామని వాళ్లను పిలిచి మీరు హీరోయిన్ కదా అని పులిహార కలుపుతాడు. ఇంటికెళ్లేదాకా మూసుకునేలా చేస్తానని కన్నాతో అంటుంది మహా. పెద్దిని కాయిన్ అడిగి.. కిందపడేసి తీయమంటుంది మహా. చక్రి తీసేందుకు కిందకు వంగుతాడు అప్పుడే కర్చీఫ్‌ని చింపేస్తుంది.పోలీస్‌కు దొరికిన చక్రిదాంతో చక్రి ప్యాంట్ చిరిగినట్లుగా వెనక్కి రెండు చేతులు పెట్టుకుంటాడు చక్రి. మూసుకునేలా చేయడమంటే ఇదేనని మహా అంటుంది. రెండు చేతులు వెనక్కి పెట్టుకుంటాడు. వెనకేముందిరా చూపించు అని అడుగుతాడు పెద్ది. చక్రి సిగ్గుతో వెనక్కి వెళ్తాడు. అక్కడున్న ట్రాఫిక్ కానిస్టేబుల్‌ను చూసుకోకుండా గుద్దుతాడు. దాంతో పోలీస్ కోప్పడుతాడు.ఎవరయ్యా నువ్వు. దొంగవా.. నీ చేతుల్లో ఏముందు చూపించూ అని గొడవ చేస్తాడు పోలీస్. వెళ్లి నిజం చెప్పమని మహా అంటుంది. కేశవ వెళ్లి వాడి ప్యాంట్ చిరిగింది అందుకే చేతులు అలా పెట్టుకున్నాడని చెబుతాడు. దాంతో పోలీస్ వదిలేస్తాడు. చక్రిని తీసుకొస్తాడు. నీకో విషయం చెప్పనా చిరిగింది నీ ప్యాంట్ కాదు కర్చీఫ్ అని మహా ట్రిక్ గురించి చెబుతాడు కేశవ.మూసుకునేలా చేస్తానని చెప్పి చేసిందని కన్నా అంటాడు. అంతా నవ్వుతారు. హమ్మయ్య కన్నా నవ్వాడని అంటారు. ఏం జరిగినా మన మంచికే అనుకోవాలి. నవ్వుతూ ఉండాలని పెద్ది అంటాడు. షాప్ ఓపెనింగ్‌కి అంతా రావాలని కేశవ అంటాడు. మరుసటి రోజు ఉదయం కేశవ షాప్‌కి వెళ్తుంటారు. దారిలో మహా ఆగమంటుంది.కేశవను ఆటాడుకున్న మహా అండ్ కోముహుర్తం బాగాలేదా అని తలో మాట అంటారు. నేనేమైనా పంచాంగాలు చూసే పంతులమ్మనా అని మహా అంటుంది. ఆ బుర్రుపిట్టను కాసేపు ఆటపట్టిద్దామని. ఓనర్‌గా అవడం జీవితాంతం గుర్తుంటుందని మహాలక్ష్మి అంటుంది. ఏడిపించే ప్లాన్ చెబుతుంది. కేశవను ఓనర్ గారు అంటూ ఏడిపిస్తారు. ఇలా అయితే నేను వెళ్తానని కేశవ అలుగుతాడు.దాంతో అంతా నవ్వుతారు. నీ కల నెరవేరబోతుంది నా ఆశ తీరుతుందని పెద్ది చెబుతాడు. ఇదంతా మీ వల్లే అని కేశవ అంటాడు. కుటుంబం గురించి గొప్పగా చెబుతాడు పెద్ది. దాంతో చక్రి విజిల్ కొడతాడు. పాత ఓనర్ గురించి అడగ్గానే.. వస్తాడు. మాధవతో డబ్బు ఇప్పిస్తాడు కేశవ. పాత ఓనర్ డబ్బు తీసుకుని ఇకనుంచి ఈ స్థలానికి యజమాని కేశవనే అని అతను చెబుతాడు.అప్పుడే వచ్చిన శైలు అదంతా పక్కన ఉండి చూస్తుంది. ఒక్కో మెట్టు ఎదుగుతూ ఇక్కడిదాకా వచ్చావని పాత ఓనర్ చెబుతాడు. స్లాట్ బుక్ చేశాను. రేపే రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ పెట్టుకుందామని చెప్పి పాత ఓనర్ వెళ్లిపోతాడు. వాళ్లంతా సంతోషంగా ఉంటారు. అందరిని పిలిచి నన్ను ఒక్కదాన్నే వదిలేస్తాడా అని కేశవకు కాల్ చేస్తుంది శైలు. అన్నదమ్ములు చక్కిలిగింతలు పెట్టడంతో కేశవకు వినపడదు.కన్నాపై మహా కోపంశైలు కోపంగా అలిగి వెళ్లిపోతుంది. అందరికి రెస్టారెంట్‌లో కేశవ ట్రీట్ ఇస్తాడు. కన్నా ఫోన్ చూసుకుంటూ డల్‌గా ఉంటే మహా కోప్పడుతుంది. 20 ఏళ్లుగా నీతో ఉండని తల్లి ఇప్పుడు ఉంటుందని ఎలా భ్రమపడ్డావని మహా చెబుతుంది. దాంతో కన్నా హుషారై అందరికి ఏమేం కావాలో ఆర్డర్ ఇస్తాడు. మీ నాన్నకు చికెన్ బిర్యానీ ఒకటి, చికెన్ డ్రమ్‌స్టిక్స్ ఆర్డర్ ఇద్దామని మహా అంటుంది.ఎందుకు బాగా తిని అందరిని తిట్టి కొట్టడానికా. ఆయన గురించి ఎందుకు పట్టించుకుంటున్నారని కన్నా అంటాడు. నువ్వు నిన్ను 20 ఏళ్లు వదిలేసిన నీ తల్లిని నిలదీసి ఉంటే బాగుండేది. 20 ఏళ్ల తర్వాత వచ్చి మళ్లీ వెళ్లినందుకు నీ మీద ప్రేమ లేదని బాధపడి ఉంటే బాగుండేది. సంబంధం లేని మీ నాన్నను ప్రతిసారి నిందించడం నాకు నచ్చలేదు. నోరు మూసుకుని తిను అని కోపంగా చెబుతుంది మహాలక్ష్మి.దాంతో అందరూ తింటారు. అందరూ కలిసి సెల్ఫీ తీసుకుంటారు. తర్వాత రాత్రి నారాయణ మందు తాగుతుంటాడు. నారాయణకు చికెన్ బిర్యానీ ఇస్తుంది. కేశవ బిల్ కట్టి తెచ్చాడని చెబుతుంది మహా. ఇద్దరు నవ్వుకుంటారు. ఇంతలో వచ్చిన కన్నా జమునను పీక పట్టుకుంది గుర్తు చేసుకుని కోపంతో రగిలిపోతాడు.మహాపై కన్నా పంచాయతీఇతనికి బిర్యానీ పెడతావా అని ప్లేట్ లాక్కుని పడేయబోతాడు కన్నా. రేయ్ అందులోనుంచి ఒక్క మెతుకు కిందపడిన నీకు నా చేతుల్లో ఉంటదని కన్నాకు వార్నింగ్ ఇస్తుంది మహా. తర్వాత ఇంట్లో మహాపై పంచాయతీ పెడతాడు కన్నా. నా మీద వదినకు ప్రేమ లేదు. నేను ఎంత చెప్పిన నారాయణనే వెనుకేసుకొస్తుందని అంటాడు. అక్కడితో నేటి పొదరిల్లు సీరియల్ ఎపిసోడ్ ముగుస్తుంది.

title: RNA from Antarctica’s red Blood Falls pointed researchers to a marine microbial community linked to brine beneath the Taylor Glacier | World News
description: A 2026 study of Antarctica’s Blood Falls found a marine microbial community linked to brine under Taylor Glacier, though wind transport can’t be ruled out.  | World News
content: A red stain flowing down a white glacier might look like a movie scene, but it is real. It is called Blood Falls, and it is in Antarctica. According toa 2026 Nature Geoscience study, genetic clues from this site led researchers to a marine microbial community associated with the brine below Taylor Glacier. The community appears to have survived for a long time after being cut off from the ocean.The red brine and the ancient sea beneath itBlood Falls pours out from the end of the Taylor Glacier in the McMurdo Dry Valleys. The water is red and salty, and it is full of iron. It runs down the slope and flows into Lake Bonney. Previous studies provided some clues to the origin of this brine. They suggest it formed when seawater flooded Taylor Valley during warm periods, before the advancing glacier trapped it. In a 2019 paper in the Journal of Geophysical Research: Biogeosciences, Lyons and colleagues presented evidence that the dissolved material in the brine came from ancient seawater. The team took samples of brine from a channel within the glacier in 2014.In the 2026 paper, the team analyzed 167 water, sediment, and wind-blown samples from the Dry Valleys and from marine sites. The marine samples included sea ice and seawater from McMurdo Sound that were collected earlier, in 2015. At the end of the glacier, they found a distinct community of marine microorganisms living only in the red ice, mud, and sediment. Many of them were diatoms, minute algae. Others were haptophytes, dinoflagellates, and ciliates. What the genetic evidence indicatesThe numbers were striking. More than 60 percent of the diatoms in the red mud and sediment were sea types. Sea diatoms from McMurdo Sound matched 20.4 percent of the diatom sequence types at Blood Falls, compared with only 1.5 percent of those in other Dry Valleys streams and lakes. Those streams and lakes held mostly freshwater and land diatoms. The team extracted RNA from the samples, converted it into complementary DNA, and sequenced it. This showed activity of organisms at the time of sampling in late Antarctic summer. Genetic analysis revealed photosynthesis, salt stress response, and cell repair. The authors say this fits with life in a salty setting, though it does not prove it.Another possible explanation is wind, because the Dry Valleys are very windy. Nevertheless, wind-blown samples contained almost no sea signals. The authors say the wind alone today is unlikely to explain the pattern. Another group of diatoms, Chaetoceros, also created its own lineage at Blood Falls. Its genetic types were unique to that location. The authors suggest that the community is likely composed of long-term survivors from ancient seawater flooding, possible ancient wind transport, and very limited modern wind input.What scientists still do not knowThe study has definite limitations. Previous work has found bacteria in the brine that are close relatives of sea bacteria. But no tiny sea organisms with complex cells, called eukaryotes, have been detected in the brine itself. The new findings come from the red ice, mud, and sediment at the glacier’s end, where the brine meets the surface. The method used also cannot ascertain exact species. The team also could not check the shapes of the organisms, as the samples were too small and too poorly preserved.Ancient wind transport cannot be ruled out entirely. Questions also remain about how far ancient seawater reached and when. Still, the authors describe Blood Falls as a unique refuge for ancient lineages. They say it sets the stage for future work that could show how remnant communities record past change and future polar risk.

title: Manoj Bajpayee calls Tiger Shroff's shooting incident sad and scary, Divya Dutta stresses the need for safety | Bollywood
description: Manoj Bajpayee called the shooting involving Tiger Shroff frightening and hoped investigators would quickly hold those responsible accountable.   | Bollywood
content: On Sunday, Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff was returning after playing football when three gunmen opened fire at his car. The incident sparked concerns about celebrity safety in Mumbai. Several actors, including Ram Gopal Varma, Vidyut Jammwal, Suniel Shetty and Rakesh Bedi, expressed concern and called for action against those responsible. In a recent conversation with ANI, Manoj Bajpayee and Divya Dutta also reacted to the incident, describing it as sad and scary.Manoj Bajpayee and Divya Dutt react to Tiger Shroff's shooting incidentManoj Bajpayee said he did not view the incident as a gang war but admitted that the uncertainty surrounding such attacks was frightening. He said, “I don't see a gang war, but shots are being fired from who knows where—that's really scary. It's sad what happened to Tiger, but the best and the happiest part is that he's safe, and his driver is also recovering slowly. We aren't law and order experts or anything."Manoj expressed hope that the authorities would ensure those responsible faced consequences. He said, "From what I've heard in the news, the investigation is ongoing. The alleged suspects have been brought to Mumbai, and they've been arrested too. I just hope the investigation wraps up as soon as possible, and that an example is set so that next time, anyone will think twice before doing something like this." Divya Dutta also spoke about the fear such incidents create, emphasising that feeling safe is a basic necessity for everyone. “Unfortunately, hearing it sends a wave of ‘what happened?’ everywhere. We all just want a normal sort of safety. Everyone needs that basic to survive, and it's really important. When it shakes like that, it absolutely shakes you up, but I'm sure the authorities are looking into it, and Tiger is safe. Yeah, God bless,” she said.All about Tiger Shroff's shooting incidentOn October 18, Tiger was returning after playing football in Juhu when three bike-borne assailants opened fire at his vehicle. The gunmen reportedly fired at least five rounds. While Tiger escaped with minor abrasions, his driver and a bystander sustained gunshot wounds.A social media post attributed to individuals linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang claimed responsibility for the attack and alleged that Tiger had been targeted because of his association with actor Salman Khan. Following the incident, Tiger's father, actor Jackie Shroff, assured the media that his son was safe. Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde also visited Tiger at his residence, where the actor was seen with bandages on his chest and arm. Tiger suffered minor injuries, was examined and was subsequently discharged.Three days after the shooting in Mumbai's Juhu area, seven people had been arrested in connection with the case. Those arrested included three alleged shooters and four people suspected of being part of a larger network that helped transport firearms and ammunition to Mumbai.

title: Stock market : రూ. 110 దాటేసిన ముడి చమురు ధర- ఈరోజు స్టాక్ మార్కెట్ పరిస్థితేంటి? | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: అక్టోబర్ 22, 2026 ట్రేడర్లు నేడు ట్రాక్​ చేయాల్సిన స్టాక్స్​ టు బై లిస్ట్​ని నిపుణులు వెల్లడించారు. వీటితో పాటు లేటెస్ట్​ స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​ అప్డేట్స్, ముడి చమురు ధర వివరాలను ఇక్కడ తెలుసుకోండి..
content: బుధవారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​ని దేశీయ స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు ఫ్లాట్​గా ముగించాయి. బీఎస్​ఈ సెన్సెక్స్​ 143 పాయింట్లు పడి 73,710 వద్ద స్థిరపడింది. నిఫ్టీ50.. 78 పాయింట్లు కోల్పోయి 22,811 వద్ద సెషన్​ని ముగించింది. ఇక బ్యాంక్​ నిఫ్టీ 511 పాయింట్లు పడి 54,977 వద్దకు చేరింది.ఎఫ్​ఐఐలు.. డీఐఐలు..బుధవారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​లో ఎఫ్​ఐఐలు రూ. 1,022.32 కోట్లు విలువ చేసే షేర్లను కొన్నారు. అదే సమయంలో డీఐఐలు రూ. 1,614.32 కోట్లు విలువ చేసే షేర్లను కొనుగోలు చేశారు.ఈరోజు స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​ ఎలా ఉండబోతోంది?ఇక గురువారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​ని దేశీయ స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​ నష్టాల్లో ప్రారంభించే అవకాశం ఉంది. గిఫ్ట్​ నిఫ్టీ దాదాపు 50 పాయింట్ల నష్టంలో ఉండటం ఇందుకు కారణం.“నిఫ్టీ50 తన 20డీఎంఏ రేంజ్​లో తిరుగుతోంది. కానీ హయ్యర్ హైస్, హయ్యర్ లోస్​ పాటర్న్ మాత్రం కొనసాగుతోంది. 22,720 కీలక సపోర్ట్​ జోన్​ని సూచీ తట్టుకుంటోంది. అది బ్రేక్ అయితే మాత్రం సూచీ 22,650- 22,600కి వెళ్లే అవకాశం ఉంది. ఇక 22,900- 23,000 వద్ద ఉన్న రిసెస్టెన్స్ ఉంది. 23,150 వద్ద ఉన్న మరో రెసిస్టెన్స్​ని దాటితే నిఫ్టీ50 మరింత పెరగొచ్చు,” అని ఏంజిల్​ వన్​కి చెందిన చీఫ్ మేనేజర్, టెక్నికల్ అండ్ డెరివేటివ్ రీసెర్చ్ ఓషో కృష్ణన్ తెలిపారు.ఐటీ షేర్ల జాతర: ఎల్‌టీటీఎస్ 15% అప్, దూసుకెళ్లిన టీసీఎస్, ఇన్ఫోసిస్అమెరికా స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు..బుధవారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​ని అమెరికా స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు లాభాల్లో ముగించాయి. డౌ జోన్స్​ 0.6 శాతం పెరిగింది. ఎస్​ అండ్​ పీ 500​ 0.5శాతం వృద్ధిచెందింది. టెక్​ ఇండెక్స్​ నాస్​డాక్ 1శాతం పెరిగింది.ఆసియా స్టాక్​ మార్కెట్​లు బుధవారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​లో నష్టాల్లో కొనసాగుతున్నాయి.ముడి చమురు ధర..అంతర్జాతీయ మార్కెట్​లో ముడి చమురు ధర భగభగలాడుతోంది. గురువారం ట్రేడింగ్​ సెషన్​లో బ్రెంట్ క్రూడ్ 1శాతం కన్నా ఎక్కువ పెరిగి బ్యారెల్​కు 110.2 డాలర్లకు చేరింది.స్టాక్స్​ టు బై..కాస్ట్రోల్ ఇండ్- బై రూ. 198, స్టాప్​ లాస్​ రూ. 188, టార్గెట్​ రూ. 211హెక్సావేర్ టెక్నాలజీస్ లిమిటెడ్- బై రూ. 594- రూ. 603, స్టాప్​ లాస్​ రూ. 569, టార్గెట్​ రూ. 700టీసీఎస్- బై రూ. 2504- రూ. 2542, స్టాప్​ లాస్​ రూ. 2400, టార్గెట్​ రూ. 2790(గమనిక:- ఇవి నిపుణుల అభిప్రాయాలు మాత్రమే. హిందుస్థాన్​ టైమ్స్​ తెలుగుకు ఎలాంటి సంబంధం లేదు. ఏదైనా ట్రేడ్​ తీసుకునే ముందు ట్రేడర్లకు సొంతంగా ఎనాలసిస్​ ఉండటం శ్రేయస్కరం.)

title: A number of Aussie players are playing for their careers, says Katich as Labuschagne disappoints again | Cricket
description: Marnus Labuschagne, Nic Maddinson and Beau Webster have disappointed so far in South Africa.  | Cricket
content: Former batsman Simon Katich believes some Australian players’ performance in the second innings of the ongoing second Test against South Africa at Gqeberha can decide whether or not they will be selected again.After being asked to follow on, the Aussies were 156/4, trailing the Proteas by 170 runs at the end of the fourth day. Marnus Labuschagne, who has been struggling for some time now, once again disappointed with 39. He often gets a good start, but big runs have eluded the batter in recent years. Nic Maddinson, who stayed in the playing XI amid criticism, scored 0 and 8 in the second Test. All-rounder Beau Webster has not been of much use either.Also Read: Temba Bavuma, captaincy and the making of a batting star Katich took a dig at Labuschagne, who played a careless shot to get out off Simon Harmer, with the score reading 100/1. Travis Head (87 not out) and Labuschagne looked solid before the latter went for a high-risk aerial shot and gave his wicket away."There are a number of players playing for their careers in this innings," Katich said on SEN radio. "Only he knows what was going through his mind when he tried to take Harmer down the ground, against the breeze, when Australia are trying to play for a draw."How will the Australian selectors view that dismissal? He's been given plenty of rope over the past few years, when plenty of others haven't, but he has," he added.Australia head coach Andrew McDonald wasn’t happy with what he saw from Labuschagne either. The 32-year-old batsman, who has not scored a Test ton since July 2023, now finds himself under tremendous pressure. "You saw what we saw," McDonald said.‘I feel like I am on repeat’"For me, the option is there if the ball is in the right area. But in that scenario, there probably are some shots that players would take back. He did a lot of hard work once again. I feel like I am on repeat around the amount of 30s that he has got. That has become a danger period for him. We had a good partnership going and were starting to claw ourselves back into the game, albeit a long way behind."When you do that hard work, you've got to cash in, and unfortunately, that wasn't to be the case for Marn. We were disappointed, and he will be too," the head coach added.Australia currently lead the three-game series 1-0, having won the first game at Kingsmead by 214 runs. At Gqeberha, just 43 overs could be bowled on the first two days. In light of that, the Proteas deserve a lot of credit for putting themselves into a match-winning position, having first scored 425/9d and then bowled out the visitors for 99 in the first innings. Head and nightwatchman Scott Boland will resume the innings on the fifth and final day of the game today.Nathan Lyon’s exclusion for this Test wasn’t received well in many quarters, and if the visitors lose at Gqeberha, the Aussie team management will find itself under more pressure.

title: El Nino could be unprecedented, may rise to 3.8°C above average between Nov-Jan: WMO | India News
description: A peak is likely in December, with weather patterns to be disrupted globally, including higher than normal temperatures and weaker rainfall in south and southeast Asia, including India | India News
content: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) in its latest seasonal climate outlook has said the current El Nino event could be “unprecedented in strength” and may rise to 3.8°C above average between November 2026 to January 2027 period. A peak is likely in December, with weather patterns to be disrupted globally, including higher than normal temperatures and weaker rainfall in south and southeast Asia, including India.WMO declares an El Niño when the sea surface temperature anomaly in the tropical Pacific is 0.5°C and higher. The outlook, shared late on Wednesday, said a very strong El Niño disrupts normal temperature and rainfall patterns and can bring severe drought to some regions, heavy rainfall and flooding to others. Overall, increased heat is likely across large parts of the world.On Wednesday, the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) also released a new report, stating if current policies continue, global warming could reach 2.8°C above pre-industrial standards within this century and increase thereafter. It said urgent and stringent cuts are needed to greenhouse emissions to minimize the magnitude and duration of this overshoot and to return to 1.5°C by the end of the century.Also Read:Growth in buildings remains robust in India, Southeast Asia: UNEP reportIn its latest outlook for south Asia, WMO said normal to above normal maximum and minimum temperatures are likely over most parts of the region, which includes Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.“The southern parts of South Asia – specifically southern India, Sri Lanka, and Maldives - receive significant amounts of rainfall during the October to December season, which is critical for agricultural operations. Northeastern parts, including Afghanistan, also receive a sizable proportion of annual precipitation during these months,” the outlook said. While the southwest monsoon departed India on October 15, simultaneously, northeast monsoon rains began in southern India on the same day. This seasonal rain is likely to suffer ahead.“This is literally off the monitoring charts that we have used for the past four decades. El Niño will peak towards the end of 2026 but its impacts will be felt long after that,” WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo said on Wednesday, sharing an update on El Niño, but adding it does not have to be a recipe for humanitarian disaster.“We have the science, the forecasts and the early warning systems to save lives and protect livelihoods. What we need now is decisive action, especially to protect the most vulnerable communities,” Saulo told a joint press conference with Tom Fletcher, UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator.WMO’s forecast for east Africa shows wetter-than-normal conditions, with increasing concerns about heavy rainfall and flooding, while southern Africa should suffer with drier conditions.Across north and south America, increased rainfall is likely in the northwest US and southern parts of western South America.Also Read: Earth’s climate more out of balance than at any time in observed history: WMO“North America and the northern portion of the Caribbean is also expected to face above normal precipitation. In turn, there is increased drought risk in parts of Central America, the southern Caribbean and the Amazon,” it said.

title: Priyanka Gandhi's son Raihan says asked to remove protest photos from Delhi exhibition: '50% of artworks' | Latest News Delhi
description: Raihan Vadra said he was asked to remove images documenting recent protests in the Capital; they were absent when the exhibition opened on Wednesday.  | Latest News Delhi
content: Raihan Vadra, the son of Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi and businessman Robert Vadra, alleged on Wednesday that he was asked to remove some photographs from his exhibition hours before it was scheduled to open at Bikaner House in New Delhi.The photographs were part of his exhibition, “No Idea is Final”, which features wildlife and street photography. Vadra said he was asked to remove images documenting recent protests in the Capital; they were absent when the exhibition opened on Wednesday.Also Read I Keeping up with UP: Can Rahul Gandhi’s street activism revive the Congress in UP?Asked to remove ‘50% of artworks’“Yesterday [Tuesday] I was contacted by the management of Bikaner House raising objections towards the ‘political nature’ of the protest images and was requested to remove them,” Vadra, 26, wrote in a statement that he circulated at the opening of the exhibition.Vadra said the proposal approved by the Bikaner House management on June 30, 2026, clearly stated the exhibition would feature images depicting “themes of choice, control, and unity”. “The photos are simply a visual documentation of the people and the armed forces at the protests with no added commentary. Not a single photograph taken by me contains any derogatory or inflammatory comment of any kind,” he said.Despite this, Vadra alleged, he was asked to remove “50% of the artworks”. He alleged that Rohit Kumar, the principal resident commissioner of Bikaner House, toured the rooms where the photographs were displayed before purportedly “calling the Rajasthan chief secretary” and another officer at the chief minister’s office. “[They] finally informed me that I would have to remove all works deemed by him to be political by 3.30pm today, failing which the show would stand cancelled,” he wrote.Bikaner House is owned and managed by the Rajasthan government. Rajasthan chief secretary V Srinivas did not respond to requests for comment by the time of going to printVadra also said he was asked to remove two photographs depicting the Indian flag, which he refused to do. “I will not take down a photo of the Indian flag.”Also Read I Same voter ID, different names: Congress alleges voter list tamperingHe said the exhibition would continue until October 25, as planned, but that he would soon display the entire collection at another venue.Priyanka Vadra termed it ridiculous and “muzzling” of the voice of the youth across the nation. “Today it’s him, tomorrow it’ll be another artist,” she was quoted as saying by PTI. “I think it’s ridiculous… He is a young boy… they are muzzling the voice of the youth across the nation. So, it’s only expected that they’ll do it to anyone,” she said.

title: The complicated truth: NZ pitches can be good for batting too | Cricket
description: A decade of data suggests that New Zealand’s surfaces may be less hostile to batters than their reputation implies, especially as Test matches wear on  | Cricket
content: For years, cricket in New Zealand has endured a familiar trope—green pitches, cloud cover, a hint of movement off the seam and fast bowlers capable of making life uncomfortable for even the most accomplished visiting batters. For touring sides, mastering those conditions is often presented as the essential first step towards success. But a look at international scoring patterns over the past decade suggests the story is more complicated.New Zealand’s reputation as a country where the ball moves and batting can be difficult is not necessarily incompatible with another possibility—that its pitches can become rewarding places to score runs, particularly in Test cricket. With India beginning an all-format tour on Thursday, the numbers offer a useful counterpoint to the conventional wisdom. Across Tests, ODIs and T20Is, New Zealand doesn’t consistently sit at the bottom of the scoring tables. Most strikingly, it tops the comparison for average team totals in the second half of Test matches.The analysis using CricViz data covers the 10 countries—excluding Ireland and Afghanistan—that held full-member status throughout the entire 10-year period. It removes weather-shortened games and compares average first-innings scores across the three formats. In Tests, it also examines the combined scoring averages for the third and fourth innings. At first glance, the white-ball numbers are hardly evidence of a batting paradise. New Zealand’s average first-innings T20I score is 172, placing it fourth among the 10 countries, behind England, South Africa and India. That is a respectable scoring environment, but not an exceptional one.At individual grounds, however, the figures illustrate the wide range within New Zealand cricket. Eden Park in Auckland averages a very high 184 in first-innings T20 totals, while Wellington averages a middling 170. Bay Oval in Mount Maunganui records 163 and Hagley Oval in Christchurch 161. The difference between Auckland and Christchurch is substantial, reinforcing the point that an overall average can conceal important venue-specific characteristics. In ODIs, New Zealand sits seventh among the 10 countries, with an average first-innings total of 257. That is a distinctly middling position, suggesting that the country’s white-ball conditions don’t routinely produce the kind of high-scoring totals associated with the most batter-friendly environments. One year before the ODI World Cup to be hosted by South Africa, this tour of New Zealand could ideally help India ace the art of cautious but productive batting.The ODI numbers could seem intimidating, yet neither format supports the simplistic assumption that New Zealand is invariably a difficult place to bat. Nor do the numbers establish that the surfaces are unusually flat. They indicate something more nuanced—New Zealand's scoring environment varies by format and venue, and its reputation cannot substitute for the evidence.Tests reveal a positiveIn Test cricket, however, the data become particularly revealing. New Zealand's average first-innings total per team innings is 324—fifth among the 10 Test playing nations. Pakistan leads with 355, followed by Sri Lanka at 352, Zimbabwe at 338 and India at 329. New Zealand is therefore neither an outlier nor an obvious batting haven when the opening two innings of a Test are considered.But the picture changes when the match moves into its second half. New Zealand averages 242 runs per team innings across the third and fourth innings—the highest in the 10-nation comparison. England is second at 241, and Sri Lanka are third at 228. India, by contrast, averages 190, the second worst among all 10 countries. The contrast between its fifth-place first-innings position and first-place second-innings position is difficult to ignore. It doesn’t, on its own, prove that New Zealand pitches become flat as matches progress. But it does challenge the idea that seam-friendly conditions necessarily mean a sustained advantage for bowlers.There is a distinction, too, between a pitch offering movement early in a match and one remaining difficult to bat on for five days. A surface can reward disciplined seam bowling in the opening session while still allowing batters to prosper once they have negotiated the initial challenge. But New Zealand's second-innings figures suggest that visitors shouldn’t automatically assume the early conditions will define the entire Test. More importantly, unlike in a few other countries, New Zealand still provides reasonably good chances to batters till the last session of the fifth day.For India, who lost by 10 and seven wickets the two Tests they had last played in New Zealand (in 2020), that distinction should matter. The constant disclaimer here is the factor of overhead conditions, which across two Tests is small yet significant. Which is why the most pragmatic way to understand New Zealand’s venues is not to label them seamer-friendly or batter-friendly, but to recognise that both descriptions can be true at different stages of the same game.The ball may talk early, but runs too could come later on. For visiting batters thus, the real test is not merely surviving the conditions that New Zealand is known for, but to recognise when those conditions have changed—and making the most of the opportunity that follows.

title: Some old bits, lots of new: India’s adaptability, depth face stern New Zealand test | Cricket
description: India embark on a rare all-format tour of New Zealand with a T20I series that promises fresh challenges, new faces and a test of their  mettle  | Cricket
content: India and New Zealand have developed quite the rivalry. It may not be as emotional or one-sided as India vs Pakistan, but it has become as gruelling and fiercely contested as India vs Australia. India don’t tour New Zealand often: just four times in the last 15 years. It’s even rarer these days for a team to travel for a full-fledged tour covering all three formats. That makes this upcoming tour something of an exception, but also one that promises to be vastly different from any assignment this Indian team has undertaken in recent times.First things first. With the long tour beginning with the T20Is on Thursday, don’t expect it to be anything like the West Indies series, where runs flowed freely and sixes smoked with ease. New Zealand’s grounds may be smaller, but the winds can make all the difference. Rest assured, batters will have to work hard to post totals of 200, let alone smash batting records as they did in the previous two bilateral T20I series in India.Also Read: How India have fared in bilateral T20I series in New Zealand over the years A lot has changed since India last toured New Zealand. Shikhar Dhawan, now retired, was India’s T20I opener, and Suryakumar Yadav world’s No. 1 T20I batter. Bhuvneshwar Kumar was part of India’s bowling setup before being pushed into a four-year exile. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was yet to attend trials for Rajasthan Royals. Rishabh Pant was the wicketkeeper, and Umran Malik the pacer of that squad. As were Deepak Hooda and Yuzvendra Chahal. In fact, only six players from that 15 have made it into the current team.Virat Kohli and Hardik Pandya are the only Indian captains to have won a T20I series in New Zealand. Even MS Dhoni endured back-to-back series defeats. Under Kohli, India recorded their biggest series-winning margin in 2020, sweeping the Black Caps 5-0. The more recent 1-0 series win, however, could have swung either way, with two matches affected by rain.The questions Iyer needs to answerIf Ireland and England were considered Shreyas Iyer’s biggest test yet, New Zealand promises to be a different kettle of fish. The Indian captain played it safe at the pre-match press conference, addressing the usual talking points - gruelling travel, flexibility in batting positions and the wait for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. What he wasn’t asked, though, was how he plans to give the newcomers game time. Will Naman Dhir get a game on the strength of his batting alone, given that his off-spin may not warrant a place in the XI? How many overs will Mayank Yadav and Prince Yadav get to bowl? Or will the returning Varun Chakaravarthy be an automatic pick?Also Read: From Ireland to New Zealand, India seek answers in relentless T20I scheduleWickets in New Zealand have traditionally been a tad green and more conducive to seam bowling, although much will depend on the pitches that are rolled out. India picking more or less the same squad that faced the West Indies suggests the team management trusts its depth, with as many as eight players embarking on their first tour of New Zealand as part of the senior team.A closer look at the last five T20Is at Christchurch’s Hagley Oval suggests the average first-innings score is 161, a far cry from the run-fests witnessed in Thiruvananthapuram, Guwahati and New Chandigarh. Pacers have accounted for almost 70 per cent of the wickets, while the toss has made little difference, with teams batting first holding a narrow 3-2 edge over those chasing.The No. 4 position has yielded the most runs. Tim Seifert has scored 104 in four matches, while Glenn Phillips has 96 in two innings.New Zealand have been dealing with player contract issues for over a year, but this series has seen most of them return for a high-stakes assignment, including Finn Allen, arguably one of the most exciting T20 batters in the world now. Allen last played a T20I for New Zealand early last year, but his strike-rate of close to 185 at home underlines the threat he poses. Unlike the Australia-South Africa Tests, where poor crowd turnout has given the board headaches, Allen’s presence could help draw a capacity crowd close to 30,000 for the two teams vying for supremacy.For the longest time, New Zealand had the wood over India in ICC tournaments. They went 21 years without losing a knockout to India, until the jinx was broken in 2023. The last time these two teams met in a similar setting was earlier this year, when India handed New Zealand a thumping defeat to clinch the T20 World Cup title. Such was India’s dominant campaign that it has almost faded into the background already. The T20I series will be a precursor to the ODIs and, eventually, the Tests, but it will also set the tone for the next 40-odd days.

content: Illu Illalu PIllalu October 22 Episode: ఇల్లు ఇల్లాలు పిల్లలు సీరియల్ ఈ రోజు ఎపిసోడ్ లో.. వల్లిని ఇంట్లో నుంచి భాగ్యం గెంటేయడంపై రామరాజు ఇంట్లో చర్చ కొనసాగుతుంది. ఆ దొంగల ముఠా పేర్లు వినపడొద్దని చెప్తున్నా నాన్న. ఇక మీదట వాళ్లు మన ఇంటి వైపు కన్నెత్తి కూడా చూడరని రామరాజుకు చందు చెప్తాడు.ప్రేమ కాన్ఫిడెంట్ట్రావెల్స్ ఆఫీస్ వేలం పాటకు వెళ్తున్నావా? అని ధీరజ్ ను రామరాజు అడుగుతాడు. ధీరజ్ చెప్పేందుకు తడబడుతుంటే ప్రేమ మాత్రం కాన్ఫిడెంట్ గా వెళ్తున్నామని చెప్తుంది. ట్రావెల్స్ ఆఫీస్ వదిలేది లేదని ప్రేమ అంటుంది. అత్తాకోడళ్లు వెటకారంగా పంచ్ లు వేసుకుంటారు.పొదుపుగా పాడతామనివేలం పాటకు వేదవతి వస్తానంటే ప్రేమ వద్దంటుంది. అప్పుడే నా కొడుకును నాకు దూరం చేస్తున్నావా? అని వేదవతి అడుగుతుంది. నువ్వు వస్తే కొడుకు మీద ప్రేమతో ఎక్కువ రేటుకు పాడుతావ్. కానీ నేను పొదుపుగా ఆచితూచి మాట్లాడతానని ప్రేమ అంటుంది. నర్మద, వేదవతి ఆల్ ది బెస్ట్ చెప్పి ధీరజ్, ప్రేమను పంపిస్తారు.కత్తి ఎంట్రీవేలం పాట జరిగే చోటుకు ధీరజ్, ప్రేమ వెళ్తారు. అన్నీ చూసి రూ.12 లక్షల కంటే ఎక్కువ పాడితే వేస్ట్ అని ప్రేమకు ధీరజ్ చెప్తాడు. అప్పుడే భార్య నగలు అమ్మేసి వేలానికి వచ్చానని కామెడీ చేస్తూ కత్తి వస్తాడు. మా అమ్మకు అరడజను మంది ఆడపిల్లలు పుట్టారు. ఆ తర్వాత కత్తిలాంటి వాడిని పుట్టానని కత్తి అని పేరు పెట్టారని చెప్తాడు.ప్రేమ కంగారుట్రావెల్స్ ఆఫీస్ కోసం వేలం పాట మొదలవుతుంది. ధీరజ్ పాడిన వేలానికి కత్తి ఒక్క రూపాయి యాడ్ చేస్తూ వెళ్తాడు. ధీరజ్ ఏకంగా రూ.14 లక్షలు అనేసరికి అందరూ షాక్ అవుతారు. అమౌంట్ అడ్జెస్ట్ అవుతాయా అని ప్రేమ కంగారుగా అడుగుతుంది. అంతా తాను చూసుకుంటానని ధీరజ్ చెప్తాడు.అవమానించిన భద్రావతిధీరజ్ పాట రూ.14 లక్షలు మూడోసారి అని వేలం నిర్వాహకులు అనబోతుండగా రూ.20 లక్షలు అని భద్రావతి షాకింగ్ ఎంట్రీ ఇస్తుంది. ఆమెను చూసి ధీరజ్, ప్రేమ వెళ్లిపోతారు. ధీరజ్ ను భద్రావతి అవమానించేలా మాట్లాడుతుంది. కోటలోని యువరాణి పల్లకిని మోసేవాడిని పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటే ఇలాగే ఉంటుంది ప్రేమ అని భద్రావతి అంటుంది.ప్రేమ పంతంఅవును, నేను పల్లకిని మోసేవాడిని. భార్యను నెత్తిన, గుండెల్లో పెట్టుకొని మోసేవాడినే అని ధీరజ్ కౌంటర్ వేస్తాడు. ప్రేమను తీసుకొని వెళ్దామంటాడు. కానీ ప్రేమ ఏమో రూ.21 లక్షలు అంటుంది. నా మొగుడు తగ్గకూడదని ధీరజ్ ను తీసుకొని వెళ్లి ప్రేమ కుర్చీలో కూర్చుంటుంది. భద్రావతి రూ.22 లక్షలంటుంది. ప్రేమ రూ.23 లక్షలకు పెంచుతుంది. ధీరజ్ వెళ్లిపోదామని చెప్పినా ప్రేమ వినదు.కత్తి కమీషన్కత్తిని పిలిచి ధీరజ్ ఎంత అమౌంట్ తెచ్చావని అడుగుతాడు. తన సూట్ కేసులో ఉన్న రూపాయిని చూపించి కత్తి షాక్ ఇస్తాడు. వేలం పాట పాడేవాళ్లు మమ్మల్ని పాట పెంచేందుకు పెట్టుకుంటారు. వాళ్లు అనుకున్న దానికంటే ఎక్కువ రేట్ వస్తే మాకు కమీషన్ ఇస్తారని కత్తి చెప్తాడు.గెలిచిన ప్రేమ కానీఇక భద్రావతి ఏమో రూ.25 లక్షలు అని అంటుంది. ప్రేమ, భద్రావతి పోటాపోటీగా వేలం పాట పాడతారు. ప్రేమ మాట్లాడకుండా ధీరజ్ నోరు మూస్తాడు. ప్రేమ పాట 30 లక్షల ఒక్క రూపాయి అని కత్తి చెప్తాడు. అవును అని ప్రేమ అంటుంది.చివరకు వేలంలో ప్రేమ గెలుస్తుంది. ధీరజ్ మనం గెలిచాం రా అని ధీరజ్ కలర్ ఎగరేస్తుంది ప్రేమ. చెప్పినట్లే నా భర్తను గెలిపించానని అత్తకు కౌంటర్ వేస్తుంది. కానీ ఎక్కువ రేటుకు పాడించి దెబ్బ కొట్టానన్నట్లు భద్రావతి సైకోలా నవ్వుతుంది. ఇక్కడితో నేటి ఇల్లు ఇల్లాలు పిల్లలు సీరియల్ ఎపిసోడ్ ముగుస్తుంది.

title: ‘Keep your powder dry’: Delhi HC tells CJP's Das, Ranka, says cops showed ‘benevolence’ | India News
description: The CJP leaders decided to withdraw the plea after justice Subramonium Prasad raised questions concerning the maintainability of the petition. | India News
content: The Delhi High Court in a special hearing on Wednesday declined to entertain Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka’s petition challenging special executive magistrate’s (SEM) order extending their judicial custody in an alleged bond-of-peace violation case, following their decision to withdraw the same.The CJP leaders decided to withdraw the plea after Justice Subramonium Prasad raised questions concerning the maintainability of the petition. The Delhi Police represented by Additional Solicitor General Chetan Sharma and standing counsel Ashish Dixit, also opposed its petition.Also Read I No Jantar Mantar protest call until it remains de-notified: CJP's Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka to court‘Keep your powder dry’The court observed that the appropriate remedy for the two CJP leaders was to challenge the SEM’s order before the sessions court. Emphasising that personal liberty is sacrosanct, the court noted that when a prescribed legal remedy is available, one should follow the established procedure rather than approach the high court directly.“Your remedy actually lies in revision. There is difference between maintainability and entertainability... Instead of arguing now, why don’t you keep your powder dry? First before the revisional court (trial court) and then HC,” the judge told their lawyer Abhik Chimni.Das and Ranka approached the high court against SEM’s October 19 order to extend their custody by two days. The executive magistrate at Mandir Marg police station cited concerns over public peace and security, and said the CJP leaders showed “no respect for law” by repeatedly calling for protests at de-notified sites, supporting Delhi Police’s contention that their release could pose an imminent threat to public order. Seeking immediate release on personal bond rather than a surety, the two said that the order was contrary to a Delhi high court’s ruling in Aldanish Rein vs State of NCT of Delhi & Anr, in which it was held that an arrested person should be released on a personal bond once surety bonds are submitted, pending their verification.Das and Ranka said they had been in custody for six days despite submitting multiple sureties and challenged the grounds for rejecting the sureties.The court said the Delhi Police had shown “benevolence” by issuing a fresh notice to the duo despite their alleged breach of the bond. “The reason for the first bond came true: you had a tendency to break the peace for a second time, which you did. Are the authorities not right in putting you to stricter rule?” the court said.Also Read I 'Barricades have a purpose': Delhi HC pulls up Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, cites arson outside IndiaLater, after their release, commenting on the Delhi High Court’s oral observations regarding the activists’ ages during an earlier hearing, Singh said, “The high court made certain oral observations, but those were their observations... Saurav Das is 27. He is absolutely GenZ. Ashutosh is borderline GenZ, and we relate to the cause of the youth. We are ultimately the youth of this country, so of course, we are the youth.”

title: In 2025, Matthew McConaughey's fundraiser raised over $17 million for kid’s health, education and wellness, bringing MJ&M's total to over $78 million | World News
description: In 2025, Matthew McConaughey’s MJ&M fundraiser raised over $17 million for five children’s charities, organizers say, bringing its total past $78 million.  | World News
content: What can a weekend of concerts, golf, and fashion do for kids in need? In Austin, Texas, the answer was more than $17 million. The 13th annual fundraiser took place on April 24 and 25, 2025, according to a press release from Mack, Jack & McConaughey (MJ&M). It was the group's highest-grossing event to date. The money was raised for five charities that aid children's education, health, and wellness. The organizers say the effort has raised more than $78 million since 2013.Who is behind MJ&MMJ&M is a collaboration of Academy Award-winning actor Matthew McConaughey, recording artist Jack Ingram, and coach Mack Brown. Ingram is an ACM Award-winning artist, and Brown is a longtime Texas coach. The group started fundraising in 2013, making the 2025 weekend its 13th. Brown called it the group's most impactful event to date, and MJ&M describes itself as one of the region's leading charitable initiatives. Both are the organizers' own assessments rather than external measurements of results. Brown also thanked everyone who had helped.What happened over two daysThe weekend kicked off Thursday, April 24, with a gala that featured a performance by country star Eric Church. On Friday, guests could join a golf tournament, a fashion show by Neiman Marcus, and the Jack & Friends concert. The fashion show highlighted the Carolina Herrera Fall/Winter 2025 collection, led by Creative Director Wes Gordon. It was hosted by Sally Brown and Camila Alves McConaughey, who called the collection elegant and poetic. Neiman Marcus was the presenting partner. Jack Ingram, who shared the stage with Miranda Lambert, Ryan Bingham, and other artists, performed in the concert. Where the money wentThe five beneficiaries are CureDuchenne, Dell Children's Medical Center, HeartGift, just keep livin Foundation, and The Rise School of Austin. The funds support children's health care, education, and wellness programs across Texas and beyond. However, the announcement provides no details on what each group does and does not name the amount each charity received.Children's health needsThe needs these charities address are significant. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) congenital heart defects fact sheet, each year almost 40,000 infants in the United States are born with a heart defect. It also says that about 1 in 4 babies with a heart defect has a critical heart defect that generally requires surgery or some other procedure during the first year of life. These defects are the most common type of structural birth defect, according to the fact sheet.Duchenne muscular dystrophy, the condition behind CureDuchenne, is rarer. A 2015 Pediatrics study by Paul Romitti and colleagues covered six sites and used a CDC surveillance network that was set up in 2002. Between 1991 and 2005, Duchenne or Becker muscular dystrophy was estimated to affect about 2 of every 10,000 boys aged 5 through 9 years in each period and about 1.5 of every 10,000 boys in 2006 through 2010.These figures show the scale of children's health needs, but they come from CDC surveillance data and do not measure MJ&M's impact. Overall, the release shows that the 2025 weekend set a record for MJ&M, raising more than $17 million for five children's charities, and the research provides context for the health needs behind that giving.

title: Lucknow bizman’s death: UP cops get transit remand of Shraddha Dubey, others | Hindustan Times
description: The three accused were produced before Chief Judicial Magistrate Sameer Sattaram Kamat at a Nagpur court around 2.30pm.
content: The Uttar Pradesh Police on Wednesday secured transit remand of model and social media influencer Shraddha Dubey, 31, her sister Rashmi Dubey and their driver Tanveer Ali, alias Danish, a day after their arrest in Nagpur in connection with the death of Lucknow cafe owner Shiva Sharma, 28. The police team left for Lucknow by road with the three accused for further investigation.The trio was produced before Chief Judicial Magistrate Sameer Sattaram Kamat at a Nagpur court around 2.30pm, following which the court granted their transit remand till October 24. A team of the Nagpur crime branch, led by senior police inspector Shubhangi Deshmukh, and personnel of the UP Special Task Force (STF) were present during the proceedings.Also Read I Model Shraddha Dubey, sister and driver arrested in Lucknow cafe owner Shiva Sharma's death caseAccused en route to LucknowDCP (central) Arpit Vijayvargiya confirmed that the accused were being brought to Lucknow. “The UP Police are bringing the three accused to Lucknow for questioning and further investigation into the case,” he said.The police are covering the distance of about 900 km by road, with the journey expected to take 14-15 hours. The absence of a direct flight between Nagpur and Lucknow is said to be the reason for choosing road transport. Sharma died on October 9 after falling from the fourth floor of an apartment building near Balu Adda in central Lucknow. The incident was initially treated as an accidental death, but his mother later filed a murder complaint alleging that her son had been subjected to physical and mental torture. A murder case was registered on October 10. According to his mother, Sharma called her shortly before his death and said he would return in five minutes after Dubey called him outside. Dubey is alleged to have been in a live-in relationship with Sharma.The three accused were arrested on Tuesday after a search operation launched on inputs from the UP Police. Investigators used CCTV footage and local intelligence to track them down. A crucial lead reportedly came from an e-rickshaw driver who had given a ride to the burqa-clad trio.Evasion attemptsAccording to UP STF chief Amitabh Yash, Dubey allegedly tried to evade investigators by concealing her identity with a burqa, changing vehicles, limiting mobile phone use and staying at budget lodges with limited surveillance. She reportedly stayed at an Agra hotel for about 24 hours on October 17 before leaving with two others.Yash said information suggested she had travelled to Nepal and returned, though this remained unconfirmed. Investigators later traced a vehicle used by the trio in Nagpur and examined footage from around 200-250 CCTV cameras. Technical inputs and AI-assisted tracking helped narrow their location to Prozone Palms society in Beltarodi, from where they were arrested.After leaving Lucknow, the three allegedly travelled to Kanpur, Agra and Nepal before reaching Nagpur on Monday. They rented a flat on the 11th floor of an apartment in the Beltarodi area of south-west Nagpur, where they were eventually traced by the crime branch.Also Read I Model Shraddha Dubey, sister and driver arrested in Nagpur after 11-day manhunt in Lucknow cafe owner's death caseThe case gained further attention after videos of Dubey surfaced on social media. In a video interview with a news agency, she denied any role in Sharma’s death and claimed he died by suicide because of financial difficulties. She alleged that Sharma owed between ₹15 lakh and ₹20 lakh and had threatened to end his life if he could not repay the money.Investigators have also questioned the possible role of a man identified as Aamir, who was suspected of helping Dubey reach the Rupaidiha border crossing near Nepal and transfer Sharma’s mobile phone. However, his detention has not been officially confirmed, and Vijayvargiya denied that Aamir had been detained.The circumstances surrounding Sharma’s death remain under investigation.

title: Man arrested in Bengaluru for allegedly creating AI-generated video of bomb blast at Vidhana Soudha | Trending
description: A migrant labourer from Bihar has been arrested for allegedly creating and posting an AI-generated video showing a bomb blast at Vidhana Soudha.  | Trending
content: A labourer from Bihar was arrested by Bengaluru Police for allegedly creating an AI-generated video showing a bomb blast at Vidhana Soudha. The man, identified as Ali, initially shared the video on an Instagram page; later, the clip went viral on social media.What does the video show?The clip created using AI shows a person mimicking a trigger pull. It then shows an explosion that destroys the structure. The video was widely spread on social media on October 20.It was posted from an Instagram account “Jnx king Hg”, which has now been deactivated. In the caption, Ali allegedly claimed that he had blown up Vidhana Soudha.Social media outrage and arrest:The fabricated video created using AI soon sparked intense outrage on social media, with many tagging the police department to take strict action. Bengaluru Police later arrested Ali for allegedly creating the video.The police also stated that no real blast has occurred in Vidhana Soudha and the video is fake. An FIR has been registered. The authorities are interrogating the accused to ascertain his motive.The police department has warned people against the misuse of AI, especially for creating threatening content or visuals that could trigger mass panic.(With inputs from ANI)

title: ఏకాదశి ఉపవాసం చేయలేకపోతున్నారా? ఈ 6 నియమాలు పాటిస్తే శ్రీహరి కృప లభిస్తుంది! | Hindustan Times Telugu
description: పాపాంకుశ ఏకాదశి రోజున శ్రీమహావిష్ణువును భక్తిశ్రద్ధలతో ఆరాధించడం విశేషమైనదిగా భావిస్తారు. ఆరోగ్య సమస్యలు, వయస్సు లేదా ఇతర కారణాలతో ఉపవాసం చేయలేనివారు కూడా కొన్ని ఆధ్యాత్మిక నియమాలను పాటించవచ్చు.
content: హిందూ ధర్మంలో ఏకాదశి వ్రతానికి అత్యున్నత స్థానం ఉంది. ముఖ్యంగా ఆశ్వయుజ మాసం శుక్ల పక్షంలో వచ్చే పాపాంకుశ ఏకాదశి శ్రీ మహావిష్ణువు అనుగ్రహాన్ని ప్రసాదించే అత్యంత పవిత్రమైన రోజుగా భక్తులు భావిస్తారు. ఈ ఏడాది అక్టోబర్ 22, 2026 గురువారం రోజున ఈ పర్వదినం వచ్చింది.సమస్త పాపాలను హరించే శక్తి ఈ ఏకాదశి వ్రతానికి ఉందని పురాణాలు చెబుతున్నాయి. అయితే నేటి ఉరుకులు పరుగుల జీవితంలో అనారోగ్యం, వయస్సురీత్యా లేదా ప్రయాణాల కారణంగా ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ రోజంతా నిరాహార దీక్ష లేదా ఉపవాసం ఉండటం సాధ్యపడదు.అలాంటప్పుడు భక్తులు మనస్తాపం చెందాల్సిన అవసరం లేదని శాస్త్రాలు స్పష్టం చేస్తున్నాయి. ఉపవాసం ఉండలేకపోయినా, ఈ పవిత్ర రోజున కొన్ని ప్రత్యేకమైన నియమాలు పాటించడం ద్వారా వ్రత ఫలితాన్ని పొందవచ్చని ఆధ్యాత్మిక నిపుణులు సూచిస్తున్నారు. అవేమిటో ఇక్కడ పరిశీలిద్దాం.సూర్యోదయ వేళ శ్రీహరి పూజఉపవాస దీక్ష చేయలేని వారు ఉదయాన్నే తలస్నానం చేసి శుభ్రమైన వస్త్రాలు ధరించాలి. అనంతరం పూజా మందిరంలో విష్ణుమూర్తి ప్రతిమ లేదా చిత్రపటం ఎదుట స్వచ్ఛమైన ఆవు నెయ్యితో దీపం వెలిగించాలి.శ్రీహరికి పసుపు రంగు వస్త్రాలు, పరిమళభరితమైన పుష్పాలు, తాజా పండ్లను నివేదించాలి. ముఖ్యంగా మహావిష్ణువుకు అత్యంత ప్రీతిపాత్రమైన తులసి దళాలను సమర్పించి, భక్తిశ్రద్ధలతో నమస్కరించుకోవాలి.మంత్ర జపంతో మానసిక ప్రశాంతతఏకాదశి రోజున దైవనామ స్మరణకు ప్రత్యేక శక్తి ఉంటుంది. 'ఓం నమో భగవతే వాసుదేవాయ' అనే ద్వాదశాక్షరీ మంత్రాన్ని కనీసం 108 సార్లు జపించడం ఉత్తమం. ఒకవేళ పూజా కార్యక్రమాలకు తగినంత సమయం లేకపోతే, రోజంతా మనసులోనే శ్రీహరి నామాన్ని స్మరిస్తూ ఉండవచ్చు. విష్ణు సహస్రనామం లేదా విష్ణు స్తోత్రాలను పఠించడం వల్ల ఇంటా బయటా సానుకూల శక్తి వెల్లివిరుస్తుంది.సాత్విక ఆహార నియమాలుఉపవాసం చేయలేకపోయినప్పటికీ, ఈ రోజున తీసుకునే ఆహారంపై ప్రత్యేక శ్రద్ధ వహించాలి. రోజంతా పూర్తిగా సాత్వీక మరియు తేలికపాటి ఆహారాన్ని మాత్రమే తీసుకోవాలి. పొరపాటున కూడా మాంసాహారం వంటి తామసిక పదార్థాలకు పూర్తిగా దూరంగా ఉండాలి. శరీరాన్ని శుభ్రంగా ఉంచుకుంటూ మనసును కూడా పవిత్రంగా ఉంచుకోవడమే అసలైన ఆచరణ.దాన ధర్మాల ప్రాముఖ్యతఏకాదశి తిథి రోజున చేసే దానాలు అనంతమైన పుణ్యఫలాలను ఇస్తాయి. మీ శక్తి సామర్థ్యాలను బట్టి పేదలకు లేదా నిరుపేద విద్యార్థులకు అన్నదానం, వస్త్రదానం లేదా ధనసహాయం చేయండి. ఇలా చేయడం వల్ల లక్ష్మీదేవి కటాక్షం లభించి ఇంట్లో సిరిసంపదలు వర్ధిల్లుతాయని ప్రగాఢ నమ్మకం.తులసి దళాల ప్రత్యేక నిబంధన"ఏకాదశి నాడు తులసి ఆకులను ఎట్టి పరిస్థితుల్లోనూ చెట్ల నుండి కోయకూడదు," అని పెద్దలు చెబుతుంటారు. తులసిని తెంపడం ఆ రోజున మహా పాపంతో సమానం. కాబట్టి, ఈ పర్వదినం కోసం తులసి దళాలను ముందురోజే సేకరించి ఉంచుకోవాలి. ముందురోజు భద్రపరిచిన తులసి ఆకులనే పూజలో విష్ణుమూర్తికి సమర్పించాలి.సాయంత్రం దీపారాదనసూర్యాస్తమయ వేళ ఇంటి ప్రధాన ద్వారం వద్ద మరియు పూజా గదిలో దీపాలు వెలిగించాలి. సాయంత్రం వేళ విష్ణు మందిరంలో లేదా ఇంట్లో నెయ్యి దీపం ఉంచి కుటుంబం అంతా సుఖసంతోషాలతో ఉండాలని ప్రార్థించాలి. ఈ చిన్న ఆచారాల ద్వారా భగవంతుని కృప ఎల్లప్పుడూ కుటుంబంపై ఉంటుందని నమ్ముతారు.

title: CBI takes over anti-drug activist Jhota's murder probe, registers fresh FIR as team visits family in Punjab’s Mansa | Hindustan Times
description: The agency has registered an FIR against pharmacy owner Ashwani Kumar and unidentified others, booking them under murder, criminal conspiracy and other charges.
content: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) on Wednesday took over the probe into the murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota after registering a fresh first information report (FIR), officials said, adding that a team from the federal agency visited Jhota’s residence in Mansa to record his family’s statements.The development came a day after Union home minister Amit Shah met Jhota’s family and criticised the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government over the state’s drug crisis. It also came a day after Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann announced that the state would hand over the case to CBI, following the family’s demand for a central probe.Officials said a specialised CBI team arrived in Mansa around midnight and formally requisitioned all case files, records, and physical seizures from the City-2 police station, where the original murder case was registered on October 14.Later in the day, the CBI team visited Jhota’s residence to record statements from the family members, officials said, without divulging further details.Jhota, a vocal campaigner against the illegal sale of addictive drugs at chemist shops, was shot dead at a pharmacy by its owner in Mansa on October 13.Also read: Punjab activist Jhota's kin refuse to cremate him; Amit Shah vows ‘drug-free’ state after meeting familyAgency books pharmacy owner under murder and conspiracy chargesIn its FIR, based on a complaint from Jhota’s father Bhim Singh, CBI has booked pharmacy owner Ashwani Kumar and other unidentified persons under Sections 103 (1) (murder), 109 (attempt to murder), 61 (2) (criminal conspiracy), 118 (1) (voluntarily causing hurt) and 3 (5) (common intention) of the BNS, along with the relevant provisions of the Arms Act.Meanwhile, the deceased activist’s family refused to allow consent for the post-mortem of the body until their demands — which include the resignation of CM Bhagwant Mann and DGP Gaurav Yadav and punitive action against officers from the police and drug departments — are met.On October 13, Jhota was shot dead inside a medical store in a crowded Mansa marketplace while livestreaming a confrontation on Facebook. He was questioning the shop owner, Ashwani, over the alleged illegal sale of prescription drugs to an elderly man. Kumar opened fire with his licensed pistol, killing Jhota and injuring four others.Also read: Parvinder Singh Jhota murder probe to be handed over to CBI: Bhagwant MannAccused arrested in Rajasthan after fleeing PunjabAfter the incident, Kumar fled Punjab but was apprehended by the police in Salasar, Rajasthan. Mansa police subsequently arrested Kumar’s wife, Neelam Rani, along with two accomplices for aiding his escape.Following the murder, Mansa-based drug inspector Naresh Kumar and DSP Harjinder Singh Gill were suspended from service, police officers said.On Tuesday, Shah urged the state government to transfer two more cases involving the deaths of two men, Gulzar Singh and Bikramjit Singh, who took on the narcotics trade to CBI. Shah welcomed the transfer of investigation into Jhota’s murder to CBI.Shah, who was on a day-long visit to Punjab to meet the families of the three men, said the Punjab government would not be able to solve two of the cases. He cited the demands of the families for a CBI probe and stressed that no accused would be spared, regardless of their influence or position. Mann announced the transfer of Jhota’s murder case hours before Shah arrived in Punjab.Also read: Parvinder Singh Jhota murder probe to be handed over to CBI: Bhagwant MannPunjab leader of Opposition Partap Singh Bajwa slammed the government for failing to curb drug trafficking and gang-related activities. “Law and order will be a key issue as people from all walks of life feel unsafe. We will demand resignation of the CM over Jhota’s murder as AAP has failed on all fronts,” he said.SAD (Punar-Surjit) chief Giani Harpreet Singh termed the CBI probe decision as a victory for the family. “The unwavering resolve of Jhota’s family, particularly his elderly father, and the unity shown by people had compelled the government to heed their demand,” he said.

title: Tourist’s photo leads to discovery of 120-million-year-old dinosaur footprints in Thailand | Trending
description: Thailand has confirmed the discovery of dinosaur footprints dating back roughly 120 million years.  | Trending
content: Thailand has confirmed the discovery of dinosaur footprints dating back roughly 120 million years. The six fossilized footprints were discovered in the northeastern province of Udon Thani.The Department of Mineral Resources confirmed the discovery on Wednesday, writing that the footprints were likely made by theropod (meat-eating) dinosaurs. The site of the footprints—Phu Phrabat National Park in Udon Thani—has been closed off to tourists while scientists conduct inspections.Tourist’s photo led to discoveryAccording to The Thaiger, the discovery of the dinosaur footprints began when Thai tourist Pichai Prathetsena, 32, spotted unusual marks near a stream while exploring a nature trail in Phu Phrabat National Park.
